drmundo__yuumi.notes:
- Yuumi attaches to her ally and makes them unkillable; focus on shutting down her partner instead
- Play safe early; Yuumi provides poke and healing, so avoid extended trades level 1-3
- Trade when Yuumi detaches to heal an ally; dodge her Q poke by moving unpredictably sideways
- Post-6 Yuumi ult locks you down hard; respect the engage window and play further back
- First Moonstone spike gives her partner sustain; punish the carry while Yuumi lacks offensive pressure early
- You spike hardest mid-game when tanky; force fights when Yuumi is low mana and vulnerable
- Slow-push into tower; this delays Yuumi's roams and forces her to stay lane defending
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke; you need healing to match Yuumi's defensive playstyle
- Build Force of Nature early; magic resist negates her healing and poke effectiveness significantly

drmundo__mordekaiser.notes:
- Mordekaiser's all-in combo with E-Q kills you if you're caught without cooldowns or escape
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with cleaver, avoid his E pull range entirely
- Bait his E by positioning near minions, then all-in when it's down with Q spam
- His ultimate removes you from teamfight; focus on splitpushing and avoiding mid-game grouping when possible
- First item spike (Rylai's) is dangerous; respect his kite potential and don't force extended fights
- You scale better after two items; farm safely early and exploit his immobility late
- Slow-push to deny his roam and force him to answer your wave; prevents ganks
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading pressure; Mordekaiser's melee range favors short, poke-heavy trades
- Build Force of Nature second if ahead; it shreds his damage and heals amplification

drmundo__jarvaniv.notes:
- Jarvan IV's Cataclysm traps you; avoid all-ins inside his arena without escape planned.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his early damage and Martial Cadence procs hurt hard.
- Bait Dragon Strike, then counter-trade with Infected Bonesaw; sidestep his Q knockup combo.
- Post-6 Cataclysm is lethal; stay near walls or play around cooldown timers strictly.
- His first item spike (trinity-type) is a major danger; respect his damage window.
- Post-6 when his ult is down, press aggression; Maximum Dosage sustain outlasts his poke.
- Slow-push to deny Jarvan gank setup; prevents him planting Demacian Standard aggressively.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain and scaling offset his early Martial Cadence trades.
- Build Abyssal Mask early; magic resist and mana counter his Magic Damage and poke.

drmundo__lux.notes:
- Lux lands her E root; you're immobilized, taking massive poke and unable to retaliate or escape
- Play safe behind minions; her Q range exceeds yours—dodge her attempts, don't force early trades yet
- Bait her E with sideways movement, then all-in when she misses; avoid her Q at all costs
- Her R becomes instant teamfight threat; respect damage spike and don't get caught in choke points
- Lux Liandry's spike hurts hard—play safer, stack MR early, and abuse her immobility window before items
- Post-9 minutes when Lux base cooldowns extend and you've stacked HP; chase her down relentlessly
- Slow-push to deny her poke angles; eventually threaten dive when minion wave crashes into tower
- Take Grasp for sustain and HP scaling; makes her poke irrelevant and strengthens all-in potential
- Add Adaptive Helm after core; nullifies her burst and percentage damage from repeated ability casts

drmundo__thresh.notes:
- Thresh's hook catches you out of position and chains you down for ganks
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; farm safely at range with Cleaver spam
- Bait his hook by moving unpredictably; dodge and all-in him immediately after
- His ultimate creates a death box; stay mobile and cleave through minions instead
- His Flay on first back powerspike is dangerous; respect his zone control early
- You outscale him hard at three items; abuse your tankiness to teamfight then
- Slow-push to deny his hook angles; keep minions between you and him always
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness to weather his poke and hook attempts
- Buy Adaptive Helm after core tank items to negate his ability poke damage

drmundo__xerath.notes:
- Xerath's long-range poke chunks your health; dodge skillshots by moving unpredictably between minions.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range and use Cleaver for poke trades only.
- Bait his E stun by moving erratically; trade only after he wastes cooldowns on minions.
- Post-6 his ultimate range dominates; stay behind minions and use fog of war strategically always.
- Xerath's first item (Liandry's or Luden's) spikes hard around 10-12 minutes; play passive then.
- You outscale and punish around level 11-13 when tankiness peaks; look for close fights.
- Slow-push waves toward his tower; forces him to either CS or poke, creating mistakes.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain keeps you healthy through his poke damage overall.
- Consider Abyssal Mask third item; reduces his magic damage and lets you trade back.

drmundo__urgot.notes:
- Urgot's shotgun knees shred armor; his execute ult at 25% HP kills you instantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Q and avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait his E flip, then trade back with Q; never face-check brush against Urgot.
- Urgot gains massive gank setup and execute threat; play further back post-6 always.
- His Manamune spike around 10 minutes increases DPS; respect his poke and kite back.
- Win between your level 9-11 when tankiness peaks; abuse his immobility then relentlessly.
- Slow-push and stack wave; force Urgot to farm under tower, miss CS constantly.
- Take Grasp for sustained healing and poke resistance; it outscales his early armor shred.
- Buy Adaptive Helm third or fourth; reduces his poke DPS and ult burn significantly.

drmundo__caitlyn.notes:
- Caitlyn's trap cage and headshot range abuse punish your immobility and low early resistances hard.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with cleaver, dodge traps, expect level 2 all-in.
- Never walk into her effective range for trades; bait her traps with positioning then all-in.
- Post-6 your ultimate sustain and tankiness outscale her burst, but respect ult chip damage pressure.
- First-item Manamune spike (levels 9-11) is her damage window; farm safely and scale into teamfights.
- Mid-game (levels 11-13) you outbrute-force her; engage grouped fights where she cannot kite freely.
- Slow-push side lanes to create map pressure; force her to respond or lose turrets gradually.
- Grasp gives you trading sustain when she forces short trades before your ultimate cooldown resets.
- Kaenic Lifeburst adds grievous resistance and defensive stats, countering her poke and kite layers.

drmundo__irelia.notes:
- Irelia's stun from Bladesurge mark hits you in lane; dodge it or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Cleaver, avoid her all-in range.
- Bait her Bladesurge onto minions, then trade back with Cleaver as she resets.
- Post-6 her ult zoning is strong; respect it, don't fight in her wave.
- First Sheen spike hurts; play defensive, scale into your tankiness advantage instead.
- Mid-game teamfights after liandry's where your sustained damage outpaces her single-target burst.
- Slow-push waves into tower; forces her to choose between CS and roaming danger.
- Run Grasp for sustain to duel her poke and abuse your passive healing.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early if she snowballs; blocks burst and gives you mana.

drmundo__leona.notes:
- Leona locks you down with E-Q combo, then her team follows up for guaranteed kill
- Play safe at range, abuse your Q poke, never let her close the gap early
- Bait her E with sidestep, then immediately trade back with Q before she reaches you
- Her ultimate makes ganks lethal; play further back and respect jungle proximity after level six

- You outscale hard mid-game; farm safely until you're unkillable, then force fights and dominate teamfights
- Slow-push to deny her engage range and force her to walk further for plays
- Grasp provides sustain to offset her poke and converts tank stats into meaningful damage
- Abyssal Mask reduces her burst and lets you sustain through repeated engage attempts effectively

drmundo__lillia.notes:

- Post-6, Lillia ult forces you back or risks sleep—respect it, don't face-check bushes.

- Use Grasp for sustain trades and poke reduction; it scales your tankiness better here.
- Build Abyssal Mask second; reduces her burst and heal-block helps you survive her sustained damage.

drmundo__swain.notes:

drmundo__yone.notes:

drmundo__fiora.notes:

drmundo__jinx.notes:

drmundo__illaoi.notes:

drmundo__tahmkench.notes:
- Tahm Kench's gray health and W devour combo prevents your all-in damage from sticking effectively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his short-range trading outdamages you early, so respect his aggression.
- Bait his W with positioning, then trade back; never fight inside his minion wave damage.

drmundo__morgana.notes:

- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from max range with cleaver, avoid her Q's effective zone
- Trade after she misses Q; dash forward with E, land cleaver, back off immediately after
- Post-6 her ultimate roots entire team; position around edges, never cluster with allies near her
- At Liandry's first item she burns you; expect poke damage spike around minute 13-14

drmundo__veigar.notes:

- Post-6, Veigar's ult becomes lethal execute tool; maintain distance and stack MR early to survive.

drmundo__amumu.notes:

- Bait his Q with unpredictable movement; trade after he misses; never engage into his E range
- Post-6 Amumu ult locks you down; play around fog of war; group only when confident

drmundo__brand.notes:

- wave: Slow-push side lanes; Brand needs to position forward to threaten; let minions come to you

drmundo__jax.notes:

- Play safe levels 1-3; Jax out-damages you early, so farm defensively with cleavers

drmundo__ashe.notes:

drmundo__ezreal.notes:

- You spike hardest with Rocketbelt or Liandry's completion; use this window to force unfavorable all-ins

drmundo__zaahen.notes:

drmundo__singed.notes:

drmundo__missfortune.notes:

drmundo__kayn.notes:

drmundo__xayah.notes:

drmundo__nami.notes:

drmundo__malzahar.notes:

drmundo__seraphine.notes:

drmundo__trundle.notes:

- Spike: First item spike (likely Sunfire or Hollow Radiance) makes Trundle stronger. Respect his power—don't force fights.
- Window: After your Ultimate and when Trundle's Subjugate is down. Push advantage immediately before cooldown resets.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny him freeze opportunities. Keep minions near your tower for safety positioning.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying gives sustain to offset Chomp's attack damage reduction and poke damage.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip provides healing amplification and a cleanse-adjacent effect to counter Subjugate's stat theft impact.

drmundo__kaisa.notes:

drmundo__teemo.notes:

- Slow-push into him; force him to shove you in or lose CS. Prevents his roam pressure.
- Run Grasp for consistent trading and healing. Tank matchups favor Grasp's reliable proc over burst runes.
- Build Adaptive Helm early if Teemo goes AP; nullifies shroom damage and reduces his poke effectiveness.

drmundo__vayne.notes:
- Vayne kites you endlessly with Condemn knockback and Silver Bolts true damage percentage health.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early damage is real. Farm under tower, don't chase.
- Bait her Condemn into walls before trading. Dodge her third auto with your movement.
- Post-6 her Nightfall mobility makes kiting worse for you; use ultimate to force fights.
- Her Sheen/Trinity first spike is real danger; respect her damage and play safer.
- Your window: levels 4-5 before Trinity, and teamfights where she can't kite five people.
- Slow-push relentlessly to stack waves and force her into bad all-ins near your tower.
- Take Grasp for sustain; you need healing to survive her poke and all-ins.
- Buy Adaptive Helm third or fourth to reduce her true damage scaling impact significantly.

drmundo__sett.notes:
- Sett's Haymaker stun combo catches you immobile; respect his all-in range constantly
- Play safe levels 1-3; abuse range with Q poke, avoid his bush camps
- Bait his Haymaker cooldown before trading; dodge with E movement, then all-in back
- Sett gains kill pressure at 6 with Grit shield; don't fight near walls
- His Sheen/Trinity spike at first item creates lethal all-in window; farm safely
- Your power window arrives at Liandry's when poke damage and tankiness spike together
- Slow-push waves to deny his all-in setup; prevent him freezing near his tower
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; Sett's brawling playstyle rewards your repeated poke
- Buy Force of Nature third if Sett snowballs early; magic resist counters his base damage

drmundo__nautilus.notes:
- Nautilus root chains you down then all-ins; respect his CC and positioning threat range
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance and avoid his hook range near river
- Bait his anchor then trade back; dodge hook by positioning behind minions consistently
- His ultimate lockdown becomes lethal; stay spread and never fight when isolated from team
- His Sunfire spike around level 9-11 is dangerous; farm safely and scale your resistances instead
- You outscale and duel him post-three items; abuse sidelane pressure when teamfights are avoidable
- Slow-push waves to deny his all-in setups; maintain control and force him to initiate
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling; it outdamages his poke over time
- Buy Adaptive Helm early after first tank item; it blocks his damage and CC pressure

drmundo__shen.notes:
- Shen's Taunt locks you down; his poke and teleport ult punish your immobility and teamfight presence.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Shen wins short trades. Farm at range with Cleaver, avoid his Spirit's Refuge.
- Never trade into Spirit's Refuge cooldown. Bait his Taunt by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Cleaver.
- Post-6 Shen becomes a global threat; respect his ult timing and play around your team's needs.
- Shen's Sunfire or Hollow Radiance spike around 8-10 minutes; farm safely and scale, don't force skirmishes.
- You spike at Liandry's completion; Shen can't outsustain your damage then. Push for kills or objectives.
- Slow-push into him; force him to choose between losing CS or committing to unfavorable trades with you.
- Take Grasp for sustain in poke trades and scaling; it lets you out-duel him mid-game.
- Consider Kaenic Lifeburst second item; it gives you tankiness and healing against his spirit damage output.

drmundo__leesin.notes:
- Lee Sin's early Insec kick into your team kills you; respect his kick range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Q poke, farm with Cleaver, avoid extended trades.
- Bait his Q, then all-in when it misses; never trade into his followup damage.
- Lee Sin gains massive engage threat post-6; position deeper, use ult defensively, not offensively.
- Watch for Warrior Enchant spike around 10 minutes; play safer, scale into your tank role.
- You outscale and outduel him mid-game; look to group and force teamfights when strong.
- Slow-push sideways; don't let him roam freely, punish him farming under tower weakness.
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; it outpaces poke damage and empowers your teamfights.
- Buy Force of Nature second or third; magic resist hard-counters his true damage scaling.

drmundo__maokai.notes:
- Maokai's root chain and sustained damage output lock you down and prevent escape or healing effectively
- Play safe levels 1-3; Maokai wins short trades—farm with Q from range, avoid pushing into his brush
- Bait his root with movement prediction, then all-in with E cleaver spam; dodge saplings when possible
- Post-6 his ult provides massive AOE CC and chase—respect its range and play around cooldown windows
- Maokai's first item spike (Liandry's or Abyssal) accelerates his damage window around minute 10-12; farm safely
- Dr. Mundo power window arrives mid-game when Maokai's CC matters less and you out-duel with healing
- Slow-push side lanes to bait Maokai; he must respond to your split pressure and cannot kite easily
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and healing proc advantage; poke him down methodically over time
- Build Adaptive Helm after core items to reduce his damage amplification and persistent DOT threats significantly

drmundo__syndra.notes:
- Syndra's burst damage and stun lock eliminate you before healing matters; respect her range
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; her Q poke chunks hard; don't chase cs
- Bait her E stun by moving unpredictably; dodge backward when she positions balls aggressively
- Post-6 her ultimate becomes lethal; stay further back and respect the five-ball execute range
- Her first item spike (Luden's or Liandry's) hurts immensely; play defensive and scale instead
- You spike harder mid-game when tankier; run her down after her combo cooldown ends
- Slow-push waves toward your tower; forces her to step up closer and shortens her range
- Take Grasp for sustain; you need healing to offset her poke damage throughout laning
- Add Adaptive Helm as third item; reduces her repeated magic damage from Q and E spam

drmundo__tryndamere.notes:
- Tryndamere's all-in spin crit damage and heal ignore burst you down before Mundo ult triggers
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his spin attempts and farm ranged with Cleaver poke
- Bait his spin with movement, then trade back with Cleaver; never face-tank his crits
- His ult removes kill pressure but extends fights—your sustain edges out his if you kite
- First item Sheen spike around level 9-11 creates kill potential; respect spacing and back off
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when his ult is on cooldown; coordinate with jungler then
- Slow-push and freeze near tower; prevent all-ins and force him to chase into your range
- Take Grasp for tankier sustain matchup; the healing stacks outpace Tryndamere's early burst windows
- Consider Thornmail after core to tank his crits and return damage; punishes his auto-reliance

drmundo__pantheon.notes:
- Pantheon's empowered Q and all-in trades chunk you hard before you scale up.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm ranged when possible and respect his Q poke range.
- Dodge his Q by positioning behind minions; bait his empowered Q then trade back.
- Post-6 Pantheon can dive with ult support; play near tower and use ult defensively.
- First item spike (Manamune or Serpent's Fang) hurts; respect his damage window but scale.
- You outscale him hard mid-game; farm safely until level 9+ when you win trades.
- Slow-push waves into him to avoid all-ins while scaling; deny him roam opportunities.
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; it outvalues aggressive runes in this poke matchup.
- Build Adaptive Helm early if he's ahead; magic resist and health counter his poke.

drmundo__ekko.notes:
- Ekko's burst combo and time warp teleport escape make him slippery and dangerous in all-ins
- Play safe levels 1-3; his damage output scales fast, so avoid extended trades early
- Bait his E dash toward you, then trade back; dodge his Q by moving sideways predictably
- Post-6, Ekko gains huge kill threat and escape; respect his ultimate's repositioning and damage
- First item spike (Protobelt or Lichbane) around 10-12 minutes; play safer, avoid overextending during this window
- Your power window emerges mid-game when Ekko falls behind or after he wastes ultimate
- Slow-push waves to stack them; force Ekko to choose between farming and roaming pressure
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke; Ekko favors short trades, so extended ones favor you
- Build Adaptive Helm third or fourth to reduce his burst and percentage damage significantly

drmundo__darius.notes:
- Darius' pull combo into bleed stack resets kill you through sustain if you get caught
- Play safe level 1-3, respect his all-in range, farm with Cleaver from distance only
- Never trade short; bait his axe handle then all-in with full Cleaver passive stacked
- Post-6 Darius becomes execution threat; don't fight low health, maintain distance until ult cooldown
- His first Phage spike (items 1-2) forces caution; wait until you have Hollow Radiance
- You outscale at three items with sustained healing; punish his ult cooldown aggressively then
- Slow-push waves to deny him freeze near his tower, maintain gank safety and scaling
- Grasp provides sustained lane pressure and heal stacking to outlast his early aggression consistently
- Build Hollow Radiance after core to reduce his bleed effectiveness and strengthen your sustain greatly

drmundo__jhin.notes:
- Jhin's root trap and fourth shot execute burst will delete you if caught out of position
- Play safe and farm from distance; his early poke outranges your abilities significantly
- Never chase Jhin into fog of war; bait his root then all-in with Mundo Cleavers
- His ultimate at six creates kill threat from anywhere on map; respect vision and positioning
- Jhin's Manamune spike at first item is your window to abuse him pre-completion
- You outscale and outduel Jhin mid-game when you complete first defensive item; punish this
- Slow-push waves toward Jhin's tower to force him into your Cleaver range repeatedly
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain in extended trades and scaling into teamfights
- Build Adaptive Helm second if Jhin gets ahead; blocks his burst and regenerates your health

shen__smolder.notes:
- Threat: Smolder's stacking damage from Dragon Practice makes him scale hard; avoid extended trades.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Farm with Q from distance; don't let him stack freely.
- Trading: Bait his Q Super Scorcher Breath, then Shadow Dash in to taunt and disengage quickly.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save allies from MMOOOMMMM!'s damage; warn teammates about his ult range.
- Spike: Smolder's first item spike is dangerous. Play passive and focus on scaling into mid-game.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Shen can taunt multiple enemies; Smolder falls behind if he lacks stacks.
- Wave: Slow-push toward enemy tower. Forces Smolder to choose between farming and roaming for stacks.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying lets you trade safely; sustain neutralizes his poke damage.
- Item: Add Hollow Radiance to reduce his ability damage and protect nearby allies from burst.

shen__lux.notes:
- Threat: Light Binding roots you; Final Spark chunks health. Stay mobile, dodge Q.
- Early: Safe farm. Lux out-ranges you heavily. Use minions for cover, avoid straight lines.
- Trading: Bait Q with Shadow Dash positioning. Once she misses, all-in with E taunt.
- Post6: Stand United saves allies from Final Spark burst. Use ult proactively before her engagement.
- Spike: First item (Luden's or similar) is danger. Respect range spike; play safer, scale up.
- Window: Mid-game when Stand United cooldown favors teamfights. Shen becomes more valuable than poke.
- Wave: Slow-push toward Lux. Forces her to choose: shove back or respect Shadow Dash.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustains against poke and gives scaling health per trade.
- Item: Hollow Radiance. Reduces Lux's magic damage output; provides health and cooldown reduction.

shen__drmundo.notes:
- Threat: Dr. Mundo's post-six tankiness and sustain make him unkillable; avoid extended fights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Mundo outrades you hard with Infected Cleaver spam.
- Trading: Dodge his Cleaver, then E-Q him quickly before he resets with Burning Agony.
- Post6: His ultimate healing turns him unkillable; focus on roaming instead of dueling him.
- Spike: First Liandry's spike hurts but isn't lethal; punish him with roam advantage then.
- Window: Mid-game before his second item; your taunt and roam pressure beats his split.
- Wave: Slow-push toward his tower; denies his Cleaver poke range and enables roam escapes.
- Rune: Grasp for trading sustain; you need healing to match his regeneration pressure.
- Item: Add Spectre's Cowl early; stacks magic resist and health against his magic spam.

shen__olaf.notes:
- Olaf's true damage from Reckless Swing and Ragnarok disable immunity makes him very dangerous up close.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Olaf out-trades you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Bait his Undertow axe pickup attempts, then trade. Never fight when Ragnarok is up and active.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables nullifies Shadow Dash taunt. Use Stand United to help teammates instead.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous. Stay back; let him push into you safely.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where Stand United shields matter more than raw Olaf dueling.
- Slow-push sidewaves to control Olaf's roaming and force him to choose between farm or grouping.
- Pick Grasp of the Undying for sustain and poke damage to wear Olaf down safely.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for magic resist and health against his true damage and AP threats.

shen__volibear.notes:
- Volibear's Thundering Smash stun locks you down; follow with Frenzied Maul burst kills.
- Play safe level 1-2; respect his all-in range. Use Q from distance only.
- Bait Thundering Smash, then Shadow Dash to taunt him during his gap-close animation.
- Stand United becomes his engage tool; position allies away from predictable locations post-6.
- First item spike (likely tank item) timing around level 9; punish before he stabilizes.
- You spike when Shadow Dash cooldown resets; spam taunt to control his approach patterns.
- Slow-push waves into him; denies his all-in setup and forces his jungle reliance.
- Grasp; sustain and tankiness counter his burst and repeated Frenzied Maul trades effectively.
- Thornmail; reflects his attack damage and applies grievous wounds to reduce Frenzied Maul healing.

drmundo__blitzcrank.notes:
- His grab one-shots you or forces your ultimate; respect hook range constantly and play unpredictably
- Stay behind minions level one through three; dodge hooks and farm safely with Q from distance
- Bait his hook by moving erratically, then all-in when it's down; avoid standing in obvious positions
- Mundo dominates post-six since he can't be hooked during ultimate; use it aggressively to all-in him
- His first item spike (Archangel's or Luden's) is dangerous; farm safely and scale into your own power
- Your spike comes mid-game when you're unkillable; engage when his hook is clearly on cooldown
- Slow-push waves to deny his hook angles and create gank opportunities for your jungler when grouped
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading pressure; you outscale him and need durability through laning phase
- Build Adaptive Helm second or third to reduce his poke and spam-heal through his damage output

drmundo__varus.notes:
- Varus' hail of arrows and blight passive stack burst — dodge or you die fast
- Play safe behind minions; his early poke chunks you hard; farm defensively at range
- Never trade when blight stacks are high; bait his Q then all-in him
- His ultimate locks you down; play around fog of war and stick to walls
- His first item spike (manamune or crit) hurts badly; respect his damage window
- Post-12 minutes when you've stacked HP; all-in before his kite team arrives
- Slow-push waves into him; force him to choose between farm and poke safety
- Grasp gives you sustain to offset poke damage and win extended fights
- Spirit Visage early; the healing amplification turns his poke into negligible chip damage

drmundo__cassiopeia.notes:
- Cassiopeia's twin fang spam and poison kite pressure forces you to chase and take repeated damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her poke range and avoid pushing into poison clouds early.
- Bait her Q, then all-in with E; dodge her W by moving unpredictably sideways always.
- Her ultimate at six becomes a teamfight tool; play around fog of war and angle carefully.
- Liandry's completion around 20 minutes spikes her DPS; exploit early game before she hits power.
- Your window comes post-Rylai's when you lock her down; she has minimal kite then.
- Slow-push waves to stack for all-in; prevents her from spacing freely and forces engages.
- Pick Grasp for sustained trading and lane durability against her relentless poke damage output.
- Mercury's Treads early reduces poison application and poison duration; rush over standard boots here.

drmundo__aurelionsol.notes:
- Aurelion Sol's perma-slow stars and burst rotation delete you if you walk forward carelessly
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his star damage and avoid pushing into his effective range
- Dodge star orbits by moving unpredictably; bait his E cooldown before committing to all-ins
- Post-6 his ultimate knock-up zones you harder; use your ult to tank and sustain through it
- First item Liandry's spike hurts at 1100g; punish him before completion if he overextends
- You spike when he burns mana or mispositions; chase him down with ult active then
- Slow-push side lanes to force his rotation; prevents him from grouping and farming safely mid
- Take Grasp for sustain in poke trades; Mundo scales harder with early health pool advantages
- Build Adaptive Helm fourth or fifth to block his sustained magic damage and DoT effects

drmundo__shyvana.notes:
- Shyvana's sustained damage and tankiness make her hard to kill; her mobility closes gaps you create.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her AA range and avoid extended trades near minions early.
- Bait her Q with positioning; dodge or tank her E poke, then trade back with cleaver.
- Post-6 Shyvana gains mobility and tankiness; avoid fighting in her ult radius, kite backward instead.
- Her first item spike (Sunfire or Liandry's) hurts around 10-12 minutes; play safe, scale harder.
- Mid-game teamfights (15-20 min) favor Dr. Mundo when enemies group; you outscale her teamfight presence.
- Slow-push into her to deny roams and force her to answer your wave presence constantly.
- Run Grasp for sustain and poke trading; it mitigates her constant damage and fuels tankiness.
- Build Force of Nature second or third to stack MR and amplify your healing against her.

drmundo__drmundo.notes:
- Both Mundos sustain equally; whoever lands more Cleavers and avoids them wins trades.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Cleaver, avoid all-in attempts.
- Bait his Cleaver with sidestep movement, then trade back with your own Cleaver.
- Your ult negates his ult damage; use it reactively to out-sustain his burst.
- First item (typically Sunfire) gives waveclear advantage; abuse it to control the lane.
- After level 6, whoever engages poorly dies harder; play patient and reactive.
- Slow-push waves to stack them; force him to make a mistake or lose CS.
- Take Grasp; it procs easily in an extended auto-attack heavy matchup like this.
- Buy Adaptive Helm after core items to reduce his repeated Cleaver poke damage significantly.

drmundo__janna.notes:
- Janna's knockback and peel deny your engage; respect her disengage or get kited forever
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke outdamages your sustain early, farm at range with cleaver
- Dodge her tornado knockback before trading; bait it out then all-in with your cleavers immediately
- Post-6 her ult zoning becomes massive; use fog of war and flank routes to engage her
- First item Ardent Spike timing around 10-12 minutes is danger window; respect her poke damage then
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where her team groups; force fights before she scales infinitely
- Slow-push to stack waves; force her to choose between waveclear or roaming with her poke
- Grasp of the Undying for sustain; her poke trades chip damage you can heal back constantly
- Force of Nature gives movespeed to chase through her knockback and tenacity to reduce her slow

drmundo__mel.notes:
- Mel's homing missiles and cc lockdown burst you down before you heal back up
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her poke range and don't get caught extended alone
- Bait her missile with movement, then all-in when she's on cooldown; dodge the stun
- Mundo becomes stronger post-6; your ult sustain outpaces her sustained damage output significantly
- Her first item spike around 1000g is dangerous; play back and scale into midgame
- Mundo dominates mid-game teamfights when you have 2+ items and healing advantage established
- Slow-push waves into her to force her closer; prevents her from freely poking you
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and tank stats; scales better than Stormraider's here
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce her burst and add survivability against her combo

drmundo__smolder.notes:
- Smolder's % health damage and range make extended trades lethal; avoid prolonged all-ins.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his poke range and farm from distance passively.
- Bait his W cooldown before committing trades; dodge his fire breath with positioning.
- Post-6 his ult adds burst and execute threat; play around cover and timing.
- First item spike (likely Liandry's or Manamune) increases poke threat; respect increased damage.
- Window opens when Smolder pushes too far; gank setup or all-in with jungler.
- Slow-push to deny his siege pressure and set up favorable jungle gank angles.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and healing to offset his percentage health damage.
- Build Kaenic Lifeburst third-fourth to reduce his burn damage and increase your healing.

drmundo__zed.notes:
- Zed's all-in burst from shadow swaps and ult overkills you before sustained damage matters.
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; dodge his Q's, don't walk up for short trades.
- Bait his E with positioning; trade after he wastes cooldowns, then heal with passive.
- Post-6 Zed becomes a execution threat; play safer, use ult reactively for survivability.
- First Serrated Dirk spike hurts at 10-12 minutes; farm safely and don't overextend then.
- Your power window opens around level 9 when tankiness outpaces his burst damage scaling.
- Slow-push or freeze near tower; avoid pushing out since Zed roams and one-shots squishies.
- Take Grasp for consistent sustain and tankiness to survive his combo attempts repeatedly.
- Build Adaptive Helm after core tank items to reduce repeated spell damage from rotations.

drmundo__galio.notes:
- Galio's taunt combo locks you down and forces unfavorable all-ins; respect his engage range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with cleaver, avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait his taunt by repositioning, then trade back with cleaver and autos when it's down.
- Post-6 Galio becomes a teamfight threat; respect his ultimate and avoid clustering with allies.
- First item spike (Protobelt or Liandry's) hurts; play safer and scale into your tankiness advantage.
- Dr. Mundo spikes harder mid-game with items; use this window to farm and duel him.
- Slow-push waves to deny his roam impact; force him to stay lane or lose CS.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and healing; it outscales Galio's burst in extended fights.
- Consider Adaptive Helm after core tank items to mitigate his percentage damage and ability spam.

drmundo__akali.notes:
- Akali's shroud makes her untargetable; you cannot trade or ultimate her inside it
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in potential and farm with Cleaver at range
- Never chase Akali into fog of war; bait her shroud then disengage immediately
- Post-6 Akali gains massive kill pressure with ultimate; respect her engage range completely
- Akali's first Protobelt spike is dangerous; play defensive and scale into your item advantages
- You spike harder at Liandry's completion; use it to kite and wear her down
- Slow-push waves into her; force her to contest or lose CS under tower pressure
- Take Grasp for sustained healing and trading damage; it adds up through the laning phase
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce her burst and provide tankiness against her combo

drmundo__riven.notes:
- Riven's burst combo and mobility chain let her all-in you before you can react or heal enough.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in range and only farm at max Cleaver range safely.
- Dodge her stun, then trade back with Cleaver; never chase or let her kite you freely.
- Post-6 her ultimate amplifies burst damage massively—stack more armor and respect her damage window harder.
- First item spike (Black Cleaver) is dangerous; she gets mobility and armor shred—play back and scale.
- Your window opens mid-game when you have two items and Riven needs to teamfight around you.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roaming and let you scale; avoid pushing into her jungler gank.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke trading; it helps you survive her early aggression patterns.
- Add KaenicActivehelm if ahead or even; the heal amplification counters her burst and sustains you.

drmundo__heimerdinger.notes:
- Heimerdinger's turrets deal constant poke damage; dodge or tank unavoidable chip with sustain.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid walking into turret zones and respect early poke damage.
- Bait turret aggro onto minions, then trade when cooldowns reset; dodge grenade with movement.
- Post-6, Heimerdinger gains zone control; use your ultimate to force all-ins or disengage.
- His first item spike (Liandry's or Luden's) hurts; respect damage window but scale better later.
- Mid-game teamfights when Heimerdinger lacks setup; run him down with ultimate and close gaps.
- Slow-push waves to deny turret placement and build minion advantage for all-in windows.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke and extra tankiness to absorb turret damage safely.
- Buy Adaptive Helm third or fourth to reduce turret and ability spam damage significantly.

drmundo__lulu.notes:
- Lulu's poke damage and polymorph cc lock you down; respect her range and kiting
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance and avoid her auto-attack range entirely
- Never trade into her directly; bait polymorph with fake engages then all-in after cooldown
- Post-6 Lulu becomes unkillable with ult; focus on scaling and wave management instead
- Lulu's first item (Liandrys/Moonstone) spike is dangerous; play safer and prioritize farm
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights when Lulu lacks peel for isolated targets
- Slow-push to stack waves; force Lulu to hard-shove then gank her overextended lane
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; outscales Lulu's poke significantly in extended fights
- Build Adaptive Helm early second item; reduces her poke and ult burst substantially

shen__caitlyn.notes:
- Caitlyn's Piltover Peacemaker and Ace in the Hole poke you down from range safely.
- Stay behind minions levels 1–3; avoid unnecessary Shadow Dash trades; farm with Q when safe.
- Bait Yordle Snap Trap placement, then Shadow Dash through her when she repositions; dodge Piltover Peacemaker.
- Stand United shields your ally from Ace in the Hole; use it proactively when she channels.
- First item (likely Kraken Slayer or crit item) spikes her damage; respect range, play safer.
- Post-6 and mid-game teamfights where you flank; Shadow Dash in, taunt her, collapse with team.
- Slow-push toward her tower; force her to farm closer, reducing her poke safety and range.
- Grasp of the Undying; sustain through her poke and trade healthier in extended fights.
- Kaenic Lifegrip; converts her damage into healing for you and shields your low-health ally.

shen__mordekaiser.notes:
- Realm of Death isolates you alone; stat steal and potential kill guarantee Mordekaiser dominance in fights.
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid close trades—Mordekaiser outdamages you early and will all-in.
- Bait Obliterate by moving sideways; Shadow Dash away when he approaches for melee engagement trades.
- Post-6 avoid isolation; Stand United saves teammates from Realm of Death but cannot save you.
- First item spike (Rylai's or similar) is dangerous; Mordekaiser gains tankiness and utility—scale instead, don't fight.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where Stand United value peaks and Mordekaiser lacks stat advantage yet.
- Slow-push waves into your tower; deny him roaming opportunities and force him to commit resources.
- Take Grasp for extended trading sustainability and health scaling to survive Mordekaiser's heavy burst damage.
- Build Kaenic Lifebringer to strip his shield and reduce his healing—directly counters Indestructible's sustain pattern.

shen__bluecasterminion.notes:
- Threat: Blue Caster Minion's sustained poke damage forces you to respect range and repositioning constantly
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm from max range with Q to avoid minion aggression entirely
- Trading: Never all-in when minion has full mana; bait its spells before committing to engage
- Post6: Your ultimate provides escape and roam potential; minion lacks mobility to punish your map plays
- Spike: First item spike is minimal threat; use this window to scale and impact sidelanes freely
- Window: Level 6+ onwards when you ult for plays; minion cannot match your global pressure strength
- Wave: Slow-push to extend lane; forces minion to overextend or miss CS under tower pressure consistently
- Rune: Phase Rush allows you to dodge minion poke and kite when needed; mobility outweighs sustain
- Item: Add Spectre's Cowl early if poke becomes unbearable; converts magic damage into effective durability

shen__sightward.notes:
- Threat: Sight Ward provides enemy vision; you cannot hide roams or flanks effectively
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Sight Ward has no combat threat, farm freely and scale
- Trading: Sight Ward cannot trade back; abuse this by poking freely with Q slashes
- Post6: Your ultimate remains superior; Sight Ward still cannot duel or threaten you directly
- Spike: Sight Ward never spikes; it provides utility only, never a danger window for Shen
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you; roam and create plays Sight Ward cannot prevent or counter
- Wave: Slow-push into Sight Ward; deny it information and control while scaling safely
- Rune: Grasp punishes extended trades; Sight Ward cannot retaliate, making free damage guaranteed
- Item: Kaenic Lifeline adds waveclear and sustain against poke if enemy team has threats

shen__bluemeleeminion.notes:
- Blue Melee Minion has no threat; it deals minimal damage and cannot kill or punish Shen meaningfully.
- Levels 1-3 are entirely safe; farm freely with autos and Q without fear of retaliation or all-in.
- No meaningful trades exist; use this time to stack Grasp procs and build health advantage safely.
- Level 6 changes nothing; Blue Mealie Minion lacks ultimate and poses zero threat to Shen's Standstill ultimate.
- Blue Melee Minion has no item spike; Shen can farm safely through all enemy item timings without danger.
- Shen has constant power edge; Blue Melee Minion cannot match Shen's tankiness, sustain, or trading ability ever.
- Push wave consistently to deny Blue Melee Minion gold and experience while maintaining safety near enemy tower.
- Take Grasp for free health stacking; Blue Melee Minion cannot punish your extended trading or aggressive proc usage.
- Thornmail is unnecessary here; prioritize standard tank items like Kaenic Nashors or Hollow Radiance instead for value.

shen__bluesiegeminion.notes:
- Threat: Blue Siege Minion's explosive AOE damage zones you out and melts through your health bar.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from distance and avoid walking into cannon blast range.
- Trading: Bait its attack animation before engaging; dodge the blast cone by moving perpendicular to its aim.
- Post6: Your ultimate provides escape and teamfight utility; use it to save allies caught in siege blasts.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Abyssal Mask) increases its AOE damage—play safer and respect its range.
- Window: Pre-6 before cannon charges; engage when its blast is on cooldown after wasting on minions.
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions near tower; this limits its effective blast radius and lowers kill pressure.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying—sustain lets you absorb poke and stay healthy through siege damage.
- Item: Adaptive Helm reduces its repeated AOE damage and provides health regeneration against sustained pressure.

shen__blastcone.notes:
- Blast Cone's explosive knockback disrupts your positioning, preventing taunt follow-up or escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect its range and avoid extended trades near walls.
- Bait its knockback ability, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge sideways.
- Your ultimate becomes stronger; use it to catch Blast Cone after it commits.
- Watch its first item spike; abuse Shen's mid-game teamfight strength during its power dip.
- Levels 9-11 when your cooldowns peak; force fights when Blast Cone can't kite effectively.
- Slow-push to deny it wall resets; control wave near your tower for safety.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; Phase Rush if you need extra kite escape.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early if taking excessive burst; maintains tankiness without disrupting core build.

drmundo__evelynn.notes:
- Evelynn's charm into burst combo kills you before you heal; respect her all-in range.
- Play safe and farm with Cleaver; she has no kill threat pre-6 if you respect range.
- Never trade into her charm window; bait her charm, then walk away and re-engage after.
- Post-6 Evelynn becomes lethal; play closer to tower and hug walls to deny flank angles.
- Her first item spike (Luden's or Protobelt) is real danger; stay healthy and play passive.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where she's a squishy carry; position to catch her.
- Slow-push waves into her so she cannot roam freely; denies her jungle tracking potential.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; you need HP to survive her burst combo.
- Buy Abyssal Mask after core items to reduce her magic damage and charm pressure.

drmundo__chogath.notes:
- Cho'Gath's Rupture and Feral Scream combo silences you, blocking Maximum Dosage healing clutch moments.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Rupture outranges you. Farm defensively, avoid pushing into river bushes.
- Bait Rupture with sidestepping, then trade with Infected Bonesaw. Never all-in before his cooldowns.
- Post-6, Feast true damage threatens you heavily. Play around cooldown; never let him stack freely.
- His first item power spike is moderate. Abuse his mana costs and cooldowns early.
- Your window is mid-game when Maximum Dosage sustain outpaces his damage; push advantage before scaling.
- Slow-push waves to deny Cho'Gath kills and stack resets from Carnivore passive efficiently.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain duels and reward extended trades in lane.
- Add Hollow Radiance late to reduce his true damage and burst from Feast.

drmundo__zoe.notes:
- Zoe's Sleepy Trouble Bubble locks you down; you cannot engage or escape when hit.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge her Q poke and avoid pushing into her range.
- Bait her bubble by moving unpredictably, then all-in when she misses or is on cooldown.
- Post-6 Zoe gains kill pressure with Portal; respect her burst and play more cautiously.
- Her Luden's spike around 10-12 minutes threatens you hard; play defensively and farm safely.
- Level 9+ you out-trade her in close range; look to all-in when she wastes abilities.
- Slow-push waves to crash into her tower; this denies her roam pressure and safety.
- Take Grasp to sustain her poke and gain scaling; Adaptive Force helps you later.
- Rush Adaptive Helm after core items to block her burst and reduce Luden's damage.

drmundo__yasuo.notes:
- Yasuo's dash-windwall combo negates your Q and lets him kite away safely always
- Play safe levels 1-3; stand behind minions to avoid his poke and all-ins
- Never trade when windwall is up; bait it out before committing damage with Q
- Post-6 Yasuo gains kill pressure with ult; respect his dash-in and play further back
- His first item spike around 1100g is dangerous; respect his powerspike and farm safely
- You spike harder mid-game with items and levels; look to all-in when he's overextended
- Slow-push waves to stack minions; forces Yasuo to fight in larger waves where you win
- Take Grasp for consistent poke damage and sustain to out-trade him over time always
- Build Force of Nature second or third; the MR and movespeed counter his kiting hard

drmundo__elise.notes:
- Elise's Cocoon stun locks you down; dodge it or get bursted with no escape available.
- Play safe early; her Cocoon ranges far and her burst outdamages your sustain at level 2-3.
- Bait her Cocoon with unpredictable movement, then trade with Q and W while she's on cooldown.
- Post-6 she gains mobility and dive potential; play near towers and use R defensively for healing.
- First item spike (typically Liandry's) hurts but isn't lethal; farm safely and scale into your tankiness.
- Level 9+ with items you outduel her; she can't kill you if Cocoon misses and you commit.
- Slow-push waves to stack them; forces her to choose between farming and roaming to other lanes.
- Take Grasp for sustain to negate her poke and gain tankiness for extended trades later.
- Add Adaptive Helm into your build to reduce her magic damage and amplify your own healing effectiveness.

drmundo__sion.notes:
- Sion's charged Q stun locks you down; respect its range and timing always
- Play safe levels 1-3; Sion outranges you early, farm with Q from distance
- Bait his Q charge, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge the stun
- Post-6 Sion gains map pressure; use ult to match his roams or punish
- Sion first-item spike (Hollow Radiance) is dangerous; play defensive until you finish items
- Dr. Mundo spikes harder mid-game with tankiness; all-in when his Q is down
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Sion to use Q on minions, not you
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading; converts repeated short trades into health advantage
- Build Adaptive Helm after core tank items; reduces his Q poke and ult damage

drmundo__ryze.notes:
- Ryze kites and roots you with W after applying E Spell Flux; stay out of range.
- Play safe early; Ryze outranges you heavily. Farm defensively and avoid walking into E Spell Flux.
- Bait his W Rune Prison cooldown, then all-in with Q Infected Bonesaw and E Blunt Force Trauma.
- Post-6, Maximum Dosage healing lets you tank his damage better; still respect R Realm Warp escapes.
- His first mana item is dangerous; he'll have consistent root access. This is a punish window for you.
- You spike when he's low mana or after he wastes W Rune Prison on your P Goes Where He Pleases.
- Slow-push waves; this lets you engage safely when minions meet near your tower and his abilities reset.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for tankiness, sustain, and trading power to offset his poke damage.
- Consider Hollow Radiance to reduce his spell damage and boost your tankiness against his persistent magic damage.

drmundo__diana.notes:
- Diana's all-in burst and cc chain after ulting in delete you before sustain matters
- Play safe levels 1-3; Diana outranges and out-damages you early; farm under tower if needed
- Never chase Diana through minions; bait her Q then all-in her; dodge her E stun
- Diana ult makes her untargetable and gaps instantly; you cannot kite or escape her engage
- Diana's first item spike (Protobelt or Shadowflame) is a kill window; respect range and positioning
- You outscale and out-sustain Diana mid-game; punish when her ult cooldown is down
- Slow-push side lanes to control wave timing; deny her roam opportunities and gank setup
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke trading; every proc helps you survive her burst
- Build Hollow Radiance after core to reduce her burst damage and increase your tankiness significantly

drmundo__kayle.notes:
- Kayle's ranged attacks and on-hit damage scales hard; respect her damage growth throughout game.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance and avoid her poke; she outranges you early.
- Bait her Q with movement; trade back only when she walks up for autoattacks.
- Post-6 Kayle gains invulnerability; play around her ultimate cooldown; don't force all-ins during it.
- First item spike (Nashors or Guinsoos) makes her threatening; punish her before she completes it.
- Mid-game teamfights are your window when Kayle itemizes damage over defense; engage when her ult down.
- Slow-push waves to stack; force her to choose between defending and roaming; control side lane.
- Grasp gives you sustain to outlast her poke and scale into late-game better.
- Adaptive Helm reduces her on-hit and magic damage; prioritize it if she stacks magic early.

shen__tristana.notes:
- Threat: Buster Shot knockback denies Shadow Dash engage and enables all-in combos with Explosive Charge.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Tristana out-ranges you. Only farm with Q when she repositions.
- Trading: Bait Rocket Jump, then Shadow Dash in. Avoid trading when Explosive Charge is active.
- Post6: Stand United loses value when Buster Shot pushes target away. Use it reactively for burst.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Kraken Slayer) is dangerous. Play safer; your window comes later.
- Window: Mid-game when Tristana lacks items. Spirit's Refuge blocks her attacks; force grouped fights.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes. Prevents Rocket Jump all-ins and lets you roam with Stand United.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; healing sustains poke and empowers Spirit's Refuge trades.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts her damage into healing and shields allies when she ults.

shen__amumu.notes:
- Amumu's Bandage Toss combo into Curse of the Sad Mummy locks you down for his team's burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Amumu out-trades you early with Despair passive damage, so farm with Q range.
- Dodge Bandage Toss by positioning near minions; bait his hook before committing to trades or all-ins.
- Post-6 Amumu becomes a teamfight monster—stay grouped with your team and never split alone against him.
- First item CDR spike (Abyssal or RoA) accelerates his engage potential; punish him before he completes it.
- Your advantage window is mid-game when he's not yet grouped with his team to enable his ult.
- Slow-push waves into him to deny Bandage Toss opportunities and build pressure for your team's objectives.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling to survive his poke and all-in attempts consistently.
- Buy Adaptive Helm after core items to reduce Despair damage and his repeated ability poke significantly.

shen__teemo.notes:
- Threat: Teemo's invisibility and traps prevent reliable engagement; kite and blind counter Shen's melee pressure.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Blinding Dart, avoid brush, farm with Q from range only.
- Trading: Bait Blinding Dart with Shadow Dash fake, then all-in; never trade into his poison stacks.
- Post6: Stand United becomes useless if Teemo traps your ally; warn them about trap placements.
- Spike: Teemo's first-item spike (Liandry's or Nashor's) threatens sustained damage; outscale him with your tank items.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you if Teemo wastes invisibility; roam to create picks before traps scale.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny his trap placements and control vision; prevents free trap resets on wave.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain counters his poke and poison tick damage over laning phase.
- Item: Adaptive Helm or Hollow Radiance; reduces his poison and trap damage per second significantly.

shen__fizz.notes:
- Fizz's Urchin Strike gap-close combos with Chum the Waters for guaranteed kill pressure.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect Fizz's all-in potential and avoid trading near minions.
- Bait Playful / Trickster before committing; use Shadow Dash to engage or disengage cleanly.
- Post-6 Fizz becomes lethal; position away from walls and never fight near Chum zones.
- First item spike (Lich Bane or similar) makes Fizz extremely dangerous—play defensive and kite.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where Spirit's Refuge blocks Urchin Strike follow-ups.
- Slow-push waves to deny Fizz all-in opportunities and set up Stand United roams safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and poke to out-trade Fizz's early harass.
- Build Force of Nature early to reduce Fizz's magic damage and burst from abilities.

drmundo__twistedfate.notes:
- Twisted Fate stuns you with Gold Card, then kites away while dealing consistent magic damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Cleaver and avoid overextending for trades.
- Bait his Gold Card by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown immediately.
- Post-6 Twisted Fate can teleport anywhere to gank allies; play safer and help your team.
- His first item spike (Lich Bane or Zhonyas) makes him harder to catch; farm safely.
- Dr. Mundo spikes harder at level 9 with full Cleaver; look to dominate extended trades.
- Slow-push waves to set up all-ins when Twisted Fate's Gold Card is down; control pacing.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain, trading pressure, and health to tank his poke.
- Add Adaptive Helm after core to reduce his magic damage and spell-spam effectiveness significantly.

drmundo__aurora.notes:
- Threat: Aurora's mobility and invisibility from Across the Veil let her kite and avoid your engage attempts.
- Early: Play safe and farm. Aurora out-ranges you early; avoid extended trades before level 3.
- Trading: Bait Across the Veil with Q, then all-in when she lands. Dodge her E slow.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you sustain her poke, but Between Worlds gives her even more kiting tools.
- Spike: First item spike (likely utility) isn't a major threat window; keep farming and scaling safely.
- Window: Level 9+ when Heart Zapper and Blunt Force Trauma deal real damage; chase her down.
- Wave: Slow-push and look for all-ins when wave crashes near your tower; she struggles in close terrain.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying sustains through her poke and scales with your max Health pool.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her spell damage and gives you the magic resistance you need.

drmundo__soraka.notes:
- Soraka's silence zones you out and prevents your healing; respect her Q poke range always
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her range and avoid extended trades near minion wave
- Bait her silence with fake engages, then all-in when it's down; dodge her Q's
- Post-6 her ultimate healing makes you useless; coordinate ganks with jungler to catch her
- Her first item spike (Moonstone) strengthens her healing; this is your window to pressure hard
- You spike harder mid-game with tankiness items; look to all-in her when she's isolated
- Slow-push waves to create gank opportunities and deny her safe positioning for healing teammates
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and healing synergy; it helps you win extended fights
- Buy Adaptive Helm third item to reduce her healing and magic damage output significantly

drmundo__kindred.notes:
- Kindred kites and bursts you down with mobility; respect their range and high early damage
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance and avoid extended trades near lane brush
- Trade after Kindred uses Dance of Arrows; bait their dash then all-in with Cleaver spam
- Post-6 their ult negates your burst healing; play around it and duel outside Lamb's Respite
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; farm safely and scale into your tankiness
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where sustained damage and healing overwhelm their burst
- Slow-push waves to build jungle pressure; prevents Kindred ganks and sets up your scaling advantage
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading pressure; it procs frequently against their hit-and-run style
- Consider Kaenic Lifeburst early to amplify healing and threaten their burst before resistances needed

drmundo__gwen.notes:
- Gwen's range and true damage on-hit threaten all-ins; respect her kiting and sustained poke damage
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from distance and avoid her melee range near minions
- Don't chase her through her W mist; bait her close then trade with cleaver and auto
- Post-6 Gwen gains burst and chase potential; use your ult defensively to survive her all-in
- First Nashor's Tooth spike around 10-12 minutes increases her sustained damage; abuse before completion
- Dr. Mundo spikes at level 11 with ult cooldown reduction; all-in when her cooldowns are down
- Slow-push waves into her to deny her freeze and force her into extended trades
- Take Grasp for consistent sustain and true damage matching her poke; scales your tankiness well
- Consider Maw of Malmortius if Gwen stacks true damage; shields and lifesteal help durability significantly

drmundo__volibear.notes:
- Volibear's all-in with bite damage and flip stun locks you down; respect his engage range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Q thunder claws and farm at range with Cleaver.
- Bait his E flip onto minions, then trade back hard with Q and Cleaver poke.
- Post-6 Volibear gains massive tankiness and chase; avoid extended fights in his ult zone.
- His Sunfire or Trinity first-spike forces you back; play for sustain and late-game scaling.
- Around level 9+ with items, you outscale and heal through his damage; farm safely until then.
- Slow-push and maintain distance; freezing lets him freeze and zone you from farm entirely.
- Take Grasp for scaling trades and healing synergy; Mundo loves health-to-damage conversion over raw sustain.
- Add Force of Nature early if he stacks magic pen; magic resist keeps you alive.

drmundo__wukong.notes:
- Wukong's clone-enhanced all-in with Nimbus Cloak mobility; dodge his engage or die fast.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Wukong out-damages you early. Farm ranged, avoid his Q-W combo.
- Bait his clone feint then trade back; dodge clone clone with positioning, not reaction.
- Post-6 his ultimate resets fights; play around cooldown windows and group with jungler.
- First Triforce spike around 10-12 min is dangerous; respect damage, don't greed for kills.
- Your power window arrives after Liandry's when you out-sustain his burst and splitpush.
- Slow-push into freeze near tower; deny him roam windows and force him to engage.
- Take Grasp for sustain and stack health; poke trades add up versus his bursts.
- Buy Adaptive Helm after core; reduces his magic damage and his all-in threat significantly.

drmundo__nunuwillump.notes:
- Nunu's Absolute Zero point-blank stun and slow lock you down for his team's follow-up
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid pushing; respect his early gank setup and CC chains
- Bait his Snowball engage, then trade back with Cleaver; dodge Absolute Zero by positioning backward
- Post-6 Absolute Zero becomes lethal teamfight tool; play around fog of war and position carefully
- First item Liandry's spike around 9-11 minutes; punish by farming safely and scaling harder
- Your power window is mid-game when tankier; abuse it before he gets full build
- Slow-push waves to deny his roam impact and force him to answer your pressure
- Grasp provides sustain against poke and strengthens your dueling for sidelane skirmishes consistently
- Hollow Radiance early gives you magic resist and slows to counter his engage attempts

drmundo__zac.notes:
- Zac's W Unstable Matter deals max health damage, shredding your health pool relentlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Zac outranges you early, avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait his Q Stretching Strikes grab, then trade back with E Blunt Force Trauma.
- Post-6, R Maximum Dosage healing lets you survive R Let's Bounce! knockup chains.
- First item spike around 8-10 minutes; play safer but don't cede map pressure entirely.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where you can E into backline and Q spam.
- Slow-push waves to deny Zac roam opportunities while scaling your health pool larger.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained healing trades and late-game tankiness scaling.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce Zac's W magic damage and gain armor simultaneously.

drmundo__leblanc.notes:
- Avoid her burst combo and chain CC; her damage amplifies fast and locks you down hard.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; respect her poke range and never face-check brush alone.
- Dodge her chain when she goes in; trade back only after her W cooldown expires safely.
- Her ult doubles her threat post-6; respect the clone and avoid fighting in tight jungle spaces.
- Watch for Protobelt or Shadowflame spike around 10-12 minutes; farm safely, don't overextend during this window.
- You scale better and heal more; punish her immobility once you hit level 9 with items.
- Slow-push to deny her roam potential; this forces her to stay lane or lose CS.
- Pick Grasp for sustained trading; you need extra durability and healing in extended poke matchups.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early as second item; it cuts her burst damage and strengthens your resilience significantly.

drmundo__kennen.notes:
- Kennen stuns you repeatedly with Mark of the Storm; avoid getting hit three times before ulting.
- Play safe and farm at distance; Kennen's early poke with Q and W outranges your engage.
- Bait his Q, dodge it, then walk forward; never trade into his W passive procs.
- Your R heals you through his burst; use it when marked twice to reset the stun counter.
- Kennen first item spike threatens you; respect his damage increase and play safer until you scale.
- Post-15 minutes your tankiness outscales his damage; look to force extended teamfights where he can't kite.
- Slow-push waves toward his tower; this forces him to choose between farming and poking you.
- Take Grasp for sustain against his poke and to win extended trades with him later.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce his burst damage and protect your health pool from his ult.

drmundo__aphelios.notes:
- threat: Aphelios' long-range poke and kiting make it hard for you to close gaps safely
- early: Play safe; farm at distance. Aphelios out-ranges you heavily early—avoid extended trades near minions
- trading: Bait his Calibrum mark, then all-in when he swaps weapons. Dodge his poke by moving unpredictably
- post6: Maximum Dosage lets you tank Moonlight Vigil and heal back; use ult to engage aggressively
- spike: His first item spike is dangerous; stay behind minions and respect his damage until you scale
- window: Mid-game when you have two items and he's still building; your tankiness outscales his damage
- wave: Slow-push to stack minions; forces Aphelios to fight you or lose CS—you win extended fights
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; gives you sustain to offset poke and grants tankiness per proc
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip; amplifies your healing from Maximum Dosage and provides magic resist against burst

drmundo__orianna.notes:
- threat: Command: Shockwave launches you away from fights, disrupting your engage and combo timing
- early: Safe farm—Orianna outranges you heavily; cs safely and avoid her poke with Command: Attack
- trading: Bait Command: Protect on allies, then all-in when her Ball repositions; dodge Command: Attack
- post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive Shockwave burst, but she zones harder with R threat
- spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) hurts; farm safely and don't force trades into poke
- window: When Orianna Ball is far from her body, engage Hard with Q and E combo
- wave: Slow-push into her; builds minion advantage and forces her to choose between poke and cs
- rune: Grasp of the Undying—sustains poke damage and converts it into tankiness and health scaling
- item: Add Hollow Radiance for Magic Resist early; reduces her sustained damage and Command: Dissonance slow

drmundo__malphite.notes:
- Threat: Unstoppable Force catches you immobile; Seismic Shard kites you relentlessly in extended fights.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Malphite outranges you significantly, so avoid unnecessary Q trades.
- Trading: Bait Seismic Shard, then all-in with Infected Bonesaw and Heart Zapper combo for burst.
- Post6: Unstoppable Force becomes lethal teamfight tool; respect distance and position near walls for safety.
- Spike: First armor item (Kaenic Rookern or similar) is his danger spike; play safe then.
- Window: Mid-game when you're tankier; abuse longer cooldown on Unstoppable Force between rotations.
- Wave: Slow-push into him; deny Malphite easy roam timer and avoid his grouped-up ult setup.
- Rune: Grasp; sustain through poke and convert tank stats into trading damage consistently.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts his armor scaling and magic burst into survivability for you.

drmundo__sivir.notes:
- Sivir's spell shield blocks your Q and negates your engage attempts repeatedly
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid trading into her poke
- Bait her spell shield with cleaver, then all-in when it's down with E
- Post-6, Sivir's ult lets her kite away; don't chase, zone and farm instead
- Her first item spike (Manamune or Crit) is your window—she's still immobile then
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where she can't kite your full combo easily
- Slow-push waves to create side lane pressure; forces her to rotate or fall behind
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling into her poke-heavy playstyle
- Build Adaptive Helm second to reduce her sustained magic poke damage significantly

drmundo__gangplank.notes:
- Gangplank's Cannon Barrage slows you, preventing escape or engagement when you need mobility most.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gangplank outranges you with Parrrley, so avoid extended trades early.
- Bait his Remove Scurvy before committing to Goes Where He Pleases immobilize resistance trade.
- Post-6, respect Cannon Barrage's slow; it nullifies your ult's move speed and repositioning power.
- His first item spike (around level 7-9) is your window; he's not yet tanky enough.
- Your power window is mid-game when Maximum Dosage healing outscales his poke damage output significantly.
- Slow-push waves to deny his Powder Keg setup; force fights on your terms near minions.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain to counter his poke and win extended trades.
- Build Adaptive Helm second or third to reduce his Cannon Barrage and ability poke damage.

drmundo__rammus.notes:
- Rammus taunts you with E Frenzying Taunt, forces you to attack him while W Defensive Ball Curl reflects massive damage back.
- Play safe early; Rammus weak pre-6 but his taunt range dangerous. Farm with Q Infected Bonesaw from distance, avoid close trades.
- Never engage close where E Frenzying Taunt lands. Bait his W Defensive Ball Curl, then trade with E Blunt Force Trauma and Q.
- Post-6, Rammus gains massive kill pressure with R Soaring Slam slow and damage spike. Play passive, respect his engage range entirely.
- Rammus first armor item (Thornmail or Kaenic Cascade) is his power spike. You cannot trade effectively; focus on farming safely instead.
- Your window comes when Rammus wastes E Frenzying Taunt on cooldown. All-in with R Maximum Dosage, Q, and E immediately after.
- Slow-push waves into him to build minion advantage and avoid jungle ganks. Never hard-push; gives Rammus easy gank setup with Q.
- Pick Grasp of the Undying for trading sustain and health scaling to farm safely and survive his poke and all-in attempts.
- Add Hollow Radiance late to reduce his armor scaling on P Spiked Shell and reflect less damage from W Defensive Ball Curl.

drmundo__hwei.notes:
- Hwei's Subject abilities lock you down while painting signatures; you can't all-in without getting controlled and bursted.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Hwei out-ranges you badly, so farm from distance and avoid walking into his Q combo patterns.
- Bait his Subject: Torment crowd control, then all-in with E and R; dodge Spiraling Despair by moving perpendicular to expansion.
- Post-6, Maximum Dosage sustain lets you survive Spiraling Despair burst, but respect his full ability-rotation damage and kiting potential.
- Hwei's first item spike is dangerous; you lack tankiness to survive his painted combos, so play safer and scale defensively.
- Your window comes mid-game when you're tanky enough to absorb his damage and close gaps; force teamfights where he can't kite.
- Slow-push waves into Hwei; this lets you look for roams and reduces his poke damage opportunities on a static lane.
- Take Grasp; you need sustain and tankiness to survive his relentless poke and combo damage during extended trades.
- Add Hollow Radiance after core; its healing reduction punishes his sustain and makes your tankiness more valuable against his burst.

drmundo__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Unraveled Earth stuns you during fights; W Heart Zapper makes you vulnerable to her knockback combos.
- Early: Safely farm; her Q Threaded Volley outranges you. Don't chase into Worked Ground where she controls space.
- Trading: Bait her W Seismic Shove, then engage with Q Infected Bonesaw and E Blunt Force Trauma immediately.
- Post6: Weaver's Wall gives her escape and repositioning; reduces your all-in potential. Play around her wall's cooldown timer.
- Spike: First item spike matters less; focus on sustain items. Her damage doesn't spike as hard as yours.
- Window: Post-6 when her Weaver's Wall is down, engage aggressively. Your R Maximum Dosage sustain outlasts her poke.
- Wave: Slow-push toward her turret; forces her to position forward where you can land Q Infected Bonesaw reliably.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain and tankiness counter her poke damage and kite pattern hard.
- Item: Add Hollow Radiance; the ability haste and cooldown reduction amplify your tankiness against her burst windows.

drmundo__nilah.notes:
- Nilah's mobility and Jubilant Veil dodge make her untargetable; you can't reliably land Q or E.
- Play safe early; Nilah outranges and out-mobilizes you. Farm safely with Q from distance.
- Bait Jubilant Veil with Heart Zapper, then all-in when her dodge ends and cooldown runs.
- Maximum Dosage sustain lets you survive Nilah's burst, but her ult pull combo is dangerous.
- Nilah's first item spike is moderate; you spike harder post-6 with ult healing sustain advantage.
- You outscale mid-game when tankier; catch her between dashes or when Jubilant Veil is down.
- Slow-push waves to deny her space for Slipstream dashes and create gank setup opportunities.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain trading and health scaling into your tankiness.
- Consider Adaptive Helm to reduce her repeated damage and amplify your own healing effectiveness.

sivir__sion.notes:
- Sion's charged Q Decimating Smash stuns you; avoid the knockup by staying outside charge range
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance, never walk into Q range
- Bait his Q Decimating Smash, then kite sideways; use E Spell Shield to block fully-charged Q
- Post-6, Unstoppable Onslaught gap-closes; position near walls to limit his steering and collision damage
- Sion's first item spike (Kaenic Dreamfire or Hollow Radiance) pressures you; farm safely and scale
- You spike when Sion lacks Armor; abuse mid-game with W Ricochet bounces and R On Hunt
- Slow-push waves toward his tower; force him to chase, triggering his Q outside his comfort zone
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain through poke and scale into late-game team fights better
- Add Kaenic Dreamfire early; reduce his Magic Damage and provide healing against his W Soul Furnace

sivir__nasus.notes:
- Nasus stacks Q damage infinitely; let him free farm and he becomes unkillable late game threat
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his Q damage and avoid trading when he has mana
- Bait his W Wither with movement; use E Spell Shield to block it when he commits
- On The Hunt lets you kite and escape; Fury of the Sands makes him tanky monster
- First Armor item spike (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) is danger; he gains tankiness and sustain
- Mid-game when Nasus hasn't fully stacked; punish with poke and roam before he becomes unkillable
- Slow-push to deny his stacking; force him to choose between wave and following your roams
- Electrocute or Hail of Blades; bully him early before Q stacking makes trading suicidal
- Manamune gives attack speed and mana; lets you spam Q Boomerang Blade for consistent poke

sivir__volibear.notes:
- threat: Volibear's Q stun chains into massive damage; avoid letting him close distance freely
- early: Play safe; Volibear wins short trades at levels 1-3, farm at max range with Q
- trading: Bait his Q, then kite sideways; use E to block his W or R engage
- post6: Stormbringer lets him tower-dive; stay grouped and use On The Hunt to escape together
- spike: His first tank item (Kaenic Rookern, Hollow Radiance) strengthens him; abuse pre-6 range advantage now
- window: After Volibear wastes Q on wave, punish with Boomerang Blade and auto-attacks for free damage
- wave: Slow-push to deny his all-in and buy time for allies to rotate; prevent early ganks
- rune: Stormraider's Surge gives kite potential and escape; outweighs Fleet of Foot's minor dueling value here
- item: Manamune provides survivability and damage without breaking core; scales with On The Hunt spam

sivir__mordekaiser.notes:
- Threat: Mordekaiser's E Death's Grasp pulls you into kill range; R Realm of Death isolates you alone.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Q Boomerang Blade, avoid melee range trades.
- Trading: Bait his E Death's Grasp with E Spell Shield ready, then kite backward using your movement speed.
- Post6: Mordekaiser's R Realm of Death is devastating; stay grouped with teammates and never fight him alone.
- Spike: His first item spike is dangerous; you cannot duel him one-versus-one at any point in game.
- Window: Punish when his E Death's Grasp is on cooldown; attack from range while he walks forward.
- Wave: Slow-push waves to keep minions near your tower; this denies his E Death's Grasp engage range.
- Rune: Take Stormraider's Surge; escape velocity lets you kite away after E Spell Shield blocks his engage.
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifeline to tank his R Realm of Death burst and cleanse his stat steal effect.

sivir__missfortune.notes:
- Miss Fortune's double-up ricochet and ultimate deal massive grouped damage; respect her zone.
- Play safe level 1-3; Miss Fortune out-trades you early. Farm from distance, avoid her Q.
- Bait her Q with Spellshield, then trade back. Never let her free-fire; dodge left-right.
- Post-6, her ultimate lockdown threatens teamfights hard. Stay spread and positioned to Spellshield it.
- Her first-item spike (Manamune or Kraken) around 10-12 minutes increases all-in threat; play safer then.
- Sivir power window: levels 9-11 when your waveclear and Spellshield cooldown dominate her poke.
- Slow-push or freeze; avoid fast pushing into her gank setup. Control wave near your tower.
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and kiting; Miss Fortune's poke and pressure demand safety.
- Grab a Hexdrinker third-item if her damage spirals; protects you from her burst combos.

drmundo__camille.notes:
- Camille's E Hookshot into R Ultimatum locks you down; you cannot kite or escape her burst.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near walls where she can E onto you easily.
- Bait her E Hookshot by positioning away from walls, then trade back with Q Infected Bonesaw.
- Post-6, respect her R Ultimatum range; never fight her when walls are nearby for easy engagement.
- Her first item spike (likely Trinity Force) makes her trades lethal; farm safely and scale instead.
- You outscale her hard; play for late game teamfights where W Heart Zapper and R Maximum Dosage shine.
- Slow-push waves into her to control wall proximity; denies her E positioning and forces her decisions.
- Take Grasp of the Undying to sustain her poke and convert tank stats into trade damage.
- Add Hollow Radiance late to reduce her magic damage burst and strengthen your healing from R Maximum Dosage.

shen__darius.notes:
- Darius stacks Hemorrhage and executes you with Noxian Guillotine when enraged.
- Stay at range, farm safely with Q Twilight Assault, avoid melee trades.
- Bait E Apprehend, dodge it with E Shadow Dash, then trade back.
- Stand United saves you from Noxian Guillotine execute if timed correctly always.
- His first item spike is dangerous; play safe and respect all-in threat.
- You gain edge when he wastes E Apprehend; all-in with full combo.
