- Slow-push to stack minions and control where fights occur near your blade.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling advantage.
- Add Kaenic Lifeburst to cleanse his bleeds and amplify your own damage.

shen__nidalee.notes:
- threat: Nidalee's Javelin Toss poke forces you back; cougar all-in bursts kill you fast.
- early: Safe farm near minions; dodge Javelin Toss by staying behind wave. Ward brush.
- trading: Bait her Javelin, then Shadow Dash through her. Block cougar swipes with Spirit's Refuge.
- post6: Stand United saves allies from her burst; use it proactively on low teammates.
- spike: First item spike hurts; play safe, scale. Your durability outpaces her raw damage later.
- window: Post-level 9 you win extended fights. Force teamfights where Stand United matters most.
- wave: Slow-push toward her tower; forces her to farm, denies brush mobility for Prowl.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying. Healing sustains her poke damage; stacks into late game.
- item: Hollow Radiance. Her burst and % health damage pressure demands magic resist early.

shen__katarina.notes:
- Katarina's Death Lotus channels massive damage; interrupt with Shadow Dash taunt or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Katarina farms freely but lacks kill pressure on you early.
- Bait her Shunpo onto you, then Shadow Dash to taunt and trade back.
- Stand United becomes critical; shield allies she targets, then teleport to stop her cleanup.
- First item spike (Liandry's or similar) increases her damage; respect it but don't overcommit.
- Post-level 9 when your cooldowns shorten; Shadow Dash taunt windows extend your trades significantly.
- Slow-push sideways; force her to choose between defending or roaming for teamfight resets.
- Pick Grasp for sustained trading pressure and tankiness to survive her burst attempts.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce her magic damage and protect nearby allies from her.

shen__vi.notes:
- Vi's Vault Breaker and Cease and Desist lock you down; you cannot escape once committed.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Vi outrades you early. Use Shadow Dash only for dodging Vault Breaker.
- Bait Vault Breaker with positioning, then Shadow Dash through her to escape the knockback.
- Stand United becomes useless if Vi ults you; coordinate team to stop her engage.
- Vi's first item spike (Black Cleaver or Trinity) at 10-12 minutes; avoid extended fights then.
- Post-15 minutes when you have Hollow Radiance; Spirit's Refuge blocks her repeated punches effectively.
- Slow-push waves into Vi; let her overextend, then Shadow Dash gank with your jungler.
- Grasp of the Undying; proc it safely with Spirit Blade while limiting Vi's all-in range.
- Adaptive Helm reduces Vi's repeated burst damage and synergizes well with your defensive itemization.

shen__ziggs.notes:
- Ziggs' poke and wave clear from range make him safe; his Mega Inferno Bomb punishes positioning mistakes.
- Play safe and farm with Q Twilight Assault from distance; avoid pushing early into his Bouncing Bomb.
- Bait his Satchel Charge cooldown before committing trades; dodge Bouncing Bomb and respect Hexplosive Minefield proximity.
- Stand United lets you protect teammates from Mega Inferno Bomb; use it proactively on grouped allies.
- First item spike is manageable; Shen scales better—farm safely and wait for mid-game team fights.
- Post-six teamfights are your window; Shadow Dash taunts him into position while Stand United saves carries.
- Slow-push to deny Ziggs safe wave clear; force him to choose between farming and poking.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against his poke and scaling into teamfights.
- Consider Adaptive Helm to reduce Ziggs' repeated magic damage and Hexplosive Minefield slow effectiveness.

shen__missfortune.notes:
- Her Make It Rain slows hard; dodge it or eat repeated burst damage trades.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke outranges your Q, farm under tower if needed.
- Bait her Make It Rain, then E-dash in; never trade into her full combo.
- Post-6 her ultimate is zoning; use Standoff to block damage or rotate away fast.
- First item spike (Manamune or Collector) hurts; respect her damage, don't face-check bushes.
- You spike mid-game teamfights; group when she's immobile or force 5v4s via ult.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces her to shove or lose farm, controls her positioning.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; you need healing to survive her poke spam.
- Buy Kaenic Orb if her team stacks AP or she gets early Liandry's pressure.

shen__nautilus.notes:
- Nautilus roots you with Staggering Blow then chains with Dredge Line — you cannot escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his root duration scales with level, so avoid extended trades early.
- Bait Dredge Line, then Shadow Dash through him to avoid the root-into-pull combo chain.
- Stand United becomes crucial; use ult to save allies he targets with Depth Charge engage.
- His first item spike (likely Hollow Radiance or Kaenic) pressures you hard; play defensively then.
- You spike when Spirit's Refuge blocks Titan's Wrath damage-over-time; use this window to trade back.
- Slow-push waves to control spacing; prevents him from roaming and lets you manage his engage range.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke damage to offset his tankiness and root threat consistently.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce his Dredge Line root duration and Riptide slow impact.

drmundo__sona.notes:
- Sona's poke and mana sustain chip you down; her ultimate stuns and disables your engage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with cleaver, avoid her Q poke spam pattern.
- Trade after she uses Q; dodge her E speed-up by predicting her retreat angle.
- Post-6 Sona gains teamfight control; her ultimate stops your engage, so play around cooldown.
- Sona spikes hard at Tear; dodge teamfights and farm jungle camps during this window.
- Mundo spikes at level 9 and Liandry's purchase; all-in her before cooldowns reset.
- Slow-push waves into her tower; forces her to either poke or lose CS.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; proc it safely on minions, sustain through her poke.
- Build Maw of Malmortius second; its spell shield blocks her ult engage and Q damage.

drmundo__zyra.notes:
- Threat: Zyra roots lock you down; plants zone you from waves and objectives relentlessly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Grasping Roots, farm carefully, avoid her seed clusters.
- Trading: Bait her E root, then all-in with Q and E; never trade into plants.
- Post6: Stranglethorns knocks you airborne and enrages plants; stay dispersed, don't clump near her.
- Spike: First item spike around 2500 gold; she gains plant damage—punish her before completion.
- Window: Post-6 when you land R; heal up, tank plants, run her down with movespeed.
- Wave: Slow-push side waves; avoid her seed-heavy areas, collapse to teamfight when she ults.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain trades, heal from frequent minion and plant hits.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip; cleanse her root crowd control and amplify your healing against magic burst.

drmundo__quinn.notes:
- Quinn's Vault + kite combo makes you immobile; her burst damages faster than you heal
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid her range, CS carefully, let Quinn push toward your tower
- Never trade when her Vault is up; bait it out then all-in with Cleaver
- Post-6 her roam threat increases dramatically; expect ganks, ward river, don't overextend lane
- First item spike (Manamune/Youmuu's) around 10-12 minutes; play defensively, scale harder than she does
- Mid-game teamfight window when she lacks resets; group and force fights where her mobility matters less
- Slow-push waves into her; denies her roam opportunities, lets you stack HP safely
- Grasp of the Undying for sustain trades; stacking health makes her burst less threatening
- Abyssal Mask early; reduces her burst damage and helps you survive her all-in attempts

drmundo__renekton.notes:
- Renekton's all-in burst with Fury empowered abilities chunks you hard before you heal back.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his W stun and farm at max range with Q.
- Bait his W cooldown, then trade back with Q; never let him stack Fury freely.
- Post-6 his ultimate gives him tankiness and damage—respect it, kite back and outlast him.
- Renekton's Sheen spike around 900g is dangerous; play safer and farm defensively until you scale.
- Your window comes mid-game when your scaling and healing outpace his burst; abuse cooldowns.
- Slow-push waves to control spacing and force him to commit; never hard-push into his strength.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and healing synergy to outheal his poke over time.
- Build Adaptive Helm third or fourth to reduce his burst and spike damage significantly.

drmundo__karthus.notes:
- Threat: Requiem deals unavoidable damage globally; Wall of Pain kites you relentlessly across map.
- Early: Safe farm at range with Q; avoid walking into Lay Waste blast zones needlessly.
- Trading: Bait Lay Waste with positioning, then E onto him; dodge isolated Lay Waste damage.
- Post6: Requiem forces you to commit fights quickly; use R before channeling completes for sustain.
- Spike: First item spike minimal threat; Karthus scales better into mid-game; pressure early before that.
- Window: Levels 1-5 before Requiem; all-in when Karthus mispositions near you in lane phase.
- Wave: Push wave to deny Lay Waste isolated damage bonus; maintain tempo toward Karthus tower.
- Rune: Grasp sustains through poke damage; converts long trades into healing advantage over Karthus.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts Requiem damage into healing; counters his ult's raw damage threat.

drmundo__ziggs.notes:
- Ziggs pokes you relentlessly with Bouncing Bomb; respect the range advantage early.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Cleaver when possible, avoid unnecessary pushing forward.
- Bait his Bomb cooldown, then trade with Cleaver; dodge by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Post-6, his Mega Inferno Bomb chunks you hard; respect it and play safer.
- First Liandry's spike hurts; expect increased poke damage around 10-12 minutes, play cautious.
- Level 9+ with items, you outscale and outduel him in extended fights.
- Slow-push waves into him; let him waste mana trying to farm, then all-in.
- Take Grasp for sustain against his poke; healing lets you outsustain his chip damage.
- Buy Adaptive Helm third or fourth; reduces his spell damage and persistent burn threat.

drmundo__vladimir.notes:
- Threat: Vladimir's Hemoplague amplifies your incoming damage while he heals off your tanky health pool.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Vladimir outranges you with Q and W punishes aggressive positioning.
- Trading: Bait Vladimir's W Sanguine Pool, then all-in; dodge his E Tides of Blood charges.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage healing gets reduced by Hemoplague's damage amplification; time ult carefully after plague expires.
- Spike: Vladimir first item spike is moderate; abuse your superior tankiness and early healing through trades.
- Window: Dr. Mundo dominates mid-game teamfights when Vladimir lacks cooldown resets; extended fights favor your sustain.
- Wave: Slow-push to maintain pressure; prevents Vladimir from roaming while letting you scale into teamfights.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying stacks health and sustains trades; synergizes with your tankiness better.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces Vladimir's Hemoplague damage amplification while giving you extra tankiness and ability haste.

drmundo__nasus.notes:
- Nasus stacks and scales infinitely; his Q becomes unkillable late-game threat you cannot match
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his Q poke range and do not all-in early
- Bait his Wither before trading; dodge or cleanse it to prevent kiting and all-in kills
- Post-6, Nasus gains tankiness and sustain; your kill pressure diminishes significantly after his ultimate
- First-item Sheen spike around 10-12 minutes makes Nasus dangerous; punish before he completes it
- Push lane hard before Sheen completion; force him to choose between stacking and defending
- Slow-push side lane to deny stacks; avoid grouping where Nasus excels in sustained teamfights
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and pressure; matches his scaling better than alternatives
- Build Kaenic Lifeburst fourth or fifth item; shreds his resistances and amplifies your magic damage

shen__talon.notes:
- Talon's all-in burst from Q and W combo kills you if you're caught without Shadow Dash ready.
- Play safe, farm ranged with Q, respect his all-in range. Don't get greedy for poke trades.
- Bait his W Rake, then Shadow Dash through him when he commits. Never fight in his terrain.
- Stand United lets you escape or save allies from his burst; use it proactively before he engages.
- First item spike is dangerous; play respectfully, use wave control to deny all-in opportunities near him.
- Post-first-item, you outscale and teamfight better. Punish his roams by grouping and converting to objectives.
- Slow-push waves toward him so he must either farm or roam; limits his gank threats.
- Pick Grasp for sustain and scaling; you need health stacking to survive his burst trades.
- Build Force of Nature if he goes lethality heavy; the magic resist and movespeed pays dividends.

shen__kennen.notes:
- Kennen stuns you repeatedly with Mark of the Storm; avoid his poke and get caught in ulti.
- Play safe, farm with Q from distance; dodge Thundering Shuriken and don't fight level 2.
- Bait his Electrical Surge activation, then Shadow Dash through him; never walk into his Lightning Rush.
- Kennen gains massive teamfight value with Slicing Maelstrom; use Stand United proactively to save teammates.
- First item spike is real threat; play safer and respect his damage output window.
- Post-six, you win isolated skirmishes if he wastes Slicing Maelstrom; punish cooldown windows hard.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces Kennen closer to your tower, reducing his safe poke range.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and scales; better than Stormraider's Surge here.
- Hollow Radiance blocks extra burst damage and reduces his attack speed when he procs it.

shen__poppy.notes:
- Poppy's E Heroic Charge walls stun you; her W grounds dashes, negating Shadow Dash.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid close trades where Poppy lands E near walls or terrain.
- Bait Poppy's W Steadfast Presence before committing; trade when her W is on cooldown only.
- Stand United remains strong, but Keeper's Verdict knocks you away; coordinate ult timing carefully.
- First item spike (Hollow Radiance or tank items) increases her tankiness; play scaling game instead.
- Shen spikes mid-game when Spirit's Refuge blocks sustained damage; use wave pressure then for picks.
- Slow-push waves; deny Poppy wall stun setups and force her to chase you into lane.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain matches her durability and scales better into teamfights.
- Buy Adaptive Helm if Poppy builds AP or damage; otherwise prioritize Thornmail for armor value.

shen__brand.notes:
- Brand's Blaze stacking and Pyroclasm bounces deal massive damage; you cannot face-tank his combo.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades where Brand lands multiple spells on you.
- Bait Sear with Shadow Dash, then trade back; never let him stack Blaze freely.
- Stand United shields an ally but leaves you vulnerable; Brand ult bounces harder post-6.
- Brand's first item spike (around 2-3 items) is dangerous; pressure and roam before then.
- Your power window is early laning before Blaze stacks; punish overextension with Shadow Dash taunts.
- Slow-push to deny Brand mana and reset opportunities; control wave near your tower safety.
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading windows against his poke; shields matter in this fight.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for magic resist and cooldown reduction against his repeated damage.

drmundo__braum.notes:
- Braum stuns you with Unbreakable after soaking damage; dodge his ult knockup at all costs.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Braum's early trading is strong; farm from range with cleaver.
- Bait his shield with poke, then all-in when it's down; dodge the stun attempt.
- Post-6, Braum's ultimate creates teamfight chaos; position away from walls or grouped enemies always.
- Braum's Hollow Radiance spike around Kindlegem forces you to adapt; it's a punish window.
- Dr. Mundo spikes harder at three items; disengage during his one-item power and farm safely.
- Slow-push waves into him; Braum needs grouping, so deny him solo kill pressure waves.
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading pressure; this lets you out-scale his early dominance.
- Build Kaenic Lifeburst after core items; the magic damage shred helps burst through his tankiness.

drmundo__belveth.notes:
- Bel'Veth's true damage and attack speed destroy you; kite and avoid extended duels.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early all-in trades hurt despite your sustain potential.
- Bait her Q forward, then trade back with cleaver; dodge her dash resets.
- Post-6 her ultimate resets make her untargetable and near unkillable; play around cooldowns.
- Her first item spike (Kraken or Trinity) threatens you; farm safely and scale.
- You spike mid-game with multiple tank items and cooldown; bully her then.
- Slow-push into her; force her to engage or lose CS under tower pressure.
- Take Grasp for healing trades; sustain lets you outlast her early aggression attempts.
- Build Hollow Radiance early if she snowballs; reduces her healing and true damage.

drmundo__lucian.notes:
- Lucian's mobility and burst combo delete you before you land meaningful damage back.
- Play safe behind minions; his early poke chunks hard. Farm passively, avoid Level 2 all-ins.
- Never chase Lucian down lane; bait his dash, then Cleaver him as he repositions.
- Post-6 his ultimate adds dps pressure—play around cooldowns and stack HP to outlast spam.
- First Manamune spike hurts; expect increased pressure. Abuse him pre-first-back if he recalls early.
- You spike harder mid-game with two items; look to run him down and sustain through trades.
- Slow-push to deny his kite space and force him into your effective range eventually.
- Grasp sustains your health pool against poke while scaling into late-game tankiness and damage.
- Consider Manamune second to match his sustained damage and improve your own mana economics significantly.

drmundo__senna.notes:
- Senna's long-range poke and root severely damage you; dodge or tank with Passive
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance and avoid her auto-attack range entirely
- Never trade into her; let her push, then all-in with Hemorrhage slow applied
- Her ult range expands massively; respect it and don't fight in its path
- Her Manamune spike (first item) threatens poke; farm safely and scale into teamfights
- Post-10 minutes when tankier; all-in her when she overextends for wave control
- Slow-push and freeze near tower; deny her roam and maintain pressure safely
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke mitigation; scales better than other keystones here
- Build Adaptive Helm second after Sunfire; blocks her poke and reduces her burst

drmundo__udyr.notes:
- Udyr's sustained attack damage and stuns lock you down; kite or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trades near minions where Udyr stuns you.
- Bait Blazing Stampede stun with Q poke, then trade when it's down.
- Maximum Dosage sustain lets you survive Udyr's all-in; use it proactively.
- Udyr first item spike hurts; respect his damage window around level 9.
- Dr. Mundo peaks mid-game; kite with Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage.
- Slow-push to deny Udyr gank setup; freeze only when clearly ahead.
- Take Grasp for sustain trades and tank Udyr's early poke damage.
- Kaenic Lifeburst amplifies your healing and cuts Udyr's sustained damage output.

drmundo__rakan.notes:
- Rakan's engage-and-dash with Xayah creates kiting angles; avoid getting caught immobile mid-fight.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Rakan pokes freely with W, so farm defensively under tower.
- Dodge his Gleam on approach; trade back only after he wastes cooldowns on minions.
- Post-6, Rakan's engage range expands dramatically; position deeper and respect his The Quickness initiate.
- First item (Luden's or Chemtech) lets Rakan roam and permaroam; pressure lane before he leaves.
- Dr. Mundo spikes at Hollow Radiance—sustain outraces Rakan's poke; abuse this tank item timing.
- Slow-push waves into Rakan; he cannot contest your bulk, and jungle help arrives slowly.
- Grasp of the Undying for health sustain to offset his constant poke damage output.
- Adaptive Helm blocks Rakan's magic damage and shields; build it third after core items.

drmundo__rengar.notes:
- Rengar one-shots you from stealth with empowered Q; respect his all-in range always
- Play safe early; farm under tower and avoid pushing into river without vision
- Never fight him in brush; bait his leap outside then trade with axe
- His ultimate forces you to play extremely cautiously; buy control wards immediately
- His first item spike (Dirk/Serrated) is lethal; respect damage and disengage aggressively
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Rengar uses ult poorly; punish overextends brutally
- Slow-push to deny his brush access; maintain minion advantage for safety farming
- Take Grasp for scaling tankiness and sustain to outvalue his burst damage
- Buy Adaptive Helm second or third to reduce his burst and heal more

drmundo__anivia.notes:
- Threat: Anivia's Crystallize wall traps you; her Frostbite doubles damage after Flash Frost hits.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid her Q range and don't commit to trades near walls.
- Trading: Bait her Flash Frost, then all-in with Q and E; dodge Crystallize by positioning.
- Post6: Glacial Storm zones you hard; use Maximum Dosage to sustain through poke and reposition.
- Spike: First Liandry's hurts; respect her damage window but you sustain it with ult healing.
- Window: Mid-game when you're tanky; all-in when her Flash Frost is down and rotate fast.
- Wave: Slow-push toward her tower; force her to use abilities on wave instead of poking you.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; extra tankiness and sustain counter her poke and zone control.
- Item: Hollow Radiance; blocks her burst damage and reduces Glacial Storm's slow effectiveness significantly.

drmundo__kled.notes:
- Kled's all-in with Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and Jousting dash combo kills you if caught without cooldowns.
- Play safe levels 1-3, farm at range with Q, avoid Kled's aggressive engage attempts entirely.
- Bait Jousting with positioning, then counter-trade with Q and W while he repositions back.
- Maximum Dosage sustain keeps you alive through Kled's burst, but respect Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engage range always.
- Kled's first item spike is moderate; your tankiness and sustain scale better than his early damage.
- Dr. Mundo dominates mid-game teamfights when Kled dismounts Skaarl; focus on surviving his initial burst.
- Slow-push waves into tower to control Kled's roaming and force him to defend tower pressure.
- Pick Grasp of the Undying for sustain scaling and tankiness against Kled's repeated trading.
- Consider Kaenic Lifegem early for health stacking and magic damage reduction against his mixed damage.

drmundo__katarina.notes:
- Katarina's burst combo and resets delete you if you're immobile during her ultimate.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge her Q poke and don't chase into minions.
- Bait her Q with movement, then trade back with E; never fight in tight space.
- Post-6 becomes lethal for you; respect her ult range and maintain distance always.
- Her first Protobelt spike around 10-12 minutes forces you to play extremely passive.
- You spike harder at Liandry's completion; she needs kills to stay relevant then.
- Slow-push side lanes to create gank setup and remove her roam kill potential.
- Take Grasp for sustain trading and health scaling; you need survivability into her burst.
- Build Hollow Radiance second after Liandry to reduce her burst damage and healing output.

drmundo__olaf.notes:
- Threat: Olaf's true damage E and Attack Speed overwhelm your Health pool in extended fights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Olaf wins short trades. Farm at range with Q Infected Bonesaw.
- Trading: Bait his W Tough It Out shield, then trade back. Never all-in before level 6.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage turns fights; use it proactively when Olaf commits, not reactively after burst damage.
- Spike: First item spike hurts around 10-12 minutes. Stay healthy and stack Health to survive.
- Window: You outscale after two Health items. Play for mid-game teamfights where you sustain longer.
- Wave: Slow-push waves to deny Olaf roam and extend fight duration in your favor.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; extra Health and sustained trading matches Olaf's durable kit.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip adds healing against his true damage and gives you teamfight presence.

sivir__jayce.notes:
- Jayce's Shock Blast and Thundering Blow combo burst you down before you can react or escape safely.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge Shock Blast by positioning unpredictably; farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance.
- Bait his E Thundering Blow, then trade back with W Ricochet; never fight him in hammer range.
- On The Hunt lets you kite his all-ins better; use R to escape or chase down picks.
- His first item spike is immediate and dangerous; respect his damage and play extra safe during this window.
- Mid-game when he lacks immediate threat; group with allies and use On The Hunt to siege or rotate.
- Slow-push waves to deny his engagement angles; avoid pushing into his tower where Shock Blast lands easier.
- Take Fleet of Foot keystone for sustain and mobility to kite his melee engages and burst attempts.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip early for survivability and to reduce his burst damage in extended teamfights.

sivir__diana.notes:
- Threat: Diana's Lunar Rush gaps you instantly; dodge Crescent Strike or get all-inned.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Farm at range with Boomerang Blade; avoid close trades.
- Trading: Bait Crescent Strike with lateral movement, then trade back with Ricochet bounces.
- Post6: Moonfall pulls you in for guaranteed Lunar Rush combo. Use Spell Shield preemptively.
- Spike: First item spike dangerous. Stay grouped; let Spell Shield block her engage tools.
- Window: After Diana ults on cooldown, abuse Ricochet and On The Hunt to kite.
- Wave: Slow-push and group mid. Prevent Diana roaming; deny isolated Crescent Strike hits.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge. Ensures you kite and escape Lunar Rush engagement attempts reliably.
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifeline. Blocks Moonfall pull and heals you through her burst.

sivir__leesin.notes:
- Lee Sin's Q Sonic Wave and subsequent Resonating Strike combo locks you down for guaranteed damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his all-in range and avoid predictable positioning near minions.
- Bait Q Sonic Wave with unpredictable movement, then trade back when his follow-up is unavailable.
- R On The Hunt lets you kite his R Dragon's Rage and escape ganks more reliably.
- His first item spike (around 1200 gold) is dangerous; respect his damage and play safer.
- You spike harder mid-game when R On The Hunt and W Ricochet enable sustained fights.
- Slow-push waves to maintain safety distance and deny Lee Sin easy engage opportunities with minions.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for trading sustain and survivability against his burst damage.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip early to block his burst and gain healing against his physical damage.

drmundo__khazix.notes:
- Kha'Zix's isolated Q one-shots you; avoid fighting alone without backup nearby always.
- Play safe under tower; Kha'Zix dominates isolated trades so stay grouped conceptually.
- Bait his Leap with positioning; trade back with Q and E when he commits.
- His Void Assault invisibility triggers isolation; use R preemptively to heal and prepare.
- First item spike (likely Serrated Dirk path) is dangerous; play ultra-defensive then.
- You spike harder post-first-item with health stacking; leverage superior tankiness around minute ten.
- Slow-push waves to deny isolation; grouping minions prevents him from finding picks easily.
- Grasp of the Undying for trading sustain and health scaling into late game.
- Adaptive Helm blocks his W spike damage and reduces his burst threat significantly.

drmundo__nidalee.notes:
- threat: Nidalee's long-range Javelin Toss pokes you down before all-ins; dodge or tank with E
- early: Dangerous—stay behind minions, avoid brush. Farm safe; her level 2 all-in with Pounce hurts
- trading: Bait her Javelin, then all-in with Q and E. Never fight in her brush
- post6: Much harder—Cougar form Pounce engages faster. Play safer, use W to counter her burst
- spike: First item spike hurts around level 9-11. Farm safely; don't contest objectives then
- window: Post-6 when your R heals spike damage. Extended teamfights favor your tankiness over her burst
- wave: Slow-push; denies her brush control and forces her into your range for all-ins
- rune: Grasp—sustains you against poke and adds tankiness to endure her Javelin repeated harassment
- item: Hollow Radiance—reduces her ability damage and gives you more health to tank Javelin spam

sivir__senna.notes:
- Threat: Last Embrace root traps you; Piercing Darkness pokes from range safely.
- Early: Play safe; Senna out-ranges you significantly. Farm with Boomerang Blade from distance.
- Trading: Bait Last Embrace with movement, then all-in. Never fight in her beam.
- Post6: Dawning Shadow shields her team globally; use On The Hunt to engage fights.
- Spike: First item spike around 2-3 items; dodge her poke, farm safely meanwhile.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where On The Hunt speed lets you close distance quickly.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her farm safely; prevents her scaling too quickly.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; the speed boost helps you kite and dodge Last Embrace.
- Item: Add Adaptive Helm to reduce her poke damage and heal attempts.

sivir__annie.notes:
- Annie's stun from Pyromania after four spells locks you down for guaranteed Summon: Tibbers combo damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her Disintegrate poke range and avoid standing near minions she targets.
- Bait her Disintegrate onto minions to refund her mana, then trade when her spell stack resets.
- Post-6, Summon: Tibbers forces you to respect massive damage radius; play around cooldown windows and Spell Shield.
- Annie's first-item spike around level 9 is dangerous; farm safely and use Boomerang Blade from distance.
- You spike when Annie's ultimate cooldown resets; punish her vulnerable windows by grouping with teammates aggressively.
- Slow-push waves to create side lane pressure; avoid grouping where Summon: Tibbers lands in team fights.
- Take Electrocute to match her burst threat and enable all-in scenarios when her cooldowns misalign.
- Add Abyssal Mask later to reduce her magic damage output and survive extended poke exchanges safely.

drmundo__akshan.notes:
- Akshan's Comeuppance executes low-health targets; respect his ult range constantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Akshan out-damages you early, avoid extended trades.
- Bait Avengerang by positioning behind minions, then all-in when it's down.
- Maximum Dosage healing lets you survive Comeuppance better; use ult preemptively.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes hurts; respect his damage window hard.
- Post-15 minutes you out-tank him; abuse late teamfights with tankiness advantage.
- Slow-push waves to deny Heroic Swing grapple points and control spacing.
- Take Grasp for sustain trading and scaling health into tankiness advantage.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce his burst damage and lower his ult threat.

drmundo__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Fiddlesticks' fear chains you down, preventing kiting and allowing his team to collapse on you.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his fear range and avoid pushing too far into lane.
- Bait his fear with sidesteps, then trade with Cleaver; never fight during his drain channel.
- Post-6, his ult fear is devastating in teamfights; play safer and ward river entrances religiously.
- His first item (Liandry's or Zhonyas) spikes hard around 10-12 minutes; avoid extended fights then.
- Your power window is mid-game when you have Spirit Visage; abuse it before teamfights start.
- Slow-push waves to deny him roam opportunities and maintain pressure for your jungler's ganks.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain mitigates his poke and healing amp scales your tankiness.
- Add Adaptive Helm after Spirit Visage to reduce his drain damage and deny his AP scaling.

shen__shyvana.notes:
- threat: Shyvana's Dragon Form transforms her into a dueling monster; you cannot 1v1 her post-six without help.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Emberstrike and Inferno Aegis trade better than your early poke. Farm defensively.
- trading: Bait her Inferno Aegis shield, then Shadow Dash away before she detonates. Never trade into her full combo.
- post6: Dragon's Descent makes her unstoppable in extended fights. Play around your Stand United to cover vulnerable allies instead.
- spike: First item spike is real danger. Avoid extended trades when she completes her first major item purchase.
- window: Early game before level 6 and first item is your safest window. Punish with aggressive Q harass then.
- wave: Slow-push and let her push into you. This denies her roam on Stand United and forces her mistakes.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying grants you sustain to survive her poke and scales into mid-game dueling power.
- item: Add Adaptive Helm if she stacks magic damage; reduces her burst and persistent Molten Burst trail damage significantly.

sivir__veigar.notes:
- threat: Event Horizon stun cage traps you; Primordial Burst one-shots if you're low health
- early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Q; never walk into cage range near center lane
- trading: Bait Event Horizon with movement, then trade. Use Spell Shield to block Baleful Strike poke
- post6: Primordial Burst scales with missing health—stay healthy. On The Hunt lets you kite cage
- spike: First item around level 9—Veigar gains burst. Punish him before; respect range after completion
- window: Levels 1-5 before cage stun. Abuse mobility and range advantage; group and end fast
- wave: Slow-push side lanes. Force Veigar to choose: defend or roam. Never fight in center
- rune: Stormraider's Surge. Kite cage and burst windows; movespeed breaks his trap pattern
- item: Kaenic Lifeline or Maw. Blocks Primordial burst damage or shields you from one-shot combos

sivir__yorick.notes:
- Yorick's Maiden and Mist Walkers overwhelm you; kite backwards and use Spell Shield on high-damage moments.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid Dark Procession walls and farm at range with Boomerang Blade safely.
- Bait Dark Procession by moving predictably, then trade with Ricochet bounces; dodge Mourning Mist's slow and armor shred.
- Post-6, Eulogy of the Isles makes Yorick extremely threatening; respect Maiden damage and maintain distance always.
- Yorick's first item spike is dangerous; play safer, focus on scaling, and avoid extended fights near walls.
- Your power window arrives mid-game when On The Hunt enables kiting and teamfighting; abuse mobility advantage then.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance from Yorick; deny him easy graves and Mist Walker spawns from minions.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for consistent kiting and escape tools against Yorick's slow and wall pressure relentlessly.
- Add Kaenic Arcanum to reduce Mourning Mist's armor shred and weaken Maiden/Walker damage output significantly.

sivir__kayn.notes:
- Kayn's Umbral Trespass locks you down, deals massive damage, and you cannot Spell Shield it.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kayn out-damages you early. Farm with Q, avoid pushing into him.
- Bait Kayn's W Blade's Reach, then trade back with Q Boomerang Blade and autos.
- Post-6 Kayn becomes extremely dangerous; respect Umbral Trespass range and position near allies always.
- Kayn's first item spike is dangerous; he gains tankiness or burst. Play defensive, farm safely.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where Ricochet bounces and On The Hunt enable kiting.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces Kayn to choose between pushing or roaming, limits his impact.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for kiting potential against Shadow Assassin or sustain runes against Darkin form.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius for the shield against burst and lifeline activation during Umbral Trespass.

sivir__rumble.notes:
- threat: Rumble's Flamespitter cone and Equalizer wall deal massive damage; avoid getting trapped in them
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Rumble outranges you and Flamespitter hurts; farm from distance with Q
- trading: Bait Rumble's E Electro Harpoon with E Spell Shield to block and gain health back
- post6: Equalizer creates impassable terrain; respect its range and never fight inside the flame wall zone
- spike: Rumble's first AP item spike around 1100 gold is dangerous; play safer and use E defensively
- window: Punish Rumble when his Heat drops below Danger Zone; he loses bonus damage and shield strength
- wave: Slow-push toward Rumble to maintain distance and control when he can all-in you effectively
- rune: Grasp of the Undying provides tankiness and sustain against his poke and all-in pressure consistently
- item: Abyssal Mask reduces his magic damage and gives health; add after core for survivability spike

sivir__vayne.notes:
- threat: Vayne's Silver Bolts true damage and Condemn stun wall abuse will shred your health bar
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near walls where Condemn pins you down
- trading: Bait her Tumble with Q; use E Spell Shield to block Condemn, not abilities
- post6: Final Hour invisibility on Tumble makes her untargetable; respect her all-in potential severely
- spike: Her first Blade of Ruined King spike is dangerous; play back and scale instead
- window: You outrange her early; poke with Q Boomerang Blade before she hits Silver Bolts
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; avoid extended fights and prevent her from pinning you on walls
- rune: Fleet Footwork; the extra healing and movespeed help kite her Night Hunter pursuit pressure
- item: Kaenic Lifeline provides shields and anti-healing to reduce her true damage burst threat

sivir__tahmkench.notes:
- Tahm Kench's Devour eliminates you from fights; respect three-stack threat range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Tongue Lash and avoid short trades near him.
- Bait Spell Shield with Boomerang Blade, then trade when it's down immediately.
- Post-6 Devour threatens you heavily; maintain distance and position near allies for peel.
- His first item spike is dangerous; respect his tankiness and avoid all-ins.
- You spike at two items with attack speed; kite and poke before then.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance and avoid being pinned against tower by him.
- Take Lethal Tempo for extended kiting and consistent damage against his tank frame.
- Build Manamune second for poke damage and mana sustain to harass safely.

sivir__lux.notes:
- Lux lands a binding or combo from range, then chains damage; respect her threat zone.
- Play safe behind minions; her Q range exceeds yours, so don't get caught extended.
- Bait her Q with lateral movement, then trade back hard; dodge the binding always.
- Her ultimate becomes a zoning tool and execute threat; position behind teammates or minions.
- Lux spikes at Lost Chapter; play safer, farm defensively, avoid extended trades during this window.
- You spike when Lux wastes binding; immediately all-in trade or freeze to punish her cooldown.
- Slow-push waves to deny her safe farming space and create gank setup for your jungler.
- Take Manaflow Band for sustained mana pressure; Lux zones you, so sustain matters heavily.
- Grab Null-Magic Mantle into Adaptive Helm; her poke and burst become manageable and predictable.

sivir__mel.notes:
- Mel's Overwhelm stacking and Golden Eclipse execute you from range; dodge her abilities relentlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q poke outranges yours, so respect her volley damage.
- Bait her Q with lateral movement, then trade back with your own Q return damage.
- Post-6, Mel gains execute threat; avoid clustering with teammates and space carefully from her marks.
- First item spike is dangerous; she gains raw damage and Overwhelm application—play defensively then.
- Your window comes mid-game when her cooldowns are longer; group and flank with ult speed.
- Slow-push to prevent her from roaming; keep lane pushed so she must defend or lose.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite her Solar Snare root and escape Golden Eclipse range threat.
- Add Abyssal Mask to reduce her magic damage and Overwhelm stack damage per hit significantly.

sivir__tryndamere.notes:
- Tryndamere's sustained auto-attack damage and Undying Rage ult make him a dueling threat you cannot match.
- Play safe and farm with Q Boomerang Blade from range; avoid close trades where his autos stack Fury.
- Bait his Spinning Slash, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces; use E Spell Shield to block Mocking Shout slow.
- Undying Rage means you cannot kill him in extended fights; kite and disengage when he ults.
- First item spike (Crit or AD item) is dangerous; respect his damage and maintain distance during this window.
- Post-teamfight or when Tryndamere's ult is down, you have a window to group and force objectives with R On The Hunt.
- Slow-push waves to deny him safe farming; prevents him from grouping while maintaining your escape route.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for the movement speed boost to kite his autos and Spinning Slash engages reliably.
- Add Maw of Malmortius for the spell shield passive and survivability against his sustained physical damage output.

sivir__tristana.notes:
- Tristana's Rocket Jump gap-closer and Buster Shot knockback catch Sivir out of position easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q boomerang from distance, avoid Tristana's all-in trades.
- Bait Rocket Jump with positioning, then use Spell Shield to block Buster Shot follow-up.
- Post-6 Buster Shot becomes lethal; respect knock-back range and position near walls carefully.
- Tristana's first item spike is dangerous; play safer and use range advantage with Q.
- Sivir dominates mid-game teamfights when On The Hunt active; group and leverage movement speed.
- Slow-push waves to deny Tristana roaming; maintain distance and kite backward with mobility.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for the movement speed to escape Rocket Jump dives consistently.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline as a survivability item against Tristana's burst and knockback threat.

sivir__naafiri.notes:
- Naafiri's packmates and bleed stack from Q overwhelm you in extended trades or all-ins.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid stepping up into packmate range.
- Bait her W with E Spell Shield, then trade back hard with Q and autos.
- Her R Hounds' Pursuit forces you to kite hard; use E to block the dash damage.
- First item spike around 1200g is dangerous; don't trade when she has item advantage.
- You spike when E blocks her Q or W, then immediately Q-auto-W for damage burst.
- Slow-push waves to set up gank windows; prevent her from grouping pack numbers against you.
- Fleet of Foot keeps you healthy and mobile to kite her pack pressure consistently.
- Buy Plated Steelcaps early to reduce her attack speed and packmate auto damage significantly.

drmundo__annie.notes:
- Threat: Annie's Pyromania stun locks you down; Tibbers burns and controls fights around him.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Annie out-damages you early. Farm at range with Q.
- Trading: Bait her W Incinerate cone, then trade back. Never fight into Pyromania stacks.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive Summon: Tibbers burst, but respect the stun follow-up.
- Spike: Annie first item (Liandry's or Shadowflame) hurts; farm safer, use W Heart Zapper defensively.
- Window: After Annie wastes Pyromania stun, all-in her before cooldown resets. Push your advantage.
- Wave: Slow-push; forces Annie to choose between waveclear and roaming. Deny her gank setup.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains poke damage and scales into tankiness Annie can't burst.
- Item: Force of Nature; magic resist and move speed counter her sustained burn and kite.

drmundo__sejuani.notes:
- Threat: Sejuani's E stun on max Frost stacks locks you down for her team to burst
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her W applies Frost fast, avoid extended trades near minions
- Trading: Bait her Q Arctic Assault, then trade back; dodge W Winter's Wrath swings when possible
- Post6: Glacial Prison stun is devastating; play around fog of war and reduce all-in attempts
- Spike: First armor item (Kaenic救赎 or similar) spikes her survivability; farm safely, don't force trades
- Window: Levels 4-5 before her first item; use Q poke and E active burst her down
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; prevents her from landing Q charges and limits her roam pressure
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains you through her poke and White Wrath spam
- Item: Hollow Radiance; reduces her damage output and counters her Frost Armor resistances effectively

drmundo__nocturne.notes:
- Nocturne's Duskbringer poke and all-in burst threaten your health bar before teamfights matter
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nocturne outtrrades you early; farm with Q from range only
- Never trade melee; bait his Duskbringer, then all-in with E after he wastes it
- Post-6 his ult removes vision; group mid, play around teammates' positioning, never face-check alone
- First item spike (Dirk) makes his burst lethal; play defensive and scale toward teamfights
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where tankiness and healing let you outsustain his burst
- Slow-push waves into him; forces him to either farm dangerously or roam predictably
- Take Grasp for sustain in trades and health scaling to offset his early poke pressure
- Buy Maw of Malmortius second; its magic shield blocks Nocturne's burst and ult damage

shen__ezreal.notes:
- threat: Ezreal kites away and pokes safely; your Shadow Dash struggles to land on him
- early: Safe farm with Q; avoid walking forward into Mystic Shot spam and poke damage
- trading: Bait Arcane Shift with Shadow Dash threat, then all-in when his escape is down
- post6: Stand United covers his burst but Trueshot Barrage still chips you; respect its damage
- spike: First item (likely Trinity Force) makes him durable and stronger; play safer, farm defensively
- window: Post-6 when his Arcane Shift is down; engage aggressively before cooldown resets
- wave: Slow-push to deny him safe farming space and create gank opportunities for jungler
- rune: Grasp sustains poke damage and strengthens your scaling into mid-game teamfights naturally
- item: Hollow Radiance reduces his magic damage and supports teammates; slot it into build flexibly

shen__renekton.notes:
- Renekton's W stun into Q combo locks you down and deals massive sustained damage with heal.
- Play safe near tower; avoid going for CS when Renekton has high Fury visible.
- Bait his W before trading; use Q to poke from distance while kiting backward.
- Stand United now shields him too—use it to save teammates instead of fighting him.
- His first item spike (likely Black Cleaver) makes him extremely tanky; don't duel him.
- Your advantage comes when his Fury depletes after failed all-ins; punish with Q trades.
- Slow-push waves toward your tower to deny him guaranteed kills from ganks and dives.
- Grasp sustains your health and synergizes with your defensive playstyle against his all-in threat.
- Build Adaptive Helm early to reduce his sustained damage and Dominus burn effectiveness significantly.

shen__chogath.notes:
- Rupture interrupts your dash and denies your only escape; respect its range constantly
- Play safe near minions; Rupture needs a target; farm from distance with Q
- Bait Rupture by faking Shadow Dash; trade after he wastes it on minions
- Cho'Gath gains massive health per stack; your sustained damage falls off hard post-six
- His first item spike around ten minutes is dangerous; play safer and scale instead
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Cho'Gath lacks stacks; roam and create picks elsewhere
- Slow-push waves to deny him easy Rupture targets; deny his kill pressure windows
- Grasp sustains you through poke and scales into late; synergizes with your tanking role
- Mercury's Treads reduce Rupture knockup and Feral Scream silence duration; buy early if ahead

shen__lulu.notes:
- threat: Whimsy turns you useless; Wild Growth makes her untargetable and unkillable for teamfights
- early: Farm safely at range with Q; avoid trading into her poke and slows
- trading: Bait Whimsy with Shadow Dash feints; all-in only when she wastes it early
- post6: Stand United becomes risky—she shields allies from burst; focus on enabling your team instead
- spike: First Chemtech Putrifier or similar utility spike hurts; punish her before she completes it
- window: Early levels before her cooldowns reset; mid-game when her mana pools are strained
- wave: Slow-push toward enemy tower; sets up Stand United roams without losing lane pressure
- rune: Grasp for sustained tankiness against her poke; keeps you healthy for extended teamfights
- item: Add Hollow Radiance to reduce her healing and utility amplification in extended fights

shen__yorick.notes:
- Threat: Yorick's Maiden of the Mist and Mist Walkers overwhelm you; kite backward and use E Shadow Dash to escape.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Yorick weak pre-6, so farm and scale. Avoid extended trades where his Q Last Rites healing sustains.
- Trading: Bait Yorick's W Dark Procession, then trade. Never fight inside his wall; use E Shadow Dash to escape it immediately.
- Post6: Eulogy of the Isles makes Yorick extremely dangerous. Use R Stand United to assist allies or escape prolonged Maiden fights.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Kaenic Rookern or bruiser item) is dangerous. Avoid long trades; focus on safety and wave management instead.
- Window: Early game levels 1-5 before his ult is your punish window. Dominate CS lead and roam with R Stand United advantage.
- Wave: Slow-push toward him to deny his Mist Walkers space and reduce his all-in threat. Reset when dangerous.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for consistent short-trade sustain against Yorick's poke and Q Last Rites healing pressure.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces Yorick's damage and Maiden effectiveness; add after core defensive items for armor and magic resist layering.

sivir__teemo.notes:
- Teemo blinds you and kites with shrooms; respect his range and poke damage heavily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Q and avoid walking into blind range.
- Bait his blind with W, then reposition; never trade when blinded or low vision.
- Post-6 shroom waves block your engage paths; clear them with Q or sacrifice map control.
- Teemo's Nashor's Tooth spike hurts; this is your window to group and force teamfights.
- You outscale and teamfight better; wait for him to use blind, then all-in him.
- Slow-push into him; force him to choose between farming or harassing, then roam priority.
- Run Grasp for sustain and poke resistance; the extra durability is mandatory into Teemo.
- Build Maw second if he's ahead; the shield and magic resistance directly counter his damage.

drmundo__milio.notes:
- Milio's W Cozy Campfire zone denies you reliable all-in damage and healing amplification punishes your sustained fights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Milio out-ranges you early and his Q knockback punishes close positioning attempts.
- Bait his E Warm Hugs shield, then engage; his cooldowns are long and he lacks escape afterward.
- Post-6, R Maximum Dosage becomes crucial for sustaining through Milio's R Breath of Life healing and cleanse.
- Watch for Milio first-item spike around 10-12 minutes; his W zone control becomes oppressive, farm safely instead.
- Your power window is when Milio is separated from allies; hunt him solo or catch him rotating.
- Slow-push waves toward Milio's side to force him into extended trades where you out-sustain his poke damage.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; its sustain and damage synergize with your health-scaling while trading with Milio.
- Consider adding Adaptive Helm to reduce his team's magic damage and amplify your own R healing benefits.

drmundo__zeri.notes:
- Zeri's all-in burst and mobility chain make you vulnerable to sudden engages and kite patterns
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early damage is high, so farm at distance and avoid trades
- Never chase Zeri through her E dashes; bait her engage, then punish her with Mundo ult slow
- At level 6, Zeri gains sustained chase potential; respect her ult range and don't overextend forward
- Her first spike (Sheen/Trinity) hurts; farm safely and scale, as you outscale her significantly later
- Your power window opens mid-game when you complete core items and tanky stats; abuse her then
- Slow-push waves to create gank setup for your jungler; Zeri struggles against coordinated CC chains
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke trading; it helps you scale and survive her aggression better
- Rush Hollow Radiance after core tank items to block her crit damage and reduce her burst

drmundo__locke.notes:
- Locke's lockdown chain and burst combo delete you if you're caught without escape tools ready.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his damage range and farm from distance using Cleaver.
- Bait his chain with unpredictable movement, then trade back hard when it's on cooldown.
- Post-6 your ult sustain lets you outlast him in extended fights; abuse this advantage.
- His first item spike (usually crit) is dangerous; respect damage window and play around cooldowns.
- You spike harder mid-game when you have two items and he lacks full build potential.
- Slow-push waves into him so you can fight with minion advantage and deny his roams.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling to survive his burst and poke attempts.
- Build Spirit Visage earlier if he stacks magic damage; it amplifies your healing significantly.

drmundo__gragas.notes:
- Gragas Body Slam stun chains you; dodge it or die to follow-up burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid overextending as Body Slam cooldown is short early.
- Bait Body Slam with positioning, then trade with Q or E when he commits.
- Maximum Dosage healing lets you survive Explosive Cask knockback; use it proactively before fights.
- First item spike is moderate; stay healthy and don't fight near walls post-six.
- You spike harder mid-game when tankier; force fights away from terrain where Body Slam works.
- Slow-push waves to control jungle proximity; prevent Gragas roaming and ganks onto your lane.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health stacking to survive his burst combo.
- Add Hollow Radiance early to reduce his magic damage and gain utility.

sivir__yuumi.notes:
- threat: Yuumi attaches to allies, making her untargetable while providing healing and buffs to her team
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Yuumi poses minimal threat alone, so focus cs and avoid Prowling Projectile
- trading: Bait Prowling Projectile with movement, then trade back; use E Spell Shield to block slows
- post6: Final Chapter heals her team while dealing damage; respect the range and use E reactively
- spike: Yuumi's first item spike matters less; exploit her immobility when attached to carry champions
- window: Sivir dominates when Yuumi detaches to reposition; punish with Q Boomerang Blade and W Ricochet
- wave: Slow-push to create extended fights where Yuumi's healing gets overwhelmed by your sustained damage output
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; kite away from Yuumi's projectile and chase when she's forced to detach
- item: Kaenic Lifesteal reduces healing Yuumi provides to her teammates; counters her core utility effectively

sivir__masteryi.notes:
- Master Yi's Alpha Strike makes him untargetable while dealing massive damage; kite carefully.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Boomerang Blade, avoid all-ins.
- Bait Alpha Strike with positioning, then Spell Shield his follow-up damage immediately.
- On The Hunt grants him massive speed; use Spell Shield preemptively for his burst.
- First item spike around 1200-1500 gold is dangerous; respect his damage and kiting.
- You spike when Master Yi burns Highlander without kills; punish his cooldown window.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance and control engagement; prevent him diving your tower.
- Grasp of the Undying provides survivability and trading pressure in extended fights.
- Build Maw of Malmortius early for magic damage reduction and shield value.

sivir__yone.notes:
- threat: Yone's Mortal Steel dash stuns you at 2 stacks; his mobility lets him all-in easily
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; his Q poke threatens you more than you threaten him back
- trading: Bait his Mortal Steel with movement, then trade back; use Spell Shield to block followup
- post6: Fate Sealed lets him reposition for guaranteed damage; respect his On The Hunt teamfight power
- spike: First Sheen/Trinity gives him sustained damage spike; farm safely and don't get caught isolated
- window: After Yone wastes Mortal Steel without stacks, punish with Boomerang Blade and Ricochet trades
- wave: Slow-push sidewaves; Yone needs to chase you, limiting his jungle synergy and teamfight setup
- rune: Stormraider's Surge for kite potential and escape when Yone commits to Fate Sealed engage
- item: Kaenic Lifeline shields you from burst and blocks his follow-up; fits your survival needs

sivir__ashe.notes:
- Ashe's Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns you from miles away; respect her ultimate range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ashe out-ranges you early, so farm defensively and avoid her poke.
- Trade only after she wastes Volley; dodge her arrows and use Boomerang Blade to harass.
- Post-6, Ashe gains guaranteed engage tool; position deeper and use Spellshield to block her ult.
- Ashe's first item spike (Manamune or Collector) significantly increases her poke and kill pressure.
- Sivir spikes harder at two items and teamfights; abuse mid-game before her utility scales.
- Slow-push waves to deny her freeze setup; this prevents her from controlling the lane.
- Take Lethal Tempo for extended trades and attack speed to out-duel her in fights.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius after core AD items to block her slow and survive ganks.

sivir__aurelionsol.notes:
- Aurelion Sol's Breath of Light and Singularity deal heavy AoE damage; stay spread and mobile.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Aurelion Sol out-ranges your Q, so farm with autos only.
- Bait his Breath of Light with positioning, then trade back hard with Boomerang Blade.
- His On The Hunt lets him chase and kite; use Spell Shield to block Singularity.
- Post-6, Falling Star stuns and damages; dodge it by moving unpredictably or using Spell Shield.
- His first item-spike is dangerous; stay off-map and avoid grouping until you have items.
- Sivir powers spike after two items; then teamfight and abuse On The Hunt's cooldown reduction.
- Slow-push waves to deny him roam and force him to farm; prevents his scaling dominance.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for the extra movespeed to kite his engage and Singularity pulls.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius early if fed; the magic shield blocks his burst patterns.

sivir__seraphine.notes:
- Seraphine's Encore charms you at range; dodge or shield it to survive teamfights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her High Note poke outranges your Boomerang Blade early on.
- Bait her Beat Drop with positioning, then trade back with Boomerang Blade bounces.
- Post-6, respect Encore's charm range and use Spell Shield preemptively or kite backwards hard.
- First item spike is moderate; punish her immobility before she groups with allies.
- Your power window is mid-game when On The Hunt enables kiting and skirmishing.
- Slow-push waves to space from her poke and set up On The Hunt engages.
- Take Grasp for sustain against her poke pressure and extended trading patterns.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip to mitigate her magic damage and protect against Encore chains.

sivir__nunuwillump.notes:
- Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks you up and locks you down for ganks or burst
- Play safe behind minions; Snowball Barrage roots you if hit, so respect his range
- Bait Snowball Barrage with positioning, then trade back; use Spell Shield to block Consume
- On The Hunt lets Nunu chase you down; kite backward and spam Boomerang Blade
- His first major item spike threatens you hard; abuse the window before he completes it
- You spike when Nunu wastes Snowball Barrage; punish with Ricochet and Boomerang Blade spam
- Push the wave to deny his jungle proximity; deny roams and gank setup opportunities
- Take Stormraider's Surge for escape tools when Biggest Snowball Ever! forces all-ins constantly
- Add Quicksilver Sash after core to cleanse roots from Snowball Barrage and survive fights

drmundo__poppy.notes:
- Threat: Poppy's E Heroic Charge stuns you into walls, enabling her burst and allies' follow-up
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her E range outmatches your Q range significantly at level 1
- Trading: Bait her E by walking near walls, then Q her as she commits to dash
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive her R knockback and chase; reduces her ult value significantly
- Spike: First item around level 9 gives her tankiness; maintain distance and farm safely during this window
- Window: Post-6 with Maximum Dosage active, you outduel and chase her down relentlessly every fight
- Wave: Slow-push waves toward her tower; forces her to choose between defending and roaming for kills
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying sustains your trades and scales your health for E damage
- Item: Force of Nature reduces her magic damage and provides move speed to escape her E

drmundo__jayce.notes:
- Jayce's poke with Shock Blast and all-in with Thundering Blow punish overextension and lack of mobility.
- Play safe early; Jayce outranges you. Farm behind minions and avoid unnecessary skirmishing before level 6.
- Dodge Shock Blast by positioning behind minions. Never trade directly into his Cannon Stance combo.
- Maximum Dosage lets you tank his burst and heal back up; use it to turn fights.
- First item spike (Manamune or Trinity Force) makes Jayce extremely dangerous; respect his damage and play safe.
- Post-6 after landing Q, chase and use Maximum Dosage to sustain through his damage and win.
- Slow-push waves into tower so Jayce must break freeze or lose farm; limits his roaming.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness to out-trade him in extended short fights.
- Add Abyssal Mask early to reduce his magic damage and provide additional tankiness against poke.

sivir__amumu.notes:
- Amumu's Q Bandage Toss stun chains into his ultimate for guaranteed teamfight deletion.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Amumu outtrrades you. Farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade.
- Bait his Q with E Spell Shield, then punish his missed cooldown window.
- Post-6, Curse of the Sad Mummy engages entire team; position far back always.
- First item spike around 1100 gold is dangerous; respect his all-in threat window.
- Your window exists when Amumu wastes Q; immediately push wave and gain tempo.
- Slow-push waves to deny Amumu roam timing and set up your R On The Hunt.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for movespeed to kite and escape his engage threat.
- Add Quicksilver Sash to cleanse Curse of the Sad Mummy's stun before damage.

sivir__yasuo.notes:
- threat: Yasuo's Wind Wall blocks your Boomerang Blade and Last Breath ultimate engage attempts
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading when Wind Wall is up, farm with Q
- trading: Bait Wind Wall with Q before committing; use E Spell Shield to block Steel Tempest
- post6: Yasuo gains all-in potential with Last Breath; position carefully to avoid Airborne setup chains
- spike: First item (likely Infinity Edge) is dangerous; respect his crit damage and duel threat
- window: Mid-game teamfights where On The Hunt speed advantage lets you kite and control fights
- wave: Slow-push to deny Yasuo roaming while maintaining escape distance; prevent him flanking teammates
- rune: Stormraider's Surge for mobility to escape his dashes and repositioning during team fights
- item: Malmortius provides magic resist against his E and Q damage while offering durability

sivir__zilean.notes:
- threat: Zilean's Time Bomb combo and Chronoshift make him unkillable and enable his team's engage
- early: Play safe; Time Bomb range lets him harass freely. Farm from distance, respect his poke.
- trading: Dodge Time Bombs with movement. Use Spell Shield on bombs stuck to you, not predictable ones.
- post6: Chronoshift turns him into a teamfight anchor. Stop forcing kills; focus on scaling and utility.
- spike: First item spike is moderate. He gains reliability but lacks burst. Continue farming safely.
- window: Post-first-item, your On The Hunt outpaces his Time Warp. Engage when he's on cooldown.
- wave: Slow-push sideways. Avoid grouping mid where Time Bomb chains devastate. Create side pressure instead.
- rune: Fleet of Foot works better; sustain mitigates his poke while you scale into teamfights.
- item: Add Kaenic Lifegrip for anti-burst survivability and to enhance your On The Hunt engage.

sivir__udyr.notes:
- Threat: Udyr's Blazing Stampede stun locks you down; his sustained damage overwhelms your kiting
- Early: Play safe—Udyr wins short trades. Farm with Q from distance; avoid close combat
- Trading: Bait his Blazing Stampede stun, then kite backward. Never let him land first hit
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite better, but Udyr's Wingborne Storm damage scales hard
- Spike: His first tank item is dangerous. You need range and mobility to survive
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you have distance. Catch Udyr overextending; burst him before he closes
- Wave: Slow-push sideways. Avoid pushing into him; deny him engage angles and gank setup
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge—the extra burst speed lets you kite his gap-close and stun attempts
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip—boosts durability against his mixed damage and enhances your survivability in prolonged fights

sivir__fizz.notes:
- Fizz's Urchin Strike dash all-ins you; E Spell Shield blocks it but he'll wait for cooldown.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid close range where Fizz can dash-engage. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade distance.
- Bait his E Playful / Trickster before committing trades; dodge his W Seastone Trident bleeds by kiting backward.
- Post-6, Chum the Waters is a guaranteed engage tool; respect the range and position near escape routes.
- Watch for Fizz's first damage item spike around 10-12 minutes; play safer when he completes it fully.
- Your power window comes when Fizz's E is down; chase trades aggressively and use W Ricochet bounces.
- Slow-push waves to deny Fizz jungle ganks and maintain distance; hard-push only when E cooldown is confirmed.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain trades and poke; you'll extend fights where Fizz struggles most.
- Add Adaptive Helm into your build to reduce Fizz's W Seastone Trident bleed damage and magic pressure overall.

sivir__jinx.notes:
- threat: Jinx's Zap! slows and reveals you; Super Mega Death Rocket! executes from range
- early: Farm safely at distance; dodge Zap! by positioning behind minions and moving unpredictably
- trading: Bait Zap! with fake movements, then trade with Boomerang Blade; never chase her
- post6: Super Mega Death Rocket! pins you down; use Spell Shield reactively or position behind allies
- spike: First item spike around 10-12 minutes; respect her damage but maintain range advantage
- window: Mid-game teamfights where Spell Shield blocks Zap!; use On The Hunt to kite her
- wave: Slow-push to deny Zap! poke and force her to overextend or lose CS
- rune: Stormraider's Surge gives kiting power against her all-in attempts and Get Excited! procs
- item: Adaptive Force component or early Hexdrinker if Rocket! spam becomes overwhelming threat

sivir__rell.notes:
- Rell's Magnet Storm pulls you in, enabling her team to burst you down instantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her Shattering Strike range and avoid getting stunned early.
- Bait her Shattering Strike with positioning, then trade back with Boomerang Blade safely after.
- Post-6, Magnet Storm makes you vulnerable; position further back and use Spell Shield reactively.
- Her first armor item spike is dangerous; respect her increased tankiness and reduced burst.
- You have a window when Rell is dismounted and slowed; kite and trade then.
- Slow-push to control spacing; this lets you Spell Shield her mounted engage attempts safely.
- Take Lethal Tempo to scale attack speed and kite her effectively throughout the game.
- Add Maw of Malmortius after core for magic resist and shield against her burst.

sivir__warwick.notes:
- Warwick's R Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5 seconds; you cannot block it with E Spell Shield.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Warwick out-duels you early. Farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade, avoid close trades.
- Bait his E Primal Howl by positioning aggressively, then back off before he re-activates. Never fight when he hunts low-health targets.
- Post-6, Warwick gains extreme all-in threat. Stay healthy above 50% to avoid W Blood Hunt bonuses triggering against you.
- His first item spike (likely health or damage) empowers Q healing and E tankiness. Play safer; farm sideways instead of fighting.
- Your window comes when Warwick is above 50% health and far from you. Abuse R On The Hunt to kite and farm safely.
- Slow-push waves toward your tower. Force Warwick to chase into your range or lose farm; deny his W activation opportunities.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for consistent trading and extra health to survive his burst and all-in attempts.
- Add a Manamune or Essence Reaver second to scale attack speed and enable kiting with R On The Hunt active.

drmundo__azir.notes:
- Azir kites you with soldiers and shurima shuffle; dodge his poke before all-inning him.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Azir's range outpaces you early, so cs under tower and scale.
- Bait his soldier placement, then all-in when soldiers expire; dodge shuffle with predicting his angle.
- Post-6 Azir gains escape via ult shurima shuffle; your all-in window closes significantly, play patient.
- Azir first item (lost chapter or liandry's) spikes around 8-10min; respect damage but stay farming.
- Dr. Mundo dominates at level 9+ when tankiness peaks; force fights after boots two completed.
- Slow-push waves toward Azir's tower; forces him to clear and reduces his roam threat.
- Pick Grasp of the Undying; sustain through his poke and gain tankiness for mid-game teamfights.
- Consider early Spectre's Cowl; blocks magic damage and healing reduction from his potential teammates.

shen__mel.notes:
- Mel's long-range poke and CC chain lock you down; respect her engage distance.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke outranges you early, so farm defensively under tower.
- Dodge her E stun by moving unpredictably; bait it before committing to trades.
- Her ult makes her untargetable and slows; use your ult to save teammates instead.
- First item spike (Luden's or Crown) increases her poke damage; play around minions more.
- You spike when she wastes cooldowns; all-in immediately after her E or Q miss.
- Slow-push waves to set up ganks; she struggles against coordinated pressure and jungle help.
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; you need healing to survive her poke spam.
- Build Kaenic Lifeburst early to duel and sustain against her sustained magic damage poke.

shen__maokai.notes:
- Maokai roots you in place, then combos damage—avoid his Q knockup at all costs
- Play safe levels 1-3; his root combo trades favorably—farm at range, respect his all-in
- Bait his Q with movement, then trade back hard—never fight near his creep wave
- His ultimate pressures teamfights globally; use Taunt to stop channel or ult away proactively
- First item spike (Liandry's) hurts; punish him before completion by abusing cooldowns aggressively
- Level 6+ gives you map pressure; coordinate ganks while Maokai lacks roam threat
- Slow-push into him; force him to come to you, setting up your Taunt engage
- Take Grasp for sustain—Maokai's poke drains you, and Grasp sustain keeps you healthy
- Buy Adaptive Helm after core items to mitigate his sustained Liandry's damage output

drmundo__neeko.notes:
- Neeko's root from her E stuns you, preventing Regeneration and leaving you vulnerable to burst
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her root range and farm from distance with Cleaver
- Bait her E root by moving unpredictably, then all-in her when it's on cooldown
- Post-6 her ult root becomes devastating; play around fog of war and respect teamfight positioning
- First item spike around 1100g is dangerous; play safer until you complete your first item
- You spike harder at level 9 with maxed Regeneration; punish her then in extended trades
- Slow-push to stack wave; forces her to engage or lose CS, limiting her roam threat
- Take Grasp for consistent sustain and poke trading; helps offset her harassment in laning
- Purchase Force of Nature early if she builds AP heavy; reduces her burst damage meaningfully

drmundo__bluecasterminion.notes:
- Threat: Blue Caster Minion's sustained magic damage poke chunks your health relentlessly
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3; dodge its projectiles by moving unpredictably, farm safely at range
- Trading: Avoid extended trades; bait its auto-attack then all-in with Cleaver + Masochism
- Post6: Your ult sustain hard-counters its poke; abuse this advantage to dominate lane
- Spike: Danger spike at Liandry's completion; respect its burst, don't greed for CS
- Window: Post-6 all-in window when ult is ready; dive it if minion wave favors you
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions; forces Blue Caster Minion to overextend or take tower damage
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; healing amplifies against repeated poke damage over time
- Item: Add Adaptive Helm after core items; negates its repeated spell damage effectively

drmundo__sightward.notes:
- Sight Ward provides no threat; it cannot trade, fight, or damage you meaningfully
- Level 1-3: farm safely and freely; Ward cannot contest CS or threaten all-ins
- Trading: Ward cannot trade back; abuse this by hitting it whenever it walks up
- Post6: Ward gains no ultimate; matchup remains completely one-sided in your favor indefinitely
- Spike: Ward has no item spikes; it never becomes dangerous at any point
- Window: your entire laning phase is a window; dominate freely from minute one onward
- Wave: push constantly; Ward cannot defend or punish; crash waves into turret repeatedly
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; free damage stacks every few seconds on helpless target
- Item: no counter-item needed; build your standard tank items and ignore this non-threat

drmundo__honeyfruit.notes:
- Honeyfruit's sustained poke and kite pressure slowly wears you down; avoid extended fights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range, dodge Honeyfruit's fruit projectiles, don't chase.
- Bait out Honeyfruit's cooldowns before trading; use Cleaver to close gaps and trade back.
- Post-6 your ult sustain scales better; use it to out-trade Honeyfruit's poke damage.
- Watch for first item spike around 10-12 minutes; it's not a major threat window.
- Your power window is mid-game when tankiness stacks; all-in when Honeyfruit wastes cooldowns.
- Slow-push waves to stack them and force Honeyfruit to interact; controls her poke range.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for healing trades and bonus tankiness scaling throughout game.
- Buy Adaptive Helm second or third to reduce Honeyfruit's poke and enhance healing efficiency.

drmundo__samira.notes:
- Samira dashes in with W, combos you down fast—dodge her spacing or kite backward always
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance and avoid her all-in range near minions
- Bait her W dash, then E her during recovery; don't trade while she has passive stacked
- Post-6 her ult resets dash range—respect it, kite harder, don't clump near teammates in lane
- First item spike (Manamune or Dirk) is her danger window—farm safer, scale into teamfights instead
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when she wastes ult; engage front-to-back and let her burn cooldowns
- Slow-push waves into her so she must overextend chasing; gives you jungle gank setup window
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading harassment; sustain keeps you healthy through her aggressive poke
- Build Hollow Radiance second to reduce her burst damage and heal more from her harass

drmundo__kalista.notes:
- Kalista kites you infinitely with passive mobility; dodge her spear poke or die slowly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early damage and kiting outscale yours—farm under tower.
- Never chase Kalista sideways; bait her spear, then all-in when she's committed.
- Post-6 her support gains engage tools; play safer and group for teamfights faster.
- First Manamune spike hurts; respect her damage window but punish with sustain advantage.
- Level 9+ you outduel her when she overextends; look to all-in isolated Kalista.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces her to engage into minions favoring your tankiness.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling against her constant poke damage.
- Buy Adaptive Helm after core tank items to reduce her repeated spear damage.

sivir__malzahar.notes:
- Malzahar's voidlings and ultimate suppress lock you down; respect his all-in potential always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from distance and dodge voidling aggression near minions.
- Bait his E onto minions, then trade with Q; never let voidlings stack free.
- Post-6 Malzahar becomes a kill threat; position near teammates and respect suppress range.
- His first Liandry's spike hurts; play safer then and punish his mana gate.
- Sivir dominates before 6; push wave and force him to clear or lose cs.
- Slow-push sidewaves; this denies him roam power and lets you kite his voidlings.
- Take Lethal Tempo; attack speed lets you kite voidlings and duel him better.
- Rush Quicksilver Sash; suppresses counter lets you survive his engage and fight back.

sivir__illaoi.notes:
- Illaoi lands tentacle slam on you; gets massive damage and healing if you're caught
- Play safe behind minions; dodge her Q tentacles; farm at range with autos and W
- Bait her Q with positioning, then sidestep hard; never let her E grab your soul
- Her ultimate creates zone control; kite away or use Sivir ult to disengage cleanly
- Illaoi spikes hard with Sheen and HP; respect her all-in; don't get isolated
- Sivir gains edge after Manamune or when teamfights start; kite her tentacles with mobility
- Slow-push side lanes; avoid fighting in river; group for teamfights where tentacles matter less
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and kiting; Illaoi pokes hard and you need mobility
- Buy early Manamune for mana sustain; consider Adaptive Helm if tentacle poke becomes overkill

sivir__malphite.notes:
- Malphite ultimate stun locks you down; position far back and respect his engage range always
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from distance and avoid pushing into his zone
- Bait his Q poke then trade back; dodge his abilities and reposition immediately after each trade
- Post-6 his ultimate becomes lethal; stay grouped with team and never face-check river or jungle
- His Sunfire spike around item two creates sustained damage; abuse him before he completes first item
- You spike harder mid-game with crit items; punish him when he lacks ultimate cooldown restoration
- Slow-push waves to deny him roam timing; maintain pressure so he cannot impact other lanes
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and kiting; you need healing to survive his poke phase
- Rush Maw of Malmortius if he stacks magic damage; it blocks burst and gives lifesteal

sivir__yunara.notes:
