- Yunara's all-in combo chains CC and burst; respect her engage range and kite backwards always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Q, avoid her melee range completely.
- Bait her dash-in, then E her follow-up damage; trade only when her combo is down.
- Post-6 her ultimate extends her threat range; play further back and respect teamfight initiation danger.
- First item spike makes her extremely tanky; don't force fights—scale and farm safely instead.
- Sivir spikes harder mid-game with items and passive procs; group and teamfight when you have 2+ items.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance and control; never hard-push into her; let her come to you.
- Take Lethal Tempo for extended teamfights and kite potential; scaling wins this matchup decisively.
- Consider Maw second or third item if she stacks magic damage; defensive stat helps survive her.

sivir__urgot.notes:
- Urgot's tentacle legs extend his effective trade range; respect the threat and maintain distance.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Q poke and avoid going near minions carelessly.
- Bait his Q, then punish with autos and W while he recovers from cast.
- Post-6 Urgot executes you under half health; play around map pressure, never extend alone.
- First item spike (Manamune or Hullbreaker) makes him tankier; use this window to scale safely.
- Your power spike comes mid-game with crit items; kite and group with team fights.
- Slow-push waves to deny him all-in opportunities and set up jungler ganks safely.
- Fleet Footwork sustains his poke and helps kiting; Resolve secondary for extra durability here.
- Grab Maw of Malmortius if Urgot builds early Black Cleaver for the magic shield.

sivir__chogath.notes:
- Threat: Cho'Gath's silence locks you down; his feast ult deletes you if caught out of position
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect his all-in if he lands knock-up; farm from max range with autos
- Trading: Dodge his knock-up with Sivir E or side-stepping; never trade if his silence cooldown is up
- Post6: Massive danger spike; Feast ult one-shots you; position behind teammates and never face-check bush alone ever
- Spike: His Rylai's or Liandry's spike is dangerous; abuse him while immobile; kite and punish his slow waveclear
- Window: You outscale and out-damage him mid-game; use teamfights where allies peel; avoid one-versus-one scenarios always
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes to create distance; prevents all-in engages; rotate to teamfights only when grouped safely
- Rune: Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and kite potential; Grasp is wasted since he avoids short trades anyway
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his burst and silence damage; delays your damage but keeps you alive longer

drmundo__rumble.notes:
- Rumble's Flamespitter burns you down fast; respect his damage range and heat management windows
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Cleaver, avoid his close-range harass entirely
- Bait his Flamespitter cooldown, then all-in with Cleaver spam; never trade while he's overheated
- Post-6 his Equalizer ult zoning is devastating; play around it with positioning or wait for cooldown
- Rumble's first item spike (Protobelt/Liandry's) hurts hard; farm safely and scale into your tankiness advantage
- You spike when Rumble falls behind or runs low on mana; punish overextended positioning then
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Rumble to either shove and get ganked or lose CS safely
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; you need health stacking to survive his burn damage
- Grab Adaptive Helm early to reduce his burst and ongoing burn damage threat significantly

sivir__ziggs.notes:
- Ziggs bombs chunk you from range; dodge skillshots or he controls lane spacing entirely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Q poke and farm from distance with autos.
- Bait his Q with lateral movement, then trade back with W when he whiffs.
- Post-6 his ult zoning is oppressive; play around map pressure and don't overextend.
- His Luden's spike hurts; abuse his weak early game before first back completes.
- You outscale and duel better post-3-items; survive lane and pivot to teamfight win condition.
- Slow-push to deny his poke damage and set up gank windows for your jungler.
- Take Manaflow Band; you need mana sustain to farm safely and match his poke.
- Build Hexdrinker second if losing lane hard; the shield blocks his burst effectively.

sivir__garen.notes:
- Garen silences you with his Q dash, eliminating your ability to kite or use Spellshield defensively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his all-in range and farm with autos from maximum distance only.
- Bait his Q dash, then reposition sideways; never trade directly when his silence is available for you.
- Post-6, his execute ultimate threatens you harder than most matchups; play further back and respect kill range.
- Garen's Stridebreaker spike (first item) is a major danger window; avoid short fights during this period.
- Sivir punishes Garen hardest in mid-game teamfights where distance and peel champions protect your backline positioning.
- Push the wave to deny him jungle gank setup; force him to chase you or lose CS.
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and kiting; you need the extra mobility to escape his engage.
- Purchase Manamune second-third item for mana sustain; lets you spam abilities to maintain safety distance always.

sivir__lulu.notes:
- Lulu's poly and slow chain you down; kite away from her support and respect her range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance and avoid extended trades where Lulu lands multiple abilities.
- Bait her E shield on minions, then trade when it's down; dodge her Q with sidestepping.
- Post-6 Lulu gains peel and engage threat; respect her ult and play around your team's engage.
- Watch for Lulu's first-item spike around 10-12 minutes; respect her utility but it's not a hard spike.
- You outscale and damage teamfight at three-item; position safely in fights and shred with Q bounces.
- Slow-push sidewaves to create pick opportunities; avoid hard-pushing into Lulu's setup for ganks and teamfights.
- Take Lethal Tempo for extended kiting and positioning; you need attack speed to abuse her squishiness.
- Consider Maw as a later defensive option if Lulu's poke and CC stack become unbearable problems.

sivir__akshan.notes:
- Akshan's grappling hook mobility lets him dodge your Q and all-in you with guaranteed damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm under tower when possible and respect his hook range threat.
- Bait his hook with fake positioning, then trade back hard with Q; never extend alone.
- Post-6 Akshan gains revive potential on kills, making him harder to punish—play safer and group.
- First item Manamune spike (around 10-12 min) increases his poke; farm safer and respect distance then.
- Sivir spikes at three items when mana is abundant; kite and teamfight at that point.
- Slow-push to stack waves, forcing Akshan to either cs or roam; limits his all-in setup.
- Take Grasp for extra sustain to mitigate poke damage from his consistent hook harassment.
- Build Kaenic Lifebane third to reduce his burst and heal through his magic damage poke.

sivir__akali.notes:
- Akali's all-in dive with shroud reset kills you; respect her burst and kite backward always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Q and avoid her melee engage attempts.
- Bait her Q or shroud, then trade with W; never chase into fog of war.
- Akali becomes lethal; her ultimate lets her gap-close; play with teammates and use E preemptively.
- Her first item spike (gunblade) is dangerous; respect her all-in but punish waveclearing mistakes then.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you; group with team and kite; her isolation is her weakness.
- Push the wave out; deny her shroud access and force her to roam or ult.
- Take Glacial Augment; the slow helps kite and escape Akali's inevitable dive and all-in attempts.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius second; the spell shield blocks burst and lifeline prevents her one-shot.

drmundo__bluemeleeminion.notes:
- Blue Melee Minion has no meaningful threat; farm safely and avoid unnecessary trades.
- Levels 1-3: Safe farm. CS normally and abuse Mundo's sustain when poked slightly.
- Trading: Bait minion aggro onto yourself, then trade back with Q. Dodge nothing.
- Post6: Matchup remains unchanged; Mundo's ult sustain outscales minion damage output completely.
- Spike: Blue Melee Minion has no spike. Mundo dominates whenever he builds tankiness.
- Window: Entire laning phase favors Mundo. Outheal minion damage and scale infinitely.
- Wave: Slow-push to build waves. Minion cannot contest large pushes; take free plates.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustain stacking synergizes with Mundo's passive healing.
- Item: Adaptive Helm later if minion wave pushes heavily; prioritize core tank items.

drmundo__bluesiegeminion.notes:
- Blue Siege Minion's cannon shot deals massive damage; respect its range and positioning threat
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Cleaver, avoid pushing into cannon range
- Bait the cannon shot by moving unpredictably, then trade with Mundo Cleaver during its reload
- Post-6, your ultimate sustain lets you absorb cannon damage; use it to all-in when available
- Watch for cannon first-item spike; it's a punish window—play behind minions and scale instead
- Your power window comes mid-game when tankiness stacks; force fights away from cannon's positioning angle
- Slow-push to stack minions; this denies cannon clean shots and sets up gank assistance
- Take Grasp for consistent sustain scaling against poke; trading frequency matters more than burst
- Build Adaptive Helm after your core to reduce the cannon's sustained magical damage output significantly

drmundo__raptor.notes:
- Raptor's high mobility and burst damage catches you out of position or low on health easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at tower range and avoid extended trades near river bushes.
- Bait Raptor's gap-closer, then trade back with Cleaver while moving toward your tower for safety.
- Post-6 Raptor gains chase potential; use your ultimate defensively to survive ganks and extended fights.
- Watch first item spike around 1100g; play safer but don't lose farm—it's a gank window.
- Punish Raptor when cooldowns are down; all-in after dodging their combo and forcing them to retreat.
- Slow-push to stack minions; this lets you engage safely on your terms with minion advantage.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for consistent healing and tankiness to survive Raptor's burst trades.
- Buy Force of Nature early if Raptor deals heavy magic damage; adjusts your survivability significantly.

drmundo__viktor.notes:
- Viktor's laser beam and upgraded Hex Core burst combo delete you if caught immobile.
- Play safe at range; farm with cleaver. Avoid pushing; respect his level 2 damage spike.
- Bait his E laser before trading; dodge it, then all-in with W active.
- Post-six, his ult zoning gets worse; play around fog of war and avoid center lane.
- First upgrade (Glyphs) hurts hard; farm safely until you hit level 6 and sustain advantage.
- Levels 9-11 when your cleaver spam and regeneration outpace his poke and mana efficiency.
- Slow-push side lanes to deny his wave clear value; group mid only when ahead.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; it scales better than Stormraider's into his repeated poke.
- Buy Adaptive Helm second after Sunfire to reduce his repeated laser damage and sustained burn.

drmundo__karma.notes:
- Karma's poke and kite chain you down; respect her range and positioning advantage always
- Play safe level 1-3; farm from range with cleaver, avoid her empowered Q root setup
- Let her waste empowered abilities; trade after she uses root, then all-in with E active
- Post-6 she gains mobility and shield strength; your all-in window closes, play safer teamfight role
- First item spike (Luden's or Liandry's) makes her poke lethal; farm safer, don't force fights
- Your window is levels 4-5 before her items; abuse this with E-empowered aggression and ganks
- Slow-push into her; force her to answer waves, preventing constant harassment and roaming threats
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading; health scales your healing and gives late-game durability
- Consider Adaptive Helm second; reduces her ability damage and shields, improving your sustained survival rate

kogmaw__akali.notes:
- Akali's W Twilight Shroud makes her untargetable; you cannot kite or damage her effectively.
- Play safe and farm with Q Caustic Spittle from range; avoid pushing wave early.
- Bait her W Twilight Shroud, then back off; never chase into shroud or die.
- Post-6, Perfect Execution gap-closes instantly and executes you; play near towers and teammates only.
- First item spike is dangerous; Akali gains kill pressure and all-in threat immediately after.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Akali is on cooldown post-fight; punish her E Shuriken Flip cooldown.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam and control jungle proximity; stay grouped when pushed.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for survival and poke trading when she commits forward.
- Add Kaenic Lifeline to survive her burst and apply healing reduction into her all-in.

kogmaw__ahri.notes:
- threat: Ahri's Charm stops you cold; her mobility lets her kite and escape your range easily
- early: Safely farm from max range with Caustic Spittle; avoid walking up into Charm range at levels 1-3
- trading: Bait out her Charm before committing; trade back only after she wastes it on a minion
- post6: Spirit Rush gives Ahri three escape dashes; she becomes significantly harder to lock down or punish
- spike: Her first Luden's-type item spike is dangerous; you lack mobility to escape her burst and charm
- window: Mid-game when you complete two items; your Bio-Arcane range and Living Artillery kite her effectively then
- wave: Slow-push sideways; maintains distance from Ahri while letting you farm safely and scale toward your power spike
- rune: Guardian provides a shield buffer against her burst combo and Charm followup damage in lane
- item: Abyssal Mask gives you magic resist, sustain, and reduces her magic damage output significantly

kogmaw__alistar.notes:
- Alistar's Pulverize and Headbutt combo locks you down; you die if caught immobile.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge toward lane walls when Alistar advances aggressively early.
- Bait his Pulverize by positioning near minions, then trade with Caustic Spittle and autos.
- Unbreakable Will blocks your damage and crowd control; focus on kiting and poking instead.
- First item spike (Sunfire or similar) is moderate danger; abuse range advantage before he completes.
- Kog'Maw spikes at three items with range and damage; Alistar falls off relative to you.
- Slow-push side lanes to create space; prevent Alistar from engaging your team in river.
- Grasp sustains you through poke trades and improves short trades when Alistar commits early.
- Hollow Radiance blocks his burst and reduces his engage damage output meaningfully late.

kogmaw__akshan.notes:
- threat: Akshan's Heroic Swing mobility and Avengerang boomerang burst catch immobile Kog'Maw off-guard constantly
- early: Dangerous; Akshan out-trades at level 2. Play safe, farm with Q, avoid close range
- trading: Never fight when Akshan has Heroic Swing ready. Bait it, then trade with W
- post6: Living Artillery range advantage matters; use it to poke him down before he all-ins
- spike: First item is dangerous window. Stay max range, kite backward, don't get caught grouping
- window: Mid-game teamfights where Akshan lacks grapple terrain. Position safely, let allies engage first
- wave: Slow-push sideways; denies Akshan all-in terrain angles and keeps you safer from ganks
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains poke damage and scales durability into midgame fights
- item: Hollow Radiance; blocks Avengerang burst, reduces his magic damage output meaningfully over fights

kogmaw__ambessa.notes:
- threat: Ambessa's Public Execution suppresses you; dash-reset with Drakehound's Step lets her stick and burst.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range with Bio-Arcane Barrage; Ambessa wins short trades with Cunning Sweep damage.
- trading: Dodge Cunning Sweep, then spam Caustic Spittle from distance; never let her dash into you.
- post6: Lethal. Public Execution eliminates your kiting; play further back and use Void Ooze for escape.
- spike: First item spike is dangerous. Respect her engage range; stay beyond her dash initiation window.
- window: Post-first-item when your poke outdamages her all-in; abuse range advantage before she completes defenses.
- wave: Slow-push toward your tower; force her to walk into your range or miss wave pressure.
- rune: Grasp for sustain durability; Ambessa cannot burst you as easily when you heal from trades.
- item: Hollow Radiance for armor and healing amplification; counters her mixed burst and sustained pressure.

kogmaw__amumu.notes:
- Amumu's Q stun into R locks you down; you explode before kiting away.
- Play safe behind minions; Amumu's Q range is shorter than your Caustic Spittle.
- Bait Q with positioning, then trade back with Caustic Spittle and auto-attacks.
- Amumu R is a teamfight tool that neutralizes your damage output entirely.
- First item spike is moderate; maintain distance and punish his cooldowns relentlessly.
- Your spike comes mid-game when you build attack range and kite tools.
- Slow-push waves to deny Amumu roam angle and keep him pushing back.
- Lethal Tempo or Fleet Footwork—sustain and attack speed both let you kite.
- Abyssal Mask or Kaenic Lifeline reduces his magic damage and curse amplification.

kogmaw__aphelios.notes:
- Aphelios' long-range poke with Calibrum marks you for massive followup damage consistently.
- Play safe behind minions; Aphelios outranges you early—avoid extended trades at all costs.
- Never walk into Calibrum marks; bait his Q then retaliate with Caustic Spittle.
- Living Artillery reaches farther than his guns; use R to trade safely from distance.
- His first item spike is dangerous; respect Calibrum range and play further back temporarily.
- Post-15 minutes when your attack speed and health scaling ramp, punish his positioning.
- Slow-push to stack minions; force Aphelios to farm closer, reducing his effective range advantage.
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and kiting tools against his constant poke pressure.
- Build Abyssal Mask early to reduce his magic damage and increase your effective tankiness.

kogmaw__annie.notes:
- threat: Annie's Pyromania stun locks you down; Summon: Tibbers burns you while immobilized.
- early: Dangerous. Stay back; Annie out-trades you levels 1-3. Farm safely with Q poke.
- trading: Never fight when Annie has stun stacked. Bait her spells, then trade with W.
- post6: Summon: Tibbers creates a sustained threat zone. Play further back; use R to kite.
- spike: First item spike is moderate danger. Respect her all-in; maintain distance and positioning.
- window: After Annie wastes Pyromania stun on wave, you have 5+ seconds to pressure or trade.
- wave: Slow-push to deny her engage angles. Keep distance from Annie; control side positioning.
- rune: Hail of Blades. Enables fast W attack speed to kite and duel at range.
- item: Hollow Radiance. Reduces her burst damage and keeps you alive through Tibbers burns.

kogmaw__anivia.notes:
- Threat: Anivia's Crystallize wall traps you; Flash Frost stun chains into lethal burst combo.
- Early: Dangerous—respect Flash Frost range; stay behind minions and play safe until level 3.
- Trading: Bait her Q with sidestepping; trade back with Caustic Spittle when her cooldowns reset.
- Post6: Glacial Storm zone control forces you further back; position at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range.
- Spike: First item spike (Rod of Ages or Liandry's) around minute 12—respect damage; farm safely.
- Window: After her Flash Frost misses, immediately push damage with Caustic Spittle and attacks.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; avoid mid where Crystallize walls lock you into ganks easily.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying—sustain through poke and extended trades you'll initiate safely.
- Item: Quicksilver Sash—cleanse Flash Frost stun before Frostbite or Glacial Storm followup lands damage.

kogmaw__ashe.notes:
- Threat: Enchanted Crystal Arrow stun locks you; dodge or die from follow-up burst.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions, avoid Volley cone, farm safely with Caustic Spittle poke.
- Trading: Bait Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then trade hard with Bio-Arcane Barrage. Never walk straight.
- Post6: Lethal threat. Reposition constantly, use map awareness, respect 5000-range arrow stun every 100 seconds.
- Spike: First item spike dangerous for Ashe. Respect her damage window, play safer, scale.
- Window: Mid-game when you have two items and Living Artillery range. Poke and kite.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways. Deny her Enchanted Crystal Arrow setup; position unpredictably for safety.
- Rune: Grasp sustain versus Volley poke; farm health advantage to survive arrow trades.
- Item: Abyssal Mask blocks her magic damage and reduces her burst threat significantly.

kogmaw__aurelionsol.notes:
- Aurelion Sol's Astral Flight mobility and Breath of Light range let him kite and burst you endlessly.
- Play safe behind minions; his Q outranges you early. Farm with Caustic Spittle to avoid close trades.
- Bait his Astral Flight cooldown, then trade with Bio-Arcane Barrage. Never chase him into his Singularity.
- His Falling Star stun and sustained damage spike hard; respect his ult range and reposition constantly.
- First item spike is dangerous; abuse the window before he finishes it to farm aggressively with range.
- Mid-game when he needs to teamfight; position behind allies and punish if he wastes Astral Flight.
- Slow-push to stack minions; forces him to choose between defending or roaming, limiting his kite angles.
- Take Grasp for sustain into his poke; healing offsets Breath of Light chip and lets you duel.
- Build Kaenic Lifebelt for magic resist and healing; blocks his burst and mitigates Singularity pull damage.

kogmaw__aurora.notes:
- Aurora's mobility and invisibility let her gap-close and burst you before you kite away safely.
- Play safe behind minions; her Q Twofold Hex range threatens early trades—don't get caught extended.
- Bait her W Across the Veil invisibility, then position to land Q Caustic Spittle when she reappears.
- Her R Between Worlds gives chase and zone control—stay maximum range and use R Living Artillery to poke.
- First-item spike is moderate danger; farm safely and scale—your W Bio-Arcane Barrage outranges her early-mid.
- Mid-game when you complete core items, your range and sustained damage edge her burst rotation.
- Slow-push toward her tower to control wave; prevents her from freely roaming and flanking you.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for survivability and sustain against her poke and all-in attempts.
- Build a Kaenic Lifeburst to survive her burst rotation and convert your damage into self-healing.

kogmaw__azir.notes:
- Azir's Sand Soldiers kite you infinitely; you cannot chase or all-in him safely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect Arise! range and poke with Caustic Spittle only.
- Dodge Conquering Sands by moving sideways; never trade into multiple Sand Soldier hits.
- Emperor's Divide knocks you back and negates your range advantage; respect the ultimate.
- First item spike is dangerous; Azir gains sustained damage you cannot duel into.
- Kog'Maw has no true window; focus on scaling and letting team engage Azir.
- Slow-push to deny Azir safe roams; keep wave near your tower for safety.
- Take Lethal Tempo; attack speed lets you kite back and duel his soldiers.
- Add Abyssal Mask early; reduces his magic damage and lets you survive poke.

kogmaw__belveth.notes:
- Bel'Veth's dash and knockup close gap instantly; you have no escape when caught.
- Play safe behind minions; her Q is her only threat but dodge it easily.
- Never trade when her abilities are up; bait Q then kite backward with W.
- Her ultimate transforms her into an unkillable duelist; respect range and disengage hard.
- First item spike is immediate danger; farm safely and respect her all-in potential then.
- You spike when she wastes cooldowns; punish with R and kite with W active.
- Slow-push to deny her roam pressure and create safe farming distance from her engage.
- Take Grasp for survivability and poke; sustain pressure without committing to extended trades.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for tank stats and magic resist against her magic damage.

kogmaw__blitzcrank.notes:
- threat: Rocket Grab catches you out of position; one hook ends your teamfight instantly.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions, respect Rocket Grab range, farm safely with Caustic Spittle.
- trading: Never trade when Rocket Grab is up. Bait it, then all-in with Bio-Arcane.
- post6: Living Artillery lets you poke safely from distance; Blitzcrank Static Field silences you mid-cast.
- spike: First item is moderate threat. Keep distance; your range advantage grows as you scale.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where Blitzcrank wastes Rocket Grab; punish with kiting and Living Artillery spam.
- wave: Slow-push side lanes to limit Rocket Grab engagement; teamfight near objectives only.
- rune: Hail of Blades for faster burst trades when Blitzcrank misses Rocket Grab early.
- item: Hollow Radiance gives health and mana shield interaction; layers defense against grab setup.

kogmaw__bard.notes:
- Bard's Cosmic Binding stun locks you down; Tempered Fate ult removes you from fights entirely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Bard's early poke with Meeps hurts. Farm from max range with W.
- Never fight near walls—Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits terrain. Bait his Q, then trade back.
- Post-6, Tempered Fate removes you mid-fight or ult. Play around cooldown; fight when it's down.
- Bard's first item spike is moderate. You spike harder with attack speed; abuse that window.
- Mid-game teamfights when Bard's cooldowns are down and you have W active. Burst him then.
- Slow-push waves into tower; prevents Bard roaming to gank. Stays safe and denies his map pressure.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against poke and extra health against his burst.
- Grab Kaenic Lifebringer to tank his magic damage and shred his healing shrine utility.

kogmaw__brand.notes:
- Threat: Brand's Blaze stacking and Pyroclasm bounces delete you; respect his zone control always.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Brand out-ranges you pre-W, avoid his Q at all costs.
- Trading: Never trade into ablaze targets; bait Q, then punish with W autos from distance.
- Post6: Pyroclasm chains through teamfights; position behind teammates and use E to kite his engage.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's typically) threatens you; respect his damage spike, farm safer, scale patiently.
- Window: Post-three items you outrange and outdamage; group with team and force his ult on you.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; avoid clumping in narrow lanes where Pyroclasm bounces maximize against you.
- Rune: Grasp for sustain and trading durability; Brand pokes and Blaze burns, Grasp mitigates both.
- Item: Abyssal Mask blocks magic burst; reduces his spell damage and Blaze tick effectiveness meaningfully.

kogmaw__braum.notes:
- Braum's E Unbreakable blocks your Q and W projectiles; play around shield cooldown.
- Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid trading into his Q Winter's Bite.
- Bait his E Unbreakable with Q Caustic Spittle, then trade with W attacks safely.
- Glacial Fissure's knockup and slow massively threaten you; position deeper or kite perpendicular.
- First item doesn't spike Braum dangerously; abuse levels 7–9 before his tankiness compounds.
- Post-9, when Braum completes Hollow Radiance or Kaenic, your window narrows significantly overall.
- Slow-push waves into him; force him to engage at your tower or miss CS.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain pressure and surviving his Q poke.
- Consider Mortal Reminder if Braum stacks healing; otherwise prioritize Void Staff for magic pen.

kogmaw__briar.notes:
- threat: Briar's Head Rush and Blood Frenzy lock you down; you die if caught.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range, farm with Caustic Spittle, never let her gap close.
- trading: Bait Head Rush, then Void Ooze retreat. Never trade close; she out-duels you.
- post6: Certain Death marks you; kite backwards immediately or you're caught and feared.
- spike: First armor item hurts; stay further back and spam Caustic Spittle poke.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you position safely behind allies; Briar wastes ult chasing.
- wave: Slow-push sideways; denies her engage angle and lets you kite toward tower.
- rune: Grasp provides survival HP pool; Briar's bleed healing scales poorly against it.
- item: Plated Steelcaps reduce her armor-break value and slow her chase attack speed.

kogmaw__cassiopeia.notes:
- Cassiopeia's Miasma grounds you, shutting down kiting and escape tools entirely.
- Play safe; her Q poke has longer range. Farm with Q from distance.
- Never walk into Miasma. Bait her W before trading; dodge backward always.
- Petrifying Gaze stuns you if facing her. Position sideways or back away.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and grounding combo.
- Punish her when W is down; kite with Bio-Arcane Barrage at range.
- Slow-push to maintain distance and deny her roam opportunities safely.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; extra MS helps you escape Miasma and kite better.
- Buy Abyssal Mask to mitigate her poison damage and survive her burst.

kogmaw__caitlyn.notes:
- Threat: Caitlyn's Headshot and traps lock you down while dealing burst; you lack escape.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; dodge Piltover Peacemaker. Never walk into Yordle Snap Trap range.
- Trading: Avoid her auto-attack range entirely. Bait Yordle Snap Trap, then Caustic Spittle and farm safely.
- Post6: Living Artillery outranges Ace in the Hole slightly; use it to poke and control space.
- Spike: First item spike (usually crit item) is dangerous. Play safer; scale with Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Window: Mid-game when you have two items and Void Ooze slows her approach; kite backward.
- Wave: Slow-push toward her tower. Forces her to overextend into Void Ooze or lose farm.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain into her poke damage and extended trades.
- Item: Quicksilver Sash blocks Ace in the Hole and cleanses trap slow effects early.

kogmaw__camille.notes:
- threat: Camille's Hookshot closes gap instantly; her Hextech Ultimatum locks you down for guaranteed damage
- early: Dangerous. Stay back; abuse Caustic Spittle range to harass safely before she reaches level 2
- trading: Bait Hookshot onto walls, then kite backward with Bio-Arcane Barrage attacks; never face her directly
- post6: Extremely dangerous. Hextech Ultimatum guarantees all-in; position near teammates or maintain maximum distance always
- spike: First item spike is her danger window; you cannot duel her; prioritize safety and farming
- window: Late game teamfights where you kite from backline and she cannot reach you through peel
- wave: Slow-push sideways; deny her wall access for Hookshot while maintaining escape route toward tower
- rune: Grasp for survivability and poke; converts short trades into sustained health advantage over Camille
- item: Hollow Radiance blocks her burst damage and Hextech Ultimatum bonus magic damage effectively

kogmaw__corki.notes:
- Corki's Missile Barrage and Phosphorus Bomb burst from range; dodge or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Corki out-ranges you early, farm under tower.
- Bait Valkyrie cooldown, then trade with W attack speed and Q armor shred.
- Post-6, Corki's Big One missiles are lethal; respect range and reposition often.
- First item spike is dangerous; sit back and farm safely until you scale.
- Your window opens mid-game when W range and percent health damage spike hard.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces Corki to choose between farming and harrassing you.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness against Corki's poke-heavy ranged harassment pattern.
- Build Adaptive Helm second or third to neuter his magic damage and poke.

kogmaw__darius.notes:
- Darius runs you down with Apprehend pull and Hemorrhage stacks into Noxian Guillotine execute.
- Play safe behind minions; Darius Q outer blade chunk is massive, avoid close trades entirely.
- Never let him stack Hemorrhage past two; kite backward and use Void Ooze to slow his advance.
- Post-6 Noxian Guillotine range is lethal; maintain maximum distance or he executes you at low health.
- His first item spike (Sterak's or similar) makes him tanky and harder to burst; respect the power.
- You spike when Kog'Maw hits two items with attack speed; kite from range and exploit cooldowns.
- Slow-push waves to keep minions near your tower; forces Darius to overextend or miss farm safely.
- Take Grasp for survivability and tankiness; sustain helps you survive his early all-in pressure attempts.
- Purchase Kaenic Lifebelt or Force of Nature early; reduces his bleed damage and gives you bulk.

kogmaw__diana.notes:
- threat: Diana dashes through Lunar Rush with no cooldown on Moonlight targets, one-shotting you easily.
- early: Safely farm. Diana outranges you early; avoid her Q arc. Play passive until level 6.
- trading: Never trade into her. Bait Q, then kite backward. Her dash range exceeds yours.
- post6: Diana gains lethal all-in threat with Moonfall slow into Lunar Rush. Do not face-check.
- spike: First item (Nashors or similar AP) makes her burst dangerous. Play further back, hug tower.
- window: After Diana ults and misses or on long cooldown, push for poke and farm advantage.
- wave: Slow-push side lanes. Avoid midlane where Diana zones you. Force her to roam or lose.
- rune: Grasp. Sustain gap-closes her burst pressure and rewards safe kiting with tankier poke procs.
- item: Hollow Radiance. Reduces her magic damage and slows her chase, letting you kite safely.

kogmaw__draven.notes:
- Draven's Spinning Axe damage and Stand Aside knockback punish your immobility hard.
- Play safe behind minions; respect Stand Aside range and don't contest level 2.
- Dodge Stand Aside; use Void Ooze to create space and slow his approach.
- Living Artillery becomes your primary damage tool; use range advantage to kite backward.
- Draven's first crit item is dangerous; stay behind minions and farm safely then.
- Kog'Maw scales better; win teamfights with Bio-Arcane Barrage range and poke with Living Artillery.
- Slow-push to deny Draven all-in opportunities; deny him catching axes near your tower.
- Take Grasp for survivability and scaling; sustain helps you survive his early pressure.
- Add Adaptive Helm or Abyssal Mask to reduce his repeated burst damage output.

kogmaw__drmundo.notes:
- Mundo's Q slows you, then closes with W+E; you lack escape tools against his pressure.
- Play safe at range; his Q cooldown is long early; abuse gaps between his throws.
- Bait his Q, then trade with W auto-attacks; never let him close the gap freely.
- His R healing makes extended fights terrible for you; burst him down or disengage immediately.
- His first item spike (likely health item) makes him unkillable; play for poke with R instead.
- Mid-game when he lacks items and your W damage scales; abuse range advantage heavily then.
- Slow-push to deny his all-in; maintain distance so his Q travels farther and misses easier.
- Grasp gives him sustain matching yours; consider Lethal Tempo to kite and shred him faster.
- Add Liandry's Torment to burn through his health stacking and maximize W percent damage output.

kogmaw__ekko.notes:
- Ekko's Phase Dive gap-close and Chronobreak escape make him slippery; you lack disengage tools.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ekko out-trades you early. Farm with Caustic Spittle from distance.
- Never chase Ekko into fog. Bait Phase Dive, then kite backward; dodge Timewinder rewind.
- Chronobreak nullifies your burst windows. Wait for him to commit before unloading; he'll heal anyway.
- Ekko's first item spike hurts but isn't terminal. Position deeper; abuse your range advantage then.
- Kog'Maw peaks mid-game with attack speed items. Kite Ekko before he rotates and groups.
- Slow-push side lanes; deny Ekko roam pressure. Group only when you have clear positioning safety.
- Pick Grasp for survivability and trading sustain; helps you survive early before ranged dominance kicks in.
- Add Adaptive Helm if Ekko builds AP; reduces his burst and Chronobreak heal effectiveness.

kogmaw__elise.notes:
- Elise's Cocoon stun locks you down; follow with Spider Form all-in burst kills you.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge Cocoon at all costs. Farm with Caustic Spittle from range.
- Bait her Cocoon, then trade back hard with Bio-Arcane Barrage. Never stand predictably.
- Post-six Elise dives with Rappel; position near towers and spam Void Ooze for kite.
- First Liandry's or Zhonyas spike hurts; stay grouped and avoid isolated positioning during her window.
- Your power spike is two items with maxed Bio-Arcane Barrage; kite and duel with range.
- Slow-push to maintain distance from her all-in range; deny her gank setup windows.
- Take Grasp for sustain into her poke and all-in pressure throughout the laning phase.
- Add Zhonyas as fourth or fifth item; it counters her burst and Rappel engagement threat.

kogmaw__evelynn.notes:
- threat: Evelynn gaps you with E Whiplash speed, charms with W Allure, then ults to delete you.
- early: Safe farm. Stay near tower. Evelynn lacks early kill threat; use this to scale safely.
- trading: Never fight when W Allure is available. Bait it out, then trade with Q Caustic Spittle.
- post6: Respect R Last Caress range constantly. Play around minimap. One rotation can kill you instantly.
- spike: Her first item spike is moderate danger. You scale better; don't force fights into her ult.
- window: Kog'Maw spikes harder mid-game with attack speed and W Bio-Arcane Barrage damage. Abuse this window.
- wave: Slow-push sidewaves to safety. Prevents her from roaming freely and forces her to answer push.
- rune: Glacial Augment slows her gap close and lets you kite. Pairs perfectly with your attack range.
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip heals you through her burst and weakens her W Allure charm effectiveness.

kogmaw__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Fiddlesticks fears you into his team while you're immobile; Terrify + Crowstorm combo kills you.
- Safe farm early; stay max range with W. Ward river; Fiddlesticks needs fog to threaten.
- Bait Reap with positioning, then kite backward. Never let him get close enough for Terrify range.
- Crowstorm forces you to position far back or die; adjust positioning preemptively when unseen.
- After Liandry's or Zhonyas, Fiddlesticks becomes significantly harder to kite; respect his damage spike immediately.
- When Fiddlesticks is visible and on cooldown, pump out damage with W and R freely.
- Slow-push; you need minion buffer to safety. Never hard-push into river fog without vision.
- Stormraider's Surge; the movement speed escape tool is mandatory against Terrify lockdown patterns here.
- Quicksilver Sash early stops Terrify fear; build it third if Fiddlesticks snowballs or gets ahead.

kogmaw__fiora.notes:
- threat: Fiora's Lunge and Duelist's Dance Vitals allow her to all-in and burst you before you kite safely away
- early: Dangerous — Fiora out-trades you. Stay max range with Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid close-range Caustic Spittle trades early
- trading: Never fight in Fiora's melee range. Bait Riposte with Void Ooze or Living Artillery, then trade after cooldown
- post6: Existential threat — Grand Challenge reveals you, she gains speed hunting Vitals. Stay grouped or ultra-safe in side lanes
- spike: Fiora's first item-spike (Trinity Force or Stridebreaker) is dangerous. Farm safely and don't force fights until you scale
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you position behind front-line — Fiora must decide between chasing you or fighting your team
- wave: Slow-push to deny her all-ins. Build wave for jungle gank setup; gives you room to kite toward allies
- rune: Grasp of the Undying — sustains you in poke trades and scales into teamfights where you stay at range
- item: Hollow Radiance — reduces her burst and slows her attack speed, letting you kite her Lunge engages better

kogmaw__fizz.notes:
- Fizz's E untargetability and Q dash allow him to engage and dodge your W damage safely.
- Play safe behind minions; Fizz Q range is shorter than yours, so kite back and poke Q.
- Bait his E before committing to trades; once down, land W hits and kite backward consistently.
- Fizz ult at 6 forces you further back; stay near tower and use R to trade safely.
- Fizz first item spike is dangerous; respect his all-in potential and maintain maximum distance always.
- Post-12 minutes when you scale harder; kite and group with team to abuse range advantage.
- Slow-push to maintain distance from Fizz; deny him easy engage angles and control side-lane space.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling to survive Fizz all-ins and poke damage.
- Add Kaenic Lifeline if Fizz rushes burst; the shield and heal reduction counter his burst pattern.

kogmaw__galio.notes:
- Galio's W Shield of Durand taunts you, forcing bad positioning and interrupting Caustic Spittle casts.
- Play safe behind minions; Galio's Q Winds of War damage is frontloaded, dodge it early.
- Bait E Justice Punch by repositioning sideways, then counter-trade with Caustic Spittle and Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Post-6, Galio's Hero's Entrance shields allies and knocks up; stay grouped with team or get isolated.
- First item spike (Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern) reduces your damage output; farm safely, don't force fights.
- Your window is when Galio's W and E are on cooldown; spam Living Artillery from distance.
- Slow-push waves to deny Galio engage opportunities and maintain safe distance from his taunt threat zone.
- Pick Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and late-game tankiness against his magic damage.
- Build Hollow Radiance to reduce Galio's magic damage and provide grievous wounds if he builds durability.

kogmaw__gangplank.notes:
- Gangplank's Cannon Barrage slows and zones you; Powder Keg combos burst you down.
- Play safe; Parrrley outranges your damage. Farm with Q from distance, avoid melee.
- Dodge his Powder Keg explosions by spacing. Bait his W Remove Scurvy before trading.
- Cannon Barrage limits your positioning; expect frequent zoning. Stay mobile and behind minions.
- First item spike (Trinity, Essence Reaver) around 10 minutes; play safer, farm methodically.
- Mid-game when Gangplank itemizes defensively and his cooldowns extend; punish with poke.
- Slow-push sideways; avoids his Cannon Barrage central zone and lets you farm safely.
- Grasp of the Undying gives sustain against poke and Powder Keg chip damage.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip for tankiness and crowd-control immunity to Cannon Barrage slow.

kogmaw__garen.notes:
- Garen's Decisive Strike silence locks down your kiting; his sustained Judgment damage melts you fast.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid trades. Farm at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range when possible.
- Bait his Decisive Strike by repositioning, then Void Ooze to create distance and slow him.
- Demacian Justice executes; respect it hard. Stay healthy and position far back after level six.
- First armor item (Kaenic Righteousness or Hollow Radiance) hurts your damage; farm safely and scale.
- When Garen wastes Decisive Strike cooldown, trade with Caustic Spittle and kite backward with W.
- Slow-push waves into tower. Forces Garen to chase you or lose CS; buying Void Ooze time.
- Grasp sustains into poke trades; Aftershock gives you survival against his all-in Judgment combo.
- Build Quicksilver Sash or Maw of Malmortius to counter his burst and survive extended fights.

kogmaw__gnar.notes:
- threat: Mega Gnar's E Crunch stun into R GNAR! combo deletes you instantly
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Gnar's short range lets you kite with Q Caustic Spittle
- trading: Bait his Q Boomerang Throw, then trade with W Bio-Arcane Barrage while he retrieves it
- post6: R GNAR! transforms him into massive threat; play behind minions and respect wall stun angles
- spike: First item spike matters less; danger escalates when Gnar reaches Mega form threshold consistently
- window: Punish early before Rage builds; abuse W Bio-Arcane Barrage range when Gnar is mini-form
- wave: Slow-push toward him; keeps Gnar away from walls and limits R GNAR! wall-stun potential
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain survives his poke and converts range advantage into health
- item: Hollow Radiance; magic resist and health counter his percent damage and burst combo threat

kogmaw__gragas.notes:
- threat: Gragas E Body Slam stun chains into burst; dodge or you die instantly
- early: Dangerous; stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage, avoid pushing near Gragas
- trading: Bait E Body Slam, then kite backward; never fight when his cooldowns up
- post6: Explosive Cask knocks you into his team; position deeper, respect massive engage range
- spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) dangerous; play safer, don't get caught overextended
- window: Mid-game when Gragas lacks cooldowns; spam Q Caustic Spittle and R Living Artillery
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; deny him kill setup, maintain distance for artillery safety
- rune: Grasp sustain helps survive poke; healing softens his Drunken Rage and burst damage
- item: Zhonya's Hourglass stops Explosive Cask knockback chain; delays burst long enough for team

kogmaw__graves.notes:
- Graves' close-range burst and mobility let him all-in and escape before you retaliate effectively.
- Play safe behind minions; his Q is telegraphed, dodge it. Don't trade early—you lose.
- Bait his Quickdraw, then W and Q him when he's committed. Never fight point-blank.
- Living Artillery gives range advantage, but Collateral Damage threatens all-ins. Stay near walls for escape.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect his damage window and farm safely from distance.
- Mid-game teamfights where you have range advantage and he's caught without reload ammo ready.
- Slow-push to deny his Quickdraw engage range. Keep minions pushed away from your position.
- Grasp sustains poke trades and builds tankiness against his burst patterns and repeated engages.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his burst magic damage and provides health pool for survivability buffer.

kogmaw__gwen.notes:
- threat: Gwen's W Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable; you cannot kite or pressure her safely.
- early: Dangerous. Gwen out-trades you levels 1-3; stay max range, avoid her Q cone damage.
- trading: Never trade into her W. Bait her mist, then E Void Ooze retreat or R Living Artillery poke.
- post6: Gwen gains kill pressure with R Needlework slow and repeat casts; respect her all-in threat.
- spike: First item spike (likely Riftmaker or Nashor's Tooth) strengthens her sustained damage; farm safely, use R.
- window: Mid-game when Gwen lacks cooldown reduction; punish long W cooldown with R Artillery spam and kiting.
- wave: Slow-push side lanes. Gwen struggles to clear fast; deny her dive angle and maintain spacing.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustain helps you survive her poke and heal through her passive damage.
- item: Abyssal Mask. Reduces her magic damage amplification and gives you tankiness to survive skirmishes.

kogmaw__hecarim.notes:
- Hecarim closes gap with E, knocks you back, and all-ins with R before you kite away safely.
- Play safe near tower; Hecarim can't threaten you pre-6 without good setup. Farm with Q from distance.
- Bait his E charge, then kite backward hard. Never stand still; dodge his Q cleave pattern.
- Onslaught of Shadows gives him engage tools you can't escape. Play further back; use R defensively.
- His first item spike (Trinity Force) is dangerous. Respect his damage and maintain maximum distance always.
- Late-game teamfights favor you when Hecarim wastes E. Position safely and deal true damage through W.
- Slow-push sideways. Avoid feeding him free charges. Keep minions away from river to deny E engage.
- Take Grasp for poke damage and durability when he runs you down or all-ins you.
- Buy Rylai's Crystal Scepter for slow on W hits and R shots to kite his charges.

kogmaw__heimerdinger.notes:
- Heimerdinger's turrets deal constant damage; you cannot duel him near them safely.
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; dodge E grenades and avoid trading near turret range.
- Bait his E grenade, then W-trade when he repositions; never all-in near turrets.
- Living Artillery outranges turrets; use R to poke and reveal him from safety.
- His first item spike (Liandry's or Rylai's) increases turret pressure; farm safely, don't fight.
- Kog'Maw spikes at two items with attack speed; kite and W-duel away from turrets.
- Slow-push waves into his turret range so minions crash near your tower, not his.
- Grasp of the Undying for sustain and HP to survive turret poke damage.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early if turret poke overwhelms; it reduces ability damage significantly.

kogmaw__hwei.notes:
- threat: Hwei's Q and E replace abilities; dodge Devastating Fire and Grim Visage or get burst.
- early: Safe farm. Hwei lacks reliable damage early; stay back, let him push, farm safely.
- trading: Bait his Q and E casts, then punish with W attacks from distance safely.
- post6: Spiraling Despair creates a large slow zone; position at max W range to kite out.
- spike: First item (likely Luden's) increases burst; respect it but your W range still outranges him.
- window: Mid-game, before Hwei completes second item; you out-duel him with sustained W damage pressure.
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; forces Hwei to respond while you farm safely at distance.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite Despair slows and dodge follow-up Q or E casts.
- item: Abyssal Mask reduces Hwei's magic damage and lets you survive his burst combos better.

kogmaw__illaoi.notes:
- Illaoi's W Harsh Lesson gap-closes and triggers Tentacles; you die if caught.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge W Harsh Lesson at all costs early.
- Bait W Harsh Lesson, then trade with Q Caustic Spittle from distance.
- Leap of Faith Illaoi ult spawns Tentacles; retreat and kite from range.
- First item spike is dangerous; stay max range and avoid all-in trades.
- Post-15 minutes when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage out-scales Illaoi's melee pressure.
- Slow-push to control Illaoi's all-in window; never let her dictate fights.
- First Strike maximizes poke and scaling gold advantage over Illaoi's limited range.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline for survivability; blocks Tentacle swings and Harsh Lesson damage.

kogmaw__irelia.notes:
- threat: Irelia gaps you with Bladesurge, stuns with Flawless Duet, then melts you in melee range.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range, respect her Flawless Duet stun setup, farm safely with Caustic Spittle.
- trading: Bait her Flawless Duet by positioning near minions, then kite backwards and spam Caustic Spittle.
- post6: Vanguard's Edge marks you globally; her all-in threat multiplies. Play further back, prioritize Living Artillery.
- spike: Her first item is dangerous. Respect the damage spike; maintain distance and rely on poke.
- window: When Irelia ult is down and she lacks marks on you. Use this for aggression.
- wave: Slow-push side lane. Forces her to choose between wave and roaming; limits her kill threat.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge. Extra kiting speed lets you escape her Bladesurge and Vanguard's Edge engage.
- item: Abyssal Mask. Reduces her burst damage and helps you survive her combo in extended fights.

kogmaw__ivern.notes:
- Rootcaller root locks you down; Ivern kites and allies dash in to burst you.
- Play safe; Rootcaller range is deceptive. Farm with Q from distance, respect brush ganks.
- Bait Rootcaller by walking perpendicular; dodge it, then W-attack him before he escapes.
- Daisy provides sustained damage and engage; stay farther back, use R to poke safely.
- First item spike (likely Liandry's) hurts but isn't lethal; maintain spacing and kite.
- Mid-game with R upgrades and levels; Living Artillery range and poke outscale his early.
- Slow-push to deny his brush control and prevent jungle proximity for Ivern ganks.
- Press the Attack for extended trading; W synergizes with attack-speed bonus and true damage.
- Kaenic Lifeline blocks Daisy's magic damage and shields against Rootcaller burst follow-up.

kogmaw__janna.notes:
- Janna's Monsoon R knocks you back and heals; you cannot safely position aggressively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Janna's poke with Zephyr W outranges your early damage output.
- Never chase Janna; bait Howling Gale Q, then reposition before Zephyr W slow lands.
- Post-6, Monsoon R becomes a teamfight reset tool; avoid committing without gank or numbers.
- Janna's first item spike is minimal; you can farm safely but cannot force trades.
- Your spike comes mid-game when Bio-Arcane Barrage W range and attack speed multiply.
- Slow-push waves into tower; force Janna to choose between defending and roaming support.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and scaling against Janna's poke pressure.
- Build Abyssal Mask early for magic resist and Janna ability cooldown reduction effect.

kogmaw__jarvaniv.notes:
- Jarvan's Q-E combo locks you down; Cataclysm traps you with no escape route available.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid extended trades when his Q is off cooldown threat.
- Bait his Q, then kite backward; never let him land both Q and E combo.
- Cataclysm creates an inescapable arena; position near walls or allies to minimize trapped time.
- His first completed armor item is dangerous; punish him before he finishes that purchase.
- Once you hit two items, kite and spam W from range; he cannot catch you.
- Slow-push waves to create distance; deny him engagement angles while maintaining safe farm position.
- Fleet Footwork provides necessary kite and sustain against his repeated close-range engagement attempts.
- Quicksilver Sash cleanse his debuffs and breaks his passive Martial Cadence bonus damage proc.

kogmaw__jax.notes:
- Jax Counter Strike dodges your Q and W, then stuns you for his all-in combo.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid extended trades. Farm with Q from distance when possible.
- Bait Counter Strike with Q before committing W damage; dodge his Leap Strike with positioning.
- Living Artillery becomes your poke tool; stay max range and avoid his E engagement window.
- His first item spike (Trinity Force or similar) is dangerous; respect damage and kite back.
- Mid-game teamfights where Jax can't reach you; abuse Living Artillery range advantage consistently.
- Slow-push toward his tower; deny him roam while maintaining safety and kite options.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke to survive early aggression and short-trade harassment.
- Consider Abyssal Mask after core items to reduce his burst and survive all-ins better.

kogmaw__jayce.notes:
- Jayce's Shock Blast and Thundering Blow burst combo catches immobile Kog'Maw out of position instantly.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; his Hammer Stance all-in with To the Skies kills you.
- Dodge Shock Blast by moving perpendicular; bait Thundering Blow before committing to extended trades.
- Post-6, Living Artillery outranges his Cannon Stance; use it to poke and control space safely.
- His first item spike (Manamune or Serrated Dirk) is dangerous; respect his damage window hard.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Jayce exhausts mana or after he wastes Shock Blast; punish positioning then.
- Slow-push waves into tower; forces Jayce to choose between shoving or roaming; limits his pressure.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against repeated poke and to scale tankier.
- Consider Kaenic Lifegrip to mitigate his burst and gain bulk against mixed damage threat.

kogmaw__jhin.notes:
- Jhin's Deadly Flourish and Curtain Call outrange your abilities; respect his poke threat.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Deadly Flourish, farm with Q when Jhin repositions away.
- Bait his Deadly Flourish by faking positioning, then trade with Q and autos immediately.
- Curtain Call pins you down; position behind minions and move unpredictably to avoid shots.
- First item spike (likely crit) is dangerous; respect his damage and play further back.
- Post-teamfight window when Jhin resets; use range advantage to kite and punish mispositions.
- Slow-push to stack minions; force Jhin into unfavorable all-ins where W outduels his range.
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading power; helps survive poke and win short fights.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip to pressure through his poke and survive Curtain Call volleys.

kogmaw__jinx.notes:
- Jinx's Zap! and Super Mega Death Rocket! outrange Bio-Arcane Barrage; respect poke damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Jinx minigun beats your early damage; farm with Q range.
- Dodge Zap! by moving unpredictably; bait her minigun then trade with W attacks.
- Super Mega Death Rocket! scales with missing health; stay healthy or play safer.
- Jinx first item spike is real; respect her damage window; scale into lategame.
- Kog'Maw scales harder lategame; punish her if she oversteps; kite with W range.
- Slow-push waves into tower; force her to choose between farm and roaming threat.
- Grasp sustains poke damage and scales into lategame teamfights; fits your scaling role.
- Abyssal Mask reduces her magic damage and strengthens your magic resist against poke.

kogmaw__ksante.notes:
- K'Sante's All Out transformation closes gaps and forces you into close range where you die.
- Play safe near tower; avoid trading early—K'Sante out-damages you in short trades before items.
- Dodge Path Maker dash; bait Q Ntofo Strikes then kite backward with W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- All Out is lethal—position far back, use R Living Artillery to poke safely from distance.
- First item spike is dangerous; stay behind minions and spam R to farm and harass safely.
- Mid-game when K'Sante lacks full items; abuse range advantage with W and R to chunk him.
- Slow-push to deny him all-in angles; maintain distance from walls to prevent R knockback into team.
- Grasp sustains short trades but Stormraider's Surge lets you kite faster—Surge wins this matchup.
- Purchase Thornmail early if ahead; otherwise, Kaenic Rookern gives magic resist and cuts his healing.

kogmaw__kaisa.notes:
- Kai'Sa's Killer Instinct dash closes gap; her Plasma burst kills you before you kite away.
- Play safe behind minions; her early Plasma stacks hurt. Farm with Q, avoid short trades.
- Dodge her W Void Seeker mark; bait her E dash, then kite backward with W.
- Post-6, Kai'Sa threatens all-in; stay max range with W Bio-Arcane, spam R to zone.
- First item spike (Manamune or crit) lets her duel harder; respect her damage window.
- After Kai'Sa uses Killer Instinct, she's vulnerable; punish with R Living Artillery spam immediately.
- Slow-push waves into tower; forces Kai'Sa to overextend chasing you, letting supports engage her.
- Take Grasp; sustains poke trades and procs when she attempts short-range Plasma stacking.
- Buy Hollow Radiance; blocks her burst damage and protects teammates from her ult follow-up.

kogmaw__kalista.notes:
- Kalista's Rend spears stack fast; dodge Pierce and kite backward to avoid impale chains.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kalista out-trades early. Farm at range with Q, avoid melee.
- Bait her Pierce toward minions, then trade back with W attacks. Never face-check bushes.
- Living Artillery reaches further than her; use R to poke and control space post-6.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect her Rend damage. Farm safely, stack from range.
- Mid-game teamfights favor Kog'Maw; position behind team, use R for poke before Kalista engages.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam and force her to choose: farm or impact.
- Take Grasp for sustain and lane durability against her poke and all-in threat.
- Buy Plated Steelcaps early if dying to Rend; reduces her on-hit burst significantly.

kogmaw__karma.notes:
- threat: Karma's Focused Resolve roots you; land free damage while tethered and immobile
- early: Dangerous—Karma out-trades you levels 1-3; stay max range, avoid her Q-W combo
- trading: Never face-check; bait her Focused Resolve with positioning, then Caustic Spittle and trade back
- post6: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve becomes devastating root; respect the threat and play further back
- spike: First item around 1000g is dangerous; she gains poke pressure, farm safer and shorter
- window: Mid-game teamfights where she wastes Mantra on shields; punish with Living Artillery positioning
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; force her to choose between following you or defending tower
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain her poke and win extended trades with procs
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip; cleanse her root effect and gain tankiness against her sustained damage

kogmaw__karthus.notes:
- Requiem is unavoidable full-map damage; survive it with positioning and healing items.
- Play safe and farm at range; dodge Lay Waste by staying mobile.
- Bait Lay Waste onto minions, then Bio-Arcane Barrage trade while he recovers cooldown.
- Requiem forces you into cover; position near terrain or allies to survive channel.
- First item spike is moderate danger; maintain distance and respect his mana pool.
- Mid-game teamfights favor Kog'Maw when Karthus must position forward to deal damage.
- Slow-push to deny Karthus safe farming; force him to choose between farm or roam.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and scales into late game.
- Kaenic Lifeburst converts his magic damage into healing, reducing Requiem threat significantly.

kogmaw__kassadin.notes:
- Kassadin Riftwalk gap-closes and one-shots you; you lack escape tools to survive his burst.
- Play safe behind minions; use Caustic Spittle to harass and reduce his resistances early.
- Bait his Null Sphere shield, then trade with Bio-Arcane Barrage and auto-attacks; dodge Force Pulse.
- Riftwalk makes him untouchable; stay max range, use Living Artillery to reveal and damage him.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect his all-in range and maintain distance during his powerspike.
- Kog'Maw punishes Kassadin pre-6 and during mana-starved phases; abuse early lane dominance before Riftwalk.
- Slow-push waves to deny Kassadin roams and force him to farm closer to your range.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite away from Riftwalk engages and escape his burst attempts.
- Build Abyssal Mask to reduce his magic damage and sustain through his poke and trades.

kogmaw__katarina.notes:
- Katarina's Shunpo closes gap instantly; you die if caught without escape or peel.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid clumping. Caustic Spittle if she approaches; kite away immediately.
- Bait her Shunpo by positioning near but not in her engage range, then kite.
- Death Lotus forces you immobile; position far back and rely on support or terrain.
- First item spike (Nashor's Tooth or similar) is dangerous; respect her all-in threat window.
- Mid-game teamfights where support peels for you and Katarina lacks reset opportunity arise.
- Slow-push to deny her gank setup; maintain distance from lane bushes where she hides.
- Grasp of the Undying grants tankiness and sustain against her poke and pressure.
- Zhonya's Hourglass stops Death Lotus if caught; delays her reset and saves you.

kogmaw__kayle.notes:
- Kayle's Divine Judgment makes you vulnerable; her Starfire Spellblade burst chunks you hard.
- Play safe and farm at range with Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid trading level one.
- Dodge Radiant Blast; bait it out before committing to extended trades with her.
- Divine Judgment counters your all-in; respect it and kite backwards when she ults.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; play safer and stack range advantage passively.
- Mid-game when cooldowns matter; burst her before Divine Judgment comes off cooldown.
- Slow-push to maintain distance and control; let her push into your team safely.
- Take Grasp for sustain in poke trades; it mitigates her Starfire Spellblade harassment.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early to reduce her Starfire burst and improve survivability overall.

kogmaw__kayn.notes:
- Kayn's Umbral Trespass locks you down and deals massive burst; you cannot kite mid-channel.
- Play safe behind minions; Kayn has weak early waveclear and limited all-in threat pre-6.
- Dodge Blade's Reach slow; use Bio-Arcane Barrage range to kite away from his dashes.
- Umbral Trespass makes you an easy target; position deeper in fights post-6 to reduce hit.
- First item spike is moderate; stay far back and rely on range advantage to punish.
- Win condition is mid-game teamfights; Kog'Maw outranges and shreds Kayn if you maintain distance.
- Slow-push waves to maximize range safety; avoid pushing into river where Kayn can flank easily.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness to survive his burst windows and mid-game skirmishes.
- Build Hollow Radiance for armor and health; reduces his physical burst and Darkin healing threat.

kogmaw__kennen.notes:
- Kennen stuns you repeatedly with Mark of the Storm; avoid grouping or getting marked three times.
- Play safe at range; dodge Thundering Shuriken and farm with Caustic Spittle and Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Never fight close; bait his Lightning Rush cooldown, then kite backward while attacking with W.
- Slicing Maelstrom forces you to spread out; position near walls or use range advantage heavily.
- His first item spike is real danger; farm safer and avoid extended fights until you scale.
- Late game teamfights favor Kog'Maw; Living Artillery pokes from safety while Kennen ult forces positioning errors.
- Slow-push waves to deny him all-in engage opportunities; maintain distance and kite toward towers.
- Choose Grasp of the Undying for sustained tankiness and health scaling into his early aggression.
- Build Abyssal Mask early to reduce his burst and sustain through his ability spam.

kogmaw__khazix.notes:
- Kha'Zix isolates you with E+Q combo; you die instantly without peel or distance.
- Play safe behind minions; farm ranged, avoid pushing; Kha'Zix can't isolate you in wave.
- Dodge his W spike; bait E leap away from you, then punish with Q.
- His R makes him invisible and triggers isolation; stay grouped or hug tower hard.
- First item spike (Serrated Dirk) is lethal; respect his all-in; play ultra-safe then.
- Post-first-item when he lacks cooldowns; kite backward and spam R; he can't close gap.
- Slow-push to maintain minion proximity; never let him flank; deny isolation windows completely.
- Take Glacial Augment; slowing his E and Q keeps distance and prevents isolation kills.
- Buy Thornmail or Hollow Radiance early; reflect damage punishes his burst and reduces lethality threat.

kogmaw__kindred.notes:
- Kindred's E Mounting Dread locks you down for Wolf's massive damage burst.
- Play safe early; Kindred out-duels you pre-6. Farm under tower, avoid skirmishes.
- Never eat E slow without kiting backward. Bait their Q, then trade back.
- Lamb's Respite negates your R Living Artillery burst; hold ult for cleanup.
- First item spike is dangerous; you lack defensive stats. Hug tower, scale safely.
- Post-10 minutes when you finish two items; they can't lock you down.
- Slow-push waves to deny Kindred roam success and maintain farming safety distance.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness against their repeated all-in attempts.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip to heal through their burst and strengthen your defenses.

kogmaw__kled.notes:
- Threat: Kled's E Jousting dash closes gap fast; his Q Bear Trap locks you down hard.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid close range. Farm with Q Caustic Spittle from distance only.
- Trading: Bait Kled's E Jousting, then reposition. Never trade when he has W Violent Tendencies stacked.
- Post6: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! gives Kled engage tools. Stay far back; use R Living Artillery to poke safely.
- Spike: Kled's first item spike hurts. Play passive, farm safely, abuse R Living Artillery range advantage.
- Window: Mid-game when Kled dismounts Skaarl. All-in immediately; he deals reduced damage to you then.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways. Avoid extended fights near river; deny Kled flank angles for Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engage.
- Rune: Take Lethal Tempo. Scales into late-game where your W Bio-Arcane Barrage dominates extended fights.
- Item: Quicksilver Sash stops Bear Trap lockdown. Cleanse Q's shackle before the yank damage hits.

kogmaw__leblanc.notes:
- LeBlanc's E into R combo locks you down and bursts before you can kite or reposition safely.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid pushing. Her W-Q combo at level 2 threatens all-in; respect range.
- Never chase her chains or stand still. Bait W with positioning, then kite backward with Q attack speed.
- Mimic makes her combo deadlier; respect her burst window. Stay farther back; use R to poke safely.
- First Hextech item spike (Verdant Barrier or Zhonyas) is dangerous; farm safely and avoid extended fights then.
- Mid-game teamfights where she's used rotation cooldowns; punish with R poke. Late, you outrange and out-dps her.
- Slow-push to deny her roam windows and keep her near lane. Prevents her from snowballing sidelanes hard.
- Grasp provides sustained lane durability and health scaling against her burst; safer than early mana-dependent runes.
- Abyssal Mask or Hollow Radiance adds health and magic resist; strengthens survival against her combo pattern.

kogmaw__leona.notes:
- Threat: Leona E stun chains into Q stun, trapping Kog'Maw with no escape tools.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; stay max range, dodge E Zenith Blade at all costs.
- Trading: Never trade into Leona directly; use Q Caustic Spittle from distance only, never commit.
- Post6: Solar Flare ult massively threatens you; respect positioning and play behind minions constantly.
- Spike: Leona's first item spike (armor/magic resist items) is your punish window; farm safely instead.
- Window: Kog'Maw spikes at three items with attack speed; abuse range advantage when Leona ult down.
- Wave: Slow-push toward your tower; deny Leona engagement range and allow jungler rotation safety.
- Rune: Take Grasp for sustain into poke; you survive her all-in attempts longer this way.
- Item: Add Hollow Radiance after core attack speed; the magic resist and heal counter her damage.

kogmaw__leesin.notes:
- Lee Sin's Q-Resonating Strike combo gaps you fast; Dragon's Rage kicks you into his team.
- Play safe near tower; dodge his Q at levels 1-2, farm with W and E safely.
- Never trade when his Flurry is active; bait Q then kite backward with W active.
- Dragon's Rage at six makes you extremely vulnerable; position behind minions and request jungle help.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; stay grouped and avoid isolated positioning then.
- You spike when he's on cooldown after failed Q; punish with Living Artillery poke spam.
- Slow-push to keep minions closer to tower; prevents his all-in gap-close from one-shotting you.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke trading; lets you whittle him down safely from range.
- Buy Hollow Radiance for health and magic resist; neutralizes his burst and protects against kicks.

kogmaw__lissandra.notes:
- Lissandra's W Ring of Frost roots you in place, making you an easy target for her combo burst
- Play safe behind minions; her Q Ice Shard outranges your early damage, so respect poke and farm passively
- Dodge her W Ring of Frost by positioning away from her; bait it out before committing to trades
- Post-6, Frozen Tomb stunning you means certain death; play further back and use R Living Artillery to stay safe
- Her first major item spike (Liandry's or similar) is dangerous; respect her burst potential and maintain range advantage
- Kog'Maw spikes when Lissandra has no ultimate or when she wastes W Ring of Frost; punish cooldowns immediately
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam threat and maintain a minion buffer between you and her W Ring of Frost
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain trades in lane and minor durability against her burst damage
- Build Hollow Radiance for magic resist and health; it scales your survivability against her magic damage burst

kogmaw__lillia.notes:
- Lillia's sustained magic damage and kiting with Q Move Speed stacking prevents your trades from finishing her.
- Play safe near tower; her W range is deceptive early. Farm with Q when she approaches.
- Bait her Q activation, then Caustic Spittle her as she closes. Never chase into slowed zones.
- Lilting Lullaby sleep disables you completely; position far back and buy early Quicksilver Sash to cleanse.
- Her first item spike (Liandry's or Demonic) accelerates her sustained damage; abuse cooldown windows before completion.
- Mid-game teamfights where she's isolated and exhausted from chasing; kite backward and burst with Living Artillery.
- Slow-push waves to create distance from her engage range; deny her multi-target W and E value.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains you against her poke; Adaptive Force helps your late-game scaling.
- Abyssal Mask reduces her magic damage and her Dream-Laden Bough proc potency; buy after core items.

kogmaw__lulu.notes:
- Whimsy turns you into useless critter; avoid getting caught out of position alone.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Lulu outranges you early and Pix harass hurts.
- Bait Whimsy on yourself, then all-in when it's down; dodge Glitterlance.
- Post-6 Wild Growth makes Lulu unkillable and shields her team; respect the engage.
- First item Lulu spike is real; farm safely and don't force fights early.
- Spike when you complete Liandry's Torment or gain range advantage with items.
- Slow-push to stack minions; force Lulu to choose between helping team or shoving.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health advantage into her poke harassment.
- Build Adaptive Force item like Banshee's Veil or Kaenic Lifeline for survivability.

kogmaw__locke.notes:
- Threat: Locke's Ashen Pursuit teleport-dash closes gap and locks you down before execution ult.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Locke out-trades close range. Farm from max Bio-Arcane range.
- Trading: Bait Ashen Pursuit teleport, then kite backward with Caustic Spittle slow. Never fight point-blank.
- Post6: Purgatory execute threat forces you farther back. Use Living Artillery to poke and reveal safely.
- Spike: Locke's first item spike (health-scaling with Silver Stake) hurts at 1-item; respect and space.
- Window: Post-first-item when you have range items, kite him endlessly. He needs gap close to threat.
- Wave: Slow-push toward your tower; force Locke to overextend or miss CS if he chases you.
- Rune: Grasp sustains chip damage from Silver Stake procs and makes extended trades favorable for you.
- Item: Kaenic Lifeline blocks execute damage from Purgatory and gives health to scale your percent damage.

kogmaw__lucian.notes:
- threat: Lucian's Relentless Pursuit dash and sustained Lightslinger damage close gaps and burst Kog'Maw
- early: Dangerous—stay behind minions; Lucian wins short trades with ability-proc double-shots; farm safely at range
- trading: Never trade into his Lightslinger proc window; bait Relentless Pursuit before committing to Q harass
- post6: The Culling forces you to kite backward or use E defensively; play wider positioning
- spike: First item spike (likely crit or lethality) is dangerous; respect his all-in threat window
- window: Post-6 when Living Artillery outranges him; abuse R poke and W max range from safety
- wave: Slow-push to deny his all-in angles and let minions absorb Lightslinger double-shot damage
- rune: Grasp sustains trades and extends all-in survival; synergizes with W on-hit and tank itemization
- item: Hollow Radiance reduces his burst and synergizes with W percentage damage and survivability needs

kogmaw__lux.notes:
- Threat: Light Binding roots you; follow with Final Spark combo that you cannot escape from safely.
- Early: Safely farm at range with Caustic Spittle; dodge Q by positioning behind minions consistently.
- Trading: Bait Light Binding by repositioning; trade only when her Q is down with Caustic Spittle.
- Post6: Final Spark range exceeds yours; stay behind minions and use Void Ooze to deny her engage.
- Spike: First item hurts but not devastating; abuse her vulnerable mid-game before she scales defensive items.
- Window: Mid-game when Lux lacks cooldown reduction; Living Artillery poke and Bio-Arcane Barrage duel her support.
- Wave: Slow-push to avoid isolation; maintain minion cover and deny her angle for Light Binding setup.
- Rune: Grasp provides tankiness against poke and sustain; extra health makes root-combo less immediately lethal.
- Item: Abyssal Mask reduces her magic damage and amplifies your magic; buy after core ADC items.

kogmaw__malphite.notes:
- Malphite Unstoppable Force engages you; you have no escape and die fast.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid going near river; farm with Caustic Spittle range.
- Never trade when Seismic Shard is up; bait it then reposition immediately after.
- Unstoppable Force at level 6 forces you to respect his all-in threat window.
- His first armor item spike matters less; you still out-damage him with Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Post-15 minutes when Malphite needs more cooldown reduction; kite and poke Living Artillery safely.
- Slow-push waves toward your tower; deny his engage range and protect your positioning.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain to survive his early harassment damage.
- Build Hollow Radiance after core to shred his armor and reduce his tankiness significantly.

kogmaw__malzahar.notes:
- Nether Grasp suppression locks you down; you die helpless if caught out of position.
- Play safe; farm at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range; avoid Malzahar's Q silence engage attempts.
- Dodge Call of the Void projectiles; don't trade into Void Swarm; kite backwards always.
- Nether Grasp ult makes you vulnerable; position deeper; never face-check without vision or backup.
- His first item spike is moderate; use it to farm safely and scale harder.
- Mid-game teamfights where Malzahar wastes Nether Grasp on allies; then you freely output damage.
- Slow-push to maintain distance and control; prevent him roaming; deny his gank setup attempts.
- Grasp sustains poke and health trades; keeps you healthy against Malefic Visions harassment pressure.
- Quicksilver Sash cleanses Nether Grasp suppress and Malefic Visions DoT; build early if needed.

kogmaw__mel.notes:
- Threat: Mel's Overwhelm stacks enable Golden Eclipse burst that ignores distance and one-shots you.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades when Mel lands Solar Snare root.
- Trading: Bait Mel's Rebuttal before committing damage; dodge Solar Snare at all costs always.
- Post6: Golden Eclipse turns Overwhelm into lethal threat; stay grouped and reduce Overwhelm stacks fast.
- Spike: First item spike dangerous for Mel; respect her damage and play further back.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights when Mel lacks Overwhelm stacks or after her ult goes down.
- Wave: Slow-push to maintain distance; prevents Mel from landing Solar Snare on extended trades.
- Rune: Grasp provides sustained tankiness and healing to survive Mel's poke and burst attempts.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces Overwhelm damage and helps allies survive Golden Eclipse detonation damage.

kogmaw__maokai.notes:
- Maokai's W Twisted Advance roots you in place, leaving you vulnerable to follow-up damage.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid positioning where Maokai can dash-root you easily early.
- Bait his W with positioning, then kite back with Q Caustic Spittle and attack speed.
- His R Nature's Grasp wall locks you down; stay mobile and position perpendicular to advance.
- Maokai's first major item spike is moderate threat; abuse your range advantage before he completes.
