- Win window is mid-game when your W Bio-Arcane Barrage outranges his engage tools significantly.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance; avoid pushing into tower where Maokai can trap you.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain matches his P Sap Magic and strengthens poke trades.
- Add Abyssal Mask late to reduce his R Nature's Grasp and Q Bramble Smash damage.

kogmaw__masteryi.notes:
- threat: Alpha Strike untargetability lets Yi dodge your Q and close to kill range fast
- early: Safe farm. Stay max range with W. Never face-check bushes; Yi can all-in level 2
- trading: Bait Alpha Strike with positioning, then unload Q and E. Never trade melee range
- post6: Highlander makes Yi unstoppable and immune to E slow. Play further back; rely on R poke
- spike: First item (likely Blade of The Ruined King) is dangerous. Back off; don't let him engage
- window: Early game before Highlander and before his first item completes. Push and poke with R
- wave: Slow-push to keep wave near tower. Denies Yi flank timing and forces him to farm safely
- rune: Grasp for survivability and sustained poke damage in extended trades when you space correctly
- item: Force of Nature gives magic resist and move speed to kite Yi's relentless chase pressure

kogmaw__milio.notes:
- threat: Milio's Cozy Campfire extends ally range and heals, letting supports kite you indefinitely.
- early: Safe farm behind minions; Milio has no early kill threat but denies poke.
- trading: Avoid Ultra Mega Fire Kick knockback; bait it with positioning, then Caustic Spittle.
- post6: Breath of Life removes your Void Ooze slow and keeps allies alive through damage.
- spike: First item spike is low threat; punish Milio's immobility while he builds support items.
- window: Midgame when Milio lacks healing output; burst through shields with Void Ooze slow chains.
- wave: Slow-push to stack minions; forces Milio to choose between healing poke or waveclear.
- rune: Grasp sustains you into their healing while Campfire keeps you at range disadvantage.
- item: Liandry's Torment burns through shields and heals over time in extended fights.

kogmaw__missfortune.notes:
- threat: Miss Fortune's Bullet Time channels and one-shots you; avoid her cone at all costs always
- early: Dangerous levels 1-3; stay behind minions, respect Love Tap bonus damage on new targets constantly
- trading: Never trade into her Love Tap range; bait Q Double Up, then W Bio-Arcane harass back
- post6: Bullet Time becomes lethal; position behind terrain, never fight in open space when she channels
- spike: Her first crit item (Infinity Edge or Collector) spikes hard; respect range, farm safely then
- window: Post-Void Staff, you outdamage and out-range her significantly; abuse superior range with W poke relentlessly
- wave: Slow-push sidewaves; prevents her from roaming and forces her to farm, reducing Bullet Time impact
- rune: Grasp sustains against poke and converts W on-hits into healing; survives her early aggression better
- item: Hollow Radiance provides magic resist, health, and cooldown reduction against her damage and kiting threats

kogmaw__mordekaiser.notes:
- Threat: Death's Grasp pulls you close; Realm of Death isolates you from team peel
- Early: Safe farm. Stay outside Death's Grasp range; abuse range advantage with Bio-Arcane Barrage
- Trading: Bait Obliterate, then kite back. Never fight inside his Darkness Rise damage aura
- Post6: Realm of Death is devastating isolation. Play near teammates; avoid overextending without backup
- Spike: First item spike danger low. Kite and poke him down before he scales
- Window: Levels 1-5 before Realm of Death. Deal poke damage and maintain distance advantage
- Wave: Slow-push to control space and stay safe from Death's Grasp pull range
- Rune: Grasp for durability since you'll be poked; sustain helps against his trading
- Item: Rylai's Crystal Scepter slows enemies on your poke; kiting becomes easier and safer

kogmaw__morgana.notes:
- Morgana's Dark Binding roots you; you cannot kite or escape once caught
- Play safe behind minions; her Q is your only real threat level one
- Bait her Q cooldown, then trade with Caustic Spittle and autos freely
- Her Soul Shackles chains lock you down; position away from grouped enemies always
- Her first item completion is dangerous; dodge more and play further back
- Levels 9-11 when your Living Artillery range and Caustic Spittle cooldown spike hardest
- Slow-push to create distance; deny her all-in range and Q landing angles
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain through her poke and lock-down attempts
- Consider Adaptive Force item early if you need durability against her burst damage

kogmaw__naafiri.notes:
- Naafiri's packmates enable relentless all-in diving; you cannot kite forever without peel.
- Play safe behind minions; her Darkin Daggers combo punishes extended trades hard.
- Bait her Darkin Daggers or The Call of the Pack, then Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Her Hounds' Pursuit is devastating; position near allies or stay extreme backline always.
- First item spike is lethal; respect her damage window and play defensively until then.
- Mid-game teamfights where allies peel enable Kog'Maw to output sustained damage safely.
- Slow-push to deny her aggressive engagement angles; maintain distance from pack dive range.
- Grasp sustains poke damage and provides health to survive her all-in burst.
- Thornmail punishes her high-attack pack composition and reduces healing from her Eviscerate.

kogmaw__nami.notes:
- Aqua Prison stun locks you; position to avoid bubble zones and respect her range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nami outranges you early. Farm with Q, stay behind minions.
- Dodge Aqua Prison by spacing wide; bait it, then all-in with W attacks.
- Tidal Wave knocks you up and slows hard; position sideways, use R to kite back.
- First item spike is dangerous; she gains damage and utility. Farm safely, don't contest.
- Level 11 is your window; R cooldown drops, outrange and poke her down safely.
- Slow-push waves into her tower; forces her to use abilities on minions, not you.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; it scales better than damage runes into poke.
- Build Adaptive Helm into her repeated magic damage and healing reduction against her supports.

kogmaw__nasus.notes:
- Threat: Nasus stacks and closes gap with Wither, making you immobile and unable to kite.
- Early: Farm safely at max range with Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid short trades before level 2.
- Trading: Bait Wither, then kite backward with Caustic Spittle; never trade inside his Spirit Fire.
- Post6: Fury of the Sands closes gap and reduces Siphoning Strike cooldown; respect all-in attempts.
- Spike: First armor item (Kaenic Gauntlet or Hollow Radiance) is Nasus' danger window; farm safe.
- Window: Levels 1-5 before he scales; abuse range advantage and poke with Living Artillery.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny his freeze; prevent him from grouping or roaming mid easily.
- Rune: Hail of Blades for attack speed burst to burst him before Wither lands.
- Item: Kaenic Gauntlet reduces his armor stack value and his resistances during Fury engagement.

kogmaw__nautilus.notes:
- Nautilus' Dredge Line root chain locks you down; Depth Charge guarantees follow-up kills.
- Play safe behind minions; Nautilus Q range exceeds yours early. Dodge or die.
- Bait Dredge Line with positioning, then Caustic Spittle trade. Never fight near terrain.
- Depth Charge chases and knocks airborne; you cannot kite effectively. Full respect cooldown.
- First Sunfire or tank item spike hurts; abuse pre-6 window aggressively with Caustic Spittle.
- Levels 1-2 before his Dredge Line; late game when he runs out of mana.
- Slow-push waves into your tower; deny him anchor-to-minion flanks and jungle gank setups.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains poke damage and rewards your Q short-trade pattern.
- Hollow Radiance blocks his root chain damage and reduces Depth Charge knockup duration slightly.

kogmaw__neeko.notes:
- Neeko's E root locks you down; her R follow-up combo kills immobile Kog'Maw easily.
- Stay behind minions level 1-3; dodge Q seeds, farm safely with W poke from range.
- Bait her E root by positioning unpredictably; trade back with Q when she wastes cooldowns.
- Post-6 Neeko becomes lethal; respect her R preparation range and position near walls for escape.
- Neeko's first item spike is dangerous; play safer and stack range until you complete core.
- Kog'Maw spikes harder mid-game with items; abuse teamfights where her R can't isolate you.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam and keep minions away from her E engage range.
- Take Grasp for sustain pressure; the healing and poke help you survive her all-ins.
- Add Adaptive Helm to reduce her burst damage and R stun-combo threat significantly.

kogmaw__nidalee.notes:
- Nidalee's Javelin Toss and Takedown burst from fog of war one-shots you instantly.
- Play safe behind minions; respect brush control. Ward river and blue buff exits.
- Never trade when Nidalee has Javelin ready. Bait it out, then all-in with Q.
- Post-6, Pounce gap-close becomes lethal. Stay maximum W range; use E slow to kite.
- Her first item spike (Liandry's or Shadowflame) is your danger window; farm safely.
- Mid-game team fights favor you when Nidalee wastes cooldowns; then you duel her.
- Slow-push to deny her brush access and control. Prevent her roam effectiveness early.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; it lets you kite Pounce and escape Takedown range quickly.
- Add Quicksilver Sash if Nidalee snowballs; cleanse her burst setup and survive dives.

kogmaw__nilah.notes:
- Nilah's Slipstream gap-close and Apotheosis pull combo catches immobile Kog'Maw out of position easily.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid pushing up. Farm with Q from range when possible.
- Bait her Slipstream, then kite backward with W active; dodge Formless Blade by repositioning sideways.
- Her Apotheosis ult pulls you in—stay further back and use R to chunk her before engagement.
- First item spike is dangerous; expect all-in attempts. Play safer, maintain distance, position near tower.
- Post-first-item when Nilah lacks defense, punish with R poke and kite around terrain or minions.
- Slow-push to stack minions; denies her roam windows and lets you farm safely under tower.
- Take Grasp for sustain against her repeated Formless Blade poke and extended trades early.
- Buy Hollow Radiance or Force of Nature for tankiness and magic resist against her burst.

kogmaw__nocturne.notes:
- Nocturne's Unspeakable Horror fear locks you down; Paranoia blinds you and he dives.
- Play safe near tower; Nocturne out-trades you early. Farm with Q from distance.
- Never let him land Unspeakable Horror. Dodge sideways; bait his E before trading back.
- Paranoia is catastrophic for you. Play deeper, ward aggressively, and group with team always.
- His first damage item is dangerous. You're immobile and squishy; expect all-ins around minute eleven.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed and range. Abuse this before his items peak.
- Slow-push sideways lanes; never hard-push into river. You need vision safety and escape room.
- Glacial Augment or Predator works; you need tools to kite and survive his engage.
- Build Quicksilver Sash early to cleanse Unspeakable Horror fear and survive his burst combo.

kogmaw__nunuwillump.notes:
- threat: Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks you up; Absolute Zero locks you down immobile and vulnerable.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; dodge E Snowball Barrage roots at all costs.
- trading: Bait W Biggest Snowball Ever! sideways, then unload Q Caustic Spittle and autos. Never fight near Nunu.
- post6: Absolute Zero becomes lethal engage tool. Position near towers; use E Void Ooze to kite away always.
- spike: First Liandry's or Rylai's spike hurts. Play safer, farm at range, avoid mid-map skirmishes entirely.
- window: Kog'Maw scales harder late-game. Survive mid-game, get items, then dominate teamfights with R Living Artillery.
- wave: Slow-push sideways. Deny Nunu gank setup; maintain distance and safety, never push into river without vision.
- rune: Fleet Footwork. Movement speed lets you kite Biggest Snowball Ever! and escape Absolute Zero engagement zones.
- item: Rylai's Crystal Scepter. Slows from W attacks and R Living Artillery cripple Nunu's gap-close attempts.

kogmaw__olaf.notes:
- Olaf's gap close and true damage from Reckless Swing kill immobile Kog'Maw easily.
- Play safe behind minions; Undertow's armor shred and Move Speed reduction punish early aggression.
- Bait Undertow cooldown, then kite backward; never contest his axe pickup window.
- Ragnarok immunity lets Olaf ignore your kite—position far back and rely on poke range.
- Olaf's first damage item is dangerous; respect his all-in threat and farm safer.
- You spike when Olaf falls low health and can't teamfight; abuse Living Artillery poke.
- Slow-push to maintain distance and safety; prevent him from freezing near his tower.
- Grasp sustains poke damage and lets you survive his all-in attempts better.
- Liandry's Torment adds percent health damage to synergize with Bio-Arcane Barrage and W.

kogmaw__ornn.notes:
- Ornn's Searing Charge knockup traps you; his ult Brittle makes you take bonus damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ornn outranges you early. Farm with Caustic Spittle from distance.
- Bait his Searing Charge into terrain, then punish with Void Ooze and autos.
- Post-6 his Call of the Forge God forces you kite backwards; respect the ult.
- His first item spike is dangerous; play back until you complete Bio-Arcane Barrage items.
- Your power window is mid-game when Bio-Arcane Barrage and Living Artillery scale; abuse range.
- Slow-push waves to deny him easy terrain-charge angles; prevent him rotating to side lanes.
- Take Lethal Tempo for extended trading; Ornn's tankiness requires sustained attack speed and range.
- Build Liandry's Torment as a secondary item for sustained tank shred and health scaling.

kogmaw__orianna.notes:
- threat: Orianna's R Command: Shockwave launches you into enemies; stay spaced far apart always
- early: Safe farm levels 1–3; her Q Command: Attack outranges you, don't contest cs heavily
- trading: Bait her W Command: Dissonance, then Q Caustic Spittle her before she repositions ball
- post6: Command: Shockwave becomes lethal grouping tool; stay isolated and use E Void Ooze for spacing
- spike: First item-spike around Luden's Tempest is danger; respect her burst, farm safer distance now
- window: Post-first-item when you scale with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; she falls off relative to your percent damage
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; forces her to chase you isolated where R Living Artillery dominates
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; keeps you healthy against poke and strengthens scaling trades later
- item: Kaenic Lifeblade adds healing against her magic burst and improves W Bio-Arcane Barrage synergy significantly

kogmaw__pantheon.notes:
- Threat: Pantheon's Shield Vault stun locks you; you cannot kite or reposition safely.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; avoid close range. Let him push; farm safely under tower.
- Trading: Never trade into Shield Vault range. Bait his W cooldown, then Caustic Spittle harass.
- Post6: Severely dangerous. Grand Starfall covers map; you cannot safely position anywhere on map.
- Spike: First item spike is moderate threat. Focus on scaling; do not fight him early.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Pantheon cannot reach you. Position far back; use Living Artillery.
- Wave: Slow-push sidewaves. Force Pantheon to roam or lose CS; you scale better than him.
- Rune: Grasp for sustain and survivability against his constant Shield Vault all-in pressure.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip adds survivability against his burst and shields his damage simultaneously.

kogmaw__poppy.notes:
- Poppy's Heroic Charge and wall stuns delete you; respect her dash range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Poppy out-trades early. Farm with Q from distance safely.
- Bait her E dash, then reposition. Never let her push you toward walls.
- Post-6, Keeper's Verdict displaces you far. Use R Living Artillery from extreme range.
- First item spike dangerous; Poppy gains tankiness. Respect her all-in; don't overextend yet.
- Your power window: mid-game teamfights where you kite safely behind teammates with W range.
- Slow-push waves into her; forces her forward and away from nearby walls you fear.
- Grasp abuses her short trades; sustain through her early pressure and scale better late.
- Build Hollow Radiance third or fourth; magic resist negates her burst and sustained poke.

kogmaw__qiyana.notes:
- Qiyana's Audacity gap-close and burst combo one-shots you before you kite away safely.
- Play safe behind minions; her early damage is high, avoid trading Caustic Spittle.
- Bait Audacity with positioning, then kite backward using Bio-Arcane Barrage's range advantage immediately.
- Supreme Display of Talent stun locks you; position far back and use Void Ooze for spacing.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect her burst window and play further back cautiously.
- After Qiyana uses Audacity cooldown, punish with full Bio-Arcane Barrage combos from safe range.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam pressure and ensure you survive gank attempts safely.
- Pick First Strike for scaling gold lead; helps you outscale her mid-game burst threat.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early to tank her magic damage and reduce her burst potential significantly.

kogmaw__quinn.notes:
- Threat: Quinn's Vault dashes in, interrupts, and kites you with slows relentlessly until dead.
- Early: Play safe behind minions; Quinn out-trades you at levels 1-3 with Harrier bonus.
- Trading: Never trade when Harrier mark is active; bait her Vault, then Caustic Spittle.
- Post6: Behind Enemy Lines lets Quinn re-engage constantly; stay grouped or hug towers hard.
- Spike: First item spike hurts; Quinn gains range and burst—farm safely, avoid skirmishes early.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you stay backline protected; Quinn wastes Vault on frontline instead.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; forces Quinn to roam or lose CS, reducing her pressure.
- Rune: Grasp sustains through her poke trades and scales better than early pressure runes.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts Quinn's physical damage into healing, softens her all-in burst pressure.

kogmaw__rakan.notes:
- Rakan's Grand Entrance dash knocks you up, enabling his team to collapse and burst you.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid center lane. Let him push; farm at distance with Q.
- Dodge Grand Entrance by positioning near walls or minion clumps; bait his W before trading.
- Living Artillery gains range and damage; use R to kite and chunk him from afar safely.
- His first item spike (Chemtech Putrifier or support item) increases poke threat; respect and stay back.
- Post-laning, Kog'Maw outranges Rakan hard; abuse W range in teamfights while Rakan lacks engage tools.
- Slow-push to deny him roam windows and force him to defend; prevents jungle assistance.
- Take Grasp for scaling durability; matches his support durability and sustains your weak early game.
- Build Hollow Radiance late if Rakan stacks magic damage; reduces his charm and burst threat.

kogmaw__rammus.notes:
- Rammus's Frenzying Taunt locks you down; Defensive Ball Curl negates your damage output entirely.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid Powerball engage range. Farm with Caustic Spittle from distance only.
- Bait Defensive Ball Curl before trading. Never fight when his W is active; kite backward.
- Soaring Slam grants him engage and slow; stay further back. Living Artillery reveals him for ganks.
- First armor item (Kaenic Lifebringer or Hollow Radiance) is dangerous; farm safely and play passive then.
- Mid-game teamfights when Rammus lacks numbers; punish isolated Rammus with Living Artillery kiting and range.
- Slow-push waves toward your tower; deny Rammus roam potential and create gank safety for yourself.
- Take Grasp for sustained poke and health scaling; out-trade his defensive stat stacking over time.
- Buy Quicksilver Sash early if Taunt feels unmanageable; cleanses his Frenzying Taunt lock immediately.

kogmaw__reksai.notes:
- Rek'Sai Void Rush mark-and-lunge locks you down; Unburrow knock-up catches immobile Kog'Maw easily.
- Play safe; Rek'Sai early pressure is weak, but respect her all-in if she burrows near.
- Dodge Unburrow knock-up by positioning away from her likely burrow spots; use Q to kite.
- Void Rush adds massive all-in threat; maintain distance and use E Void Ooze trail defensively.
- Her first item spike (likely Sheen item) enables burst; stay near tower and scale safely.
- Mid-game when teammates group; Rek'Sai less mobile in teamfights; kite with W Bio-Arcane Barrage range.
- Slow-push to control minion timing; deny Rek'Sai good burrow flanks and force her to gank.
- Take Grasp for durability; extra health helps survive Void Rush burst and sustain poke trades.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip to reduce burst damage, cleanse slows, and enable kiting without sacrificing damage.

kogmaw__rell.notes:
- threat: Rell's Magnet Storm pulls you in; you get stunned and shredded by her team
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range, avoid her Shattering Strike, never let her Crash Down reach you
- trading: Bait Shattering Strike with positioning, then Caustic Spittle when she commits; dodge Ferromancy engage
- post6: Magnet Storm is lethal if you're caught mid-range; position near walls or behind teammates always
- spike: First armor item hurts your damage badly; punish before she finishes—trade aggressively at two items
- window: When Rell wastes Ferromancy or Magnet Storm, kite and spam Caustic Spittle; abuse her cooldowns
- wave: Slow-push sideways; forces her to chase or chase you, letting you control fight initiation
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; the move speed lets you kite her Magnet Storm pull and escape
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip provides shield against her burst and lets you survive her all-in engagement

kogmaw__renataglasc.notes:
- Renata's Hostile Takeover turns you against allies; avoid grouped fights entirely.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; her root threat minimal but respect Leverage marks.
- Bait Handshake by positioning wide, then reposition; never let her root you.
- Post-6, Hostile Takeover forces you to split-push or position far backline always.
- Her first item spike is moderate; your Living Artillery outranges her threat window.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed items; punish her immobility then.
- Slow-push waves to control spacing; avoid clumping near minions for Loyalty Program.
- Take Grasp for sustain and short-trade survival against her poke and pressure.
- Add Kaenic Lifebrace early if she pokes constantly; amplifies your damage back.

kogmaw__rengar.notes:
- Rengar's Unseen Predator leap and Bola Strike root eliminate your escape; you die instantly.
- Play safe near tower; abuse range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage to farm from distance safely.
- Bait his E Bola Strike, sidestep it, then trade with Q Caustic Spittle and autos.
- His R Thrill of the Hunt camouflage forces you to position near allies or tower always.
- First item spike is dangerous; stay grouped and avoid side lanes during his power window.
- You spike when teammates group; Rengar cannot all-in a 5v5 without getting cc'd or bursted.
- Slow-push waves toward tower; force him to choose between farming and roaming to dive you.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for poke sustain and scaling into teamfights versus his all-in.
- Buy Hollow Radiance second or third for armor and healing reduction against his burst and sustain.

kogmaw__renekton.notes:
- Renekton's Ruthless Predator stun locks you down; his dash gap-closes before you kite away safely.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid short trades. Let him push; farm ranged when possible from distance.
- Bait Ruthless Predator by positioning near minions, then reposition. Never trade when his Fury is high.
- Dominus transforms him into unkillable tank; your Living Artillery damage becomes less relevant. Kite harder, dodge.
- Renekton's first item spike (armor/health) is dangerous; your magic damage scales worse. Respect his all-in window.
- After he burns cooldowns or Fury depletes, punish with Caustic Spittle and Bio-Arcane Barrage kiting out.
- Slow-push sideways; deny easy engage. Never hard-push into him; he wants minion clumps for Cull the Meek.
- Fleet Footwork sustains his poke and ensures escape mobility when Ruthless Predator threatens; prioritize kiting.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his physical damage spike and bolsters your survivability against early Ruthless Predator chains.

kogmaw__riven.notes:
- Riven's gap-closing Q and W combo stuns you; you die if caught without Valor shield down.
- Play safe behind minions; use Caustic Spittle to kite and reduce her armor when she approaches.
- Bait her Valor shield, then trade with Bio-Arcane Barrage; dodge Broken Wings third hit knockback by spacing.
- Post-six, Riven gains burst from Blade of the Exile and Wind Slash; respect the all-in range.
- Her first item spike (around 10-12 minutes) is dangerous; Farm safely and spike harder with Attack Speed items.
- After first item, you outrange and out-dps her with Bio-Arcane Barrage; abuse range advantage and kite backward.
- Slow-push to maintain safety; force her to commit to fights where you kite with range advantage naturally.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against poke and to scale better into late game teamfights.
- Build Plated Steelcaps early if she snowballs; mitigates her auto-attack and ability damage significantly throughout laning.

kogmaw__rumble.notes:
- Rumble's Flamespitter cone and Danger Zone amplification zone control forces you into unsafe positioning.
- Play safe near tower; dodge Flamespitter by standing behind minions; don't trade early.
- Bait Electro Harpoon by moving unpredictably; dodge Flamespitter cones; trade only when harpoons on cooldown.
- The Equalizer wall forces you back hard; position at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range preemptively.
- First item spike (around Liandry's or Demonic) makes Danger Zone trades lethal; respect and retreat.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Rumble is low Heat and vulnerable; harass with Caustic Spittle then.
- Slow-push to deny Rumble safe wave manipulation and prevent him controlling Danger Zone positioning.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and poke damage without all-in risk.
- Add Adaptive Helm or Hollow Radiance to reduce Rumble's sustained magic damage and burst.

kogmaw__ryze.notes:
- Threat: Ryze roots you with W after Flux; you cannot kite or escape repositioning.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay out of E range; dodge Spell Flux orbs at all costs.
- Trading: Bait his W with positioning; trade when his Q is down and runes low.
- Post6: Realm Warp gives Ryze escape and engage; stay max range or behind minions always.
- Spike: First Mana item hurts; Living Artillery range lets you farm safely from distance then.
- Window: Ryze needs Flux setup; punish when both Q and W are on cooldown together.
- Wave: Slow-push to safety; forces Ryze to choose between waveclear and harass on you.
- Rune: Press the Attack; extra damage and attack speed help you outduel his early mana scaling.
- Item: Hollow Radiance; reduces his spell damage and his Bonus Mana scaling significantly.

kogmaw__samira.notes:
- Samira's E Wild Rush closes gaps instantly; you cannot kite or escape once she commits.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid short trades. Samira wins all-ins at levels 2–3 with E.
- Dodge E Wild Rush by positioning near walls or minion clumps she cannot dash through.
- Post-6 R Inferno Trigger forces you further back; use R Living Artillery to poke safely.
- First item spike (likely AD/crit item) is dangerous; respect her all-in threat window hard.
- You spike when she overextends or when her E is on cooldown; punish immediately then.
- Slow-push to maintain distance and deny her E engage angles near your tower.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for survivability and short-trade sustain when she commits.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for magic resist and health against her combo burst damage.

kogmaw__sejuani.notes:
- Sejuani's Q Arctic Assault knocks you up and closes gap; Glacial Prison stuns you immobile.
- Play safe behind minions; her Q stops at champions so bait it before trading hard.
- Dodge her W Winter's Wrath swings; space back and punish her cooldown with Caustic Spittle.
- Glacial Prison is a massive threat; stay spread and respect her engage range constantly.
- Her first tank item (Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Cascade) spikes her tankiness; play safer then.
- Kog'Maw spikes at three items with attack speed; kite and shred her armor with Q.
- Slow-push into her to deny her engage setup; force her to chase through minions.
- Fleet Footwork gives sustain and kite tools; her slows and engage pressure demand mobility.
- Manamune provides mana scaling for more R Living Artillery poke and defensive range advantage.

kogmaw__senna.notes:
- Threat: Senna's W roots you; you cannot kite or reposition once caught by Last Embrace
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Senna outranges you heavily, avoid her Q poke relentlessly
- Trading: Bait her W by moving laterally; dodge it, then all-in with Q plus W
- Post6: Dawning Shadow shields her team and damages you globally; respect its range always
- Spike: First item spike around 800-1200g is her danger window; stay behind minions only
- Window: Level 9+ with two items; your W range and attack speed overwhelm her defenses
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; deny her W engage angles and set up jungle ganks safely
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into midgame fights
- Item: Hollow Radiance for armor, magic resist, and team utility against her poke and roots

kogmaw__seraphine.notes:
- Seraphine's Encore charm locks you down and her team follows up; dodge or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q poke outranges you, farm under tower when needed.
- Bait her E Beat Drop, then sidestep and punish with W Bio-Arcane Barrage trades.
- Post-6 Encore is lethal in teamfights; stay behind teammates and never clump near allies.
- First item spike (Liandry's or Shadowflame) hurts; exploit pre-6 windows before she gets ult.
- Mid-game when teammates group; your Living Artillery outranges her engage and reveals before fights.
- Slow-push sidewaves to create distance and safety; avoid river where her Encore hits five-man.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke durability against her constant Q harassment in lane.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip to cleanse her charm and heal simultaneously during Encore teamfights.

kogmaw__shen.notes:
- Shen's Shadow Dash taunt locks you down for Void Ooze and sustained damage.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid extended trades early before you scale into range.
- Dodge Shadow Dash by repositioning sideways; bait it before committing to Living Artillery.
- Stand United shields his ally but leaves Shen vulnerable—punish the teleport window hard.
- His first-item spike is moderate; your range advantage grows stronger as you itemize.
- Mid-game when you have two items and range; kite him before Shadow Dash lands.
- Slow-push waves to deny his all-in engage and force him to overextend dangerously.
- Grasp scales your health pool and rewards you for kiting range advantage trades.
- Kaenic Orb reduces his shield effectiveness and amplifies your percent-health damage output significantly.

kogmaw__shaco.notes:
- threat: Shaco's Deceive + Backstab combo one-shots you; you have no escape or defense.
- early: Dangerous. Stay near minions, ward river, expect ganks. Play safe until level 6.
- trading: Never trade when Shaco is off-screen. Bait his Deceive, then kite backward hard.
- post6: Living Artillery reveals him post-Deceive. Use it to spot invisible Shaco and chunk him.
- spike: First item (Trinity, Black Cleaver) hurts. Play safer; you outscale him hard later.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you have teammates. Shaco struggles against grouped, coordinated teams with vision.
- wave: Slow-push toward your tower. Force Shaco to commit to all-in or lose farm safely.
- rune: Grasp. Sustain reduces his burst threat and helps you survive early all-ins.
- item: Zhonyas Hourglass. Stops Deceive burst and protects you when caught without teammates nearby.

kogmaw__sett.notes:
- threat: Sett's E Facebreaker stun locks you; his R The Show Stopper removes you from teamfights entirely.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid minion clumps where E Facebreaker stuns both sides.
- trading: Bait his W Haymaker shield with poke, then reposition. Never trade when he has grit stacked.
- post6: Lethal danger. R The Show Stopper isolates you for guaranteed W Haymaker combo. Play further back always.
- spike: First item is dangerous window. His Q Knuckle Down damage spike forces you into R Living Artillery spam range.
- window: Mid-game when you have two items and R Living Artillery range dominates. Abuse range advantage constantly.
- wave: Slow-push toward your tower. Sett needs close range; denying all-in angles keeps you alive and farming safely.
- rune: Hail of Blades. Extra early attack speed on W Bio-Arcane Barrage kite-trading keeps distance from Sett pressure.
- item: Kaenic Lifeline. Grants magic resist and active shield against his true damage W Haymaker punishment consistently.

kogmaw__shyvana.notes:
- Shyvana's Dragon Form gap-close and sustained damage output overwhelm your immobile, squishy frame easily.
- Play safe near tower; farm with Q and R from distance; avoid extended trades early.
- Dodge her W engage attempt; bait her Q cooldown before committing to extended kiting patterns.
- Post-6, Shyvana gains extreme threat; retreat to tower when Dragon Form comes off cooldown.
- First item spike is dangerous; stay maximum range with W active and spam R for poke.
- Kog'Maw punishes her when she wastes Dragon Form or overextends without backup nearby immediately.
- Slow-push waves to deny her clean all-in windows; extend fight duration to favor your scaling.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; you need durability to survive her relentless pressure.
- Grab Rylai's Crystal Scepter to kite and slow her; synergizes with R and W perfectly.

kogmaw__singed.notes:
- threat: Singed E Fling hurls you backward, separating you from team and breaking positioning
- early: Dangerous; stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage, dodge Q Caustic Spittle when possible
- trading: Bait his E Fling, then kite backward using W attack range; never walk forward
- post6: Singed R Insanity Potion makes him tankier and Poison Trail applies Grievous Wounds; play safer
- spike: First item is danger window; Singed gains durability, stack health and respect his engage
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you have peel; position behind frontline, rain R Living Artillery safely
- wave: Slow-push lane; lets you position far back, reduces E Fling threat, sets up ganks
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain mitigates Poison Trail poke and provides health bulk early
- item: Abyssal Mask or Hollow Radiance; magic resist and healing reduction counter his R damage

kogmaw__sion.notes:
- Sion's Unstoppable Onslaught ultimate charges you down; kite backwards and use range advantage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Sion outrades you close range, farm with Caustic Spittle from distance.
- Bait his Decimating Smash charge, then reposition; never trade when he's winding up.
- Post-6 Sion becomes a roaming threat; play for farm safety and late-game scaling pressure.
- His first armor item spike is dangerous; respect his tankiness, pivot to percent damage via Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed and range; abuse kiting and Living Artillery poke.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Sion to either farm or leave lane, reducing roam threat.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling to survive his all-in attempts safely.
- Build Liandry's Torment to shred his growing health pool and scale damage into late-game.

kogmaw__sivir.notes:
- threat: Sivir's Spell Shield blocks your Q and R; her mobility kites you down relentlessly
- early: Safe farm—avoid extended trades; Sivir outranges you early and punishes overextension with autos
- trading: Bait her E with Q, then all-in with W active; never lead with R
- post6: Living Artillery range lets you poke safely, but On The Hunt kite makes fights worse
- spike: First item spike (likely Kraken Slayer) is dangerous; you lack burst to all-in her
- window: Mid-game teamfights where Sivir lacks escape and your W range outscales her mobility
- wave: Slow-push sidewaves; force her to decide between grouping or losing CS to your artillery
- rune: Lethal Tempo gives you sustained DPS to overwhelm her kiting once you land W
- item: Abyssal Mask reduces her damage and gives tankiness to survive her all-ins

kogmaw__skarner.notes:
- Skarner's Impale suppresses you; you cannot move, attack, or cast while dragged helplessly.
- Play safe at range; farm from distance with W Bio-Arcane Barrage, avoid close trades.
- Bait his E Ixtal's Impact into terrain, then kite backward; never let him close gap.
- Post-6, Impale is lethal; position near walls and maintain maximum distance from Skarner always.
- His first item spike is moderate danger; your W range advantage still keeps you safe.
- You spike when Skarner lacks mobility items; abuse W range to farm and poke safely.
- Slow-push waves into tower; this prevents Skarner from roaming while you farm safely behind minions.
- Take Grasp for sustain and health scaling to survive Skarner's all-in suppression damage attempts.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for health, magic resist, and waveclear against his slowing shockwaves.

kogmaw__smolder.notes:
- Threat: Smolder's E closes gap instantly; you have no escape once he commits.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W active; dodge his Q with positioning.
- Trading: Never fight when his P stacks are high. Bait Q, then trade back.
- Post6: MMOOOMMMM! covers huge area and slows you—position behind minions; respect the range.
- Spike: First Liandry's or Nashor's is dangerous. Play safer; abuse R range advantage.
- Window: Mid-game when Smolder lacks mobility items. Kite backward with R and E spam.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes. Deny him roam windows; farm safely near tower.
- Rune: Grasp for durability against his burst and all-in pressure; survival first.
- Item: Zhonyas Hourglass as third item stops his E damage and ganks cold.

kogmaw__sona.notes:
- threat: Crescendo stun locks you; position far back and respect her ult range always.
- early: Safe farm at distance; abuse W range advantage to poke Sona down.
- trading: Dodge Hymn of Valor bolts by positioning; Q her to corrode resistances first.
- post6: Play around fog of war; never cluster with teammates or you eat five-man stun.
- spike: First item rarely kills you; abuse her immobility and scale into her.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you kite backwards; her melee range cannot match your W.
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; forces Sona to roam or lose CS, limits Crescendo impact.
- rune: Grasp sustains through poke and procs off W on-hits; strengthens extended fights.
- item: Adaptive Helm reduces her magic damage spam and negates Hymn poke pressure.

kogmaw__soraka.notes:
- Soraka's Equinox silences you, stopping W and R; root follow-up locks you in place.
- Play safe levels 1–3; her Q poke forces you to back early without pressure.
- Bait her E cooldown, then all-in with Q and W; dodge Starcall when possible.
- Wish heals her team instantly; your sustained damage pressures but cannot burst through it.
- First Chemtech Putrifier (if exists) or Liandry's spike threatens; play safe, stack mana and health.
- Post-15 minutes when Soraka runs out of mana; unleash full W damage and long-range R.
- Slow-push waves into her tower; forces her to rotate or lose CS to tower.
- Take Lethal Tempo; attack speed and range extensions let you kite her entire team.
- Build Hollow Radiance or Adaptive Helm to reduce her Q poke and spike damage.

kogmaw__swain.notes:
- threat: Nevermove root into Demonic Ascension drain locks you down and kills you instantly.
- early: Safer early; farm at max range with Caustic Spittle, avoid Swain's Q poke.
- trading: Bait his E root, then kite back hard; never let him close gap.
- post6: Demonic Ascension drains you faster than you can damage him—respect ult range massively.
- spike: His first item spike is dangerous; stay grouped and avoid isolated fights badly.
- window: Post-hextech items when you have attack range; kite and poke from distance safely.
- wave: Slow-push sideways; keeps minions away from Swain root engage range and jungle ganks.
- rune: Grasp sustains health against poke and Ascension drain damage; trades favorably into him.
- item: Kaenic Destroys his healing and drain; rush after core to cut Ascension value.

kogmaw__sylas.notes:
- threat: Sylas W Kingslayer healing and gap-close burst before you kite away safely
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; avoid Q Chain Lash intersection. Play safe levels 1-3
- trading: Bait his E Abscond cooldown, then trade with Q Caustic Spittle and W Bio-Arcane Barrage
- post6: Critical threat spike. Sylas steals Living Artillery via R Hijack; position deeper to limit his ult value
- spike: First item is danger window. Sylas gains burst; stay max range and spam R Living Artillery
- window: Mid-game when Sylas lacks cooldown reduction; abuse Living Artillery poke range and kite with W
- wave: Slow-push toward enemy tower; forces Sylas to choose between farming and engaging you at range
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain helps you survive Kingslayer trades and extended skirmishes
- item: Force of Nature against his magic burst and healing mitigation if needed later

kogmaw__tahmkench.notes:
- Tahm Kench Devour deletes you; avoid three stacks of An Acquired Taste at all costs.
- Play safe behind minions; his Tongue Lash range exceeds yours—don't trade early.
- Bait Tongue Lash, then reposition; never stand still when stacks build on you.
- Post-6 Devour is an execution threat; maintain maximum distance and respect three-stack windows.
- First item spike (Hollow Radiance or similar tank items) makes him tankier; you scale better.
- Mid-game teamfights when Tahm is isolated or low on stacks; kite and burst him.
- Slow-push to deny his all-in range; control wave near your tower for safety.
- Hail of Blades procs faster W attacks; alternatively Summon Aery for shield utility.
- Consider Kaenic Lifegrip to cleanse his debuffs and gain survivability against percent damage.

kogmaw__syndra.notes:
- Syndra's E Scatter the Weak stun chain locks you down; her R Unleashed Power deletes you at range.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge Q Dark Sphere; abuse W Bio-Arcane Barrage range advantage when she overextends.
- Bait her E, then trade with W attacks; never cluster with minions she can E through.
- Post-6, respect R Unleashed Power range and stay behind teammates; kite sideways to avoid sphere projectiles.
- Her first item spike (Liandry's or Shadowflame) is dangerous; respect her damage and maintain maximum distance always.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Syndra uses abilities for waveclear; punish her mana costs and land R Living Artillery.
- Slow-push to deny her E engage angles; keep wave near your tower for safety and gank setup.
- Take Grasp for sustain and survival in poke trades; Syndra relies on burst and extended fights hurt her.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline early to cleanse stuns and survive her combo; it synergizes with your W spam.

kogmaw__talon.notes:
- Talon's all-in burst and Assassin's Path mobility let him gap-close and delete you instantly.
- Play safe behind minions; Talon Q at range is slow. Punish his W cooldown.
- Dodge Rake on return; space back when he steps up. Bait his E for ganks.
- Shadow Assault makes him untargetable and mobile—reposition away, use R to scout his exit.
- First item (Serrated Dirk component spike) is dangerous; respect his damage and play further back.
- Mid-game teamfights when Talon lacks cooldowns; kite backward and abuse your range advantage then.
- Slow-push to deny his roam; keep wave near your tower to survive his all-in.
- Grasp for survivability and sustain against his poke and short-trade attempts early game.
- Kaenic Lifeburst grants magic resist, shred his resistances, and return his burst as healing.

kogmaw__taric.notes:
- Taric Cosmic Radiance invulnerability negates your burst; plan around it or kite.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Taric's early armor and Bastion make trading unfavorable.
- Bait Dazzle with positioning, then unload Caustic Spittle and Living Artillery freely.
- Post-6, Cosmic Radiance blocks your kill pressure; focus poke and chip damage instead.
- Taric first-item spike (armor items) is a punish window; kite and poke relentlessly.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Taric's Cosmic Radiance is down; burst windows are short.
- Slow-push to deny Taric roam; maintain range advantage and force him to engage.
- Fleet Footwork lets you kite and sustain Taric's chip damage reliably early-game.
- Build Liandry's Torment for sustained magic damage through Taric's armor and shields.

kogmaw__teemo.notes:
- threat: Teemo's Blinding Dart negates your W attacks; his Invisibility and Noxious Trap kite you endlessly.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions, avoid extended trades. Q his resistances when he steps forward.
- trading: Bait Blinding Dart by feinting autos, then trade with Q and E. Never all-in early.
- post6: Teemo's Noxious Trap becomes a zoning tool. Respect trap placement; use R to check bushes.
- spike: First item spike is moderate danger. Your W outscales his poke if you survive safely.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where Teemo lacks escape tools. Group and use R to catch him.
- wave: Slow-push toward him. Forces Teemo to either engage or lose cs; minimizes trap effectiveness.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustains poke damage and scales tankier against his kite arsenal.
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip. Converts his poison and your W damage into self-healing; reduces his poke.

kogmaw__thresh.notes:
- Threat: Death Sentence hook catches you out; you die or blow summoners immediately
- Early: Dangerous—stay behind minions, avoid predictable positioning; one hook ends your laning phase
- Trading: Never trade when hook is up; bait Q with sideways movement, then punish
- Post6: Living Artillery outranges The Box; use R to poke and control space safely
- Spike: Thresh's first item spike is real danger; play safer, respect hook range always
- Window: Mid-game when you have two items and Thresh hasn't; extended teamfights favor you
- Wave: Slow-push to maintain distance from hook range; deny him engage opportunities consistently
- Rune: Grasp sustains poke damage and helps survive hook attempts; raw survivability matters most
- Item: Kaenic Lifeline gives shield for hook follow-up and cleanse effect; covers weaknesses well

kogmaw__trundle.notes:
- Threat: Subjugate strips your resistances; you die instantly without defensive stats.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Caustic Spittle; avoid close trades.
- Trading: Bait Chomp with sidestep, then Caustic Spittle + auto. Never fight in melee.
- Post6: Subjugate doubles stat steal after 4 seconds; kite away or die.
- Spike: First Sunfire or tank item makes him tanky; punish before completion.
- Window: Levels 1–5 before resistances stolen; abuse range advantage and poke.
- Wave: Slow-push toward your tower; force him to overextend chasing; safety first.
- Rune: Grasp sustains through his poke and bulks you against Subjugate.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip purges Subjugate's stat steal and gives survivability.

kogmaw__tristana.notes:
- Threat: Tristana's Rocket Jump gap-close plus Buster Shot knockback prevent kiting; you get cornered and exploded.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are dangerous. Stay max range, respect her all-in. Farm safely with Caustic Spittle.
- Trading: Never trade short. Bait her Rocket Jump, then punish with Void Ooze slow and kiting.
- Post6: Living Artillery range lets you out-range her. Use it to poke and reveal before teamfights.
- Spike: First item is her danger spike. Play far back, use range advantage; dodge Rocket Jump landings.
- Window: Mid-game when you have two items and Living Artillery maxed. Kite and poke from safety.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes. Let her push toward you so Void Ooze and range control her engage.
- Rune: Grasp for sustain in repeated short trades and poke wars; helps you survive her all-ins.
- Item: Rylai's Crystal Scepter slows on all damage; makes kiting Rocket Jump and escaping Buster Shot safer.

kogmaw__tryndamere.notes:
- Threat: Tryndamere's Spinning Slash and auto-attacks close gap; Undying Rage negates your burst damage.
- Early: Safe farm at range with Caustic Spittle; avoid close trades before level 3.
- Trading: Bait Spinning Slash, then kite backward; never fight him head-on in melee range.
- Post6: Undying Rage makes him unkillable for five seconds; focus on kiting and positioning instead.
- Spike: First item spike is moderate threat; you outrange him, so maintain distance advantage.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you have peel support; exploit his immobility in grouped fights.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; keep distance from him while maintaining safety and scaling advantage.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork; extra mobility and healing help you kite his all-in attempts reliably.
- Item: Rylai's Crystal Scepter; slows from spells and autos make kiting him significantly easier.

kogmaw__twistedfate.notes:
- Twisted Fate's Destiny reveals you; Gate enables ganks and picks when you're isolated.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from range, avoid pushing into river vision.
- Dodge Wild Cards by positioning behind minions; never trade when Pick a Card is up.
- Post-6, respect Destiny's reveal window; play toward teammates or retreat to base immediately after.
- His first item spike (Lich Bane or similar) pressures you; farm safely, don't contest.
- Punish Twisted Fate when Destiny is on cooldown; push wave and gain map control.
- Slow-push to deny him easy gank setup; keep minions near your tower for safety.
- Take Grasp for sustain and durability against his poke and pressure throughout laning.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early if he itemizes heavy AP; bolsters your survivability significantly.

kogmaw__twitch.notes:
- Twitch's Spray and Pray pierces through you; kite backwards and abuse range advantage.
- Play safe; Twitch out-trades early with Deadly Venom stacks and all-in threat.
- Bait his Ambush cooldown, then trade with Bio-Arcane Barrage; dodge Venom Cask.
- Spray and Pray outranges you slightly; position behind minions and use Void Ooze.
- Twitch first-item spike is dangerous; play safer, farm with Living Artillery from distance.
- You spike when Twitch lacks attack speed items; maximize Bio-Arcane Barrage range then.
- Slow-push into him; force him to farm close where you control with E.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke and early venom damage from trades.
- Build Kaenic Lifeburst to reduce his magic damage and heal against true damage.

kogmaw__varus.notes:
- Varus Chain of Corruption immobilizes you; you cannot kite or escape once caught.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid Piercing Arrow range. Farm with Q from distance.
- Bait his E cooldown, then trade. Never face-check; dodge Piercing Arrow charges.
- Chain of Corruption at level 6 becomes lethal; play further back immediately.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect his damage and kite backward always.
- After Varus burns Chain of Corruption, punish hard with W range and damage.
- Slow-push to deny his all-in angle; keep minions between you and him.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; you need health against his percent damage.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early; his magic damage and self-heal reduction hurt less.

kogmaw__udyr.notes:
- Udyr's Blazing Stampede stun locks you down; Wilding Claw recast lightning chains burst damage.
- Play safe behind tower; dodge Blazing Stampede engagement attempts; farm with Caustic Spittle from range.
- Never face-check; bait Blazing Stampede then kite backward; use Bio-Arcane Barrage range advantage when he misses.
- Living Artillery outranges Udyr completely; use it to poke and kite; Wingborne Storm slows you hard.
- Udyr's first item spike (likely Thornmail or Hollow Radiance) reduces your damage; play safer, farm safely.
- After Udyr wastes Blazing Stampede cooldown, abuse Bio-Arcane Barrage range; punish when his stance rotation resets.
- Slow-push into tower; deny easy engagement; force Udyr to walk far to reach you; maintain distance.
- Fleet Footwork provides sustain and kiting; dodges and escapes Blazing Stampede stun more effectively than alternatives.
- Hollow Radiance reduces his Wilding Claw burst and Wingborne Storm damage significantly; buy after first item.

kogmaw__urgot.notes:
- Urgot's Disdain catches you at close range; Fear Beyond Death executes you at low health thresholds.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid the lane center. Farm at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range only.
- Bait Disdain by positioning near walls; dodge it, then kite backward and trade with Q harass.
- Fear Beyond Death forces you to never fight below 40% health; respect the execution threshold always.
- Urgot's first armor item (Kaenic or Black Cleaver) significantly increases his threat; farm safer during this window.
- Post-15 minutes when Urgot falls behind in items; punish with range advantage and Q poke repeatedly.
- Slow-push waves into him; force Urgot to overextend chasing, then kite out and W-attack from distance.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain into his poke and scale into a safer late-game role.
- Add Hollow Radiance; the magic resist and heal reduce his Corrosive Charge and Fear Beyond Death pressure.

kogmaw__vayne.notes:
- Vayne's Condemn stun into Silver Bolts true damage burst kills immobile Kog'Maw instantly.
- Stay at maximum W range behind minions; dodge Condemn by positioning away from walls.
- Never trade into her cooldowns; bait Tumble, then unload Q and W damage.
- Final Hour invisibility on Tumble makes her untargetable; kite backward and use E slow.
- First item spike (Guinsoo's or Sheen variant) is dangerous; respect her all-in range threat.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Vayne lacks armor; punish before she buys defensive items early.
- Slow-push to deny her roam pressure and set up ganks; avoid hard pushing.
- Grasp sustains health against her true damage; provides teamfight durability you desperately need.
- Kaenic Lifegrip converts her true damage to healing and provides needed survivability spike.

kogmaw__veigar.notes:
- Event Horizon stun cage traps you at close range; stay outside its radius.
- Play safe; Veigar out-damages you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid pushing.
- Bait Event Horizon by moving unpredictably, then trade with W attacks from range.
- Primordial Burst scales off missing health; Veigar becomes a one-shot threat post-six.
- First item (Luden's or Liandry's) is dangerous; respect his damage spike hard.
- Mid-game when Veigar lacks items but you have two; abuse range advantage then.
- Slow-push sideways; gives you escape room and prevents Veigar from caging you easily.
- Grasp sustains you through poke and gives tankiness against his burst damage.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his magic damage and cuts his Primordial Burst nuke significantly.

kogmaw__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's E knockup chains into Q damage, preventing your kiting and forcing bad positioning
- Play safe behind minions; his Q range exceeds yours, so avoid extended trades early
- Dodge his E by moving sideways; don't trade when his passive stacks are high
- His ultimate applies passive stacks instantly; respect range and use W to kite backwards
- First item spike (Liandry's or similar) is dangerous; dodge his abilities more, farm safer
- Post-teamfight windows exist when his cooldowns are down; use W range to poke freely
- Slow-push waves to deny his E engage range; avoid getting trapped near enemy tower
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and kiting mobility against his poke and all-in
- Abyssal Mask reduces his magic damage and passive true damage burst significantly

kogmaw__vi.notes:
- Vi's Cease and Desist locks you down; you die if caught out of position.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid trading with Vi's superior close-range damage early.
- Dodge Vault Breaker by positioning sideways; never trade when her Blast Shield is up.
- Cease and Desist makes you immobile; kite backwards and spam Living Artillery from distance.
- Vi's first item spike is real danger; respect her all-in potential window then.
- You outrange Vi significantly post-two items; stay max range and let her engage poorly.
- Slow-push waves to deny Vi roam opportunities; prevent her from catching you isolated.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; you need survivability against her repeated engages.
- Build Thornmail or Kaenic Lifeblade early; reflect her damage while reducing her burst.

kogmaw__vex.notes:
- threat: Vex's Doom 'n Gloom fear interrupts your repositioning; Shadow Surge dash locks you down hard
- early: Dangerous; stay beyond Mistral Bolt range, dodge Personal Space trades, farm safely with Caustic Spittle
- trading: Bait Vex's Doom 'n Gloom fear on minions, then trade back; never walk into Personal Space
- post6: Shadow Surge marks you for a dash-in all-in; play further back and respect her engage range
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; she gains burst and sustained threat—stay safe and kite backward
- window: Post-first-item when Bio-Arcane Barrage range lets you out-range her; abuse kiting and poke from distance
- wave: Slow-push toward your tower to maintain safety distance and force Vex to overextend for all-ins
- rune: Grasp of the Undying gives tankiness and sustain to survive her early poke and trades
- item: Kaenic Lifebringer reduces her magic damage and provides survivability against her burst combo pattern

kogmaw__viego.notes:
- threat: Viego's W stun and R execute delete you before you kite or reposition safely.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W, avoid letting Viego gap close with E or W.
- trading: Bait his W dash, then unload Q and autos. Never fight in his E mist.
- post6: Extremely dangerous. His R execute on low health counters your poke playstyle; play safer.
- spike: First item (Black Cleaver, Kaenic Rookern) is danger. He gains tankiness and all-in potential.
- window: After Viego uses W or E, unleash full combo before cooldowns reset and he recovers.
- wave: Slow-push to deny his roam potential and keep him under tower farming safely.
- rune: Grasp sustains through his poke and R threat, keeping you healthy for extended fights.
- item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his execute damage and cleanses his Black Mist debuffs effectively.

kogmaw__viktor.notes:
- Threat: Viktor's Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm burst you down before W lets you kite safely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; stay out of Hextech Ray line and farm from max range only.
- Trading: Never walk into Gravity Field; bait Siphon Power then trade with Q to kite away immediately.
- Post6: Arcane Storm shreds you at close range; position further back and use E to create distance.
- Spike: First item is danger; Viktor gains burst and slow pressure, reduce aggression and respect Hextech Ray.
- Window: Once you get attack speed items, W range abuse from safe distance punishes his immobility hard.
- Wave: Slow-push sidewaves to kite and maintain distance; avoid pushing lane and letting him wave-control mid.
- Rune: Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness against his poke; extra health helps survive his burst.
- Item: Buy Abyssal Mask after core; the magic resist and healing reduction weakens his damage significantly.

kogmaw__vladimir.notes:
- threat: Vladimir's Sanguine Pool makes him untargetable; you cannot duel him reliably in close range
- early: Dangerous—stay maximum distance, farm with Q, never walk up without vision control established
- trading: Bait his W with R poke from distance; dodge E charge by repositioning sideways
- post6: Hemoplague amplifies all your damage taken; respect zone control and avoid grouping predictably near him
- spike: First Protobelt or similar is dangerous; stay at maximum Bio-Arcane Barrage range during this window
- window: Mid-game when Vladimir lacks defensive items; spam R from fog of war to pressure safely
- wave: Slow-push side lanes to maintain distance; avoid mid-lane grouping where his E and R combo zones you
- rune: Stormraider's Surge—kite away from his all-in attempts and escape if he closes the gap
- item: Add Abyssal Mask after core; reduces his burst and sustain while you maintain range advantage

kogmaw__volibear.notes:
- Volibear's Q stun into all-in combo kills immobile Kog'Maw with zero counterplay.
- Play safe behind minions; Volibear can't engage without eating free poke from range.
- Bait Q with positioning; dodge sideways when he charges, then unload with W attacks.
- Stormbringer closes gaps Kog'Maw cannot escape; respect its range and play further back.
- His first item spike (Sunfire, Kaenic) is dangerous; farm safely and let him overextend.
- Kog'Maw's power spike is mid-game when W range and damage scaling dominate extended fights.
- Slow-push to deny Volibear easy engage angles; maintain distance from river brush gank setup.
- Take Grasp for survivability and poke synergy; Volibear wants short trades you must avoid.
- Grab Force of Nature if Volibear snowballs; magic resist and slow immunity help kiting.

kogmaw__wukong.notes:
- Wukong's Nimbus Strike and Cyclone combo closes gap and locks you down instantly.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid trading short. Farm with Q from distance.
- Never stand near minions when Wukong approaches—dodge Nimbus Strike by positioning unpredictably.
- Post-6 Cyclone is lethal; maintain max distance and use R to kite away.
- First item spike forces you further back; exploit cooldowns and poke with R.
- Mid-game when Wukong's cooldowns peak is your safest window; abuse range advantage.
- Slow-push to control minion positioning and deny Wukong all-in engagement opportunities consistently.
- Fleet Footwork provides mobility and sustain to kite his gap-close attempts reliably.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his burst and benefits from his magic damage early.

kogmaw__warwick.notes:
- threat: Warwick's Infinite Duress suppression locks you down; you cannot kite or escape once caught.
- early: Dangerous. Stay beyond Warwick's melee range; farm safely with Caustic Spittle and Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- trading: Avoid trading when Warwick approaches. Bait his Jaws of the Beast, then kite backward hard.
- post6: Existential threat. Infinite Duress range scales with his bonus Move Speed; respect his engagement zone.
- spike: First item spike is dangerous. Warwick gains durability and damage; farm safely and respect all-ins.
- window: You spike when you finish two items. Then kite and poke from maximum Bio-Arcane Barrage range.
- wave: Slow-push toward enemy tower. Deny Warwick gank angles and force him to overextend to engage.
- rune: Fleet Footwork. Sustain and movespeed help you kite Warwick and escape Infinite Duress engage attempts.
- item: Plated Steelcaps. Reduce his auto-attack damage and Eternal Hunger healing significantly early in the game.

kogmaw__xayah.notes:
- Xayah's Bladecaller roots you in place; you die immobilized without escape tools.
- Play safe behind minions; her Double Daggers out-ranges your Caustic Spittle early.
- Bait her Bladecaller by positioning near feathers, then kite back hard immediately.
- Her Featherstorm untargetability negates your Living Artillery burst; reposition or hold ult.
- First item spike is moderate threat; maintain distance and abuse your superior range.
- Mid-game when enemies group; your Living Artillery out-damages her in teamfights consistently.
- Slow-push sideways; avoid her feather engagement zones and maintain max Caustic Spittle range.
- Take Lethal Tempo; extended trades favor your attack-speed scaling and range advantage.
- Consider Quicksilver Sash to cleanse root and survive her Bladecaller all-in.

kogmaw__xerath.notes:
- Xerath's long-range poke with Q and W forces you into unsafe positions constantly.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid walking up without vision; farm cautiously with W range.
- Never walk into E range; dodge Xerath's W center; bait Q by moving sideways.
- Xerath's R makes you an immobile artillery target; stay behind cover and kite.
- Xerath's first item spike is dangerous; play safer until you gain sustained damage items.
- You spike when you complete W and gain range; abuse this to out-trade him.
- Slow-push to deny Xerath's poke angles; avoid pushing into his tower and free shots.
- Build Grasp for sustained trading and durability; it lets you win short extended fights.
- Add Kaenic Lifebringer to reduce his magic damage and sustain through poke phases.

kogmaw__xinzhao.notes:
- Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge closes gaps instantly; you die if caught without escape.
- Play safe early; farm ranged with Caustic Spittle, avoid close trades near minions.
- Dodge his Audacious Charge by positioning away from Challenged mark; bait three-hit combo then kite.
- Living Artillery reveals and damages from range; use it to poke safely before teamfights.
- His first-item spike (likely crit or bruiser damage) forces you further back; farm defensively.
- You spike when enemies group; use Living Artillery's range advantage to chunk from safety.
- Slow-push waves so Xin must choose between farming and roaming; prevents all-in dives.
- Take Grasp for sustain against his repeated close-range damage and extended skirmishes.
- Build Zhonya's Hourglass to survive his all-in; stasis blocks his burst and cooldowns.

kogmaw__yasuo.notes:
- Yasuo dashes through you with E, blocks your Q with W, then ults you airborne for a kill.
- Play safe behind minions; respect his Q stacks. Farm with Q from range when possible early.
- Bait his W with Q, then E through minions. Never fight him when he has two Q stacks.
- Yasuo gains a teamfight ult that chains your team airborne. Play further back and position around walls.
- His first damage item spike (Infinity Edge path) is dangerous. Respect his all-in; play safer temporarily.
- Post-Shieldbow, you outrange and out-duel him if he wastes E. Kite backward and spam R.
- Slow-push into him; forces him to engage on your terms. Maintains distance and prevents his jungle ganks.
- Grasp of the Undying grants survivability and sustain against his poke and repeated dashes through you.
- Kaenic Lifeline provides magic resist, anti-heal, and active shielding against his burst and sustained pressure.

kogmaw__yorick.notes:
- Yorick's Maiden and Mist Walkers swarm you; kiting backward becomes impossible in fights.
- Play safe near tower; Yorick Q Last Rites chunks hard—don't trade early.
- Bait his E Mourning Mist, then reposition; never stand still for W Dark Procession.
- Post-6, Eulogy of the Isles makes Yorick extremely tanky; avoid direct duels entirely.
- First Sheen item (Trinity Force or similar) spike is dangerous; respect his damage.
- Win at range when Yorick has no ult; abuse 5v5 teamfights over duels.
- Slow-push waves to deny his ghouls optimal targets; crash when minions stack.
- Take Hail of Blades for early disengage and attack-speed trading windows when safe.
- Build Liandry's Torment to burn through Yorick's durability and ult's summoned units.

kogmaw__yunara.notes:
- Yunara's Q spreads attack damage to nearby enemies; dodge or kite away from her pack.
- Play safe levels 1–3; her early Q damage and spread threaten your health pool hard.
- Bait her E movement, then land Q to reduce her resistances before all-in trades.
- Post-6, Yunara's Transcendent State dash and laser make her far more mobile and threatening.
- Her first-item spike (likely crit) is dangerous; maintain distance and abuse your W range advantage.
- You spike harder mid-game when you complete two items; abuse that window before she scales.
- Slow-push to control wave position; deny her all-in setup and maintain distance for W poke.
- Take Grasp for sustain pressure in extended trades where your W range lets you kite safely.
- Grab Kaenic Lifeline to reduce her magic damage and gain a defensive shield against burst.

kogmaw__yone.notes:
- Threat: Yone's Fate Sealed dash-engage plus Spirit Cleave shield lets him close gap and burst you down.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3, farm at max Caustic Spittle range, avoid letting him stack Gathering Storm free.
- Trading: Bait his Mortal Steel, then Caustic Spittle-auto combo while he's on cooldown; never fight his dashes.
- Post6: Fate Sealed is lethal — stay behind minions, position near walls, and spam Living Artillery for poke.
- Spike: First item spike (likely crit item) is dangerous; respect his all-in threat window, don't overextend.
- Window: When Yone wastes Soul Unbound or Fate Sealed cooldown, unleash full Caustic Spittle combos safely.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways toward river; prevents Yone from all-ining while keeping escape route open toward jungle.
- Rune: Grasp keeps you healthy and scaling; procs on Caustic Spittle and helps survive his engage.
- Item: Kaenic Lifeline (or Hollow Radiance if heavy magic) gives shield to survive his burst window.

kogmaw__zaahen.notes:
- Zaahen's gap closers and sustain let him all-in and duel you without dying.
- Play safe, farm from range with Q. Don't walk up; Zaahen wants close fights.
- Dodge Dreaded Return pull. Trade with W harass only when he's cooldown-locked.
- Living Artillery reveals and damages him; use R to kite and poke from range.
- First item spike dangerous; stay behind minions and spam R to maintain distance pressure.
- Post-15 minutes when you have two items; kite him with W and R spam.
- Slow-push waves to control space; denies him easy all-in angles and gank setups.
- Choose Grasp for sustain and tankiness to survive his early dueling pressure attempts.
- Kaenic Lifesteal cuts his healing and amplifies your magic damage into his resistances.

kogmaw__zac.notes:
- Zac's Elastic Slingshot engage from fog of war catches you immobile and vulnerable instantly.
- Farm safely at maximum range with Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid pushing into unwarded river brush.
- Bait Stretching Strikes by repositioning, then punish his missed grab with Living Artillery poke.
- Let's Bounce! locks you down and forces you toward his team; play further back always.
- Zac's first Hollow Radiance spike strengthens him; farm safely and coordinate ganks with support.
- Kog'Maw dominates mid-game teamfights when Zac exhausts his cooldowns; position behind frontline consistently.
- Slow-push waves toward enemy tower to control Zac's roam timing and catch him extended.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for kiting and repositioning away from Zac's inevitable Slingshot engages.
- Build Kaenic Lifeburst early to shred his resistances and counter his percentage health scaling.

kogmaw__ziggs.notes:
- Ziggs' W Satchel Charge knocks you away, disrupting positioning and W Bio-Arcane Barrage range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ziggs outranges you early. Farm under tower, avoid Q Bouncing Bomb.
- Never fight inside Ziggs' E Hexplosive Minefield. Bait his W, then all-in when it's down.
- Post-6, respect R Mega Inferno Bomb range. Use fog of war; position off-map when possible.
- Ziggs first item spike (Liandry's or Luden's) is danger. Play back; he gains damage and poke.
- Your window: mid-game when you hit two items and W Bio-Arcane Barrage range spike. Engage.
- Slow-push waves into him. Force him to choose: defend tower or roam and lose pressure.
- Take Grasp for survivability and poke sustain in a ranged matchup. Helps into Ziggs' harass.
- Build Abyssal Mask early for magic resist and health; reduces Ziggs' burst and poke significantly.

kogmaw__zilean.notes:
- Zilean Time Warp slows you hard, making you kited and vulnerable to ganks.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Time Bomb clusters and farm at maximum range.
- Bait Time Bomb early, then trade when cooldown is down with Q poke.
- Chronoshift negates your burst and assassination attempts; focus sustained damage instead post-6.
- Zilean first item spike is mild; punish his lack of mobility windows early.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights when Zilean lacks cooldown reduction and positioning.
- Slow-push waves to deny him roaming and force him to farm closer.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke and to win extended trades safely.
- Build Abyssal Mask early to reduce his magic damage and maximize your durability.

kogmaw__zoe.notes:
- Zoe's E sleep sets up massive Q damage; you cannot fight while drowsy.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge her Q angles; respect her all-in at level 2.
- Never stand still predictably; bait her Q redirect, then reposition before trading back.
- Living Artillery gains range and safety; use it to poke her from distance constantly.
- Zoe's first item spike is real danger; play further back, respect her burst window.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Zoe wastes E on non-threats; punish her cooldowns.
- Slow-push to control minion positioning; deny her clean Q angles and E setup range.
- Take Grasp for sustain trading and poke pressure; punishes her squishy nature every proc.
- Add Abyssal Mask after core; reduces her magic damage and gives you survivability cushion.

kogmaw__zeri.notes:
- threat: Zeri's E Spark Surge dash closes gaps; her Q Burst Fire and R Lightning Crash burst you down relentlessly.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid extended trades before level 3 when she all-ins with E.
- trading: Bait her E Spark Surge dash, then Q Caustic Spittle as she commits; kite backward and auto with W.
- post6: Severe threat spike. Her R Lightning Crash resets and gives stacking movespeed; use R Living Artillery to zone and poke safely.
- spike: First item is her danger window. She gains burst damage; play behind minions and spam R Living Artillery for poke.
- window: Level 5-6 before her ult, or when she wastes E. Short windows; capitalize with R Living Artillery spam and W kiting.
- wave: Slow-push and position near walls. This lets you R Living Artillery from safety and makes her E Spark Surge risky.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustains poke damage, gives tankiness to survive her burst attempts and extended skirmishes.
- item: Hollow Radiance. Reduces her burst damage and healing taken; gives health, ability power, and magic resist as secondary defense.

kogmaw__zyra.notes:
- Threat: Grasping Roots roots you in place; Stranglethorns knocks you airborne and locks you down.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay far back; Zyra out-trades you pre-6. Farm safely with Q poke from distance.
- Trading: Never walk into Grasping Roots range. Bait Q Deadly Spines, then reposition; dodge E at all costs.
- Post6: Stranglethorns is lethal. Stay spread, never cluster. Play around its cooldown; punish when down.
- Spike: First item spike hurts. Play back, use R Living Artillery from max range to stay safe.
- Window: Level 2-3 before plants scale, or post-15 minutes when you outrange and out-duel her plants.
- Wave: Slow-push toward your tower. Forces Zyra to overextend planting seeds; minimizes Grasping Roots engagement range.
- Rune: Grasp. Sustain through poke trades, scale safely into late game where range dominates.
- Item: Abyssal Mask. Reduces her magic damage output and improves your effective health significantly.

drmundo__aatrox.notes:
- Aatrox's sustained healing from Deathbringer Stance and E passive negates your tankiness advantage over time.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q and avoid extended trades near his minions.
- Bait his Q swings, then trade back with E when he commits; dodge W chains always.
- Maximum Dosage matches his World Ender sustain, but his extended uptime makes him more oppressive post-6.
- His first item spike (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) is dangerous; play safer and stack tankiness.
- You spike when he wastes W cooldown; punish aggressively with E and regenerate with Heart Zapper.
- Slow-push to deny his gank setup and control when fights happen; avoid pushing into his ult timer.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained lane healing and trading power in this extended lane.
- Build Kaenic Rookern to reduce his healing output and mitigate his magical damage from Deathbringer Stance.

drmundo__ahri.notes:
- Ahri's E Charm stops you cold, negating your tankiness and forcing you towards her team.
- Play safe early; her Q Orb outranges your abilities. Farm with Q Infected Bonesaw only.
- Never walk straight at her; bait E Charm by moving unpredictably, then all-in with W Heart Zapper.
- Post-6, her R Spirit Rush gives her three escape dashes; don't chase or overcommit trades.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and play passive until you complete two items.
- You outscale hard at two items; force grouping and teamfights where her charm matters less.
- Slow-push waves into her to deny her roam and force her to defend tower constantly.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain neutralizes her poke and rewards aggressive short-trade patterns.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early; her magic damage output drops significantly and you heal more efficiently.

drmundo__alistar.notes:
- Alistar's Pulverize and Headbutt combo locks you down; use P to break free and kite away safely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Alistar out-damages you early. Farm at range with Q, avoid walking into his engage range.
- Bait his Q with positioning, then trade back with Q poke. Never let him land both Q and W together.
- Maximum Dosage makes you tanky enough to survive his burst. Use ult proactively before he lands his combo.
- First item doesn't spike him dangerously; use this window to scale. Keep farming safely and stack health items.
- Post-15 minutes when you have two items, you outduel him. All-in when his Q is on cooldown.
- Slow-push waves into him. Forces Alistar to engage you in unfavorable positions where you can kite backward.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for extended trading and health scaling to survive his early pressure phases.
- Add Adaptive Helm into your build to reduce his repeated magic damage and W proc damage output.

drmundo__ambessa.notes:
- Ambessa's R suppresses you defensively and enables her team; your P cannot save you from it.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ambessa out-damages you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid extended trades.
- Bait her W shield, then trade with E active for missing Health damage. Dodge Q sweep.
- Post-6, respect R range and positioning. Play around fog of war; never get isolated or predictable.
- First item spike dangerous; she gains damage and tankiness. Farm safely, scale into mid-game tankiness advantage.
- You spike harder mid-game with tankiness stacking. Punish her when R is down; kite with Q.
- Slow-push waves into tower; forces Ambessa to choose between farm and roaming with R threat.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health stacking synergy with your E and tankiness scaling.
- Add Hollow Radiance after core; it reduces her damage output and speeds you during her trades.

drmundo__bard.notes:
- Bard's Q stun and R stasis lock you down, preventing escape and blocking your healing windows.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades since Bard's poke and meep damage add up quickly.
- Dodge Bard's Q by positioning behind minions; bait his E portal before committing to all-ins.
- Post-6, Bard's R Tempered Fate completely negates your R healing and turns fights against you.
