- Bard's first item spike is moderate threat; use this window to scale and farm safely instead.
- You spike hardest mid-game when tankier; look for isolated Bard picks away from allies and walls.
- Slow-push waves to control Bard's roaming and deny him easy portal terrain from lane bushes.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and healing since Bard's poke won't let you all-in safely.
- Build Adaptive Helm early to reduce Bard's poke damage and gain magic resist for teamfights.

drmundo__briar.notes:
- Briar's relentless pursuit via Blood Frenzy W and Certain Death R traps you in extended fights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from distance and avoid her all-in engagement attempts.
- Bait her Q Head Rush, then punish with E Blunt Force Trauma while she's vulnerable.
- Post-6, Certain Death R fear locks you down; use P Goes Where He Pleases to escape.
- Watch her first item spike around 10-12 minutes; she gains sustained damage to force all-ins.
- You spike harder with R Maximum Dosage available; use it to sustain through her pressure.
- Slow-push to control wave distance; prevent her from engaging short-range near your tower safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and extra health scaling into teamfights.
- Add Hollow Radiance for armor and healing reduction against her Crimson Curse P bleed stacking.

drmundo__corki.notes:
- Corki's poke with Phosphorus Bomb and Missile Barrage deals true damage you can't reduce with armor.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Corki outranges you heavily so farm under tower and avoid extended trades.
- Bait Valkyrie before engaging; dodge Phosphorus Bomb by positioning behind minions and wait for Corki to use cooldowns.
- Post-6, Corki gains massive poke with Missile Barrage; respect his range and play around his cooldown timing.
- Corki spikes hard at first item; avoid all-in fights and focus on farming safely during this window.
- Your power window comes when Corki wastes Valkyrie; chase him down with Q and E for guaranteed damage.
- Slow-push waves into Corki to deny him safe farming and create all-in opportunities when he's pushed up.
- Take Grasp to sustain his poke damage and gain tankiness from stacking health in extended fights.
- Build Force of Nature early if Corki gets ahead; its magic resist and healing amplification counters his burst.

drmundo__draven.notes:
- threat: Draven's early attack damage and axes catch you off-guard; his burst trading denies your sustain windows.
- early: Play safe farm; stand behind minions to avoid Spinning Axe bonus damage and poke trades.
- trading: Bait his axe catch attempts by stepping away, then trade back with Q and E combo.
- post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive his all-ins better; use healing to outlast his burst rotations.
- spike: His first crit item hurts hard; respect his damage and play around cooldowns defensively until then.
- window: Level 9+ onward you outscale; tank his damage with tankiness, E spam, and regeneration sustain.
- wave: Slow-push toward him so minions stack; this limits his Spinning Axe space and catch angles.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying gives tankiness, sustain, and poke that synergizes with your healthy trading pattern.
- item: Kaenic Rookern blocks his crit damage and reduces his burst threat significantly when you need defense.

drmundo__fizz.notes:
- Fizz's E Playful / Trickster makes him untargetable, dodging your Q and W damage easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Fizz out-damages you early. Farm at range, avoid extended trades.
- Bait his E before committing damage. Trade when his E is down; he's vulnerable.
- Post-6, Chum the Waters adds a knockup threat. Back off when Fizz has ult ready.
- First item spike around level 9 is dangerous. Respect his damage; stay near tower.
- You spike at level 11 with R Maximum Dosage healing and tankiness advantage.
- Slow-push waves to deny Fizz roam opportunities and to stack your health pool safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain to match Fizz's poke and healing.
- Build Abyssal Mask after core items to reduce his magic damage and increase resistances.

drmundo__garen.notes:
- threat: Garen's Decisive Strike silence locks you out of all abilities; his Demacian Justice executes.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading near minions where Garen gains Ms from Decisive Strike.
- trading: Bait Garen's Decisive Strike with positioning, then trade back with Infected Bonesaw while he's on cooldown.
- post6: Demacian Justice execution pressure forces you to maintain health lead; don't let him get close.
- spike: Garen's first item spike is moderate danger; you spike harder with Hollow Radiance and health stacking.
- window: After using Infected Bonesaw to kite, activate Heart Zapper while Garen chases; recast burst catches him.
- wave: Slow-push toward your tower to bait Garen all-ins where you're closer to safety and minions.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and extra health scaling into late game tankiness.
- item: Adaptive Helm reduces Garen's sustained damage and Judgment magic harm while boosting your health pool.

drmundo__gnar.notes:
- Gnar's Wallop stun in Mega form locks you down; follow up burst kills you easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gnar outdamages you early, avoid his Hyper bonus damage trades.
- Bait his Hop away, then trade with Infected Bonesaw; dodge Boomerang Throw when possible.
- Post-6 Gnar becomes extremely dangerous; use Maximum Dosage defensively when he transforms to Mega.
- First item spike is moderate danger; respect his damage but you scale better afterward.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you; catch Gnar out of position with Heart Zapper active.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance; prevents Gnar from all-inning and lets you scale safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain trades and scale health for Blunt Force Trauma.
- Add Kaenic Lifeburst for survivability; healing amplification helps you duel and survive his burst.

drmundo__graves.notes:
- Threat: Graves' short-range burst and armor pen shred your resistances and burst you down fast.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Farm at range with Q. Avoid pushing into Graves' effective range.
- Trading: Bait his E Quickdraw dash, then trade back with Q and W. Never face-check bushes.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage healing and move speed let you kite better. His R Collateral Damage outdamages yours.
- Spike: First item spike hurts around 10-12 minutes. Play safer, farm under tower, scale into teamfights.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you once you have two items and W cooldown reduction stacked.
- Wave: Slow-push waves toward your tower. Force Graves to choose between farming and engaging you.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain, tankiness scaling, and repeated short-trade value against him.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts your W damage into healing and helps you duel his burst.

drmundo__hecarim.notes:
- Hecarim's E Devastating Charge knock-back and burst damage combo catches you vulnerable and immobile.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Hecarim out-damages early. Farm with Q Infected Bonesaw from range safely.
- Bait his E Devastating Charge, then use P Goes Where He Pleases to negate it.
- Post-6, Hecarim's R Onslaught of Shadows fear chains with E knock-back; respect ultimate combo heavily.
- First item spike around level 9—punish him pre-spike by farming safely, scaling tankier than him.
- Your power window arrives after first Hollow Radiance or when you hit level 11 R.
- Slow-push waves to deny Hecarim roam angles and force him to farm under tower consistently.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain trades and scaling tankiness into his burst.
- Build Hollow Radiance second to amplify regeneration and reduce his E Devastating Charge burst damage.

drmundo__ivern.notes:
- Rootcaller roots you for extended trades; kite and use P to break free immediately.
- Safe farm early; Ivern lacks damage. Stay healthy for all-ins once you hit level 3.
- Bait Rootcaller with movement, then all-in with Q and E. Dodge roots at all costs.
- Maximum Dosage lets you sustain through Ivern poke; R when low to dominate extended fights.
- Ivern first item spike weak; this is your window to abuse stat advantage and kill.
- Post-6 Daisy adds pressure but lacks burst; use P cooldown resets to extended trade.
- Slow-push and freeze near tower; Daisy cannot effectively defend, forcing Ivern to overextend dangerously.
- Grasp of Undying provides sustain matching Ivern's poke while scaling with your health pool.
- Hollow Radiance layers magic resist against Ivern's magic damage and shields your team heavily.

drmundo__ksante.notes:
- Threat: K'Sante's All Out transformation gives him burst damage and healing that overwhelms Mundo's sustain.
- Early: Play safely; K'Sante wins short trades with Ntofo Strikes combo. Farm under tower, avoid unnecessary engagements.
- Trading: Bait Path Maker dash, then counter-trade with Infected Bonesaw and Heart Zapper. Never chase retreating K'Sante.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage sustain barely matches All Out burst. Respect ult knockback range; position near walls cautiously.
- Spike: First item spike (likely tank item) strengthens K'Sante. Mundo must have Adaptive Helm or similar defensive item.
- Window: Post-6 when K'Sante wastes All Out; punish with Maximum Dosage healing and Blunt Force Trauma burst.
- Wave: Slow-push toward K'Sante side; forces him to trade or miss farm, allowing Mundo to scale safely.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for consistent lane sustain and damage scaling into tankier build phases.
- Item: Adaptive Helm reduces K'Sante's burst damage and provides magic resist against his shockwave poke spam.

drmundo__kogmaw.notes:
- Kog'Maw's W Bio-Arcane Barrage percent max health damage shreds your tankiness relentlessly.
- Play safe early; Kog'Maw outranges you. Farm cautiously and avoid extended trades.
- Bait his Q Caustic Spittle, then all-in with E Blunt Force Trauma.
- Post-6, R Living Artillery reveals you and deals massive damage; play around fog.
- First item spike (Nashor's or Liandry's) is dangerous; respect his damage output.
- You spike hardest mid-game with R Maximum Dosage and early tank items online.
- Slow-push to stack waves; force him to choose between farming and poking.
- Grasp of the Undying provides sustain to offset his percent-health poke damage.
- Build Adaptive Helm early to reduce his magic damage and percent-health burn.

drmundo__lissandra.notes:
- Threat: Lissandra's W Ring of Frost roots you, preventing escape and enabling her burst combo.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid her Q Ice Shard range and respect W Ring of Frost.
- Trading: Bait W Ring of Frost, then trade with Q Infected Bonesaw while she's on cooldown.
- Post6: Frozen Tomb stun is devastating; play around your P Goes Where He Pleases cooldown reset timing.
- Spike: Her first mana item spikes her burst; respect it but you outscale her eventually.
- Window: Mid-game after your first major item; you outsustain her and force unfavorable trades for her.
- Wave: Slow-push to control spacing; avoid pushing into tower where W Ring of Frost traps you.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain mitigates her poke and strengthens your extended trading pattern.
- Item: Force of Nature; magic resist and tenacity reduce her root duration and burst damage significantly.

drmundo__pyke.notes:
- Threat: Pyke's E stun chains into Q pull, forcing all-ins you cannot win without ult up.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Pyke outranges and out-damages you pre-6, farm under tower.
- Trading: Never chase Pyke into fog; bait his W, then trade with Q and W.
- Post6: Death From Below executes you if low; stay above 40% health against roaming Pyke.
- Spike: First item spike (likely lethality) is dangerous; avoid fights, scale towards your ult windows.
- Window: Post-first-item with R up, you win extended trades; abuse this before he gets defensive items.
- Wave: Slow-push towards enemy tower; reduces Pyke roam pressure and forces him to stay lane.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain and poke synergize with your tankiness and Q range.
- Item: Hollow Radiance or Spirit Visage; magic resist blocks his burst and synergizes with your healing.

drmundo__qiyana.notes:
- Threat: Qiyana's Audacity dash plus Royal Privilege burst trades eliminate you before Heart Zapper activates.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Audacity cooldown is short and she outdamages your early game.
- Trading: Bait Audacity with Goes Where He Pleases passive up, then trade back with Infected Bonesaw.
- Post6: Supreme Display of Talent stun locks you; use Maximum Dosage proactively to survive her combo.
- Spike: First item spike hurts; respect her damage window and avoid extended trades near her elements.
- Window: Post-Maximum Dosage when cooldown resets, you sustain her burst and can force extended fights favorably.
- Wave: Slow-push to stack health and maximize Blunt Force Trauma bonus; prevents her roaming while scaling.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for repeated trading windows that convert her burst attempts into healing.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip provides magic resist and active healing reduction cleanse against her sustained elemental pressure.

drmundo__rell.notes:
- Rell's Magnet Storm pulls you in, then her team bursts you while dragged and immobilized.
- Play safe early; her Shattering Strike stuns through your P passive, so respect her range.
- Bait her Shattering Strike with positioning, then trade with Q and E when it's down.
- Post-6, never fight near her team; her ult pull into burst is almost guaranteed death.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect her damage output and play around minion wave for safety.
- You spike when she's out of position or low on mana; punish with R healing.
- Slow-push to deny her engagement angles; force her to crash Wave 2 for fights.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; her armor steal makes Stormraider's Surge less valuable here.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce her pull damage and magical burst after initial items.

drmundo__reksai.notes:
- Void Rush true damage and Unburrow knockup chain enable all-ins that burst through your resistances.
- Play safe early; Rek'Sai wins short trades. Farm defensively and respect her Burrow mobility threat.
- Bait her Unburrow knockup, then retaliate with Q and E. Never chase into fog of war.
- Rek'Sai gains kill pressure; use R to heal and kite. Ward tunnels to prevent ganks.
- Her first item spike is moderate. Your R sustain and tankiness scale better; farm safely.
- Post-15 minutes you outscale; abuse longer cooldowns and outsustain her burst with R and tankiness.
- Slow-push to control minion position and deny her Tunnel placements near your side of lane.
- Take Grasp for extended trading sustain; it scales into teamfights and dueling her all-ins.
- Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce her burst and nerf her high-damage true damage threat.

drmundo__shaco.notes:
- Threat: Shaco's burst from invisibility and backstab damage catches you immobile and vulnerable early.
- Early: Play safe; farm defensively. Shaco wants to all-in you level 2-3 with Q backstab.
- Trading: Bait his Q with your P passive, then trade back with Q and E.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage healing lets you survive his burst; use it reactively when he appears.
- Spike: First item is dangerous; Shaco gains burst. Play safer, hug lane, prioritize P cannister.
- Window: Level 9+ when E cooldown drops; you duel him harder and heal through his damage.
- Wave: Slow-push into him; forces Shaco to gank or fight you on your terms.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained damage and healing in extended fights against him.
- Item: Adaptive Helm reduces his Two-Shiv Poison damage and gives you tankier stats overall.

drmundo__sylas.notes:
- Sylas W Kingslayer heals him while damaging you; his burst combo with Q chains destroys your tankiness.
- Play safe early; Sylas out-trades you levels 1-3. Farm at range with Q, avoid close combat.
- Bait his E Abscond dash, then trade back hard. Never let him land W without consequence.
- Post-6 Sylas hijacks your R Maximum Dosage, healing himself massively. Play around ult cooldown carefully.
- His first item spike is dangerous; he gains damage and sustain. Respect his all-in potential then.
- You spike when you complete tank items and hit level 9; chase him down with P.
- Slow-push waves into him; denies his roam, forces him to match your wave pressure constantly.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain trades and scale into a true tank he can't burst.
- Build Hollow Radiance early; reduces his magical damage and healing from Kingslayer simultaneously, weakening his combo.

drmundo__talon.notes:
- Talon's burst damage and Blade's End bleeds delete your Health before you can react or heal.
- Play safe, farm with Q from distance, avoid pushing lane; Talon dominates short trades early.
- Bait his W Rake, then trade back; never fight him in melee range before six.
- Maximum Dosage lets you survive his all-in, but his Shadow Assault rotation still threatens you hard.
- First item spike is dangerous; stay back and scale, he falls off relative to your tankiness.
- Post-twelve minutes when you have two items, you outduel him if you land Q Infected Bonesaw.
- Slow-push sideways; deny him roam windows and prevent early ganks by controlling minion positioning carefully.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained damage, healing, and tankiness to survive his poke.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline to convert his burst into healing and reduce his bleed threat significantly.

drmundo__taric.notes:
- Threat: Taric's Cosmic Radiance invulnerability negates your burst damage and ult healing pressure.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Taric outtrades with Bravado empowered attacks and stun threat.
- Trading: Bait Dazzle with sidestepping, then all-in with Q and E when cooldown expires.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage becomes less effective; Cosmic Radiance makes all-ins risky without cooldown advantage.
- Spike: First armor item (Kaenic Gauntlet, Hollow Radiance) is dangerous; avoid extended fights then.
- Window: Punish Taric when Cosmic Radiance is down; press with Q spam and E slams.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny Taric roam windows and maintain all-in threat near your tower.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying provides healing sustain to offset Taric's poke and trading.
- Item: Kaenic Gauntlet converts his armor aura into damage, synergizes with your tankiness.

drmundo__tristana.notes:
- Threat: Tristana's Attack Range and Rocket Jump mobility kite you while Buster Shot knockback denies your engagement.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Attack Range outmatches yours, so avoid extended trades near minions.
- Trading: Bait her Rocket Jump cooldown, then engage with Q Infected Bonesaw into E Blunt Force Trauma.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive Buster Shot knockback, but respect her increased burst damage potential.
- Spike: First item spike (likely crit item) is dangerous; play around cooldowns and avoid solo fights.
- Window: When Rocket Jump is down, close the gap quickly with W Heart Zapper active trade.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her space and setup jungle ganks; fast push risks Rocket Jump kite.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained tankiness and healing in repeated short trades.
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifegrip to heal through her persistent damage and amplify your W Heart Zapper.

drmundo__twitch.notes:
- Threat: Deadly Venom true damage stacks shred your health through resistances over teamfights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades where Twitch stacks venom on you.
- Trading: Bait Q Ambush, then all-in with E Blunt Force Trauma while he's immobile.
- Post6: Spray and Pray forces you to position behind minions; dodge with P Goes Where He Pleases.
- Spike: First item spike around 10-12 minutes; punish Twitch before he scales attack speed and range.
- Window: Level 9+ with R Maximum Dosage; burst him before Contaminate deletes your stacked venom.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; deny Twitch safe positioning and force him into your jungler's gank range.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain tanks venom damage and procs on trading with him.
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifeline after Adaptive Force; its shield blocks venom burst from Contaminate damage.

drmundo__vex.notes:
- Vex's fear from Doom 'n Gloom interrupts your dashes and locks you down hard.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Vex out-ranges you. Farm with Q from distance, avoid her.
- Bait her E Looming Darkness cooldown before trading. Never dash into her Doom 'n Gloom.
- Post-6, Shadow Surge marks and dashes to you. Kite backwards and use R Maximum Dosage.
- Vex first-item spike (Luden's or similar) is dangerous. Play safer; don't overextend for farm.
- Your window arrives when Vex wastes Shadow Surge. Engage with R, chase her down.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roams and buy time for your scaling advantage.
- Pick Grasp of the Undying for lane sustain and tankiness against her poke.
- Consider Hollow Radiance for extra magic resist and healing boost against her burst damage.

drmundo__vi.notes:
- threat: Vi's R Cease and Desist locks you down and amplifies all her burst damage relentlessly
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades since Vi out-damages you; farm with Q from range
- trading: Bait her Q Vault Breaker, then trade back hard with E Blunt Force Trauma when she lands
- post6: Maximize distance when Vi has R; use P Goes Where He Pleases to tank her knockup
- spike: First item spike (Black Cleaver) is dangerous; prioritize early defensive itemization to weather the burst
- window: Post-six-item or when Vi uses R on someone else; punish with W Heart Zapper + E combo
- wave: Slow-push to deny Vi all-in angles; control minion proximity to maximize distance from her engage
- rune: Grasp of the Undying gives sustained trading power and health scaling to survive her burst
- item: Adaptive Helm reduces Vi's repeated burst damage and gives magic resist for her early game pressure

drmundo__warwick.notes:
- Warwick's W Blood Hunt triggers below 50% health, giving him speed and attack speed advantage.
- Play safe early; Warwick outduels you at level 2. Farm with Q from distance.
- Bait his E Primal Howl, then trade back. Avoid all-ins; his Q heals him.
- His R Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5 seconds. Play around vision and map awareness.
- First item spike around level 9 is dangerous. Respect his dueling power; don't force fights.
- You spike at level 11 with R Maximum Dosage and tankier items. Duel him then.
- Slow-push waves to stack health. This lets you survive his all-ins with more max health.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for early tankiness and repeated trading damage against him.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for magic resistance and cooldown reduction against his persistent damage.

drmundo__yorick.notes:
- Yorick's Maiden and Mist Walkers overwhelm you; kite backwards and use W to damage swarms.
- Play safe, farm at distance with Q, avoid close trades; Yorick's Q trade wins early.
- Dodge E Mourning Mist armor shred; bait his Q then trade with W active.
- Maximum Dosage healing lets you survive Maiden focus; use R to reengage after her spawn.
- Yorick's first item spike is moderate; your tankiness scales faster than his damage output.
- You outscale significantly; wait for teamfights where Maiden can't isolate you one-versus-one.
- Slow-push waves into tower; prevents Yorick from roaming with Maiden to other lanes easily.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and tank scaling against his poke.
- Add Thornmail if Maiden attack-focuses you; reflects damage back and reduces her effectiveness overall.

drmundo__yunara.notes:
- Yunara's Attack Speed and On-Hit damage from Q shred your Health pool relentlessly in extended fights.
- Play safe early; her Q comes online immediately and out-trades your limited damage. Farm defensively.
- Bait her Q activation then E her away before she stacks Attack Speed bonus damage heavily.
- Her R upgrades W into a laser and E into a dash—she becomes far more slippery overall.
- First item spike is dangerous; her On-Hit damage amplifies significantly. Play around cooldowns and disengage.
- You spike harder mid-game when Maximum Dosage sustain outpaces her damage. Fight near enemy towers.
- Slow-push waves into her to deny her roam and force her to trade with you.
- Take Grasp for sustain and health scaling synergy; it matches her extended trading better than alternatives.
- Add Adaptive Helm to reduce her repeated magic damage On-Hit application and maintain your bulk advantage.

drmundo__zilean.notes:
- Zilean's Chronoshift denies your all-in kills; play around cooldown windows carefully.
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid walking into double Time Bomb range.
- Bait Time Warp slow before committing trades; dodge stacked bombs with movement.
- Chronoshift makes killing Zilean impossible until cooldown; focus on objective control instead.
- His first item spike is minimal; use this window to pressure and farm safely.
- Post-Chronoshift cooldown (120s early) is your window; all-in when protection is down.
- Slow-push waves to deny Zilean roaming; reset when jungler is accounted for elsewhere.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke and to win extended trades naturally.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to stack health and maximize your passive tankiness value.

olaf__aatrox.notes:
- threat: Aatrox's Infernal Chains drags you in; World Ender fear locks you down helplessly
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Aatrox Q cooldown is long, respect his damage output
- trading: Dodge Infernal Chains at all costs; trade when his Q is down only
- post6: World Ender makes him untargetable to your crowd control; kite and wait cooldown
- spike: First item spike hurts; don't fight extended trades until you have defensive items
- window: Post-Aatrox ult cooldown is your window; all-in when World Ender expires or soon
- wave: Slow-push to stack minions; denies his Infernal Chains engage and forces extended fights
- rune: Grasp sustains your health pool against his poke and healing pressure consistently
- item: Add Maw of Malmortius early; blocks his fear and amplifies your survivability significantly

olaf__ahri.notes:
- Charm stuns you mid-engage; dodge it or accept getting kited and bursted down.
- Play safe; Ahri outranges you early. Farm with Q Undertow, avoid her poke patterns.
- Bait her E Charm before committing all-in; dodge it, then trade with W and E.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through Charm; activate R before engaging her post-6.
- First item spike is real danger; respect her damage and burst potential then.
- Level 6 onwards you dictate fights if you land Q Undertow and activate R aggressively.
- Slow-push waves toward her; force her to choose between farming or stopping your advance.
- Grasp sustains your poke damage and keeps you healthy for all-in engagements later.
- Add Adaptive Helm or Hollow Radiance to reduce her magic damage output significantly.

olaf__akali.notes:
- threat: Akali's W Twilight Shroud makes her untargetable; you cannot trade or finish her.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Five Point Strike outranges your trading tools safely.
- trading: Bait her W Twilight Shroud, then all-in with E Reckless Swing and Q Undertow.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore her R Perfect Execution execution attempts easily.
- spike: Her first item spike is real danger; respect her damage and play defensive.
- window: Once you complete two items, outdamage and sustain her through Berserker Rage and E.
- wave: Slow-push sidewaves so Akali must roam or lose CS; reduces her gank threat.
- rune: Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain and poke her down safely over time.
- item: Build Hollow Radiance early for magic resist and cooldown against her spell spam.

olaf__akshan.notes:
- threat: Akshan's Comeuppance true damage and mobility kiting make extended fights lethal for you.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading when Akshan has Dirty Fighting stacked up.
- trading: Bait Heroic Swing onto terrain, then all-in; dodge Avengerang by sidestepping its return.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Comeuppance lockdown; activate before his bullets land.
- spike: First item spike (likely crit) is dangerous; don't force extended trades yet.
- window: Level 11 with items outpaces Akshan if you land Undertow; chase relentlessly then.
- wave: Slow-push to build wave into him; forces Akshan to overextend or lose farm.
- rune: Grasp sustains poke trades and scales better into Akshan's kite-heavy playstyle than alternatives.
- item: Add Kaenic Lifegrip to reduce Comeuppance burst and heal from your own damage output.

olaf__alistar.notes:
- Alistar's Q Pulverize and W Headbutt chain stuns lock you down; his E Trample stun follows easily after.
- Levels 1-3 are safe farm; Alistar's cooldowns are long. Stay near minions, dodge Q Pulverize patterns carefully.
- Bait his Q Pulverize by moving unpredictably, then all-in with E Reckless Swing. Never face-check him raw.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables trivializes Alistar's combo chain; activate it preemptively before his stun sequence lands.
- Alistar's first item spike (Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Grudge) weakens your true damage; punish before completion.
- Your window is levels 2-5 when Ragnarok is unavailable and Alistar lacks cooldown reduction from items.
- Slow-push waves to deny Alistar aggressive angle; let him overextend toward minion stack before ganking nearby.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and strengthens short trades; synergizes with your P Berserker Rage.
- Kaenic Grudge converts his healing into shared damage taken, reducing his survivability versus your E true damage.

olaf__ambessa.notes:
- Ambessa's R Public Execution suppresses you, removing Ragnarok immunity and setting up guaranteed damage.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Ambessa has weak early trading. Farm freely and stack Berserker Rage.
- Bait her W Repudiation shield, then trade with Q Undertow. Never fight her E Lacerate.
- Ragnarok immunity does not cleanse suppression from Public Execution. Dodge her R or lose the fight.
- First item spike is minimal threat. Punish her with E Reckless Swing and Q resets aggressively.
- Your power window is mid-game with Ragnarok active and Berserker Rage stacked from trading damage.
- Slow-push waves toward her tower; forces her into extended fights where you outscale her sustained damage.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for tankiness and healing to survive her dual-blade trading patterns.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce her physical damage from Cunning Sweep and Sundering Slam pressure.

olaf__amumu.notes:
- Threat: Amumu's R stun combo into W true damage melts you; dodge or cleanse it.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Amumu outrades you, avoid extended fights before your E scales.
- Trading: Bait his Q stun, trade back with E true damage when he misses.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank R stun; activate during his ult to stay dangerous.
- Spike: First item spike around level 9 hurts; play safer, scale into your mid-game power.
- Window: Levels 11-13 you outfight him; press advantage before his tankiness and cooldowns spike hard.
- Wave: Slow-push to set up dives; force him to engage or lose CS to tower.
- Rune: Grasp for sustain trading and tankiness in the extended laning phase matchup here.
- Item: Abyssal Mask reduces his W true damage and amplifies your trading damage back.

olaf__annie.notes:
- Pyromania stun locks you down; she stacks it freely, then one spell chains you helplessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q outranges your engage, avoid her poke entirely, farm safely.
- Bait her Incinerate cone, then all-in; dodge Disintegrate by moving unpredictably, never trade back.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her stun lock; activate during her Summon Tibbers engage.
- First item spike around level 9-11 hurts; abuse levels 6-8 window before she completes items.
- Levels 6-8 are your peak; Ragnarok immunity beats her combo, run her down hard.
- Slow-push waves into her; force her to choose between farming and poking your wave.
- Take Grasp; the sustained damage and tankiness help you survive her poke and all-in.
- Add Adaptive Helm after core; reduces her spell damage significantly and weakens Tibbers burn damage.

olaf__aphelios.notes:
- Threat: Aphelios out-ranges you heavily; kite and burst you down before you close gap.
- Early: Play safe; his Calibrum marks punish close trades. Farm with Q from distance.
- Trading: Dodge his Calibrum shots by moving unpredictably; all-in only when he's out of ammo.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank his Moonlight Vigil burst and close in fearlessly.
- Spike: First item spike hurts; play around minions and avoid extended fights until you scale.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you; use Ragnarok to lock him down before he repositions.
- Wave: Slow-push to build wave; forces him into unfavorable all-ins or let you dive.
- Rune: Take Grasp; sustain through his poke and gain durability for long fights.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields burst and synergizes with Berserker Rage healing.

olaf__ashe.notes:
- Ashe's Enchanted Crystal Arrow stun locks you down; dodge or accept the engage cost.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her Volley range and Frost Shot slow chip damage.
- Bait her W Volley, then all-in with E Reckless Swing; dodge R at all costs.
- Post-6, her R Enchanted Crystal Arrow becomes a hard engage tool; play around fog of war.
- Her first item spike (likely crit) hurts; punish her before completing first major item.
- Windows open when her R is down; force fights and close distance during cooldown.
- Slow-push to deny her Volley safety; set up ganks by controlling minion positioning carefully.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke; trading often lets you heal back Volley spam.
- Buy early Adaptive Helm or Kaenic Rookern if her team stacks magic; resists help.

olaf__aurora.notes:
- Aurora's Across the Veil invisibility lets her kite and escape your all-in attempts easily
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q poke forces you to lose CS or take damage
- Bait out Across the Veil before committing; dodge The Weirding's slow or it chains escape
- Ragnarok immunity to disables helps, but she still kites; her Between Worlds shockwave is dangerous
- First item spike around 900 gold makes her poke unbearable; abuse before she completes it
- Your window is post-6 when she wastes Between Worlds mobility; then run her down immediately
- Slow-push sidewaves to force her into awkward positions where she can't kite you safely
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and shield value against her poke damage
- Grab Abyssal Mask early to reduce her spell damage and give you breathing room

olaf__aurelionsol.notes:
- Threat: Aurelion Sol kites you endlessly with Astral Flight while damaging you with Breath of Light.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid clumping near minions since his Q splashes reduced damage nearby.
- Trading: Bait his Astral Flight before committing; dodge Breath of Light channel by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore Falling Star stun; use this window to all-in.
- Spike: First item spike is his; Aurelion Sol gains Stardust stacks making abilities stronger—respect his damage.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Aurelion Sol is forced close; your all-in pressure dominates grouped enemies.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; deny him safe roam angles and force him to fight for positioning.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying sustains through his poke and procs when you catch him close.
- Item: Force of Nature blocks his magic damage and gives magic resist—essential against repeated Breath spam.

olaf__azir.notes:
- Azir kites and slows you endlessly; stay out of Conquering Sands and Sand Soldier range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range, avoid walking into his Sand Soldier attacks.
- Bait Shifting Sands before engaging; dodge Conquering Sands, then all-in when his soldiers are down.
- Ragnarok disable immunity lets you ignore his slows; use it to force fights post-6.
- First item spike (Liandry's or Nashor's) hurts; invade or roam before he completes it.
- Mid-game windows exist after Azir wastes Shifting Sands; all-in immediately with Ragnarok active.
- Slow-push into him; force him to choose between farming and repositioning under tower pressure.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading in short windows and health scaling into late game.
- Buy Kaenic Lifebringer early; heal through his poke and amplify damage he takes from you.

olaf__bard.notes:
- threat: Cosmic Binding stun locks you; Tempered Fate completely negates your Ragnarok activation window
- early: Safe farm. Bard roams constantly; respect his absence and farm defensively near tower
- trading: Bait Cosmic Binding by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing
- post6: Ragnarok makes you immune to Cosmic Binding stun, but Tempered Fate still hard-counters you
- spike: First item isn't huge threat window; use early levels before he scales roams
- window: Level 2-3 all-in before Cosmic Binding ranks up; repeat when his Q cooldown high
- wave: Slow-push toward enemy tower to minimize Bard roam impact and punish his absences
- rune: Grasp sustains you through poke and grants tankiness against his magic damage spam
- item: Hollow Radiance gives magic resist and blocks Meep slow, improving your chase and teamfights

olaf__belveth.notes:
- Bel'Veth's attack speed and mobility let her kite and duel Olaf across entire fights relentlessly
- Play safe levels 1-3; her dash range and knockup deny all-ins; farm defensively with Q
- Bait her W knockup, then immediately trade; dodge Void Surge by positioning near walls
- Ragnarok immunity lets you engage without fear of her W root, turning fights in your favor
- Her first item spike is real but manageable; punish her if she overextends for stacks
- After level 6, Olaf dominates short windows when Bel'Veth hasn't stacked enough attack speed yet
- Slow-push into her; forces her to choose between tower defense and roaming for monster stacks
- Take Grasp for consistent sustain trading and health to enable Berserker Rage scaling later
- Consider Kaenic Lifebane to reduce her lifesteal and amplify your true damage against her

olaf__blitzcrank.notes:
- Threat: Rocket Grab one-shots your positioning; dodge it or Blitzcrank drags you into his team.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range and respect Rocket Grab threat constantly.
- Trading: Bait Rocket Grab with sideways movement, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing immediately.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Rocket Grab disable and fight freely; activate before he grabs.
- Spike: First item spike matters little; Blitzcrank needs CDR to spam Rocket Grab dangerously.
- Window: Level 6 onward you dominate; Ragnarok negates his cc chain and enables aggressive engages.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways toward river; deny Blitzcrank grab angle while maintaining safety and cs pressure.
- Rune: Grasp sustains through poke and rewards frequent trading when you force his cooldowns down.
- Item: Hollow Radiance blocks his burst damage and Static Field silence; slot it third or fourth.

olaf__briar.notes:
- threat: Briar's Blood Frenzy relentless pursuit and Certain Death lockdown chain disable you completely
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near minions where she gap closes
- trading: Bait Head Rush with positioning, then retaliate with Undertow as she lands
- post6: Ragnarok becomes critical—activate immunity when she marks you with Certain Death to escape
- spike: First item around level 9 heavily favors Briar; respect her engage potential spike
- window: Level 2 before Head Rush unlock and post-Ragnarok when disables don't lock you
- wave: Slow-push toward your tower to bait her engage while maintaining exit distance
- rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain to offset her Crimson Curse bleed damage
- item: Add Hollow Radiance early to reduce her healing and stick potential damage

olaf__brand.notes:
- Brand stuns you with Q on ablaze targets; you cannot kite or escape his combo.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge W Pillar range, farm at distance, avoid extended trades.
- Bait his Q with E Reckless Swing shields or W Tough It Out; dodge W.
- Ragnarok immunity trivializes his stun chain; activate R when he combos to run him down.
- First item spike around 1000 gold is dangerous; stay healthy and respect his burst damage.
- You spike hardest levels 6-9 when Ragnarok active duration outpaces his combo windows; punish heavily.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Brand to fight near minions where you sustain better with E.
- Take Grasp for trading sustain in lane; enables repeated short trades that wear Brand down.
- Add Adaptive Helm after core items; reduces his magic damage and Blaze DoT stack pressure significantly.

olaf__braum.notes:
- Concussive Blows stun locks you; avoid stacking it by staying outside Braum's effective range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Braum out-trades you early. Farm with Q from distance.
- Bait Winter's Bite, then all-in with E and W. Never fight into Concussive stacks.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his stun; activate before he reaches 4 stacks on you.
- Braum's first armor item spikes his tankiness; your window is before he completes it fully.
- Post-first-item, Olaf dominates if Braum lacks defensive stats. Push this advantage immediately and relentlessly.
- Slow-push into him; force him to contest stacks or lose farm to tower gradually.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and tankiness to survive his support-enabled all-ins and poke.
- Build Kaenic Lifebane to shred his magic resist and convert his tankiness into your healing.

olaf__camille.notes:
- Camille's Hookshot knock-up stops your Ragnarok disable immunity; she locks you down hard.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Camille out-trades you early. Farm with Q, avoid all-ins.
- Bait her Hookshot near walls, then all-in. Never trade into her Q damage windows.
- Ragnarok immunity means nothing if she lands Hookshot first; play around her cooldown timing.
- First item spike is dangerous; avoid extended fights until you have survivability items stacked.
- You spike mid-game with multiple items; her true damage falls off relative to your tankiness.
- Slow-push to deny her wall angles for Hookshot; control side lane spacing carefully always.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains trades better than alternatives; keeps you healthy in lane.
- Adaptive Helm blocks her Tactical Sweep damage and healing; purchase when she stacks magic damage.

olaf__cassiopeia.notes:
- Cassiopeia's Miasma grounds you, blocking Ragnarok's disable immunity and all movement abilities.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Noxious Blast and Miasma poke out-range your tools.
- Dodge Miasma clouds; bait her Q then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing.
- Ragnarok immunity doesn't cleanse grounding, so Miasma still prevents you from moving or escaping.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and poke range spike.
- You gain advantage when she wastes Miasma cooldown; all-in immediately with full Undertow combo.
- Freeze or slow-push near your tower; she needs to overextend to punish you.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and tankiness against her poke damage.
- Consider Maw of Malmortius to block her burst and reduce magic damage intake.

olaf__corki.notes:
- Threat: Corki's poke from range and Missile Barrage burst catch you before engaging effectively.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Corki outranges you. Farm under tower, avoid Phosphorus Bomb poke.
- Trading: Bait Valkyrie then all-in; dodge Gatling Gun cone by moving unpredictably sideways always.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank Missile Barrage and engage; use this advantage heavily.
- Spike: Corki's first item (Trinity/similar) threatens you; stay back until Berserker Rage scales harder.
- Window: After level 6 with Ragnarok active, gap-close and duel Corki in melee range.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; forces Corki to position poorly and gives Ragnarok time to cooldown.
- Rune: Grasp sustains you through poke and strengthens trades when you do connect closely.
- Item: Adaptive Helm reduces Corki's repeated magic damage from Missile Barrage and Gatling Gun.

olaf__chogath.notes:
- Cho'Gath's Feral Scream Silence stops your Ragnarok activation, leaving you vulnerable to his full combo
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his Rupture range and avoid clumping near walls for easy hits
- Bait Feral Scream with aggressive positioning, then all-in when Silence ends; dodge Rupture by moving unpredictably
- Post-6 Ragnarok lets you ignore his Silence and trade favorably; activate proactively before Feral Scream lands
- His first major item spike is dangerous; stay healthy and avoid isolated fights until you complete items
- Olaf spikes hardest mid-game when tankier; use this window to group and force fights before he scales
- Slow-push waves to maintain pressure without overextending; control side brushes to avoid free Rupture setups
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling to outlast his poke damage
- Build Maw of Malmortius second or third to block his magic burst and mitigate Silence vulnerability

olaf__darius.notes:
- Threat: Darius stacks Hemorrhage and ults for massive true damage; you cannot out-trade him at high stacks.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades when Darius walks up with Crippling Strike ready.
- Trading: Bait his Apprehend pull, then all-in with Reckless Swing; dodge Decimate's blade by stepping inward.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you survive Noxian Guillotine; activate before he ults to negate the disable.
- Spike: His first Armor item spike is dangerous; you lack sustained damage to force favorable trades.
- Window: Level 6+ with Ragnarok active gives you a window to dive or fight without fear of ult execute.
- Wave: Slow-push waves into him; deny him freeze control and force him to chase into your terrain.
- Rune: Grasp sustains you through his poke and stacking damage; extra health scales your Berserker Rage.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts his physical damage to healing for you when he commits Hemorrhage stacks.

olaf__diana.notes:
- Diana's Lunar Rush with Moonlight resets cooldown; she'll all-in you repeatedly if you get marked.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Crescent Strike range outmatches yours. Farm with Q Undertow instead.
- Bait her Pale Cascade shield, then trade back hard; dodge her Q Crescent Strike at all costs.
- Post-6 Ragnarok, activate immediately when she Lunar Rushes in to become disable-immune and fight back.
- Diana first item spike is dangerous; respect her burst window and play safer until you scale.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where Ragnarok's disable immunity negates her Moonfall crowd control setup.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam opportunities; group fast when she leaves lane to stop picks.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain and tankiness keep you healthy against her poke and all-ins.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for magic resist; reduces her burst damage and supports your teamfight presence.

olaf__drmundo.notes:
- Mundo's Q and R healing make him unkillable; focus on preventing his reset windows.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Q and avoid extended trades near his minions.
- Bait his Q, then all-in with E true damage; dodge his Q slash at all costs.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his slows; activate R when he ults to sustain fight.
- First item spike is dangerous; abuse windows before he completes items and healing multiplies.
- Post-6 with items you outscale hard; all-in when his R is down and vulnerable.
- Slow-push to deny his Q resets and force him to extend for CS or reset.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling to match his tank-focused itemization better.
- Build Hollow Radiance to reduce his massive healing and amplify your true damage pressure.

olaf__draven.notes:
- threat: Draven's Spinning Axe resets and bonus gold snowball make him scale faster than you.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near his axes or Stand Aside engage range.
- trading: Bait Stand Aside, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing while he repositions for axes.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank Whirling Death and dive him; use this to force fights.
- spike: His first item spike hurts; dodge it by farming safely and matching his push with Undertow.
- window: Mid-game when you have 2-3 items and Ragnarok active; Draven needs constant axes to duel.
- wave: Slow-push toward his tower; forces him to either farm under tower or chase your Undertow axes.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain and chunk him during short trades when axes are down.
- item: Force of Nature; magic resist and move speed counter his kite and poke pressure.

olaf__elise.notes:
- Cocoon stun locks you down; dodge it or get deleted by her burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Undertow, avoid her all-in range.
- Bait her Cocoon by moving unpredictably, then trade with W Tough It Out shield.
- Post-6 Ragnarok blocks her stun duration; activate R when she lands Cocoon for immunity.
- First item spike (Liandry's or similar) hurts; punish her by all-inning before she completes it.
- Level 6+ is your window; Ragnarok disable immunity turns her stun into a free engage.
- Slow-push waves toward her tower; forces her to either fight or lose CS safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into late game.
- Build Adaptive Helm early to nerf her magic damage and Spider Form healing output.

olaf__ekko.notes:
- threat: Ekko's E Phase Dive lets him kite and escape your all-ins; his R Chronobreak negates your burst
- early: Safe farm; Ekko out-trades you pre-6. Don't chase into minions where his Q Timewinder stuns you easily
- trading: Bait his E Phase Dive, then engage. Avoid his Q return path; dodge into minions when possible
- post6: Ragnarok immunity doesn't stop his damage, only disables. Ekko's R Chronobreak makes extended fights unfavorable; keep pressure
- spike: First item spike (likely AP damage) hurts; punish him before he has mana and CDR online
- window: Mid-game when Ekko lacks mobility items yet. Force teamfights where he can't kite; stick with Undertow
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; control jungle proximity. Prevents Ekko from roaming and forces him to defend passively
- rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustain through poke and gain tankiness to outlast his burst trades
- item: Force of Nature. Magic resist scaling and move speed counter his chasing and magic damage stacking

olaf__evelynn.notes:
- threat: Evelynn's charm from Allure locks you down; her burst combo deletes low-health targets instantly.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Evelynn weak pre-6 without Camouflage. Avoid her Whiplash engage attempts.
- trading: Bait her Whiplash with Q movement, then E true damage trade back hard.
- post6: Evelynn gains Camouflage; expect ganks. Use R Ragnarok preemptively to cleanse her charm disable.
- spike: First item spike dangerous; she gains burst. Maintain distance and prioritize healing with Berserker Rage.
- window: Punish her post-ult cooldown window; she's vulnerable. Chase with Q reset opportunities aggressively.
- wave: Slow-push toward her; forces her to fight you or lose cs under tower.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain extends your health pool against her poke damage.
- item: Force of Nature; magic resist and move speed counter her charm lock threats.

olaf__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Threat: Terrify fear locks you down; Crowstorm damage forces you to engage or flee helplessly.
- Early: Safe farm. Fiddlesticks weak early; avoid pushing alone into fog or river without vision.
- Trading: Bait Terrify by moving unpredictably; trade when Fiddlesticks channels Bountiful Harvest for guaranteed damage.
- Post6: Crowstorm is lethal in chokes. Ward river; play wider map; never get caught isolated.
- Spike: Fiddlesticks first item spikes around level 9-11. Respect positioning; don't extend into fog pressure.
- Window: Levels 1-5 before Crowstorm. Punish lane aggression; build lead before his ultimate dominates.
- Wave: Slow-push towards enemy tower. Denies Fiddlesticks roam windows; keeps you safer in side lane.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustain through poke and execute damage from Reckless Swing.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip. Cleanse crowd control and negate execute poke from his combo damage.

olaf__fiora.notes:
- Fiora's Vitals and Riposte deny you extended fights; she kites and heals through your damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Fiora outranges you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Bait her Riposte with Undertow before committing; never Reckless Swing into her parry window.
- Ragnarok immunity breaks her disable chain but she still kites. Activate into her, not before.
- First item spike around 1100 gold is dangerous; she gains dueling power. Play safer, scale.
- Your window is mid-game when you complete first item and threaten teamfights; rotate there.
- Slow-push waves toward her; forces her to engage you in minion advantage or rotate.
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading strength; Fiora beats pure damage races early always.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip; gives tankiness, healing amplification, and helps you survive her burst patterns.

olaf__fizz.notes:
- threat: Fizz's E Playful / Trickster dodges your damage and sets up his engage onto you.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Fizz out-trades you. Farm with Q Undertow at range, avoid extended fights.
- trading: Bait out his E Playful / Trickster before committing. Trade when it's down; dodge his Q Urchin Strike.
- post6: Ragnarok Ragnarok immunity to disables counters his R Chum the Waters knockup. Use this window aggressively.
- spike: Fizz's first item spike is dangerous. Play safer and focus on farming until you complete items.
- window: You spike harder mid-game with items and Ragnarok Ragnarok active. Abuse this before late-game teamfights.
- wave: Slow-push waves toward him. This denies roams and forces him into extended fights where you scale.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains you through his poke and strengthens your early survivability.
- item: Add Hollow Radiance to reduce his magic damage and improve your tankiness against his bleed.

olaf__galio.notes:
- Threat: W Shield of Durand taunt locks you down; E Justice Punch knocks you up before fights
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Galio outranges you with Q Winds of War, avoid extended trades
- Trading: Bait E Justice Punch, then chase with Q Undertow; dodge W Shield of Durand charges
- Post6: Ragnarok R counters Galio's CC chain; activate it when he commits to W or E
- Spike: Galio first item spike threatens you; play safer, focus on scaling and side-lane pressure
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you when Galio wastes W Shield of Durand; punish isolated targets
- Wave: Slow-push toward Galio's tower; forces him to extend and vulnerable to Q Undertow ganks
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you stick and chase after dodging his CC, securing kills
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifegrip after core; converts his magic damage into healing for you

olaf__gangplank.notes:
- Gangplank's Cannon Barrage slows and zones you; his kiting and poke pressure overwhelm your close range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his Parrrley range and poke damage; farm at distance when possible.
- Bait his Remove Scurvy before committing; dodge Powder Keg explosions; trade when his Q is down.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his slow; activate mid-Cannon Barrage to gap-close and all-in him.
- His first item spike (likely Sheen item) increases his Parrrley damage; this is your punish window.
- You spike harder mid-game once you have health items; Gangplank falls off relative to your dueling power.
- Slow-push to stack waves; force him to choose between farming and defending against your all-in threat.
- Take Grasp for sustain to offset Parrrley poke and win extended trades with early item advantage.
- Build Force of Nature early if Cannon Barrage spam prevents you from reaching him safely in fights.

olaf__garen.notes:
- Garen's Decisive Strike silences you, blocking Ragnarok activation and disabling counterplay options.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Garen wins short trades. Farm at range with Q Undertow.
- Bait his Q Decisive Strike, then all-in. Dodge his E Judgment spin damage.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his Q silence and win extended fights easily.
- His first item spike is moderate; your Berserker Rage scales better into mid-game fights.
- Power spike arrives post-6 with Ragnarok; all-in him before he stacks Courage resistances.
- Slow-push waves to deny him roam pressure; keep him glued to lane farm.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain nullifies his poke and wins extended trades.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip; it converts his E true damage into healing for survivability.

olaf__gragas.notes:
- Gragas Body Slam stun locks you and negates your Ragnarok disable immunity window.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gragas out-damages you early. Farm at range, respect his all-in.
- Bait Body Slam by moving unpredictably, then trade with Undertow while his cooldown resets.
- Ragnarok makes you immune to his stun but not his damage; use carefully.
- First item spike around 10 minutes is dangerous; respect his damage and kite potential.
- You spike harder mid-game when items amplify your tankiness and Undertow spam dominates.
- Slow-push to set up ganks; Gragas needs space to land Body Slam effectively.
- Take Grasp for sustain in this poke-heavy matchup; healing keeps you healthy and aggressive.
- Build Force of Nature early if Gragas snowballs; magic resist reduces his burst significantly.

olaf__gnar.notes:
- Gnar kites you with Boomerang Throw and Hop, slowing and spacing away from Undertow range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gnar outranges you. Farm passively and avoid his Boomerang Throw poke.
- Bait his Hop away, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing when he lands.
- Ragnarok immunity counters Mega Gnar stuns from Wallop and GNAR!, but watch wall angles.
- Watch Gnar's Rage bar; at first item spike he transforms more often—dodge Mega Gnar engages.
- Your window is when Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar; he loses kiting tools temporarily.
- Slow-push waves toward Gnar to limit his Hop escape routes and force commitments.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain in a ranged matchup where trading is difficult.
- Add Kaenic Lifebane late to reduce Gnar's resistances and maximize Reckless Swing true damage output.

olaf__graves.notes:
- Graves' burst damage from close range overwhelms Olaf's defenses before Berserker Rage scales up enough.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Graves' four-bullet spread deals massive damage. Farm at range, avoid short trades.
- Bait End of the Line then all-in; dodge Smoke Screen's slow or fight inside it.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you survive Collateral Damage and close gaps; Graves must kite or lose.
- First-item spike around 1100 gold is dangerous; respect his damage and scale into mid-game.
- Post-six when Ragnarok active, you win all-ins if Graves wastes Collateral Damage or Quickdraw poorly.
- Slow-push sidewaves to force Graves to respond; don't let him roam freely with mobility advantage.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain offsets his poke and scales into longer fights naturally.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early if Graves gets ahead; the magic resist and utility help massively.

olaf__gwen.notes:
- Gwen's W Hallowed Mist blocks your all-in damage; she kites and heals through Thousand Cuts passive.
- Play safe early; Gwen outranges you with Q Snip Snip! damage. Farm at distance, avoid trades.
- Bait her W Hallowed Mist down, then all-in when it expires. Don't chase into mist.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disable tools; activate during her E Skip 'n Slash kite.
- First item spike (likely Nashor's or Liandry's) increases her sustained damage; play safer, stack resistances.
- Your window is mid-game when she lacks items; force grouping and teamfights where mist doesn't protect.
- Slow-push waves into her tower; deny her roams and force her to defend or lose CS.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; you need healing to match her passive drain pattern.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early for magic resist and healing reduction against her Thousand Cuts sustain.

olaf__hecarim.notes:
- Hecarim's Devastating Charge knockback and Onslaught of Shadows fear lock you down and kite away.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Hecarim outtrades early. Last-hit under tower, avoid his Rampage spam.
- Bait Devastating Charge, then Undertow to slow him. Trade when his E is down only.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his fear and knockback; activate during his Onslaught charge.
- First item spike (likely Trinity Force) is dangerous; respect his damage and kiting potential hard.
- Post-6 with Ragnarok active, you win extended fights. Use it proactively when he engages.
- Slow-push waves into him; denies his roam, forces him to respond or lose minions.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling into a long, attrition-based lane.
- Buy Plated Steelcaps early to reduce his Rampage damage and slow his Devastating Charge.

olaf__heimerdinger.notes:
- Heimerdinger's turrets deal constant chip damage; dodge Q placement and respect grenade stun range.
- Play safe level 1-3; farm at range, avoid turret zones, watch for E grenade setup.
- Bait his E grenade, then Undertow through turrets to reset cooldown and chase him down.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore stuns; activate during his E and dive through turret fire.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect turret damage output, but you outscale and all-in him.
- Post-6 you dominate; Ragnarok negates his crowd control, allowing you to destroy turrets and kill him.
- Slow-push toward his turrets; force him to choose between defending and roaming, creating kill windows.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain through turret poke and scale into your tankiness advantage.
- Consider Abyssal Mask second or third; magic resist reduces turret and grenade damage significantly overall.

olaf__illaoi.notes:
- Threat: Test of Spirit rips your spirit out; dodge it or face massive delayed damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Illaoi out-trades you when Tentacles are nearby on terrain.
- Trading: Bait her W Harsh Lesson, then all-in with Q-E before she lands it.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disable attempts; use it to gap-close and commit.
- Spike: First item (likely Kaenic Destructhor) isn't her spike; you can duel her early.
- Window: Levels 4-5 before her ult; abuse mobility and force short fights away from Tentacles.
- Wave: Slow-push into her; deny Tentacle spawn locations and bait her E on minions.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain through her poke and win extended trades.
- Item: Kaenic Destructhor negates her healing and reduces her magic damage threat significantly.

olaf__hwei.notes:
- threat: Hwei's crowd control from E abilities locks you down; his Q damage bursts you hard
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Hwei needs setup time, avoid trading near his painted zones
- trading: Bait his E Subject: Torment crowd control, then all-in; dodge Gaze of the Abyss stuns
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Spiraling Despair slow and damage; activate before he ults
- spike: First item is danger window; Hwei gains damage spike, kite you better with utility
- window: Level 6+ when Ragnarok active immunity nullifies his E crowd control chains completely
- wave: Slow-push to deny Hwei safe poke positioning; force him to choose between wave and farming
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; it kites Hwei's painted zones and closes gaps through his crowd control
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip; converts his burst damage into healing when he hits you during all-ins

olaf__irelia.notes:
- Irelia's Flawless Duet stun and Mark chain locks you down for Bladesurge resets.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Bladesurge heal out-trades your early damage output.
- Bait Flawless Duet with positioning, then Undertow her as she repositions to dodge.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her stun; activate before her Flawless Duet lands.
- First item spike around 1100 gold is dangerous; respect her Bladesurge reset range.
- You outscale mid-game when Tough It Out and Berserker Rage activate together.
- Slow-push to prevent her from roaming; force her to farm or lose waves.
- Grasp sustains you through her poke and trading while scaling tankier than her.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce her true-damage Bladesurge and heal reduction threats.

olaf__ivern.notes:
- threat: Rootcaller root locks you down; Daisy kites and blocks your engage paths
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Ivern outranges Q, avoid trading near brush patches
- trading: Bait Rootcaller by moving unpredictably, then all-in with E when root misses
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Daisy and root; activate before Rootcaller lands
- spike: First item spike minimal threat; Olaf damage and tankiness outpace Ivern's early output
- window: Level 6 onward; Ragnarok negates Ivern's only hard CC, enables forced teamfights
- wave: Slow-push toward Ivern; force him to defend or miss grove camp timers
- rune: Grasp; sustain through poke and gain tankiness for extended fights against Daisy
- item: Spirit Visage; magic resist counters Triggerseed shield damage and Ivern's brush amplification

olaf__janna.notes:
- Janna's Monsoon and Zephyr slow cripple your all-in; kite control shuts down Olaf entirely.
- Play safe early; Janna outranges you. Farm passively, avoid her Q knockup; wait for ganks.
- Bait her Zephyr slow before committing trades. Use Undertow to close gaps between her abilities.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disables; activate during her Monsoon to push through.
- Her first shielding item spike strengthens ally defense; punish her immobility with Undertow spam trades.
- Post-6 with Ragnarok active during team fights; she cannot stop your engagement or healing.
- Slow-push waves toward her tower; force her to choose between defending or roaming with team.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading pressure and durability against her harass.
- Build Mercury's Treads early to reduce slow effectiveness; item flexibility helps against her kite abuse.

olaf__jarvaniv.notes:
- Jarvan IV's Cataclysm traps you; Ragnarok immunity only works if attacking constantly inside.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Martial Cadence chunk procs often, respect his all-in range.
- Bait his Q Dragon Strike, then engage; dodge the knock-up by moving sideways early.
- Ragnarok counters his disable lock-down if you keep swinging; activate before Cataclysm lands.
- His first item spike (Trinity Force or Black Cleaver) hurts; match it with Kaenic Rookern.
- Post-6 when his cooldowns are down, all-in him; he cannot chain disables if Ragnarok active.
- Slow-push into him; forces Jarvan to contest or lose cs, triggering your Berserker Rage advantage.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain through poke and win extended trades with true damage.
- Build Kaenic Rookern second or third; negates his armor shred and supports your tanky playstyle.

olaf__jayce.notes:
- Jayce's Shock Blast and Thundering Blow kite and burst you before you close the gap.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Jayce out-ranges you heavily. Farm with Q Undertow, pick up axe.
- Bait Shock Blast, then all-in when it's down. Dodge Thundering Blow by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his slows and walk through gate; gap closes become viable.
- First item spike around 1000g is dangerous; avoid extended trades. Wait for your own items.
- Your window is mid-game when Ragnarok is active and you've landed items. Dominate teamfights.
- Slow-push waves into him; force Jayce to choose between shoving or roaming to teammates.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into late game.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius to block Shock Blast burst and gain spell shield protection early.

olaf__jax.notes:
- Jax Counter Strike dodges your damage and stuns; his sustained scaling outpaces yours massively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; don't trade into his range. Farm with Q from distance safely.
- Bait Counter Strike with Undertow or Reckless Swing, then all-in when dodge ends. Avoid extended trades.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his stun but Jax still out-scales; don't overcommit post-six fights.
- His first item spike is dangerous; avoid extended skirmishes until you finish your first completed item.
- You win early skirmishes before he stacks Relentless Assault; force fights levels 2-4 if ahead.
- Slow-push to deny him freeze; keep wave near your tower to control all-in timing safely.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke; the bonus health helps survive his true damage scaling.
- Buy Spirit Visage early if ahead; magic resist scales into his Grandmaster-at-Arms magic damage threat.

olaf__jhin.notes:
- threat: Deadly Flourish and Curtain Call lock you down from range; avoid getting caught
- early: Play safe; Jhin out-ranges you heavily, so focus on farming under tower
- trading: Bait Deadly Flourish by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing
- post6: Ragnarok makes you immune to Curtain Call slow; activate when he ults you
- spike: First item spike hurts; respect his damage and play defensive until you scale
- window: Mid-game teamfights where Jhin separates from team; chase with Undertow resets and engage
- wave: Slow-push to create gank opportunities; Jhin struggles when forced into close-range fights
- rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you stick and gap-close despite his kiting attempts
- item: Force of Nature reduces his magic damage and provides needed tenacity against utility

olaf__jinx.notes:
- threat: Jinx's W Zap! and R Super Mega Death Rocket! slow and burst you from range safely.
- early: Farm safely at range; Jinx out-ranges you early. Avoid walking into W Zap! slow zones.
- trading: Bait her W Zap! by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Q Undertow and E Reckless Swing.
- post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you tank her R Super Mega Death Rocket! and engage fearlessly.
- spike: Her first item spike (likely crit) hurts; play safer and farm until you complete yours.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you activate R Ragnarok and dive past her frontline to shutdown Jinx.
- wave: Slow-push waves into her so she must choose between farming and defending tower pressure.
- rune: Grasp for sustained trading and health to fuel Berserker Rage when you eventually all-in.
- item: Force of Nature if she builds lethality; otherwise prioritize your core tankiness and engage items.

olaf__kalista.notes:
- Kalista kites relentlessly with Martial Poise and Rend stacks; you cannot chase effectively.
- Play safely levels 1-3; her range and mobility deny you early all-ins.
- Bait her Rend activation then engage; dodge Pierce by moving perpendicular to its path.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her slows; use it to gap-close and commit fully.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and kite threat; farm safely.
- Post-15 minutes when you complete tank items; she struggles against sustained tankiness and engage.
- Slow-push waves toward her tower; force her to decide between farming and fighting.
- Take Grasp; sustain through her poke and gain tankiness for extended fights.
- Add Kaenic Lifebrace; reduces her percentage damage and gives you healing against her.

olaf__kaisa.notes:
- Kai'Sa's Plasma stacks from your attacks enable her burst; kite and avoid extended trades.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke outranges you. Farm with Q from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Dodge her W Void Seeker marks. Bait her E Supercharge, then engage with your R.
- Post-6, Kai'Sa's Killer Instinct dash gap-close threatens you; respect her all-in potential severely.
- Her first item spike (Manamune or AP item) is dangerous; play defensively until you scale.
- Your window is mid-game when Ragnarok active provides disable immunity; force fights then.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam; maintain lane pressure and avoid getting shoved under tower.
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; you need durability against her sustained Plasma damage.
- Buy Force of Nature if she goes full AP; magic resist counters her Plasma scaling.

olaf__karma.notes:
- Karma's Focused Resolve root locks you down; dodge it or Ragnarok through it immediately.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke range outmatches yours, farm under tower if needed.
- Bait Focused Resolve with Undertow, then all-in when her tether is on cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her roots and Mantra-enhanced CC; activate liberally in fights.
- First item spike is minimal threat; use early levels to establish wave control advantage.
- Post-6 you spike harder; Ragnarok breaks her combo, engage when she wastes Focused Resolve.
- Slow-push toward her tower to force her into extended trades where your sustain wins.
- Take Grasp for extended trade sustain; scales better into teamfights than burst alternatives do.
- Add Adaptive Helm if she stacks AP; reduces her burst and shields effectiveness significantly.

olaf__karthus.notes:
- Requiem deals unavoidable damage to all champions; dodge by staying outside fights when channeling.
- Safe farm early; Karthus weak pre-6. Avoid Lay Waste poke, position near minions for isolation negation.
- Bait Lay Waste delay, sidestep it, then all-in. Never trade into Defile's mana sustain spam.
- Post-6 Requiem forces repositioning; don't teamfight clustered. Ragnarok immunity doesn't block Requiem's damage output.
- First item spike dangerous; Karthus gains mana/damage. Punish by forcing fights before he completes.
- Level 6 onward you spike harder; all-in when Requiem unavailable or cooldown approaches.
- Slow-push to deny Lay Waste angle and control wave positioning against Wall of Pain.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke; healing lets you frontline longer pre-teamfight.
- Kaenic Lifebringer blocks magic damage and shreds magic resist on Karthus simultaneously.

olaf__kassadin.notes:
- Kassadin's mobility and damage avoidance via Riftwalk makes him slippery; catch him early before six.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kassadin outranges you and Null Sphere interrupts your aggression attempts consistently.
- Bait Null Sphere with Undertow, then all-in with Reckless Swing; dodge his Force Pulse cones.
- Post-six Kassadin becomes untouchable with Riftwalk spam; play around cooldowns and force fights when he lacks mana.
- First item spike (Archangel's or similar) makes him tankier; this is your last window before scaling.
- Your power window is levels 4-5 before Riftwalk; abuse Undertow cooldown resets and all-in pressure then.
- Slow-push toward Kassadin's tower; forces him to choose between farm and safety, limits his roaming threat.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health to enable Berserker Rage; Kassadin can't out-trade grasp procs.
- Build Force of Nature early if he stacks magic damage; negates his scaling and magic resist shred.

olaf__katarina.notes:
- Katarina's Death Lotus channels massive magic damage; dodge or disable her during ultimate.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades and respect her all-in potential early.
- Bait her Shunpo onto you, then trade back hard with Reckless Swing immediately.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you tank Death Lotus; activate during her channel phase.
- Katarina's first item spike is dangerous; play defensively and avoid grouping near her.
- Olaf dominates when Katarina wastes Shunpo or when you catch her without daggers.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam angles and keep her pinned to lane.
- Take Grasp for sustain to outlast her poke and gain tankiness into her.
- Build Abyssal Mask early to reduce her magic damage and amplify your survivability.

olaf__kayle.notes:
- threat: Kayle's Divine Judgment makes Olaf's all-in useless; her scaling outpaces his mid-game
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm under tower, avoid her Radiant Blast poke damage
- trading: Bait Celestial Blessing for allies, then all-in when her healing is on cooldown
- post6: Ragnarok becomes mandatory before Divine Judgment; time your ult activation carefully against hers
- spike: First item spike (around 10-12 minutes) is dangerous; respect her range and damage
- window: Levels 4-5 before her first item complete; aggressive trading with Undertow and Reckless Swing
- wave: Slow-push to deny her safe farming and set up ganks; minimize her scaling time
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain trades and scale better into her late-game threat
- item: Spirit Visage or Adaptive Helm; reduces her Starfire Spellblade burst damage significantly

olaf__kennen.notes:
- Kennen stuns you three times with Mark of the Storm, then ults while you're locked down helpless.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid pushing up. Farm under tower, dodge Thundering Shuriken, respect his poke range.
- Bait his Electrical Surge procs on minions, then all-in when cooldown is down. Never trade into marked stacks.
- Ragnarok lets you ignore his stuns during activation, but Slicing Maelstrom still chunks you hard. Play around it.
- Kennen's first item spike is real danger; you lack tankiness then. Survive and outscale with health items.
- Your window opens mid-game when you have Hollow Radiance and Kaenic Lifeline; duel him then aggressively.
- Slow-push waves into him so he can't roam freely. Deny his side-lane pressure while you scale.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against his poke and to stack health for late teamfights.
- Buy Kaenic Lifeline early after core defense; magic resist cuts his ult and Slicing Maelstrom burst significantly.

olaf__khazix.notes:
- Kha'Zix isolation damage on Q overwhelms Olaf; avoid fighting alone away from allies.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kha'Zix outduels you early. Farm under tower if isolated.
- Bait his Leap with positioning; punish the cooldown with Undertow and all-in.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you tank his burst, but he'll kite with Void Spike heals.
- Kha'Zix first item spike is dangerous; stay grouped and farm safely until you scale.
- You spike harder mid-game with items; group with team to negate his isolation advantage.
- Slow-push waves to maintain enemy proximity and deny him isolated targets for trading.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and durability against his poke and trades.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip to reduce his magic damage and synergize with your lifesteal scaling.

olaf__kindred.notes:
- threat: Lamb's Respite denies your all-ins; Mounting Dread's Wolf pounce chunks you hard
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid brawling—Kindred's kiting and poke outrange your engage
- trading: Bait Dance of Arrows before committing; dodge it, then Undertow into them
- post6: Ragnarok counters Lamb's Respite disable immunity—activate during their ult for free engage
- spike: First item spike (likely crit/AS item) around 2k gold is their danger window
- window: Level 6 Ragnarok and mid-game when grouped; stick close to prevent kiting
- wave: Slow-push side lanes—force Kindred to choose between farm and contesting your pressure
- rune: Grasp grants sustained bulk needed against poke; converts short trades into health leads
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip adds defensive stats while amplifying your W shield and E true damage

olaf__kled.notes:
- Kled's Jousting dash combined with Bear Trap on a Rope engage locks you down repeatedly and resets.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kled wins short trades. Farm at range, avoid his Bear Trap hook attempts.
- Bait his Jousting; dodge Bear Trap on a Rope by positioning unpredictably near minions and terrain.
