- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore his hook and dash lockdown; activate liberally post-six fights.
- Kled's first item spike is real danger; farm safely until you complete two items and Berserker Rage stacking.
- Your power window arrives mid-game when Ragnarok is available; all-in after he uses Jousting carelessly or missses hook.
- Slow-push waves toward your tower; force him to commit Jousting to reach you, then counter with Undertow.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading durability and health stacking to fuel Berserker Rage scaling.
- Buy Force of Nature early if Kled builds lethality; the magic resist and move speed helps kite his dash.

olaf__leblanc.notes:
- Threat: LeBlanc's Ethereal Chains roots you; dodge it or she kites forever with Distortion.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; she outranges you. Wait for her to waste Distortion before trading.
- Trading: Bait her W Distortion, then all-in with Q Undertow and E Reckless Swing immediately after.
- Post6: Ragnarok makes you disable-immune; activate it before her E Ethereal Chains lands to ignore root.
- Spike: Her first item spike hurts; stay healthy via W Tough It Out shield early trades.
- Window: Level 6 with Ragnarok active is your biggest advantage—chase her through her kite attempts.
- Wave: Slow-push and look for all-ins; don't chase her into tower where she Distorts freely.
- Rune: Take Grasp; sustain mitigates poke and lets you trade while staying healthy for all-ins.
- Item: Add Abyssal Mask; reduces her burst and synergizes with your health-scaling defenses from Ragnarok.

olaf__kogmaw.notes:
- threat: Kog'Maw's Bio-Arcane Barrage percentage damage shreds you; his range keeps him safe from Undertow
- early: Safe farm only; Kog'Maw out-ranges you heavily, avoid all-ins before level 6 Ragnarok
- trading: Bait his Q Caustic Spittle, then gap-close with Undertow; dodge his E Void Ooze
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his kiting; activate it before committing to all-in engages
- spike: Kog'Maw first item spike dangerous; he gains range and damage; farm safely, don't fight
- window: Post-6 when Ragnarok active and Kog'Maw low on mana; chase him down relentlessly then
- wave: Slow-push and deny him safe poke; force him into uncomfortable positions near your tower
- rune: Grasp procs repeatedly during extended fights; sustains you against his percentage health damage output
- item: Adaptive Helm reduces his magic damage; build it third after core damage items

olaf__leesin.notes:
- Lee Sin's Q-R combo catches you immobile; dodge Sonic Wave or face guaranteed knockback damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Lee Sin out-damages you early. Farm under tower, avoid his Sonic Wave.
- Bait his Q with movement; when he misses, all-in immediately before Resonating Strike cooldown resets.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables counters Dragon's Rage knockback completely; activate when you see him commit.
- First item spike around 1100 gold is dangerous; respect his burst potential, play safer near walls.
- You spike at level 11 when Ragnarok cooldown decreases; abuse immunity window to duel him freely.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Lee Sin to either engage or lose CS under tower pressure.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; extra tankiness and healing sustain outscales Lee Sin's early burst trading.
- Buy Hollow Radiance for magic resist and ability haste; reduces his magic damage and cooldown advantage.

olaf__leona.notes:
- Leona stuns you with Q or E, then your Berserker Rage cannot save you from burst combo.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her all-in with Q is stronger. Farm with Q from range.
- Bait her E Zenith Blade, then all-in when she dashes; dodge her Q stun attempts.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her stuns during ult, but she still blocks your engage.
- Her first armor item spike is dangerous; dodge engages until you complete Hollow Radiance or similar.
- You spike hardest mid-game when Ragnarok uptime peaks; force fights when her cooldowns are down.
- Slow-push waves into her tower to bait her forward, then E Reckless Swing all-in her.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and health scaling into her poke and all-ins.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for magic resist and healing amplification against her magic damage focus.

olaf__lillia.notes:
- Threat: Lillia kites you with Move Speed stacks and slows; Dream-Laden Bough shreds your Health pool.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Lillia out-ranges you and kiting makes trading terrible for Olaf.
- Trading: Bait her Q Blooming Blows activation, then all-in; dodge E Swirlseed slow to maintain chase.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore her R Lilting Lullaby sleep crowd control threat.
- Spike: First item spike favors Lillia; abuse levels 4-5 window before she gets item power.
- Window: Post-six with Ragnarok active, run her down hard; she cannot kite through your disable immunity.
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions, then all-in with Ragnarok up; prevents her kite-and-escape gameplan.
- Rune: Grasp procs in extended trades where Berserker Rage stacking makes you durable; sustains poke.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces her Magic Damage and provides tankiness against Dream-Laden Bough persistent damage.

olaf__lissandra.notes:
- threat: Lissandra's W Ring of Frost roots you, preventing Ragnarok activation and escape attempts entirely.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid her Q Ice Shard poke. Farm at max range behind minions.
- trading: Bait her W Ring of Frost, then all-in with E Reckless Swing when it's down.
- post6: Ragnarok now counters her W root, but Frozen Tomb stun still locks you down hard.
- spike: First item around level 9; stay defensive. Lissandra spikes harder—avoid extended fights near her.
- window: Post-6 when Ragnarok is up and her W is on cooldown; all-in immediately then.
- wave: Slow-push toward her tower; forces her to walk up, creating gank and all-in opportunities.
- rune: Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained poke resistance and health scaling in extended trades.
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip provides magic resist and shields, countering her burst and Frozen Tomb self-heal attempts.

olaf__lucian.notes:
- Lucian's sustained damage and kite potential with Lightslinger procs overwhelm Olaf's tanking ability.
- Play safe early; Lucian out-trades you. Farm at range, avoid his Q and W poke.
- Bait his E dash, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing when he commits.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you stick to him. Chase after he wastes E for escape.
- First item (likely Manamune) is dangerous. Play safe until you gain survivability advantage.
- Post-first-item when your resistances scale. All-in him when he's low on resources or cooldowns.
- Slow-push into him. Force Lucian to choose: chase you or defend wave pressure.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained tankiness and HP scaling into the fight.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip to reduce Lucian's magic damage burst and enable aggressive all-in fights.

olaf__locke.notes:
- Threat: Silver Stake true damage on-hit scales with your missing Health; avoid letting him poke you low.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Locke's on-hit harass outdamages your early trades, so focus on farming.
- Trading: Bait his Q Ritual Nails, then all-in when marks expire; dodge his E dash attempts.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his Purgatory execute; activate ult when he throws the binding.
- Spike: First item is dangerous; Locke gains significant on-hit damage; respect his range and back off.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you; your Health sustain from E Reckless Swing outscales his burst.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; forces Locke to choose between wave and roaming; limits his map pressure.
- Rune: Take Grasp of the Undying; Health scaling reduces Silver Stake damage and strengthens Berserker Rage.
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifegrip; reduces his on-hit magic damage and converts your tankiness into healing.

olaf__lulu.notes:
- Whimsy on you turns you helpless; avoid close range when it's off cooldown
- Play safe early; Lulu out-trades you at range with Q and auto-attacks
- Bait Whimsy before all-in; dodge Glitterlance or use minions as shields during trades
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Whimsy disable; activate ult before she casts it
- First item doesn't spike Lulu as hard; you can punish levelups and rotations
- Level 6 onwards when Ragnarok active; chase and dive with ult immunity active
- Slow-push to stack wave; forces Lulu to use cooldowns on minions, not you
- Grasp sustains poke damage and procs on minions; keeps you healthy for all-ins
- Adaptive Helm reduces her Pix bolt spam and shreds her damage output significantly

olaf__lux.notes:
- threat: Light Binding roots you; dodge it or Lux bursts you with followup combo.
- early: Safe farm; respect Light Binding range, farm at distance, avoid predictable movement patterns.
- trading: Bait Light Binding, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing; dodge her poke.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through Final Spark root attempts; activate before engage.
- spike: First Liandry's or Luden's around twelve minutes; farm safely, don't force bad fights.
- window: Post-six when Ragnarok active; run her down before cooldown; she cannot escape or root.
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; force Lux to choose between defending and grouping; split her focus.
- rune: Grasp; sustain through early poke and win extended trades with bonus health scaling.
- item: Force of Nature; magic resist reduces her burst and Liandry's burn impact significantly.

olaf__malphite.notes:
- Threat: Unstoppable Force knockup disables your Ragnarok, then Ground Slam locks your Attack Speed hard.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Malphite outranges you with Q poke, avoid unnecessary trades early.
- Trading: Bait his Q cooldown, then all-in with E true damage; dodge Seismic Shard movement.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables counters his Unstoppable Force knockup during your activation window.
- Spike: His first armor item (Thornmail, Kaenic) spikes his tankiness; punish before he completes it.
- Window: Mid-game when your Ragnarok is up and his ultimate is down; force engages then.
- Wave: Slow-push into him; forces him to engage or lose CS, playing into your Ragnarok.
- Rune: Grasp sustains through his poke and Ground Slam AS reduction, healing over time matters.
- Item: Abyssal Mask after core—reduces his magic damage output and amplifies your true damage value.

olaf__malzahar.notes:
- Nether Grasp suppresses you; Void Shift shields him during your all-in attempts.
- Play safe early; avoid pushing into Malzahar's range and risk Nether Grasp setup.
- Bait Call of the Void silence by holding Undertow, then engage aggressively after.
- Post-six, Nether Grasp becomes his primary threat; respect its range and channel time.
- First item spike is minimal danger; Olaf's sustained damage outpaces Malzahar's early poke.
- Level nine onward, Undertow cooldown reset and Ragnarok immunity allow you to dominate.
- Slow-push waves to set up all-ins when minion advantage lets you dive safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against poke and extended trading.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his magic damage and provides health for Berserker Rage scaling.

olaf__maokai.notes:
- threat: Maokai's W Twisted Advance roots you, preventing Ragnarok activation and escape attempts entirely.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near brush where Sapling Toss zones you hard.
- trading: Bait Q Bramble Smash, then all-in with E Reckless Swing before W root lands.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore his root chains; activate aggressively into his ult.
- spike: First item spike favors Maokai; you lack sustain to duel his P Sap Magic healing yet.
- window: Once you complete Goliath's Stone and have Ragnarok up, you outfight him in extended brawls.
- wave: Slow-push toward his tower; force him to engage you away from brush and saplings.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; extra tankiness and healing scale better into his sustained poke damage.
- item: Add Maw of Malmortius early; blocks his spell-amplified burst and gives you magic resist cushion.

olaf__masteryi.notes:
- Master Yi's Alpha Strike untargetability dodges your Undertow and lets him reposition freely on you.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Master Yi outduels you early. Farm with Undertow from distance, avoid extended trades.
- Bait Alpha Strike with aggressive positioning, then Undertow as he lands. Never chase him through minions.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you duel him during his Highlander. Activate when he engages, not before.
- His first item spike (likely attack speed) is dangerous. Play safer and stack your axe pickups for mana.
- You spike hardest mid-game when Ragnarok active duration gives you disable immunity during extended fights.
- Slow-push waves to control spacing and force Master Yi to commit. Prevents him from roaming freely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading pressure and health scaling into late-game tankiness.
- Build Black Cleaver early for armor shred to amplify your true damage and reduce his defensive stats.

olaf__mel.notes:
- Mel's Overwhelm stacks enable Golden Eclipse burst that ignores distance; respect her range advantage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Mel outranges you hard. Farm with Q, avoid her Radiant Barrage.
- Bait Solar Snare root, then all-in with E true damage. Never trade into her projectiles.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disables; activate before her Golden Eclipse for teamfights.
- First item spike is dangerous; her Overwhelm damage multiplies. Punish her if she overextends early.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights when Ragnarok is up; stick to her and E relentlessly.
- Slow-push toward her to force Mel to fight you at short range where you dominate.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading power and health scaling to survive her poke and burst.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce her magic damage and increase your tankiness significantly.

olaf__milio.notes:
- Milio's Warm Hugs shields and speedboosts make kiting you easy; his Breath of Life negates your all-in.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Milio out-ranges you heavily and poke trades favor him. Farm safely under tower.
- Bait Warm Hugs shields before committing trades. Dodge Ultra Mega Fire Kick knockback or take it predictably.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Breath of Life's crowd control cleanse; engage during his cooldown windows.
- Milio's first item is a minor threat; he scales gradually. You spike harder early; punish before items matter.
- Your window is levels 4-8 before Milio's healing output becomes oppressive. Kill him before he stacks items.
- Slow-push waves into him. This denies Cozy Campfire value and forces him into unsafe positions farming.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for poke pressure and sustain to fight his constant healing output.
- Consider Kaenic Lifeburst to cut his healing and your own damage taken from Reckless Swing significantly.

olaf__mordekaiser.notes:
- Threat: Mordekaiser's E Death's Grasp pulls you into R Realm of Death, isolating and stealing your stats.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid clumping near Mordekaiser and focus on farming without trading damage.
- Trading: Bait his Q Obliterate, then all-in with E Reckless Swing; dodge E Death's Grasp at all costs.
- Post6: Mordekaiser's R Realm of Death becomes lethal; never fight him isolated or low on health nearby.
- Spike: His first Liandry's or Zhonyas spike is dangerous; abuse wave control before first item completes.
- Window: All-in him before he lands 3 hits for Darkness Rise; focus on early game kills.
- Wave: Slow-push to keep minions away from his tower and force him into unfavorable extended trades.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain and trading harassment to outduel him in extended skirmishes.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts his damage aura into healing and applies grievous wounds debuff back at him.

olaf__missfortune.notes:
- Threat: Miss Fortune's Make It Rain and Bullet Time kite and burst you before you close distance.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Love Tap trades hurt hard. Farm from distance, avoid her Q line.
- Trading: Bait her Make It Rain, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing. Dodge her Double Up.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you tank Bullet Time and close. Activate during her channel to punish.
- Spike: First item spike hurts around minute 10-12. Play safe, stay healthy for all-in opportunities when she wastes cooldowns.
- Window: Post-6 during her ultimate, you dominate if she channels near you. Force fights when Bullet Time is down.
- Wave: Slow-push toward her tower; forces her to respect you, limits her roam and kite angles.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading pressure and health scaling into late game tankiness.
- Item: Adaptive Helm or Hollow Radiance to reduce her burst and sustained damage from waves and ult.

olaf__naafiri.notes:
- threat: Naafiri's packmates and bleed stack burst; you get kited and overwhelmed by pack damage
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q harass with packmates outrades your early sustain potential
- trading: Bait her W dash, then engage; dodge her Q daggers or trade after packmate recall
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disables, but packmates still deal raw damage through it
- spike: First item spike hurts; respect her damage but Undertow axe pickup window creates openings
- window: After her E cooldown ends, packmates heal and reset; all-in before that window closes
- wave: Slow-push toward her; forces her to engage into Undertow or lose CS and poke safety
- rune: Grasp for trading sustain into her poke; lets you win repeated short trades throughout lane
- item: Thornmail reduces bleed value and reflects packmate damage; mitigates her sustained duel pressure significantly

olaf__morgana.notes:
- Threat: Dark Binding locks you down; Black Shield blocks your engage and protects her from Reckless Swing.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid clumping near Dark Binding range, farm with Q when possible.
- Trading: Bait Dark Binding with movement, then all-in with W into E; dodge her Q at all costs.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Soul Shackles chains; activate R during her engage for free teamfight.
- Spike: Morgana's first item (usually Liandry's) increases her damage; punish her before it completes with aggression.
- Window: Post-level 6 with Ragnarok active, you outfight her completely; chain engages while she's on cooldown.
- Wave: Slow-push into her; force her to extend for CS, then all-in with jungler when overextended.
- Rune: Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain through her poke and heal off her minion trades.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces magic damage and CDR; purchase it third or fourth against her burst.

olaf__nami.notes:
- Threat: Nami's Q stun locks you down; her E slows prevent chasing and kiting you easily.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Nami outranges you heavily. Stay back, let her push, avoid Q.
- Trading: Bait her Q with positioning, then all-in when it's down. Don't trade into E slow.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Tidal Wave knockup; activate during her ult to engage freely.
- Spike: First item (likely support item) isn't dangerous. Push your lead before she scales into teamfights.
- Window: Levels 6-8 after Ragnarok unlock. Engage aggressively while cooldowns down; she can't stop you.
- Wave: Slow-push into her tower. Forces her to choose: defend tower or roam; limits her impact.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustains you through her poke and strengthens you for extended trades.
- Item: Force of Nature. Blocks her E bonus damage and Ebb and Flow healing amplification value.

olaf__nasus.notes:
- Wither cripples your Attack Speed and Move Speed, making you immobile and unable to fight back effectively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nasus outscales but is weak early — farm at range, avoid close trades.
- Bait Wither with Undertow repositioning, then all-in with Reckless Swing while he's vulnerable and slowed.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Wither disable entirely — activate ult before he casts, then dominate fights.
- Nasus first item spike is dangerous; respect his damage and armor gains — don't force extended trades yet.
- Your window is before Nasus stacks heavily and when Undertow cooldown resets — spam axes to kite him.
- Slow-push waves into him so he's forced to choose: stack or defend — punish greed with ganks.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and scaling — outscales Nasus's poke and mitigates Wither pressure.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip to amplify healing against his Spirit Fire armor shred and survive his sustained damage.

olaf__nautilus.notes:
- Nautilus roots you with Staggering Blow, then chains with Dredge Line for guaranteed damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his root threat and avoid extended trades near him.
- Bait his Dredge Line by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his disable chain; activate before his Depth Charge lands.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; respect his tankiness and roots spike.
- Post-level 6 with Ragnarok active, you win extended fights; force engages when ready to ult.
- Slow-push toward his tower to create gank opportunities and control when fights happen.
- Take Grasp for sustain in poke trades and extra damage in extended all-ins.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip to cleanse his roots and amplify your healing in fights.

olaf__neeko.notes:
- threat: Neeko's E root locks you down; her R stun combo deletes you before counterplay
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid her Q seeds and position away from minion clumps
- trading: Bait her E Tangle-Barbs, sidestep it, then all-in with Q-W-E before she roots
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through her R Pop Blossom stun setup; use this
- spike: First item spike (Liandry's or Shadowflame) threatens burst; stay healthy and trade back hard
- window: Level 6 onwards; activate R during her E-R combo, then chase her down relentlessly
- wave: Slow-push; forces her to respect Undertow axe resets and creates all-in opportunities safely
- rune: Grasp sustains your health, maximizes Berserker Rage damage and shields from Tough It Out procs
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts her burst magic damage into your healing for survivability advantage

olaf__nidalee.notes:
- Nidalee's Javelin Toss one-shots you from fog; respect brush control and vision.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm under tower, avoid overextending near brushes or walls.
- Bait her Javelin Toss, then all-in with Undertow into Reckless Swing trades.
- Post-6 Nidalee gains mobility with Pounce; expect more aggressive dives and skirmishes.
- First item spike is dangerous; farm safely and scale into your midgame power.
- Olaf dominates mid-to-late when items and levels stack; use this to force fights.
- Slow-push to deny her brush access and control wave timing into your spikes.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against poke and extended trades.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip for hybrid resistances and healing amplification against her sustained damage.

olaf__nilah.notes:
- threat: Nilah's W Jubilant Veil dodges all your damage; she kites and outscales you hard
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Formless Blade outranges your trades, avoid extended fights
- trading: Bait her W Jubilant Veil, then all-in with E Reckless Swing true damage
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you run her down; activate R and chase relentlessly through mist
- spike: Her first item spike hurts; avoid 1v1s until you have sustain items online
- window: Mid-game teamfights where she's isolated; your E true damage ignores her defensive layering
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; force her to choose between farm and grouping; punish rotation
- rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into her poke
- item: Add Force of Nature if she has AP threats; boosts survivability during her kite attempts

olaf__nocturne.notes:
- Nocturne's Paranoia removes your vision and forces bad fights; Unspeakable Horror locks you down hard.
- Play safe early; Nocturne out-damages you levels 1-3 if you trade heavily in lane.
- Bait Shroud of Darkness with Q Undertow before committing; dodge Unspeakable Horror's fear with positioning.
- Post-6, Paranoia is extremely dangerous; play near tower and use R Ragnarok to resist disable chain.
- Nocturne's first item spike is real; play safer and farm defensively until you complete core items.
- Olaf spikes harder mid-game with items; find isolated fights where Nocturne can't chain his crowd control.
- Slow-push waves to control fights near your tower; denies Paranoia engage angles and protects you better.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain; helps you survive his poke and trading damage.
- Add Adaptive Helm into your build; reduces his repeated magic damage from Unspeakable Horror significantly.

olaf__nunuwillump.notes:
- threat: Biggest Snowball Ever! knockup locks you down; Absolute Zero slows and nukes while you're helpless
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Nunu weak early, avoid his Snowball Barrage setup near minions
- trading: Bait Biggest Snowball Ever! then Undertow away; trade when his cooldowns down, not near walls
- post6: Ragnarok immunity negates Absolute Zero's disable but not damage; play around blizzard zones carefully
- spike: Nunu first item spike around level 9; farm safely, don't get caught overextended near walls
- window: Post-6 when Ragnarok active and attacking; chase Nunu down if he wastes Biggest Snowball Ever!
- wave: Slow-push sideways; prevents Biggest Snowball Ever! setup and keeps you away from jungle ganks
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain helps absorb poke and Absolute Zero damage chip
- item: Force of Nature; magic resist helps survive Absolute Zero damage and Snowball Barrage spam

olaf__orianna.notes:
- Orianna's R Shockwave launches you toward her, disrupting your engage and creating teamfight chaos.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Command: Attack outranges your trading tools early on.
- Bait her E Command: Protect shield by faking engages, then all-in when it's down.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through Shockwave, but time your engage carefully post-6.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes; respect her damage but maintain trading windows.
- Your window: levels 4-5 before she completes first item; abuse cooldowns aggressively then.
- Slow-push toward her tower; forces her to walk up and leaves gank setup room.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke trading; helps you outlast her early harass.
- Add Adaptive Helm to reduce her magic damage and spike healing from Berserker Rage.

olaf__pantheon.notes:
- Threat: Shield Vault stun locks you before you can retaliate or escape effectively.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Pantheon out-trades you before Berserker Rage scales damage.
- Trading: Bait Shield Vault with positioning, then Undertow when he commits to stun.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his disable chain during teamfights or duels.
- Spike: First item spike hurts; respect his damage window and avoid extended trades.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you once Ragnarok active cooldown resets via attacking.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny him roam windows and stack Berserker Rage safely.
- Rune: Grasp sustains you through his poke and grants survivability for extended fights.
- Item: Add Hollow Radiance to reduce his burst and shield its magic damage.

olaf__ornn.notes:
- Ornn's Brittle status amplifies all your damage taken; avoid his W and R procs.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ornn out-trades you early with Q poke and W burst.
- Bait his W Bellows Breath, then all-in; dodge his Q Volcanic Rupture fissure delay.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his disable chain, but Brittle still amplifies incoming damage.
- Ornn's first item spike is dangerous; he gains tankiness and Brittle application—play safe.
- Level 6+ you can all-in through Ragnarok immunity; catch him before his ult lands.
- Slow-push waves to deny Ornn pillar terrain usage; prevent him controlling fights near minions.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke pressure; Ornn needs tankiness and you need healing.
- Rush Hollow Radiance to reduce incoming damage amplification and cut his tankiness scaling value.

olaf__poppy.notes:
- threat: Heroic Charge stuns you into walls; Keeper's Verdict knocks you away during Ragnarok.
- early: Dangerous—Poppy out-trades you levels 1-3; farm safely and avoid her hammer shock zone.
- trading: Bait her Heroic Charge, then all-in; dodge Hammer Shock explosions and kite backwards.
- post6: Ragnarok removes disable immunity but Keeper's Verdict still interrupts; play around her channel timing.
- spike: First item (likely Sunfire or tank item) spikes her; farm safely, don't overextend yet.
- window: Undertow cooldown resets give you kiting tools; abuse axe pickups to trade and disengage.
- wave: Slow-push into her—forces her to chase or miss cs; limits wall-stun opportunities near lane.
- rune: Grasp sustains against her poke and trading; scales better than alternatives into mid-game.
- item: Force of Nature reduces her magic damage and Hammer Shock slow effectiveness significantly.

olaf__pyke.notes:
- threat: Pyke's E stun into R execute kills you fast; avoid his dash setup
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Pyke outranges you, so respect Q and don't overextend
- trading: Bait Pyke's W Ghostwater Dive, then all-in; dodge his E Phantom Undertow dash
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank Death From Below execute; use R aggressively into him
- spike: First item isn't as dangerous; Pyke needs items for burst, you scale better
- window: Levels 7-11 when Ragnarok cooldown is low; run him down between his W rotations
- wave: Slow-push towards his tower; forces him to commit or lose CS to tower
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain and tankiness counter his poke and all-in threat
- item: Force of Nature; magic resist blocks his burst and helps you survive R

olaf__quinn.notes:
- Threat: Quinn's Vault interrupts your Ragnarok and kites you endlessly with Move Speed
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Quinn out-ranges you—don't commit without Undertow cooldown reset
- Trading: Bait Vault with Undertow positioning, then all-in when she lands; dodge Blinding Assault
- Post6: Ragnarok lets you ignore Vault interrupts and chase, but Quinn still kites hard
- Spike: First item (likely Serrated Dirk replacement or crit item) hurts; farm safely until your items
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Ragnarok active lets you run Quinn down before she escapes
- Wave: Slow-push to stack waves and force Quinn into unfavorable all-ins; don't overextend
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain through poke and scale into mid-game advantage
- Item: Spirit Visage or Hollow Radiance if Quinn goes lethality; helps versus her sustained damage

olaf__qiyana.notes:
- Threat: Qiyana's mobility and burst from Royal Privilege and Supreme Display of Talent catch immobile Olaf.
- Early: Play safely; Qiyana out-damages you early. Farm at range, avoid her Elemental Wrath trades.
- Trading: Bait her Audacity dash, then Undertow to slow and armor-shred before all-ining with Reckless Swing.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity negates her Supreme Display of Talent stun; activate it reactively when she engages.
- Spike: Her first item spike threatens you hard. Farm safely and stack Berserker Rage health deficit.
- Window: After her cooldowns are down, especially Audacity and E, run her down with Undertow pickup resets.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; forces her to chase into your terrain, away from gank support and enemy jungler.
- Rune: Take Grasp for sustained healing in prolonged fights to outrade her burst and spike utility.
- Item: Build Force of Nature to survive her magic damage and spell rotations until you close distance.

olaf__rakan.notes:
- Rakan's Grand Entrance knockup locks you down; dodge with Ragnarok or position carefully always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Rakan outranges you early, farm from distance, avoid his dash.
- Bait Grand Entrance then trade hard; use Undertow to slow his approach, dodge knockup.
- Ragnarok immunity negates his charm completely; activate during The Quickness to maintain pressure.
- First item spike is minimal threat; punish Rakan's vulnerable positioning before he scales utility.
- Level 6 onward you dominate; Ragnarok's disable immunity makes you unkillable in fights.
- Slow-push to stack wave; forces Rakan to engage on your terms near your tower.
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; helps survive his poke and win extended trades.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip for survivability; amplifies your healing and shields against his damage.

olaf__rammus.notes:
- threat: Rammus' Frenzying Taunt locks you down; his Defensive Ball Curl negates your damage output
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near Rammus when his W is available
- trading: Bait out Frenzying Taunt before committing; dodge Powerball with movement; trade after his E cooldown
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Frenzying Taunt; activate during his taunt to maintain offensive pressure
- spike: Rammus spikes hard first item; abuse levels 1-5 before his armor scaling becomes oppressive
- window: Level 6+ with Ragnarok active is your window; engage when his E is down
- wave: Slow-push toward Rammus; force him to choose between wave and roaming; deny his rotation impact
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains you through poke and strengthens health for Berserker Rage scaling
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip; grants magic resist and converts his defensive scaling into your healing advantage

olaf__reksai.notes:
- Void Rush combo with max Fury True Damage bursts you down through your sustain.
- Play safe levels 1-3; she out-trades early. Farm under tower, avoid her Q procs.
- Bait her Burrow, then all-in with E and Ragnarok. Never chase tunnels.
- Post-6, Void Rush makes her untargetable before damage lands. Play around her mark timing.
- First item spike is dangerous. Stay healthy and play defensive until you scale harder.
- Mid-game teamfights where she's low Fury and can't burst. Engage when she's burrowed.
- Slow-push waves into her tower. Forces her to either farm or roam predictably.
- Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling. Matches her long-fight nature better.
- Spirit Visage for magic resist and healing amplification against her true damage pressure.

olaf__rell.notes:
- threat: Rell's Magnet Storm pull plus Break the Mold armor shred locks you down and strips defenses
- early: Play safely; Rell's Shattering Strike stun and shield from Ferromancy Crash Down win early trades hard
- trading: Bait her Ferromancy Crash Down, then all-in; dodge Shattering Strike by moving unpredictably sideways first
- post6: Ragnarok makes you immune to her Magnet Storm pull, turning teamfights heavily in your favor
- spike: First item spike hurts; she gains tankiness and damage simultaneously, so respect range and pressure
- window: Post-level 6 with Ragnarok active is your strongest window; force fights when her ult down
- wave: Slow-push and build pressure; forces her to engage or lose farm, playing into your strength
- rune: Grasp for tankiness and sustain to offset her armor shred and early poke damage significantly
- item: Hollow Radiance blocks her magic damage amp and gives you tankiness against her Shattering Strike

olaf__renataglasc.notes:
- Threat: Hostile Takeover forces you to fight uncontrollably; Handshake roots you before you engage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid her Loyalty Program shields and focus last-hitting minions only.
- Trading: Bait Handshake, dodge it, then Undertow and Reckless Swing her; never trade into her marks.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables counters Handshake root; activate before she lands her root.
- Spike: First item spike (around 1100g) is dangerous; her shields and damage increase significantly then.
- Window: Mid-game 2-3 item advantage; your Life Steal and true damage scale better than hers.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; force rotations and 1v1s where her CC matters less in skirmishes.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; extra mobility escapes Handshake and reposition after Hostile Takeover forces you forward.
- Item: Hollow Radiance; reduces her ability power, healing, and shield effectiveness against your sustained damage.

olaf__renekton.notes:
- Renekton's W stun locks you down, allowing him to unload damage while you cannot move or retaliate.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Renekton wins short trades. Farm at range with Q, pick up axes immediately.
- Avoid his W at all costs. Bait it with fake engagement, then trade back with E true damage.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his stun chain, turning fights heavily in your favor post-six.
- His first item spike is dangerous; respect his damage window. Wait for your ult to engage confidently.
- You spike harder once Ragnarok is up and you have significant Health investment; abuse this window.
- Slow-push waves to create gank opportunities for your jungler while maintaining safety from his all-in potential.
- Pick Grasp for sustain and Health scaling to survive his burst and enable your passive better.
- Add Force of Nature early if he stacks magic pen; survivability lets you outscale him easily.

olaf__riven.notes:
- threat: Riven's burst damage and stun chain lock you down before Ragnarok activates
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; dodge her Q combo and don't let her W stun you
- trading: Bait her E Valor with Undertow, then all-in when her cooldowns are down
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her stun chain; activate during her burst combo
- spike: Her first item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and play around cooldowns
- window: Post-6 with Ragnarok active, you can run her down and ignore her disable chain
- wave: Slow-push toward her; forces her to fight on your terms or lose CS
- rune: Take Grasp for sustained trading and health advantage in extended fights against her
- item: Add Abyssal Mask after core items to reduce her burst and heal more effectively

olaf__rumble.notes:
- Rumble's Flamespitter and Equalizer deal consistent magic damage; you cannot lifesteal or reduce it meaningfully.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Rumble out-ranges you with Flamespitter and will poke relentlessly from distance.
- Bait his Scrap Shield before committing trades; dodge Electro Harpoon slow and all-in when his Heat is low.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his slows and dive him; use this to force all-ins post-6.
- First item spike is dangerous; Rumble gains Danger Zone bonuses earlier and pokes harder—play around minions.
- Your window is post-Ragnarok activation before his Heat builds; force short fights before he reaches Danger Zone.
- Slow-push waves to stack minions; this prevents his poke from harassing you freely and sets up ganks.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health to survive his magic poke damage over time.
- Build Hollow Radiance early; reduces his magic damage and gives you the tankiness to weather his onslaught.

olaf__ryze.notes:
- Ryze roots you with W Rune Prison if you have Flux, then combos you down before escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge E Spell Flux orbs and respect his Q Overload poke damage.
- Bait his W Rune Prison, then all-in when it's down; dodge Flux to avoid root setup.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore roots, but Ryze still kites; coordinate R with his portal timing.
- Ryze first item spike (Archangel's or Liandry's) hurts; abuse him before completion with short, brutal trades.
- Olaf dominates levels 4-5 and after first back with Undertow cooldown resets and sustained pressure.
- Slow-push to stack minions and zone Ryze away from his own wave, deny safe farming.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health to fuel Berserker Rage aggression.
- Add Abyssal Mask to reduce his magic damage and scale better into teamfights than him.

olaf__samira.notes:
- threat: Samira's melee magic damage and mobility make extended trades deadly; avoid her combo.
- early: Safe farm. Respect her Q range and E dash threat; stay healthy.
- trading: Bait her W Blade Whirl, then E Reckless Swing her. Dodge her Q.
- post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore her crowd control; activate before her R.
- spike: First item is danger window. Trade carefully; wait for her to waste E.
- window: Mid-game when you stack missing Health. Use Undertow to kite and reset cooldown.
- wave: Slow-push. Build minion advantage to control her all-in range and gank setup.
- rune: Grasp. Sustain and tankiness counter her poke and extended melee skirmishes.
- item: Spirit Visage. Magic resist reduces her P bonus damage and increases your shield value.

olaf__senna.notes:
- threat: Last Embrace root traps you; Piercing Darkness pokes from safety while healing her team
- early: Safe farm only; respect her range and poke damage; never commit without vision
- trading: Bait Last Embrace before engaging; dodge it, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore roots; activate it when she roots to close distance
- spike: First item spike dangerous; she gains range and sustain; farm safely, avoid extended fights
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you stick to her; Ragnarok lets you close and bypass disables
- wave: Slow-push toward her; forces her to choose between poking or defending tower safely
- rune: Grasp; extra tankiness and sustain counter her poke damage throughout the entire laning phase
- item: Force of Nature; magic resist and movement speed counter her Piercing Darkness and rooting

olaf__sejuani.notes:
- Sejuani's crowd control chain locks you down; her E stun after W Frost stacks is devastating.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her Q Arctic Assault range and don't extend past river ward.
- Bait her Q Arctic Assault, then trade back hard with E Reckless Swing when she commits.
- Ragnarok at level 6 lets you ignore her disables; activate it proactively when she engages.
- First item spike around Sunfire Aegis is dangerous; abuse your R immunity window to all-in her.
- You spike when she's out of Frost stacks and before her next W Winter's Wrath rotation.
- Slow-push into her to deny her freeze; force her to use Q to break the wave.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and healing to offset her poke and kite.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip to cleanse her slows and gain healing when her crowd control chains you.

olaf__sett.notes:
- threat: Sett's E Facebreaker stun locks you down; his W true damage punishes extended fights
- early: Safely farm; avoid close range before level 3, respect his Q damage scaling
- trading: Bait E Facebreaker by positioning on one side only, then all-in with Q reset
- post6: Ragnarok immunity to his E stun becomes crucial; activate before he lands Facebreaker
- spike: First item spike dangerous; play safe, farm, avoid all-ins until you scale harder
- window: Mid-game when you stack items; your E true damage and sustain outscale his burst
- wave: Slow-push; use Q Undertow to reset cooldown and maintain poke pressure safely
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain and poke reward your close-range trading pattern
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip; convert his true damage into healing, strengthening your tankiness significantly

olaf__shaco.notes:
- threat: Shaco's Deceive + Backstab burst from fog of war kills you before you respond
- early: Play safe; Shaco out-damages you level 1-3. Farm under tower, watch for Q flanks
- trading: Bait his Deceive first, then trade. Never fight blind; E costs health you can't afford
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his disable attempts and chase him down after engages
- spike: His first item (Lethality) spikes hard around minute 9-11; respect and play safer then
- window: Level 6+ Ragnarok + Undertow cooldown reset lets you duel him or chase escapes
- wave: Slow-push to control where fights happen; deny him fog of war flanking opportunities safely
- rune: Grasp for sustain and tankiness to offset his burst damage and poke harassment
- item: Plated Steelcaps early; armor heavily counters his Backstab and Two-Shiv Poison damage output

olaf__shen.notes:
- threat: Shadow Dash taunt locks you down; Spirit's Refuge blocks your damage output
- early: Play safe; Shen out-trades you level 1-3 with spirit blade empowerment
- trading: Bait Shadow Dash, then all-in; dodge Twilight Assault collision or kite away
- post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore Stand United shield and dive targets
- spike: First item spike dangerous; Shen gains survivability; farm safely and scale instead
- window: Level 11+ when Ragnarok cooldown shortens; abuse disable immunity in extended fights
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; forces Shen to choose between farming and ulting allies
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain through poke and scale into teamfights better
- item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his magic resist shred and heals you from his damage

olaf__shyvana.notes:
- threat: Shyvana's Dragon Form empowers all abilities; her mobility and sustained damage overwhelm Olaf's defenses.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her sustained damage out-trades you. Farm safely and avoid extended fights.
- trading: Bait her W Inferno Aegis shield, then trade back. Never chase her into fog of war.
- post6: Avoid fighting in her Dragon Form. Her E Molten Burst and Q Emberstrike deal massive damage.
- spike: Danger window at first item completion; her sustained damage and tankiness spike hard immediately after.
- window: Level 4-5 before Dragon Form; use Undertow to kite and Reckless Swing to burst her down.
- wave: Slow-push toward her tower; forces her to commit resources, reducing her roaming and gank pressure.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain mitigates her poke and scales better into mid-game trades.
- item: Force of Nature; magic resist blocks her fire damage and gives movement speed to kite.

olaf__singed.notes:
- Threat: Singed kites you endlessly with Mega Adhesive and Move Speed while applying Grievous Wounds post-six.
- Early: Safe farm levels one-three; Singed weak early, but don't chase into Mega Adhesive traps unprepared.
- Trading: Bait Fling with Undertow, then all-in when cooldown down; avoid chasing through Poison Trail.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore disables, but Grievous Wounds drastically cuts your healing potential significantly.
- Spike: Singed first item-spike is moderate; use early game advantage to build lead before his power scales.
- Window: Levels two through five before Insanity Potion; abuse mobility and damage to force kills decisively.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes to force Singed choice between wave and roam; limits his kiting space.
- Rune: Grasp for sustained trading and health advantage; Singed outscales, so win early lane pressure.
- Item: Force of Nature reduces his Poison damage and Grievous Wounds effectiveness significantly post-Insanity Potion.

olaf__sion.notes:
- threat: Sion's Q stun locks you down; his R onslaught charges through and knocks you up helplessly.
- early: Safely farm; Sion outranges you early. Avoid his E shockwave poke and respect his Q charge.
- trading: Dodge his Q charge by moving perpendicular. Trade after he misses; close gap with Undertow into E.
- post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you charge Sion's R fearlessly. Use it to engage when his ult is down.
- spike: First item is your danger window. Sion gains tankiness; farm safely and wait for him to overextend.
- window: Mid-game teamfights favor you when Sion wastes Q or R. Punish cooldowns with all-in engages immediately.
- wave: Slow-push early; deny him freeze options. Push harder once you hit two items and can fight constantly.
- rune: Grasp for sustain against poke and extended trades; scales into tankiness when you build bruiser items.
- item: Add Force of Nature if Sion builds magic damage; blocks his W reactivation damage amplification threat.

olaf__sivir.notes:
- Threat: Sivir's Spell Shield blocks your Undertow and negates your engage tools entirely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Sivir outranges you and Spell Shield punishes Q attempts.
- Trading: Bait her Spell Shield with Undertow first, then all-in with Reckless Swing and Tough It Out.
- Post6: Ragnarok lets you ignore her kiting, but On The Hunt gives her team chase tools.
- Spike: Sivir's first crit item spike is dangerous; you lack burst to punish her yet.
- Window: Post-first-item when you have survivability; catch her when Spell Shield is down or used.
- Wave: Slow-push to stack waves then crash; forces Sivir to decide between farm and safety.
- Rune: Grasp keeps you healthy trading; sustainable poke lets you survive to all-in windows.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern adds magic resist and grievous wounds against her sustained damage output.

olaf__skarner.notes:
- threat: Impale suppress locks you down; Ixtal's Impact wall stun chains disable and kills you
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Skarner weak early, avoid his W shockwave trades near walls
- trading: Bait Ixtal's Impact away from terrain, then Undertow and Reckless Swing; dodge Quaking stacks
- post6: Ragnarok immunity negates Impale suppress duration; activate during his ultimate to keep attacking freely
- spike: Skarner first item spike dangerous; you lack tankiness yet, play safer near terrain walls
- window: Post-Ragnarok and when Skarner wastes Impale; all-in him during cooldown with Undertow pickup resets
- wave: Slow-push toward your tower; denies Skarner easy wall slam angles and Impale drag potential
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain and tankiness counter poke and prepare for suppression tank
- item: Force of Nature; magic resist hard-counters Quaking max stack damage and Skarner's mixed threat

olaf__sona.notes:
- threat: Crescendo stuns disable you; dodge or tank with Ragnarok active before engagement
- early: Safe farm; Sona outranges you early, avoid extended trades near her support
- trading: Bait Crescendo with Ragnarok, then all-in; dodge Hymn of Valor bolts when possible
- post6: Activate Ragnarok before Crescendo lands to ignore stun and continue your assault
- spike: First item spike minimal danger; Olaf outscales her damage and tankiness quickly
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you gap-close faster than her peel; abuse cooldown windows
- wave: Slow-push to create all-in angles; prevent her from farming safely at range
- rune: Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling; synergizes with Berserker Rage healing
- item: Spirit Visage or Kaenic Rookern for magic resist and healing amplification against her poke

olaf__soraka.notes:
- threat: Equinox silence locks you down; Wish healing negates your burst damage and sustain
- early: Safe farm. Soraka outranges you; avoid her Starcall. Farm with Q, reset cooldown by picking axe up
- trading: Bait Equinox with fake engages, then all-in when zone expires. Dodge Starcall, trade after it lands
- post6: Wish counters your all-ins hard. Fight when her ult is down or coordinate with your team
- spike: First item spike minimal threat. Punish her immobility before she buys survivability; all-in aggressively early
- window: Levels 2–5 before Wish. Force fights when Equinox is down. Ragnarok disable immunity lets you ignore her CC
- wave: Slow-push into her. She cannot defend easily; deny her safety and force her to overextend
- rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustains your health pool against poke, scales into teamfights where you dominate
- item: Force of Nature. Reduces her magic damage and Wish healing effectiveness; bolsters your defensive needs

olaf__swain.notes:
- Threat: Swain's E Nevermove roots you, then pulls you in for Q Death's Hand damage burst.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; dodge W Vision of Empire slow, farm at range with Q Undertow.
- Trading: Bait E Nevermove by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown with W Tough It Out.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Demonic Ascension drain; activate R before his E root connects.
- Spike: Swain's first item (Liandry's or similar) hurts around minute 11; you outscale after two items.
- Window: Level 2-4 and post-Ragnarok are your windows; use axe resets to chase and block E.
- Wave: Slow-push toward your tower to bait his E, then dodge backward and reset with Q pickups.
- Rune: Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain trades into his poke and burst combination.
- Item: Add Adaptive Helm after core bruiser items to reduce Demonic Ascension drain and Q bolt damage.

olaf__sylas.notes:
- Threat: Sylas W Kingslayer heals him while damaging you; he steals your R Ragnarok for disable immunity.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Sylas Q Chain Lash outranges your engage, avoid walking into it carelessly.
- Trading: Bait Sylas E Abscond, then all-in with Q Undertow and E Reckless Swing while he's vulnerable.
- Post6: Sylas R Hijack steals your R Ragnarok; he gains disable immunity and counters your engage pattern.
- Spike: Sylas first item spike is dangerous; his W Kingslayer healing amplifies, making him harder to all-in.
- Window: You have power before Sylas completes first item; all-in aggressively early when his cooldowns are longer.
- Wave: Slow-push toward him; forces Sylas to engage unfavorably or lose CS, limiting his W Kingslayer healing trades.
- Rune: Take Grasp of the Undying for early trading damage and shielding against his W poke.
- Item: Build Adaptive Helm to reduce Sylas Q and W magic damage output significantly in extended fights.

olaf__tahmkench.notes:
- Threat: Devour locks you down for seconds; Tahm Kench's durability makes killing him extremely difficult
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid his Tongue Lash range and don't trade into his Thick Skin sustain
- Trading: Bait Tongue Lash with positioning, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing before he stacks you
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank Devour lockdown; activate it when he attempts the devour engagement
- Spike: First Sunfire item spike hurts; Olaf should avoid prolonged trades during this window, kite outward
- Window: Level 6-9 power spike with Ragnarok active gives you a reliable counter to his ultimate threat
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; this prevents Tahm Kench from diving you under tower or locking you in freeze
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying sustains through his poke and converts health for scaling late game fights
- Item: Spirit Visage gives magic resist and amplifies Thick Skin healing reduction, forcing him to work harder

olaf__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Unraveled Earth stuns you mid-dash; Seismic Shove knocks you away from fights.
- Early: Safely farm; her Q poke outranges you. Avoid pushing; respect Seismic Shove knockback.
- Trading: Bait her W before committing. Trade when her Q is on cooldown.
- Post6: Weaver's Wall enables her escape and engage; use Ragnarok to chase through stuns.
- Spike: First item rarely threatens you. Wait for her to complete before engaging.
- Window: Level 2-3 before she maxes W. Post-6 when Ragnarok duration exceeds her W cooldown.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her engage angles and force her to commit resources.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge—mobility lets you stick and chase through her knockbacks and walls.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her damage and gives resistances for extended fights.

olaf__taric.notes:
- Threat: Dazzle stun locks you; Cosmic Radiance blocks your all-in damage temporarily
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Taric out-trades with Bravado empowered autos
- Trading: Bait Dazzle delay, then trade; dodge his E beam before committing
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Cosmic Radiance invulnerability; time aggression carefully
- Spike: First Armor item (Kaenic Ritualist area) strengthens him; exploit before completion
- Window: Post-Dazzle cooldown is your moment; all-in when his stun is down
- Wave: Slow-push waves; deny Taric easy Bastion targets, force spacing mistakes
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain trades and scale Armor naturally
- Item: Force of Nature later; magic resist helps against his Q healing

olaf__talon.notes:
- Talon's burst from Q and W combo chunks you hard; dodge or tank with E shield.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q axe from distance, avoid trading short trades.
- Bait Talon's W Rake, then all-in with E Reckless Swing true damage when he repositions.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his burst; activate ult when he commits to kill you.
- First item spike (Serrated Dirk) hurts; respect his damage but you outscale him soon after.
- Post-6 you dominate if you land Undertow; his E Assassin's Path lets him escape easily though.
- Slow-push waves to deny Talon roam priority; keep him locked in lane farming with you.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain scaling; lets you survive poke and win extended fights.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip for survivability and grievous wounds reduction on his P Blade's End bleed damage.

olaf__teemo.notes:
- threat: Teemo's blind from Blinding Dart negates your damage; his traps kite and poison you relentlessly.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Teemo outranges you heavily, avoid walking into brush where he hides.
- trading: Bait his Blinding Dart, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing; dodge Q or lose trades.
- post6: Ragnarok makes you immune to his slows, but Noxious Trap damage and kiting still hurt badly.
- spike: First item spike hurts him less than you; abuse before he completes Liandry's or Void Staff.
- window: Level 6 onwards when Ragnarok active lets you run him down; use it aggressively before cooldown.
- wave: Slow-push into him; forces him to fight near minions where you can close distance faster.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you chase through his slows and stick for all-in trades consistently.
- item: Adaptive Helm reduces Teemo's DoT and Noxious Trap damage while giving you bulk and MR.

olaf__thresh.notes:
- Thresh Q chains you down, letting his team collapse and burst you before Ragnarok activates.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect Q range and don't walk into predictable chains near lane walls.
- Bait his Q by positioning unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge with movement.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his disable chain but not his team's damage; be careful.
- First item spike (typically Liandry's or similar) isn't a danger; exploit cooldowns between his abilities.
- Your window is post-6 when Ragnarok lets you walk through chains; run him down aggressively.
- Slow-push waves to deny him easy Q angles against you and create gank setup opportunities.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke and bonus tankiness; you'll trade often and need durability.
- Grab Kaenic Lifebringer early to tank magic burst and punish his ability spam with healing.

olaf__tristana.notes:
- Threat: Buster Shot knockback disrupts your all-in; Rocket Jump kiting prevents melee engagement entirely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her range advantage and burst make extended trades lethal.
- Trading: Bait Rocket Jump before committing; dodge Buster Shot or position near walls to minimize knockback distance.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you engage through her cc, but Buster Shot still zones you hard.
- Spike: First item is danger window; abuse her immobility before she gets attack speed items.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where she's locked in position; your Undertow + Reckless Swing burst wins.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; denies her safety to farm, forces her into unfavorable trades or roams.
- Rune: Grasp sustains poke damage and scales tankiness; lets you survive her early range harassment.
- Item: Adaptive Helm reduces her burst and Explosive Charge detonations without sacrificing tankiness or resistances.

olaf__trundle.notes:
- Threat: Subjugate strips your armor and magic resist, crippling your tankiness and Ragnarok immunity value
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Trundle out-trades you early—avoid extended fights, respect his Chomp damage
- Trading: Bait his Pillar of Ice, then trade with Undertow and Reckless Swing; dodge Chomp
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity becomes worthless against pure damage; Subjugate now doubles stat theft—play around cooldown
- Spike: His first item spike (Sunfire or Hollow) is dangerous; you're not yet tanky enough to duel
- Window: Post-first-item when you stack resistances, Ragnarok's passive armor scales better than his theft percentage steal
- Wave: Slow-push toward enemy tower; use Undertow to poke safely and kite him away from minions
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying rewards extended short trades; healing helps offset Reckless Swing self-damage pressure
- Item: Spirit Visage or Hollow Radiance late-game; healing amp negates his stat theft's effectiveness better

olaf__tryndamere.notes:
- Tryndamere's Undying Rage immunity to death lets him turn losing fights into kills effortlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Tryndamere out-damages you early, so avoid extended trades near him.
- Bait his Spinning Slash then punish with Undertow; dodge his Mocking Shout's backside slow.
- Post-6 Undying Rage makes him unkillable for five seconds; kite and wait out duration.
- His first item spike (Cleavers or crit builds) is dangerous; play passive, scale safely.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where Ragnarok lets you ignore his Mocking Shout damage.
- Slow-push waves to deny him easy side lane pressure and control lane tempo safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading pressure and late teamfight durability checks.
- Buy Plated Steelcaps early to reduce his crit damage and Spinning Slash physical pressure.

olaf__twistedfate.notes:
- threat: Destiny reveals you globally; Gate escape denies all-in; Pick a Card stun locks you down hard
- early: Safe farm until level 3; avoid pushing; respect Wild Cards poke range and cumulative armor shred
- trading: Bait Pick a Card before committing; dodge Wild Cards; trade after he uses W on minions
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Destiny stun; activate R before all-ins to negate his card lock
- spike: First item (likely Lich Bane or Zhonia's) weakens him; punish early; he scales harder mid-game
- window: Levels 1-5 before Destiny; post-6 if you engage during his cooldown; catch him before Gate cast
- wave: Slow-push into him; denies his roam window; forces him to farm closer to your Undertow range
- rune: Grasp for sustain into his poke and repeated short trades; synergizes with your passive Health scaling
- item: Kaenic Lifebringer; heals through his poke and Wild Cards spam while giving magic resist for protection

olaf__twitch.notes:
- threat: Twitch Spray and Pray pierces through you; Deadly Venom stacks true damage relentlessly.
- early: Safe farm until level 3. Respect his poke range; don't chase into fog.
- trading: Bait Ambush cooldown, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing before he resets.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Spray and Pray disable attempts; activate during his ult.
- spike: First item spike (Runaan's) around 10 minutes—dangerous. Play safer; don't get caught isolated.
- window: Level 2 when Twitch lacks Contaminate; level 6 onward if you land Undertow first.
- wave: Slow-push into him. Forces Twitch to overextend or miss CS; sets up ganks.
- rune: Grasp. Sustain in poke trades and shreds his relatively low early resistances.
- item: Force of Nature. Blocks percentage magic damage from Deadly Venom true damage conversion.

olaf__udyr.notes:
- Udyr's Blazing Stampede stun locks you down; kite away or tank with Ragnarok active.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Udyr out-trades you early. Farm under tower if needed.
- Bait his Blazing Stampede stun, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing spam.
- Ragnarok immunity negates his stuns; activate before his Blazing Stampede Recast lands.
- First item spike vulnerable window; stay passive, scale into mid-game teamfights where you shine.
- Mid-game teamfights after two items; Ragnarok makes you unkillable against his crowd control.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Udyr to engage on your terms or lose CS.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and strengthens your short-trade all-ins.
- Kaenic Lifeburst turns his healing into enemy damage; adds tankiness and grievous wounds.

olaf__varus.notes:
- threat: Chain of Corruption immobilizes you; Hail of Arrows slows and reduces your healing output significantly
- early: Safe farm until level 3; respect his poke range, avoid clumping near minions for Piercing Arrow
- trading: Bait Hail of Arrows before engaging; dodge it, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing combo
- post6: Ragnarok grants disable immunity; activate it when Chain of Corruption comes to maintain aggression and control
- spike: First item around 10-12 minutes hurts; he gains consistent damage; farm safely, don't force extended fights
- window: Level 6 onwards with Ragnarok up; he cannot lock you down, turn fights heavily in your favor
- wave: Slow-push towards him; this prevents him from kiting backwards and forces close-range engagements you dominate
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains your health pool against his poke and empowers your short trades
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip; converts his healing reduction into healing, countering Hail of Arrows' anti-heal effect directly

olaf__vayne.notes:
- Vayne kites you with Move Speed while Silver Bolts true damage shreds your health pool.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early poke and kiting outrange your effective trading zone.
- Bait her Condemn into terrain, then all-in; dodge her E knockback to close distance.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her crowd control; use it to force close-range fights.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and maintain distance until then.
- Post-six when she Tumbles near walls; she loses kiting tools and dies to all-ins.
- Slow-push waves to deny her space; prevent her from freely kiting around minions.
- Grasp sustains you through her poke and helps you survive extended Silver Bolts trades.
- Add Force of Nature to reduce her true damage and gain magic resist scaling.

olaf__urgot.notes:
- threat: Urgot's E Disdain catches and throws you; his R Fear Beyond Death executes at low health thresholds
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Urgot out-trades with W Purge spam; farm with Q Undertow from distance only
- trading: Bait his E Disdain, then all-in; dodge Q Corrosive Charge; never trade into W Purge active phases
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his R Fear Beyond Death execute threat; activate before low-health teamfights
- spike: First item spike (likely Black Cleaver) threatens you; avoid all-ins; respect his sustained W Purge damage window
- window: Mid-game teamfights when Ragnarok is up; you're immune to his disables and outfight in prolonged brawls
- wave: Slow-push sidewaves to deny him roam; keep wave near your tower where E Disdain throw is weaker
- rune: Grasp for sustain against his poke and W Purge harassment; healing helps you survive extended trades
- item: Maw of Malmortius adds magic resist and lifeline shield against his sustained damage and execute threshold pressure

olaf__veigar.notes:
- threat: Event Horizon stun cages you; Primordial Burst deletes low-health Berserker Rage targets
- early: Safe farm; avoid pushing up; Veigar scales—do not let him free farm
- trading: Bait Event Horizon with fake engages, then all-in when cage is down
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore stuns; activate before stepping into Event Horizon
- spike: First item (Liandry's or Rylai's) moderately dangerous; you spike harder if ahead
- window: Levels 4-5 before Veigar's cage maxes; early Undertow damage and all-in threat
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; deny Veigar safe poke; roam when Ragnarok is up
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain into poke and reward aggressive trading patterns
- item: Abyssal Mask; reduces Veigar's burst and stacks with your magic resist gains

olaf__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's true damage from Organic Deconstruction stacks and R shreds your Health pool hard
- Play safe early; avoid E Tectonic Disruption knockup chains and farm at range with Q
- Bait his Q Plasma Fission splits, then all-in when cooldown is down; dodge E always
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his CC but true damage still hurts; play carefully
- His first item spike (Liandry's or Void Staff) is dangerous; respect range and poke
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when you gap-close and lock him down before ult channels
- Slow-push waves to create gank opportunities; avoid extended trades where he stacks Deconstruction
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke and to win short all-in trades with him
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce his magic damage output and increase survivability significantly

olaf__vex.notes:
- threat: Doom 'n Gloom fear interrupts your dashes; Shadow Surge marks and hunts you relentlessly
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Vex out-ranges you heavily with Mistral Bolt poke
- trading: Bait her Doom 'n Gloom fear onto minions, then all-in with Undertow
- post6: Shadow Surge makes kiting easier for her; respect the mark and play around cooldowns
- spike: First item spike (likely Luden's) threatens you; abuse before it completes
- window: Level 6+ Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disables; activate then commit hard
- wave: Slow-push to stack minions; this lets you run her down with wave pressure
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; you need raw movement speed to stick through her slows and kites
- item: Maw of Malmortius protects you from her burst and provides useful magic resist

olaf__viego.notes:
- threat: Viego's W Spectral Maw stun chains into massive damage; dodge or die fast
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Viego outtrrades you early, farm under tower if needed
- trading: Bait W Spectral Maw then all-in with Q Undertow and E Reckless Swing
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank W Spectral Maw stun and fight back fearlessly
- spike: First item spike hurts; respect his damage but don't get zoned entirely off
- window: Mid-game when Ragnarok active duration outlasts his burst; stick to him relentlessly
- wave: Slow-push to deny wraith spawns and control Viego's roam and teamfight power
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain through poke and heal off his minions
- item: Hollow Radiance; magic resist and item active slow counter his gap-close burst

olaf__viktor.notes:
- Gravity Field stuns you; avoid prolonged fights in his W zones at all costs.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Viktor out-ranges you with Q and E, farm safely.
- Bait his Q shield with feints, then all-in when it's down; dodge W.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his stuns; activate during his W for free engage.
- First item spike around 1000-1200 gold is dangerous; respect his damage and poke range.
- Post-six you dominate extended trades; use Ragnarok to dive through his Gravity Field.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces Viktor to choose between defending turret or roaming.
- Grasp of the Undying; sustain through his poke and gain tankiness for trades.
- Mercury's Treads early; reduces stun duration from Gravity Field and improves your survivability.

olaf__vi.notes:
- threat: Vi's R Cease and Desist locks you down; you cannot escape or cleanse the knockup
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Vi's Q Vault Breaker gap-closes and stacks Denting Blows armor shred
- trading: Bait Vi's Q, then all-in with E Reckless Swing; dodge her R cast point
- post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore her R Cease and Desist if attacking continuously
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; Vi gains armor pen through Denting Blows stacking fast
- window: Post-6 with Ragnarok active while Vi's R on cooldown; extended trades favor your true damage
- wave: Slow-push toward Vi; forces her to decide between farming and committing to unfavorable fights
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain through her armor shred and Denting Blows poke harassment
- item: Add Kaenic Lifegrip early; sustain through her burst and convert her damage into healing

olaf__vladimir.notes:
- Threat: Vladimir's Sanguine Pool dodges your burst and Hemoplague amplifies his damage output massively.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Vladimir out-trades you with Transfusion sustain and you lack kill pressure.
- Trading: Bait Sanguine Pool with Undertow, then all-in when it's on cooldown; avoid extended trades.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you fight through Hemoplague's damage amp; press your advantage immediately.
- Spike: First item spike hurts you around Kindlegem or Protobelt; play safer until you complete yours.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you when Vladimir uses Sanguine Pool; engage when it's cooling down.
- Wave: Slow-push to set up ganks; Vladimir struggles to contest you when behind his wave.
- Rune: Take Grasp for consistent trading and health scaling to match Vladimir's health conversion advantage.
- Item: Add Force of Nature against his magic damage and health scaling for better survivability.

olaf__volibear.notes:
- Volibear's Thundering Smash stun chains into Frenzied Maul burst; you die if caught immobile.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his gap close range and avoid extended trades near him.
- Bait Thundering Smash, dodge sideways, then trade back hard with Undertow and Reckless Swing combo.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his stuns; activate it when he Thundering Smash engages you.
- Volibear first item spike is real; farm safely and don't fight until you have items.
- Your window is when his Thundering Smash is down; all-in him hard with Ragnarok active.
- Slow-push waves into him so you control when fights happen and can kite toward tower.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain and health scaling counter his burst and poke pattern.
- Buy Hollow Radiance after core; the magic resist and health gutters his magic damage output.

olaf__warwick.notes:
- threat: Warwick's Infinite Duress suppression locks you down; his healing from Jaws of the Beast sustains through your damage.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Warwick out-trades you. Farm with Q Undertow from distance, avoid all-ins before level 6.
- trading: Bait his Primal Howl shield, then E Reckless Swing when it expires. Never fight near low-health minions.
- post6: Ragnarok makes you immune to his Infinite Duress suppression; activate R before his ult connects to counter-engage.
- spike: First item (likely Black Cleaver or Abyssal Mask) strengthens him around minute 10-12. Play cautiously; don't extend forward.
- window: Level 6 with Ragnarok active is your primary advantage. Force fights on your terms when R is ready.
- wave: Slow-push toward his tower to control when he engages. Prevents him from roaming; forces him to farm or fight.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying sustains through his poke and scales health; matches the extended trading pattern of this lane.
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts his magic damage burst into healing, and the active purges his crowd control briefly.

olaf__xerath.notes:
- Xerath's long-range poke with Arcanopulse and Shocking Orb stuns lock you down helplessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Arcanopulse, respect Shocking Orb range, farm under tower.
- Bait Shocking Orb by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity breaks Xerath's Shocking Orb stun chain; activate before committing hard.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect his damage and play around cooldowns.
- Post-6 Xerath becomes immobile; close gaps during Rite of the Arcane channel.
- Slow-push waves to stack minions; crash near his tower to force aggression.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains poke and strengthens your all-in trading pattern.
- Kaenic Lifegrip shields you and cleanses slows, improving survivability against his kit.

olaf__wukong.notes:
- threat: Wukong's Cyclone knockup chains with Nimbus Strike; stay mobile or eat repeated CC
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Wukong out-damages you early, avoid extended trades near minions
- trading: Bait Warrior Trickster, then Undertow through his escape path; dodge Nimbus Strike dash entirely
- post6: Ragnarok breaks his Cyclone disable chain; activate during his ult to maintain control
- spike: First item around level 9 is danger window; he gains raw damage advantage then
- window: Level 13+ with two items; your tankiness and Undertow spam outscale his burst attempts
- wave: Slow-push sideways; forces Wukong to chase you while Undertow resets let you kite backward
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain healing against his poke and reward short trades
- item: Force of Nature adds magic resist and movement speed to kite Cyclone knockups safely

olaf__xayah.notes:
- Threat: Xayah's Bladecaller root locks you down while her team collapses and bursts you.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her poke with Double Daggers and autos outranges your Undertow.
- Trading: Bait Bladecaller by positioning near her Feathers, then all-in when cooldown is down.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore her root, but dodge Featherstorm's initial daggers carefully.
- Spike: First item is dangerous; she gains consistent damage and kiting power against your gaps.
- Window: Mid-game when Undertow cooldown resets give chase potential; catch her before Featherstorm readies.
- Wave: Slow-push to set up ganks; rushing her forces mistakes and prevents safe farming patterns.
- Rune: Grasp sustains your trades and scales into late game where her poke matters less.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields burst and synergizes with Berserker Rage's Life Steal scaling.

olaf__xinzhao.notes:
- Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge gap-close and knock-up combo locks you down and bursts you hard.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Xin's early all-in is stronger—farm range, avoid his Wind Becomes Lightning.
- Bait his Audacious Charge with positioning, then Undertow his retreat; dodge his Three Talon Strike third hit.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables counters his knock-ups; activate it during his Crescent Guard engage window.
- His first damage item is a major spike; respect it and stay near minions for safety.
- Post-10 minutes with items, you out-duel him if Ragnarok is up; punish his cooldowns hard.
- Slow-push waves to control where Xin engages; deny him room to Audacious Charge in easily.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and poke; you out-scale him in extended fights.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip to boost your shield, survivability, and Berserker Rage healing in all-ins.

olaf__yasuo.notes:
- threat: Yasuo kites and pokes with Q while Wind Wall blocks your Undertow axe returns
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Yasuo out-ranges you, avoid extended trades before Berserker Rage scaling
- trading: Bait his Wind Wall with Undertow, then all-in with E Reckless Swing and autos
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his knockup; activate before he lands Last Breath combo
- spike: First Sheen-item spike hurts; dodge extended poke and use bush control to close gap
- window: Level 6 onwards when Ragnarok active negates his CC chain and you run him down
- wave: Slow-push to stack minions; all-in when wave crashes so he can't kite backwards safely
- rune: Grasp sustains through poke and strengthens all-in trades when you close the distance gap
- item: Kaenic Ruins reduces his crit damage and provides magic resist against his scaling threat

olaf__yone.notes:
- threat: Yone's Fate Sealed pulls you in and chains you; dodge or die
- early: Safe farm; Yone out-trades you pre-6, avoid unnecessary Q exchanges with him
- trading: Bait his Q stacks then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing
- post6: Ragnarok becomes critical; activate it when Fate Sealed comes or he dominates
- spike: First item spike dangerous; respect his damage, play safer until you scale harder
- window: Mid-game when Ragnarok cooldown shorter; use disable immunity to lock him down
