- wave: Slow-push to deny his roams and set up Undertow ganks with jungler
- rune: Grasp sustains your health pool and synergizes with Berserker Rage's missing health scaling
- item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his magic damage and shields you from his burst

olaf__yorick.notes:
- threat: Yorick's Maiden of the Mist and minions kite and overwhelm you; avoid prolonged fights.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Yorick weak early. Use Q poke, avoid his E armor shred.
- trading: Bait his E Mourning Mist, then all-in with W and E true damage combo.
- post6: Ragnarok becomes critical; activate to ignore Maiden's CC and chase Yorick down relentlessly.
- spike: Yorick first item rarely spikes hard; abuse his immobility window before he scales.
- window: Level 6 onward with Ragnarok active; you duel him and run down his minions.
- wave: Slow-push sideways; avoid letting him stack minions for Maiden. Don't get boxed by W.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain during extended trades and poke with Q spam.
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts his damage to healing and amplifies your sustain in extended duels.

olaf__yunara.notes:
- Threat: Yunara's Attack Speed and On-Hit spreading damage overwhelms Olaf's tanking through sustained fights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q outranges your engagement, farm defensively under tower.
- Trading: Dodge her W Arc of Judgment slow, trade back with E Reckless Swing true damage.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her slows, but Transcend State upgrades make her deadlier.
- Spike: First item spike is danger; her On-Hit damage multiplies, reduce all-in attempts then.
- Window: Post-6 when enemies group; activate Ragnarok and E through their team for teamfight value.
- Wave: Slow-push sidewaves to deny her roam pressure and create gank setup opportunities for allies.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains through her poke and scales into mid-game tanking.
- Item: Kaenic Lifeline adds magic resist and shields against her magic-damage critical strikes and On-Hit.

olaf__yuumi.notes:
- threat: Yuumi's healing and shield power with attached ally sustain makes Olaf's poke and all-ins ineffective
- early: Farm safely; Yuumi has no kill threat alone, but respect her ally's empowered on-hit healing pressure
- trading: Avoid extended trades into her shield; bait Zoomies! then engage when her ally lacks buffs
- post6: Ragnarok immunity counters her disable prevention but doesn't stop healing; focus killing her attached ally instead
- spike: First item spike around minute 10-12; punish by forcing all-ins before her ally scales healing power
- window: Mid-game when Yuumi detaches to rotate; dive her vulnerable ally or chase Yuumi before reattach
- wave: Slow-push to deny Yuumi roam efficiency and force her ally to farm under tower, pressuring attachment
- rune: Grasp for sustained trading damage that scales through the game; healing doesn't fully negate Grasp procs
- item: Add Kaenic Fissure to reduce her ally's healing received; synergizes with your true damage and engage

olaf__zaahen.notes:
- Threat: Zaahen's Q healing and W pull lock you down; his passive stacking makes him scale dangerously.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; his Q trades heal him back. Avoid extended fights near minions.
- Trading: Bait his W pull, then Undertow away. Use E true damage when he's low on stacks.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity breaks his W lockdown chain. Activate before his pull lands to maintain control.
- Spike: First item spike around 1000g is dangerous. Respect his healing; don't fight extended trades yet.
- Window: Mid-game when his stacks reset or he respawns. Dominate before he rebuilds Determination stacks high.
- Wave: Slow-push toward his tower; forces him to chase into your Undertow and Ragnarok threat range.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying—sustain matches his healing and chunks him during repeated short trades.
- Item: Thornmail reduces his Q healing and punishes his auto-attack reliance; add after core defensive item.

olaf__zac.notes:
- Zac's Q grab locks you down; follow-up R bounce chain stuns and prevents Ragnarok activation.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid pushing lane where Zac can E slingshot gank from river.
- Bait Zac's Q grab, then all-in with E true damage before he can chain abilities.
- Post-6, Ragnarok immunity breaks Zac's R knockup chain; activate during his bounce to negate CC.
- Zac's first item (typically health tank item) isn't a major spike; abuse early game before it.
- Punish window comes levels 9-11 when Ragnarok cooldown is low and Zac's utility peaks slower.
- Slow-push towards Zac to set up all-ins; avoid thin pushed waves where E slingshot has angle.
- Take Grasp for repeated short trades that trigger Berserker Rage stacking and sustain through poke.
- Add Adaptive Helm to reduce Zac's W percentage health damage and his sustained magic pressure.

olaf__zed.notes:
- Zed's Death Mark burst and repositioning let him kite and burst you repeatedly without counterplay.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Zed out-ranges you. Farm at distance, avoid his Razor Shuriken poke.
- Never chase Zed into his shadows. Bait Living Shadow dash, then trade with Undertow.
- Ragnarok at level 6 blocks Zed's disable attempts but doesn't stop his damage output.
- First item spike around level 9—punish window. Push wave and roam before he scales lethality.
- You spike hardest mid-game when tankier. Force grouping before Zed's late-game one-shot potential peaks.
- Slow-push side lanes. Zed must choose: defend or roam. Limits his map pressure leverage.
- Take Stormraider's Surge. Kite potential and escape speed counter Zed's hit-and-run assassination pattern.
- Add a Kaenic Lifeburst. Reduces his burst damage and gives you survivability against poke.

olaf__zeri.notes:
- Zeri's sustained damage and kiting with E Spark Surge and W Ultrashock Laser overwhelm Olaf's approach.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Zeri out-trades you early. Farm at range, avoid extended fights near walls.
- Bait her E Spark Surge dash, then Q Undertow to slow her escape and reset cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disable attempts; activate it when she commits with Lightning Crash.
- First item spike (likely attack speed) is dangerous; respect her burst and kite potential significantly.
- Punish windows occur when Zeri wastes E Spark Surge or W Ultrashock Laser; all-in immediately after.
- Slow-push to stack waves; deny Zeri reset opportunities and force her to engage unfavorably under tower.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into her poke-heavy style.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip to reduce her magic damage output and synergize with your Life Steal scaling.

olaf__ziggs.notes:
- Ziggs' range and Mega Inferno Bomb kite you endlessly; you cannot reach him safely.
- Play safe early; farm at range with Q Undertow, avoid Bouncing Bomb trades entirely.
- Bait Satchel Charge with aggressive positioning, then all-in while his escape is down.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Hexplosive Minefield slow and dive; use this window hard.
- Ziggs' first item spike is minimal threat; your level 6 power spike matters far more.
- All-in immediately after Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge; force fights before he resets cooldowns safely.
- Slow-push waves into tower; force Ziggs to choose between farming and poking you down.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke; you need healing to survive laning phase safely.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early; reduces his burst and gives you the tankiness to engage.

olaf__zilean.notes:
- threat: Chronoshift saves Zilean from all-ins; Time Warp kites you endlessly during fights.
- early: Safe farm. Zilean outranges you; avoid extended trades before level 3 power spike.
- trading: Bait Time Warp, then all-in with Undertow + Reckless Swing when he wastes it.
- post6: Ragnarok blocks his disable chain but Chronoshift negates your burst damage threat entirely.
- spike: His first item (Liandry's, Luden's) isn't inherently dangerous; your level 6 Ragnarok windows matter more.
- window: Level 6 with Ragnarok active lets you run him down; Time Warp is his only escape.
- wave: Slow-push into him. Force him to engage or let you scale into teamfight dominance.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge for guaranteed chase and kite removal when Ragnarok activates mid-fight.
- item: Maw of Malmortius adds magic resist and lifeline shield against his poke and burst.

olaf__zoe.notes:
- threat: Sleepy Trouble Bubble doubles damage on wake; avoid sleep or die instantly to followup
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Zoe outranges you hard, don't force trades yet
- trading: Bait Sleepy Trouble Bubble with axe pickups, then all-in when she misses cooldown
- post6: Portal Jump lets her kite and reposition; chase only if guaranteed kill incoming
- spike: First item spike hurts; dodge Paddle Star! carefully, farm safely until you scale
- window: Level 6+ with Ragnarok active; immunity lets you run her down relentlessly
- wave: Slow-push sideways; forces her to choose between defending and roaming mid-lane
- rune: Grasp for sustain and poke trading; healing mitigates her poke damage over time
- item: Hollow Radiance adds tankiness against her magic damage and cooldown reduction value

olaf__zyra.notes:
- Threat: Grasping Roots root locks you; plants zone and poke while you're immobilized helpless.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her seeds spawn slow but E root catches you easily.
- Trading: Bait her E Grasping Roots, then all-in with Q and W; dodge root always.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through Stranglethorns knockup; activate during her ult engage.
- Spike: First item spike around 1100 gold; respect her plant damage but still all-in.
- Window: Post-6 when you activate Ragnarok into her plants; she cannot stop your engagement.
- Wave: Slow-push toward her; forces seed placement predictably and lets you all-in with lane pressure.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; extra movespeed helps you dodge Grasping Roots and stick through plants.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip; converts plant magic damage to healing, sustains you through poke phase.

shen__ahri.notes:
- Ahri's Charm stops your Shadow Dash mid-dash, leaving you vulnerable and exposed.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her range and avoid her Orb of Deception poke.
- Bait Charm before engaging; dodge with positioning, then Shadow Dash through her for taunt.
- Post-6 Ahri gains mobility and extra damage; use Stand United to protect vulnerable allies.
- Ahri's first item spike is dangerous; play safer and focus on farming safely.
- Your power window arrives when Charm is down; engage aggressively with Shadow Dash then.
- Slow-push the wave to deny her roam windows and keep her focused on you.
- Take Grasp for sustain against her poke damage and to win extended trades.
- Add Hollow Radiance early to reduce her burst damage and protect nearby allies better.

shen__aatrox.notes:
- Threat: Aatrox's Q damage and W drag combo burst you down before you can retaliate effectively.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Q slams and don't contest his aggressive level 2 all-in.
- Trading: Bait his Q swings, then E in to taunt him during recovery; avoid fighting in his W zone.
- Post6: Stand United lets you save allies from his burst, but he now threatens your entire team harder.
- Spike: His first item (Kaenic Rookern or Black Cleaver) is dangerous; respect his sustained damage spike immediately.
- Window: You outscale him mid-game when you have tankiness; punish his cooldowns with E-Q trades after level 9.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny him all-in angles; stack waves to gank him or force him to overextend.
- Rune: Grasp gives you health sustain to outlast his poke and healing in extended trades.
- Item: Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce his healing and provide magic defense against his passive damage.

shen__akali.notes:
- Akali's W Twilight Shroud makes her invisible; you cannot block or taunt what you cannot target.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Twilight Assault, avoid close trades near her.
- Bait her W Twilight Shroud, then trade back hard; dodge her E Shuriken Flip mark always.
- Post-6, Akali gains all-in potential with R Perfect Execution; stay near allies for R Stand United.
- First item spike is dangerous; she deals burst and escapes easily; respect her damage window.
- Shen spikes mid-game when teamfights happen; your R Stand United and W Spirit's Refuge matter most.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam and force her to farm; control side lane pressure.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain helps you survive her poke and all-in attempts consistently.
- Build Hollow Radiance early; it blocks her burst damage and reduces her ability power significantly.

shen__akshan.notes:
- Threat: Akshan's Avengerang and Comeuppance burst you down before you can engage or respond effectively.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Akshan out-trades you hard. Farm at range, avoid his boomerang path.
- Trading: Never walk into Avengerang's return path. Bait his hook with Shadow Dash, then trade back.
- Post6: Stand United saves allies from Comeuppance execution. Use ult proactively; don't react to his damage.
- Spike: First item hurts; he gains raw damage. Stay passive, scale, and wait for teamfight advantage.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you if Akshan wastes Heroic Swing. Engage when his grapple is down.
- Wave: Slow-push sidewaves; Akshan struggles to clear efficiently. Force him into difficult positioning decisions.
- Rune: Take Grasp; sustain through his poke and gain scaling for late-game dominance in fights.
- Item: Hollow Radiance mitigates his burst and protects nearby allies from his high sustained damage output.

shen__alistar.notes:
- Threat: Alistar's Pulverize and Headbutt chain locks you down; his Unbreakable Will negates your burst.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Stay outside Headbutt range; he will all-in if you overextend.
- Trading: Bait his Pulverize before committing. Use Shadow Dash to dodge or engage after his cooldown.
- Post6: Stand United saves you from Pulverize chains. Use it preemptively when he positions aggressively.
- Spike: His first item is not a major spike. You remain relatively safe if patient.
- Window: Level 9+ when your cooldowns outpace his. Stack shields and catch him out of position.
- Wave: Slow-push toward him. Deny roams and force him to interact with you repeatedly.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain and health to survive his combo chains.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces his magic damage during Unbreakable Will and blocks crowd control.

shen__ambessa.notes:
- Ambessa's Public Execution suppression locks you down; her dashes and damage output overwhelm Shen's defenses.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Cunning Sweep and farm at range with Q Twilight Assault.
- Bait her Repudiation shield, then trade after it expires; never fight during her W bracing.
- Stand United becomes your escape tool post-6; use it liberally to avoid Public Execution suppression.
- Her first item spike (likely Black Cleaver) increases armor shred; respect her damage and play safer.
- You spike when she overextends; Shadow Dash in to taunt and kite with W Spirit's Refuge.
- Slow-push waves into her; she needs to all-in you, and stacked waves give you escape time.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain; you need health scaling to survive her combo pressure.
- Build Force of Nature third or fourth; magic resist helps survive her ability burst and rotations.

shen__annie.notes:
- Annie's Pyromania stun at four spell casts locks you down for guaranteed burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her Q poke range and avoid extended trades early.
- Bait her W Incinerate cone, then Shadow Dash through her when cooldown is down.
- Stand United becomes her escape tool; use E to taunt her before she ults out.
- First item spike around level 9-11 is dangerous; play safer and respect her stun timer.
- You spike when her Pyromania stun is down; trade aggressively during this window only.
- Slow-push to stack minions; this forces her to use mana farming and delays her stun.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against her poke and extended lane pressure.
- Build Adaptive Helm to reduce her spell damage and negate Tibbers burn threat significantly.

shen__anivia.notes:
- threat: Crystallize walls trap you; Glacial Storm slows and prevents your engage attempts completely.
- early: Safe farm. Stay mobile, dodge Q Flash Frost; don't commit to extended trades yet.
- trading: Bait her Q, then Shadow Dash through her. Avoid fighting inside Glacial Storm radius.
- post6: Stand United becomes risky—shielding allies lets Anivia ult lock them down for free.
- spike: First Liandry's or Rylai's spike hurts; kite away from teamfights, don't frontline yet.
- window: Early game before Glacial Storm; all-in her if Q is down and vulnerable.
- wave: Slow-push sideways to avoid Crystallize traps; maintain escape routes toward lane edges always.
- rune: Grasp sustains through Frostbite poke and scales tankiness for her burst patterns.
- item: Add Abyssal Mask early to reduce her magic damage and support your sustain.

shen__aphelios.notes:
- Threat: Aphelios out-ranges you and kites backward; his Calibrum marks enable all-in burst damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades when he has ammo advantage on Calibrum.
- Trading: Bait his weapon swap with Shadow Dash; trade only when his off-hand is weak.
- Post6: Stand United lets you engage or save allies; use it to force his mistakes decisively.
- Spike: First item spike hurts; respect range and kite threat, but you scale better into midgame.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you; your taunts and shields neutralize his sustained damage output harder.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; forces Aphelios to either match or lose plates, enabling roam opportunities.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains you through poke and converts tankiness into healing pressure.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip; amplifies your shields on allies and provides anti-burst utility against his range.

shen__aurelionsol.notes:
- Aurelion Sol kites you forever with Astral Flight mobility while Breath of Light pokes from range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Breath of Light by positioning behind minions and avoid extended trades.
- Bait Astral Flight before committing to Shadow Dash engage; Shadow Dash through Singularity if possible.
- Stand United becomes risky if Aurelion Sol ult stuns you mid-cast; position to minimize this risk.
- First item spike around 800-1200 gold is dangerous; respect Breath of Light range and poke damage.
- Window opens when Aurelion Sol burns Astral Flight; immediately Shadow Dash in and trade aggressively then.
- Slow-push lane to set up jungle ganks; prevent Aurelion Sol from roaming with his mobility.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain into poke and to win extended short trades.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip to reduce his magic damage and provide healing from Spirit's Refuge blocks.

shen__ashe.notes:
- Ashe's Enchanted Crystal Arrow stun locks you down, enabling ganks or all-ins you cannot escape from.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Frost Shot slows stack, making all-ins dangerous; farm at range with Q.
- Bait her Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then Shadow Dash in when she misses; dodge Volley cones.
- Stand United becomes a reactive tool; use it to save allies caught by her arrow stun.
- Her first item spike is moderate; exploit early before she scales and applies relentless Frost Shot slows.
- Push your advantage pre-6 when her Enchanted Crystal Arrow threat is absent; roam to sidelanes freely.
- Slow-push waves toward her tower; this denies her roaming and lets you scale safely into late.
- Take Grasp for sustain against her poke; the extra health also buffers Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns.
- Buy a Kaenic Lifeline to reduce burst damage and cleanse Ashe's slows via the active shield.

shen__aurora.notes:
- Aurora's mobility and invisibility from Across the Veil let her kite and escape your engages easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke outranges you. Farm passively and avoid getting cursed by Twofold Hex.
- Bait Across the Veil with Shadow Dash threats, then all-in when her invisibility is on cooldown.
- Stand United becomes her escape tool post-6; she'll use Between Worlds to disengage from your fights.
- Watch her first-item spike around 10-12 minutes; she gains damage and kiting power you cannot match yet.
- You spike hardest at level 6 with Stand United and after Hollow Radiance completes for sustain.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roaming opportunities and force her to choose between pushing or leaving lane.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain; you need healing to outlast her poke and kiting damage.
- Add Hollow Radiance earlier than usual; the healing reduces her poke effectiveness and strengthens your lane presence.

shen__azir.notes:
- Azir kites and damages you from range; his soldiers zone you off CS and trades.
- Play safe, farm with Q from distance, avoid stepping up into soldier range needlessly.
- Bait his E Shifting Sands dash, then E Shadow Dash through him to taunt and trade.
- Stand United lets you help teammates; use it when Azir commits R Emperor's Divide elsewhere.
- First item spike (Liandry's or similar) hurts; play around minions and avoid extended fights then.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Azir wastes E; close distance and lock him down hard.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces Azir to defend, reduces his roam, gives you gank setup.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and reinforces your tanking identity in extended trades.
- Adaptive Helm blocks his magic poke and reduces burst; slot it after core if behind.

shen__bard.notes:
- Bard's Tempered Fate ult locks you down; use Stand United to escape or save allies caught.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Bard's poke via Meeps is free. Farm under tower, avoid early Cosmic Binding.
- Bait Cosmic Binding into walls so it stuns Bard instead. Trade when his Meeps are depleted.
- Stand United becomes crucial counterplay post-6; shield allies caught by Tempered Fate stasis before damage follows.
- First-item spike is moderate threat; Bard gains poke and utility but lacks kill pressure on Shen.
- Shen spikes at level 6 with Stand United; use it to negate Bard's roam impact globally.
- Slow-push waves toward Bard; this limits his roam windows and forces him to farm under tower.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke; you need healing to offset Meep damage over laning phase.
- Add Kaenic Lifeburst as second-third item; the healing amplification counters Bard's distributed damage and utility.

shen__belveth.notes:
- Bel'Veth's attack speed and mobility let her kite and out-duel you in extended fights.
- Play safely; her Q Void Surge gap-close is faster than your E Shadow Dash.
- Bait her W Above and Below, then E Shadow Dash through her for guaranteed taunt.
- Stand United lets you save allies from her burst, but she still scales harder.
- First item spike is dangerous; abuse early game before her attack speed compounds dangerously.
- Levels 1-2 and when her ult is down; force short skirmishes, never long trades.
- Slow-push to deny her roam value; force her to farm and stay relevant.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain stacks help you survive her relentless early poke.
- Build Kaenic Lifesaver to reduce her lifesteal and prevent her E Royal Maelstrom healing.

shen__blitzcrank.notes:
- Rocket Grab catches you out of position; one mistake costs the lane or your life
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid close trades where Rocket Grab ranges you easily
- Bait Rocket Grab by faking positions, then Shadow Dash in to taunt and trade back
- Stand United covers allies Blitzcrank targets; use it defensively since his grab range outmatches yours
- First item spike matters less; Blitzcrank needs items for tankiness while you scale into teamfights
- Post-15 minutes when Blitzcrank falls off; abuse him in sidelane before grouped fights begin
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance from river; control spacing so Rocket Grab has longer reach
- Grasp sustains poke and rewards short trades when you land Shadow Dash taunt combos
- Hollow Radiance blocks Rocket Grab's damage and shields teammates from Static Field's lightning procs

shen__braum.notes:
- Braum's Concussive Blows stun locks you, preventing Shadow Dash escape or Stand United activation windows.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Braum out-trades you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Bait Unbreakable with Q poke, then all-in when shield resets. Never trade into his W armor buff.
- Stand United becomes your primary tool post-6; use it to enable plays elsewhere and escape ganks.
- His first Armor item spike (Kaenic Rookern, Hollow Radiance) makes you weaker; abuse before completion.
- You spike harder mid-game when maxing Q. Punish him when Unbreakable is down or cooldown vulnerable.
- Slow-push into him; force him to engage on your terms when minion wave favors you.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling into his tankiness throughout the laning phase.
- Add Hollow Radiance early second item to reduce his magic damage and match his bulk survivability.

shen__camille.notes:
- Camille's Hookshot knocks you up and her Ultimatum traps you; you cannot escape or protect allies.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid her Q range. Farm with Q from distance, never fight early.
- Bait her Hookshot onto walls, then all-in with Shadow Dash taunt while it's down.
- Post-6, Camille dominates you. Her Ultimatum negates Stand United and traps you for guaranteed damage.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous. Play safer and focus on scaling through farm.
- You spike mid-game with cooldown reduction allowing frequent shields. Use Stand United to protect grouped allies.
- Slow-push to control wave proximity to walls; deny her Hookshot angle and deny her gank setup.
- Take Grasp for sustain and health stacking; you need durability against her bonus magic damage.
- Add Hollow Radiance; the haste and health let you shield more often against her repeated burst.

shen__cassiopeia.notes:
- Miasma grounds you, preventing Shadow Dash escape and making you vulnerable to Petrifying Gaze.
- Play safe and farm from distance; avoid moving through her poison clouds early.
- Bait Miasma before trading; dodge Noxious Blast and retaliate when her cooldowns are down.
- Stand United remains your best tool; use it proactively to save allies from Petrifying Gaze.
- First-item spike is moderate; watch for Liandry's or Rylai's increasing her dueling pressure significantly.
- You spike when Cassiopeia uses ultimate; rotate immediately to punish her vulnerability window.
- Slow-push to stack minions; force her to engage under your turret where Shadow Dash works.
- Take Grasp for consistent healing trades that stack health against her poke and sustained damage.
- Build Abyssal Mask early to reduce her magic damage and enable longer fights against her.

shen__corki.notes:
- Threat: Corki's Gatling Gun armor shred and poke make you vulnerable; dodge or block with W
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Corki outranges you badly, farm with Q when blade is near
- Trading: Bait Valkyrie, then E in; avoid extended trades since Gatling Gun shreds your defenses
- Post6: Stand United lets you ult allies away from Corki's Missile Barrage; use this defensively
- Spike: First item around level 9 is dangerous; he gains sustained damage; respect his positioning
- Window: Level 6+ when Stand United is live; rotate to help teammates escape Corki's poke
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions; forces Corki closer, lets you land E more easily when ready
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains you through poke and grants tankiness against repeated pressure
- Item: Abyssal Mask; reduces Corki's magic damage and helps you survive Gatling Gun harass better

shen__diana.notes:
- Threat: Diana's Lunar Rush resets on Moonlight; she chains gap-closes and bursts you down fast.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Diana outrades you. Farm with Q from distance when possible.
- Trading: Bait her Crescent Strike, then Shadow Dash to gap close and taunt her back.
- Post6: Stand United becomes crucial—use it proactively to save allies Diana dives, not reactively.
- Spike: First item spike (Nashor's Tooth or similar) is dangerous; respect her damage output then.
- Window: Post-6, roam and ult allies before Diana snowballs; abuse her weak early teamfight setup.
- Wave: Slow-push or freeze near your tower; deny her gank setup and force her to overextend.
- Rune: Grasp sustains you through trades and scales into teamfights better than Stormraider's Surge.
- Item: Hollow Radiance blocks her AP burst and slows enemies chasing your ult target away.

shen__ekko.notes:
- Ekko's Phase Dive lets him dodge your E and all-in you with burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ekko out-trades you early. Use Q to farm from distance.
- Bait Ekko's Phase Dive before committing E. Never chase him through minions.
- Stand United cannot save you from Ekko's burst if he dives you alone.
- His first item spike is dangerous; play defensively until you complete defensive items.
- You outscale mid-game when you have two items and cooldown reduction online.
- Slow-push waves to set up ganks; Ekko lacks escape when pushed toward your tower.
- Take Grasp for sustain trades and bonus health to survive his burst combos.
- Buy Kaenic Lifeburst to reduce his magic damage output and give you healing.

shen__draven.notes:
- threat: Draven's raw AD damage and axe catch resets delete you if you get caught out of position
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading when he has two axes ready or Blood Rush active
- trading: Bait Stand Aside, then Shadow Dash through him; use Q Twilight Assault when he commits to axes
- post6: Stand United saves teammates from Whirling Death; play around their positioning, not just yours in fights
- spike: First item spike (likely Infinity Edge or Bloodthirster) is dangerous; respect his burst and kite potential
- window: You win teamfights when he's forced to catch axes near your Spirit's Refuge or your jungler arrives
- wave: Slow-push to stack waves into tower; denies him kill potential and lets you survive ganks easier
- rune: Grasp of the Undying provides sustain against poke and scaling for extended fights you want to take
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip gives damage reduction when Draven bursts and improves your W Spirit's Refuge coverage utility

shen__elise.notes:
- Elise Cocoon stun locks you into her burst combo; dodge or die early.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid her all-in engage range.
- Bait her Cocoon with Shadow Dash fakes, then trade back immediately after.
- Her Spider Form gives her sustained damage and gap close; respect her dueling power post-six.
- Watch her first AP item spike around ten to twelve minutes; play safer then.
- You spike when she wastes Cocoon; all-in her immediately after the stun expires.
- Slow-push waves to deny her Spiderling stacks and create gank setup for your jungler.
- Take Grasp to sustain her poke and win extended trades with Ki Barrier procs.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce her burst magic damage and support teammates better.

shen__evelynn.notes:
- threat: Evelynn's charm from Allure locks you down; her burst from Last Caress catches you off-guard.
- early: Safe farm. She scales hard; avoid overextending. Use Q to maintain distance and poke safely.
- trading: Bait her W Allure delay, then Shadow Dash through her. Never trade when her W is up.
- post6: Last Caress makes her untargetable and deadly. Use Stand United proactively to save teammates from burst.
- spike: First item spike (Lich Bane or Hextech Protobelt) increases her damage. Play safer; rotate to assist allies.
- window: Mid-game when Stand United is up and enemies group. Shen becomes the teamfight anchor with cooldown.
- wave: Slow-push to set up gank opportunities. Keep Spirit's Refuge up near blade to block her combo.
- rune: Grasp. Sustained trading damage helps you survive her poke and scales into mid-game tankiness better.
- item: Kaenic Orb. Reduces her magic damage and charm effectiveness; builds naturally into your defensive itemization.

shen__fiora.notes:
- Fiora's Grand Challenge reveals all Vitals; hitting them heals and out-trades you heavily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading into her Bladework attack speed windows early.
- Bait her Riposte before committing; Shadow Dash through her to taunt and escape.
- Stand United cannot save you from Vitals; use it to help teammates instead.
- First item spike is dangerous; Fiora gains raw stats and Vital healing—respect her damage.
- Your window comes when her Riposte is down; Shadow Dash in and trade hard.
- Slow-push waves to deny her all-in opportunities and set up jungle ganks safely.
- Take Grasp for sustain in a poke war where Fiora out-damages raw short trades.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce her attack speed and protect against Bladework critical strikes.

shen__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Terrify fear locks you down; Crowstorm burst deletes you when caught alone or displaced.
- Play safe; Fiddlesticks weak early but Terrify punishes overextension—farm under tower if needed.
- Bait Reap silence by positioning wide; Shadow Dash through his fear range to engage safely.
- Stand United becomes your lifeline; use it preemptively when Crowstorm channels to negate damage.
- First item spike dangerous; Fiddlesticks gains sustained damage—play around cooldowns and avoid jungle camps.
- Shen spikes when Fiddlesticks wastes Crowstorm; all-in immediately after or force plays mid-map.
- Slow-push and freeze near tower; deny Fiddlesticks easy roam flanks and setup for Terrify.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; Fiddlesticks pokes relentlessly and fear kiting limits trading.
- Adaptive Helm blocks drain and execute; delays Bountiful Harvest damage significantly in extended fights.

shen__galio.notes:
- Galio's W Shield of Durand taunt locks you down; his E Justice Punch knocks you up.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Galio outranges Q Twilight Assault. Farm under tower, avoid his Q Winds of War.
- Bait W Shield of Durand by walking up, then E Shadow Dash away before he releases taunt.
- Post-6, Galio R Hero's Entrance shields allies and knocks up; your R Stand United can counter-engage.
- First item spike is moderate threat; Galio needs mana and tankiness before he dominates mid-game.
- You spike when Galio wastes W Shield of Durand; dash in for all-in with E Shadow Dash.
- Slow-push waves toward Galio; forces him to trade or lose minions, reducing his roam pressure upmap.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain during long trades and chunk Galio's health before teamfights.
- Build Kaenic Orb to reduce Galio's magic damage shields and cut healing from his tankiness items.

shen__garen.notes:
- threat: Garen's Judgment spin deals heavy sustained damage; his Demacian Justice executes low-health targets.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3. Use Q to poke from range before Garen closes gap.
- trading: Bait Garen's Q Decisive Strike, then E Shadow Dash away. Never all-in early.
- post6: Demacian Justice threatens execute attempts. Use R Stand United to save low-health allies preemptively.
- spike: Garen's first item spike (Black Cleaver) is dangerous. Respect his armor shred and damage.
- window: Post-6, when Garen's Demacian Justice is on cooldown, you have extended window to trade.
- wave: Slow-push toward Garen. This denies his all-in range and lets your jungler gank safely.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health advantage throughout laning phase.
- item: Hollow Radiance blocks his physical damage and armor shred scaling from Black Cleaver.

shen__gnar.notes:
- Mega Gnar's Wallop stun into GNAR! combo locks you down and deals massive damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gnar out-trades you early. Farm with Q from distance safely.
- Bait his Hop, then Shadow Dash in when he lands; dodge Boomerang Throw returns.
- Stand United becomes critical; use it defensively when he transforms or offensively to engage.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect his damage and play around cooldowns more carefully.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Gnar is mini; split and force grouped fights then.
- Slow-push to deny him good Rage generation; prevent him from hitting critical Transform points.
- Take Grasp for sustain in a poke-heavy matchup; proc it safely with Q trades.
- Build Hollow Radiance early; the armor and health reduce Mega Gnar's burst significantly.

shen__graves.notes:
- Graves' burst damage from close range with reloads forces you into unfavorable all-ins constantly.
- Play safe early; his superior short-range damage wins extended trades at levels 1-3.
- Bait Smoke Screen or End of the Line before committing; dodge his reload windows.
- Stand United becomes powerful; use it to save allies Graves bursts while pressuring him back.
- His first item spike is dangerous; respect his damage and avoid extended skirmishes then.
- You spike when Graves runs out of ammo mid-fight; punish his reload windows hard.
- Slow-push to deny him all-ins; maintain distance and let him push into tower range.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading pressure and healing to offset his burst damage trades.
- Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce his burst damage and amplify your tankiness significantly overall.

shen__gragas.notes:
- Gragas E Body Slam stun locks you; dodge or get chain-CC'd into burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge barrel rolls and avoid close range where he stuns easily.
- Bait his E Body Slam, then Q Twilight Assault him during his recovery window.
- R Stand United becomes your escape; use it to leave when he lands E.
- First item spike around Liandry's or Rylai's lets him kite better; punish before completion.
- Post-15 minutes when you stack resistances; Gragas struggles to burst through your tankiness then.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces him to choose between farming and roaming with ult.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and wins short trades consistently.
- Consider Adaptive Helm early second or third to reduce his repeated burst magic damage.

shen__gwen.notes:
- Gwen's W Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable; your E Shadow Dash and R Stand United cannot reach her.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gwen out-trades you early. Farm with Q Twilight Assault, avoid walking into her mist.
- Bait her W Hallowed Mist, then trade back. Never chase her into mist; she heals and out-damages you.
- Your R Stand United cannot follow her into mist. Use it to protect teammates instead; she cannot punish it.
- Gwen's first item spike is dangerous. She gains sustained damage and healing. Avoid extended fights; kite backward with Q.
- You spike when Gwen wastes W Hallowed Mist. All-in immediately with E Shadow Dash and Q Twilight Assault combo.
- Slow-push waves into her tower. Force her to choose: farm safely in mist or trade and fall behind.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain trades and scaling damage. You need healing to outlast her poke.
- Buy Kaenic Lifeburst; the magic damage reduction and healing amp help you survive and trade against her A Thousand Cuts.

shen__heimerdinger.notes:
- Heimerdinger's turrets zone you and his grenade stuns, preventing engagement and W blocks.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge grenade, farm under tower, avoid turret clusters.
- Bait his grenade with E, then dash through; avoid trading into turret damage.
- Stand United lets you escape gank attempts and support teammates; leverage this advantage.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes; play safer, respect turret damage, wait for gank.
- Post-teamfight, Shen dominates; force grouped fights where turrets matter less than your taunt.
- Slow-push toward his tower; force him to choose between farming and defending turrets.
- Grasp for sustained trading and tankiness against poke-heavy turret harassment over time.
- Abyssal Mask reduces turret and ability damage while improving your tankiness and sustain.

shen__hecarim.notes:
- Threat: Hecarim's E Devastating Charge knockback and R Onslaught of Shadows fear lock you down and kite away.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Hecarim out-trades you. Farm with Q Twilight Assault from distance, avoid close combat.
- Trading: Bait his E Devastating Charge, then E Shadow Dash to taunt and disengage. Never stand in Q Rampage range.
- Post6: Stand United becomes critical—use it defensively when he engages. His R Onslaught of Shadows fear means you need escape tools.
- Spike: First item spike around level 9-11 is dangerous. Stack armor early; his physical damage from E and Q accelerates.
- Window: Punish Hecarim when E Devastating Charge is down; he loses mobility. Engage after he wastes ultimate on team fights.
- Wave: Slow-push and hold mid-wave. This lets you E Shadow Dash away safely and deny his roam pressure upward.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying rewards short trades when you taunt and escape; sustain helps lane sustainability against his poke.
- Item: Thornmail after core tank items. Reflects his damage and reduces healing from W Spirit of Dread significantly.

shen__hwei.notes:
- Hwei's Subject abilities lock you into one damage type; dodge painted spells or get overwhelmed.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Hwei outranges you. Farm with Q, avoid walking into Subject: Disaster range.
- Bait Subject: Disaster or Subject: Torment casts, then E Shadow Dash through him to taunt.
- Stand United shields incoming Spiraling Despair damage and repositions you away from expanding painting center.
- First item spike around 1000-1200 gold; not a major threat. Maintain spacing and dodge casts.
- Post-first-item or level 9+, your tankiness outscales his poke. Pressure him with Q trades.
- Slow-push waves toward him; forces Hwei to choose between farming or fighting near your tower.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against his poke; every trade heals you back.
- Build Hollow Radiance early; its magic resist and healing amplification counters his sustained painted damage.

shen__irelia.notes:
- Irelia's Bladesurge resets on Marked targets; she chains kills and dives you repeatedly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge her Flawless Duet and farm at range with Q.
- Bait her Flawless Duet by positioning sideways; Shadow Dash through her when she commits.
- Stand United saves allies she targets; she scales harder and all-ins become deadlier post-6.
- Her first item spike (Trinity Force or similar) is a punish window; respect her damage.
- You spike when she's low on Mark stacks or after she wastes Bladesurge cooldown.
- Slow-push and leverage Shadow Dash to create gank opportunities; avoid hard-pushing into her.
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading power to match her early poke and aggression.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline to reduce her burst and provide utility against her sustained damage.

shen__illaoi.notes:
- Illaoi's E Test of Spirit roots you in place, forcing damage trades you cannot escape or block.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid her W Harsh Lesson range and respect tentacle damage near walls.
- Bait her E Test of Spirit, then Shadow Dash away; never trade directly into tentacle swings.
- Stand United becomes your escape tool post-6; use it to bail when she ults aggressively.
- First item spike around Sheen/Trinity is dangerous; dodge her engage and kite backward with Q Twilight Assault.
- Your power window is mid-game when you can roam; force teamfights away from tentacle terrain.
- Slow-push waves toward her tower; deny her space to set up tentacles and force rotations.
- Take Grasp to sustain tentacle poke and scale into teamfights where her single-target threat matters less.
- Buy Kaenic Lifeline early; its active cleanses her E Test of Spirit channel and saves you.

shen__ivern.notes:
- Rootcaller root locks you down; Daisy kites and blocks your Shadow Dash engage attempts.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading near brush where Brushmaker bonus damage punishes you hard.
- Bait Rootcaller by sidestepping, then Shadow Dash in; dodge his Triggerseed shield timing before committing.
- Stand United becomes risky post-6; Ivern can root you mid-dash or have Daisy kite away.
- First item spike (usually Liandry or Zhonya) is dangerous; respect his damage and root threat window.
- Shen spikes when Ivern wastes Rootcaller; all-in immediately after or punish cooldown with trading.
- Slow-push side lane; avoid grouping where Daisy and roots chain-lock you in teamfights easily.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; extended trades force Ivern to respect your shield scaling.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline for magic damage mitigation; it's cheaper than pure tank items versus poke.

shen__janna.notes:
- Monsoon knocks you away and heals her team; respect its teamfight presence always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Janna outranges you, farm with Q from distance only.
- Bait Eye Of The Storm shield with Q poke, then all-in when it's down.
- Stand United becomes useless when Janna zones you; focus on split-pushing instead post-6.
- First item spike is weak for Janna; abuse her vulnerability before she scales.
- You spike hardest at two items with cooldown reduction and tankiness; use this window.
- Slow-push and freeze near your tower; forces Janna to walk up and get caught.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and healing; short trades favor her, long ones favor you.
- Hollow Radiance blocks her attack damage buff from Eye Of The Storm effectively.

shen__jayce.notes:
- Jayce's Shock Blast and Thundering Blow poke you down from range before engaging.
- Play safe; dodge Shock Blast by positioning behind minions, farm cautiously at range.
- Bait Shock Blast, then Shadow Dash in to trade; avoid Thundering Blow knockback combos.
- Stand United gives you an escape tool; use it to bail when cornered.
- First item spike hurts; respect his damage and don't fight during his power window.
- Post-first-item, you scale better; look to group and use Stand United for side fights.
- Slow-push to stack minions; deny Jayce melee engages and control when fights happen.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains you through poke and strengthens your scaling.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce his damage and support your teammates' tankiness.

shen__jax.notes:
- Jax's Counter Strike dodges your Q and stuns you; his burst outdamages your shield.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Jax out-trades you early. Farm from distance, avoid his Leap Strike.
- Bait Counter Strike with Shadow Dash or Q, then all-in after his stun ends.
- Stand United lets you support allies, but Jax scales harder into mid-game teamfights.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; respect his damage and dodge fights.
- You win at level 6 with Stand United roams; abuse map pressure before his scaling.
- Slow-push waves into him; deny him roam angles and force him to match your ult.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and shield scaling against his poke damage.
- Build Hollow Radiance to reduce his burst damage and increase your defensive utility value.

shen__jhin.notes:
- Jhin's Deadly Flourish and Curtain Call eliminate you from extreme range before engaging.
- Play safe behind minions; Jhin outranges your Q Twilight Assault significantly early.
- Bait Deadly Flourish by repositioning, then Shadow Dash through minion wave toward him.
- Stand United shields target but doesn't dodge Curtain Call; position allies away from Jhin.
- First item spike makes Jhin deadlier; play around cooldowns and wave control early.
- Level 6 when Jhin ults gives him engage threat; stay behind minions always.
- Slow-push waves to deny Jhin safe poke angle; force him up or miss farm.
- Grasp sustains poke damage from Deadly Flourish and enables short trade windows safely.
- Hollow Radiance blocks Curtain Call lotus traps and mitigates Jhin's execute threat significantly.

shen__jarvaniv.notes:
- Jarvan IV's Cataclysm traps you; you cannot Shadow Dash or Stand United out easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Martial Cadence burst hurts. Stay behind minions, avoid all-ins.
- Bait his Dragon Strike, then trade back with Twilight Assault. Never fight near his Demacian Standard.
- Post-6 Cataclysm is a cage. Play around it; use Stand United to help allies instead.
- His first item spike (Black Cleaver or similar) increases his threat. Respect his damage window.
- Level 6+ when Stand United enables you to skip fights and save teammates. Abuse this advantage.
- Slow-push waves toward him. Force him to break your freeze or lose farm. Avoid his set-ups.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into his tankiness.
- Buy Abyssal Mask second or third. Its magic resist and health counter his mixed damage output.

shen__jinx.notes:
- Threat: Jinx's Zap! and Super Mega Death Rocket! burst from range before you close distance safely.
- Early: Play safe; Jinx out-ranges your Twilight Assault. Farm with Q when she's on cooldown.
- Trading: Bait Zap! by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash in when she's locked in animation.
- Post6: Stand United becomes critical—shield allies before her rocket lands, then teleport to continue teamfights.
- Spike: Her first item spike (likely crit or AD) increases damage output; play safer and group.
- Window: Mid-game when cooldowns stack in teamfights. Catch her out of position with Shadow Dash.
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions near your tower, forcing her closer and into Shadow Dash range.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained health in extended short-range trades she wants to avoid.
- Item: Spirit Visage for magic resist against her burst and to amplify your shield sustain value.

shen__ksante.notes:
- K'Sante's All Out transformation and sustained damage output overwhelm Shen's defensive tools and shield value.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading into Ntofo Strikes stacks—farm at range and respect his damage.
- Bait Path Maker's dash, then Shadow Dash through him; dodge Ntofo Strikes shockwave pull at all costs.
- Post-6, K'Sante gains All Out transformation after his ultimate—expect massive damage spike and reduced defenses on him.
- First item spike around Kaenic Rookern or Adaptive Helm makes K'Sante extremely threatening; farm safely and scale.
- Power window is when K'Sante ultimate is on cooldown; then leverage Stand United and Ki Barrier defensively.
- Slow-push waves to control positioning near your tower; prevents K'Sante from catching you with Shadow Dash taunts.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for consistent tankiness trades and scaling; helps you survive his burst.
- Consider Kaenic Rookern early to reduce his sustained damage and amplify your shield value against his attacks.

shen__karma.notes:
- Karma's Focused Resolve root locks you down; dodge it or get kited and bursted.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke outranges your Q, avoid unnecessary minion contests.
- Bait Focused Resolve with Shadow Dash sidestep, then all-in with Q and E together.
- Stand United negates her burst attempts; use it proactively to deny her kill pressure.
- Her first item spike (likely Liandry's) increases poke damage; farm safely and respect range.
- You spike when Focused Resolve is down; dash in and force trades then immediately.
- Slow-push to stack minions; prevents her from roaming and lets you all-in with numbers.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke; scales into teamfights and helps you survive lane.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early; reduces her ability damage and gives you needed tankiness baseline.

shen__kaisa.notes:
- Kai'Sa's high attack speed and Plasma stacks burst you down faster than you can react or shield
- Play safe and farm at range with Q; avoid close trades before level 3 when she scales
- Bait her E Supercharge, then E Shadow Dash through her to taunt and create distance immediately
- Her R Killer Instinct closes gaps instantly; use R Stand United proactively to protect threatened teammates
- Her first item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and play behind minions until you itemize
- Post-6 you match her roaming power; use R Stand United to enable bot lane skirmishes decisively
- Slow-push to stack minions; forces her to either engage into larger wave or lose CS pressure
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through her poke and scales into tankiness for late game
- Kaenic Lifeburst converts her magic damage into healing, reducing burst threat and strengthening your kit significantly

shen__karthus.notes:
- Requiem catches you and allies off-guard; avoid grouping predictably when it channels.
- Safe farm early; Karthus has no kill pressure. Focus on CS and scaling.
- Dodge Lay Waste by moving unpredictably; bait Wall of Pain then all-in him.
- Stand United becomes your primary tool; use it to save allies from Requiem damage.
- First item spike is moderate; abuse his immobility with Shadow Dash engages immediately after.
- You spike mid-game when Stand United shields matter most; dominate sidelanes before teamfights.
- Slow-push waves to deny Karthus safety; force him to choose between farming and grouping.
- Grasp of the Undying provides sustain against poke and scaling for teamfights.
- Consider Kaenic Lifebringer to reduce Karthus damage and heal teammates during Stand United.

shen__kalista.notes:
- Kalista's Rend stacking and kiting with Martial Poise makes you vulnerable to poke and all-in combos.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Pierce and avoid extended trades near her Sentinel bonus damage zone.
- Bait Pierce by positioning sideways, then Shadow Dash when she commits; block Rend with Spirit's Refuge.
- Stand United becomes less valuable since Fate's Call negates your ult's teleport advantage; play around it.
- First item spike (likely Kraken Slayer or Serrated Dirk) increases her burst and Rend damage significantly.
- Your power window is early Shadow Dash all-in before she stacks Rend spears or uses Fate's Call.
- Slow-push to deny her all-in range; stacking minions gives you gank setup and Stand United windows.
- Take Grasp for sustain against her poke and to win short trades before she kites away.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce her attack speed and lower Rend scaling damage against you.

shen__kassadin.notes:
- Kassadin's Riftwalk mobility lets him kite and escape your Shadow Dash engage attempts repeatedly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kassadin out-ranges you with Null Sphere, so farm with Q only.
- Bait his Null Sphere shield, then all-in with Shadow Dash; avoid trading into Force Pulse.
- Post-6 Kassadin becomes untargetable and mobile; your Stand United ult cannot reliably catch him.
- First item spike (Archangel's Staff or Manamune) significantly strengthens his damage and sustain against you.
- Your power window is before level 6; punish him early before Riftwalk gives him escape.
- Slow-push waves to deny Kassadin safe roam opportunities and force him to farm under tower.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading pressure and health to survive his poke.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce his magic damage output and support your tankiness baseline.

shen__kayn.notes:
- Kayn's Shadow Step lets him chase you down; his Umbral Trespass burst kills you alone.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kayn out-damages you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Bait his Q Reaping Slash, then Spirit's Refuge blocks his follow-up. Never trade into his W.
- Post-6, Shadow Dash away from Umbral Trespass animation; use Stand United to escape or save allies.
- First item spike is dangerous; Kayn gets burst damage. Farm safely, don't get caught isolated.
- You spike when he's stuck between forms; pressure him then. Mid-game teamfights favor your utility.
- Slow-push waves to deny his roam. Keep minions near your tower so he can't all-in.
- Take Grasp for sustain; you need tankiness and healing against his sustained poke and burst.
- Add Kaenic Lifebane; it gives tankiness and lets you heal off his spell damage trades.

shen__khazix.notes:
- Kha'Zix isolation damage and burst from Q/E combo; you die if caught alone without cooldowns.
- Play safe, hug tower, farm with Q from range; avoid trading short before level 3.
- Bait his E Leap with positioning, then E Shadow Dash through him to taunt and escape.
- His R Void Assault invisibility triggers your danger; play around cooldowns and group with teammates always.
- First item spike (likely Serrated Dirk) is dangerous; respect his all-in and maintain defensive cooldown usage.
- Your power window is post-6 with R Stand United; use it to enable team fights and save allies.
- Slow-push and position near teammates to deny him isolation kills; never walk alone in sidelane.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain tankiness against his poke and burst trading patterns.
- Add Kaenic Lifebrand to maximize healing output and reduce his burst damage effectiveness on you.

shen__kled.notes:
- Kled's Jousting and mounted damage burst you down; dismount him first.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid his W attack-speed window, farm with Q.
- Bait his E Jousting, then Shadow Dash through him for taunt.
- Stand United becomes your escape tool; use it before he all-ins.
- First item spike hurts; play safer, stack your shield with Q trades.
- You spike when Kled dismounts; chase him down and finish fights.
- Slow-push waves to deny his all-in angle and control bushes.
- Grasp of the Undying provides sustain against his repeated burst trades.
- Hollow Radiance gives armor and cooldown reduction against his physical damage.

shen__leblanc.notes:
- threat: LeBlanc's Ethereal Chains roots you; avoid getting shackled or she bursts you.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from range, dodge her Sigil of Malice.
- trading: Bait her W Distortion dash, then E Shadow Dash through her return path.
- post6: Stand United becomes reactive; use it to save teammates LeBlanc targets, not yourself.
- spike: First item spike dangerous; stay grouped and use W Spirit's Refuge defensively.
- window: After her W Distortion cooldown ends, gap-close with E Shadow Dash and trade.
- wave: Slow-push to deny her roam angles; proxy if safe and team is stable.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain from short trades reduces her poke pressure.
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip; activate before her burst to shield allies and amplify your tankiness.

shen__kogmaw.notes:
- Kog'Maw's W Bio-Arcane Barrage shreds you from range; you cannot all-in safely without closing gap first.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid his auto-attacks; he outranges early.
- Bait his Q Caustic Spittle, then E Shadow Dash in to taunt and trade back.
- Stand United cannot save you from his R Living Artillery; use it proactively on teammates instead.
- His first item spike (Nashor's Tooth or AP item) is dangerous; avoid extended trades then.
- Post-level 9, you outscale him in teamfights; use R Stand United to enable winning fights.
- Slow-push waves to stack them; force him to choose between farming and fighting you.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against his poke and max health damage.
- Build Hollow Radiance to reduce his magic damage and counter his percent health shred.

shen__leesin.notes:
- Lee Sin's Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike combo deals huge burst and enables all-in kills on isolated Shen.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading near minions where Lee Sin can land Sonic Wave easily.
- Bait Sonic Wave by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge with Shadow Dash.
- Stand United becomes your primary defense tool post-6; use it preemptively against Dragon's Rage knockback chains.
- Lee Sin's first item spike (Brutalizer components) is dangerous; respect his damage window and play safer.
- You spike when Lee Sin wastes Sonic Wave; punish the long cooldown with aggressive Twilight Assault trades.
- Slow-push waves to deny Lee Sin gank setup angles; keep minions closer to your tower for safety.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling; synergizes with your shield trades.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip to amplify your shields and provide healing against his burst physical damage threat.

shen__leona.notes:
- Leona's E Zenith Blade immobilizes you, enabling W Eclipse tankiness and Q Shield of Daybreak stun chain.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in potential. Farm with Q Twilight Assault from range when possible.
- Bait her E Zenith Blade, then Shadow Dash through her to escape or punish her cooldown.
- Stand United saves allies from Solar Flare burst. Use it proactively when she positions for teamfight ult.
- First item spike around Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Lifebrace hits hard; respect her tankiness but stay relevant.
- Post-15 minutes when cooldowns align favorably; punish her if E Zenith Blade whiffs or teammates engage.
- Slow-push into her; force her to engage or lose cs. Prevents ganks and lets you scale safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into her tanky build naturally.
- Add Kaenic Lifebrace to reduce her W Eclipse damage reduction and amplify your own trading effectiveness.

shen__lillia.notes:
- Lillia kites you relentlessly with movespeed stacks while applying max health DoT damage passively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid fighting near her—her W deals heavy center damage early.
- Bait her E Swirlseed rolls, then Shadow Dash through her when she commits forward.
- Stand United now shields an ally but can't stop her from kiting your team away.
- First item spike around 1100g isn't dangerous; farm safely and scale—you outscale her late.
- Post-10 minutes when you complete first item, you're tankier and can duel effectively, punish.
- Slow-push waves to stack them; forces her to decide between farming and roaming pressure.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for reliable poke and healing to negate her passive DoT.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip second for healing amp against her damage and utility against her kiting.

shen__locke.notes:
- Threat: Locke's On-Hit magic damage executes low-health targets; avoid his sustained damage trades.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Locke out-damages you early, farm with Q from distance.
- Trading: Bait Ritual Nails, dodge with Shadow Dash, then E-taunt him for short trades.
- Post6: Stand United saves marked allies from Purgatory execution; use it reactively for protection.
- Spike: Locke's first item spike (Nashor's Tooth or similar) is dangerous; play defensive then.
- Window: Post-6 with Stand United active, punish Locke if he overextends near your team.
- Wave: Slow-push lanes to stack minions; denies Locke execute angles and forces him forward.
- Rune: Grasp for sustain and health stacking to survive his On-Hit magic damage.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces his On-Hit damage and supports tanking his sustained offense.

shen__lucian.notes:
- Threat: Lucian's Lightslinger procs and kiting force you to commit resources just to trade damage back.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Lucian out-damages you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait his E Relentless Pursuit, then E Shadow Dash through him to taunt and close gap.
- Post6: Stand United shields an ally, but Lucian's sustained damage and mobility still pressure you heavily.
- Spike: First item spike is dangerous; Lucian gains sustained DPS. Play around cooldowns and teamfights, not 1v1.
- Window: Mid-game when Stand United enables roams; leave lane to impact fights and shield vulnerable allies.
- Wave: Slow-push and roam; you win by multiplying impact via ult, not winning sidelane 1v1 trades.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; stacking health scales your shields and gives you sustain against poke.
- Item: Adaptive Helm blocks Lightslinger magic damage and gives MR; add it after core tank items build.

shen__malphite.notes:
- Threat: Unstoppable Force gap-closes and knocks you up, leaving you vulnerable to follow-up damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; avoid close trades since Malphite out-trades you without cooldown items.
- Trading: Bait Thunderclap activation, then Shadow Dash away; never fight him head-on in minion wave.
- Post6: Unstoppable Force forces you to play around Stand United; position to protect squishy teammates instead.
- Spike: First armor item (Thornmail, Kaenic Cascade) spikes Malphite hard; respect his damage and poke safety.
- Window: Mid-game when Malphite ult is down; pressure and farm aggressively until he lands it again.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes to deny Malphite roam value and force him to stay and farm.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains your poke trades and scales into late-game tankiness better.
- Item: Kaenic Cascade reduces his armor scaling and lets you duel him more reliably than raw tank items.

shen__masteryi.notes:
- Threat: Master Yi's Alpha Strike untargetability negates your taunt; his true damage shreds you.
- Early: Play safe; Master Yi outduels you level 2-3. Farm with Q from distance.
- Trading: Bait Alpha Strike with Shadow Dash prediction, then punish his cooldown window hard.
- Post6: Stand United becomes crucial for saving teammates Yi dives; you cannot 1v1 him.
- Spike: First item spike (Blade of Ruined King) is dangerous. Play defensively, stack armor early.
- Window: Early levels 1 and mid-game teamfights where you can taunt and shield allies.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny his roam impact; prevents Yi from snowballing kills elsewhere.
- Rune: Grasp sustains you through poke and provides tankiness against his true damage scaling.
- Item: Thornmail reflects his attack damage and applies Grievous Wounds against his healing.

shen__milio.notes:
- Threat: Milio's Cozy Campfire zone denies your melee trades and heals his team repeatedly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Milio outranges you, avoid extended trades near his Campfire.
- Trading: Bait Warm Hugs shield, then Shadow Dash in for quick Q-empowered trades before backing.
- Post6: Stand United becomes stronger; use ult to save allies Milio can't burst down fast enough.
- Spike: First item spike around 800 gold—punish Milio when he backs; he lacks burst defense.
- Window: Level 6 onward when Stand United shields spike; dominate sidelane fights with ult advantage.
- Wave: Slow-push toward enemy tower; forces Milio to choose between defending tower or grouping early.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying gives sustained health trades into Milio's poke-heavy support playstyle.
- Item: Spirit Visage adds bulk and healing reduction against Milio's consistent zone healing output.

shen__morgana.notes:
- Threat: Dark Binding locks you down; follow with Tormented Shadow burst punishes immobile Shen hard.
- Early: Play safe; avoid clustering near minions where Dark Binding chains through you easily.
- Trading: Bait Dark Binding with Shadow Dash positioning, then trade back with Twilight Assault combos.
- Post6: Stand United saves teammates from Soul Shackles chains; use it proactively before her engagement.
- Spike: First item (likely Zhonyas or Liandry's) isn't a major threat; continue farming safely.
- Window: Mid-game when Stand United cooldown resets faster; roam with cooldown advantage over her.
- Wave: Slow-push waves toward her tower; forces her into Shadow Dash engage or farming distance.
- Rune: Grasp trades sustain and tankiness; keeps you healthy through her poke and trades.
- Item: Hollow Radiance blocks her Tormented Shadow scaling damage; build after core tank items.

shen__naafiri.notes:
- Threat: Naafiri's packmates overwhelm you; her bleed stacks and dash resets punish immobile champions.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades when her packmates are active nearby.
- Trading: Bait out The Call of the Pack, then trade while her pack is gone.
- Post6: Stand United becomes crucial for saving allies she dives; use it proactively on threats.
- Spike: First item spike (Serrated Dirk components) is dangerous; farm safely and respect her range.
- Window: After her E cooldown, packmates are vulnerable; engage when she has no reset option.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her roam angles and keep her pinned in lane farming.
- Rune: Grasp provides sustained health to survive her bleed damage and packmate poke patterns.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces her bleed application and heals allies; slot after first core item.

shen__nasus.notes:
- Nasus' Wither slows you heavily, preventing escapes and enabling his damage output.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Q poke from range, avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait Wither with Shadow Dash, then trade when it's down; dodge Spirit Fire.
- Stand United becomes crucial for saving teammates from Nasus ult burst damage.
- First item spike around level 9—punish his mana struggles and immobility before scaling.
- Early mid-game before his resistances stack; roam and leverage Stand United advantage.
- Slow-push to deny his Siphoning Strike stacking and force him to overextend.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and scales into teamfights well.
- Hollow Radiance reduces his damage and provides armor against his ult sustained pressure.

shen__neeko.notes:
- threat: Neeko's E Tangle-Barbs roots you, then R Pop Blossom stuns; you cannot escape or peel.
- early: Safe farm. Neeko outranges you with Q Blooming Burst; do not walk into her minion line.
- trading: Bait her E Tangle-Barbs by faking aggression, then E Shadow Dash through her for the taunt.
- post6: Stand United saves allies from Pop Blossom damage and stun, but does not prevent the CC itself.
- spike: First item spike (likely Liandry's or Zhonyas) increases her burst; respect her range, do not overextend.
- window: You spike when Neeko wastes E Tangle-Barbs; immediately Q Twilight Assault into trading stance or W Spirit's Refuge.
- wave: Slow-push sideways; deny her minion line while staying away from her Q Blooming Burst bounce angles.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustains into her poke and scales your health pool through teamfights.
- item: Hollow Radiance; blocks her burst magic damage and reduces her ability power effectiveness against you.

shen__nilah.notes:
- Nilah's Slipstream dash and Apotheosis pull lock you down while her Jubilant Veil dodges your damage output.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nilah's early Slipstream trades are strong—farm with Q from distance, avoid short trades.
- Bait Jubilant Veil with Shadow Dash, then trade back hard when her dodge window closes—don't chase.
- Stand United becomes weaker since Nilah's Apotheosis pulls your entire team in—use ult defensively or roam instead.
- Her first item spike (likely Navori or Kaenic) around 10-12 minutes increases her dueling—respect her damage spike hard.
- Post-first-item, your tankiness and cooldowns let you abuse gaps—force fights when her Slipstream is down cooldown-wise.
- Slow-push waves into her; this denies Nilah roam opportunities and lets you stay healthy for extended trades.
- Grasp of the Undying scales your tankiness and lets you win short trades despite her early pressure.
- Build Kaenic Rookern early to reduce her healing amplification and mitigate her damage output significantly.

shen__nocturne.notes:
- Nocturne's Paranoia removes your vision and enables all-in engages; Unspeakable Horror fear locks you down.
- Play safe near tower; avoid extended trades early since Nocturne out-damages you with Umbra Blades procs.
- Bait Shroud of Darkness with Shadow Dash before committing; dodge Unspeakable Horror or back away immediately.
- Stand United becomes critical for saving teammates Nocturne dives; expect him to flash-engage post-six constantly.
- His first item spike (Black Cleaver or Serrated Dirk) threatens burst; punish him early with Wave clear.
- You spike when teamfighting with Stand United and Spirit's Refuge blocking his burst; coordinate with team.
- Slow-push to deny Paranoia roam value and maintain vision control; reset when Nocturne moves to gank.
- Take Grasp to sustain his poke and generate tankiness for extended trades; winning scaling matters here.
- Add Kaenic Lifeline to block his burst damage and cleanse fears from Unspeakable Horror reliably.

shen__nunuwillump.notes:
- Threat: Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks you up and roots you with Snowball Barrage; you cannot escape or block.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Nunu's gank setup is strong. Hug tower and avoid overextending for Q poke.
- Trading: Bait Biggest Snowball Ever! by positioning near minions, then Shadow Dash away. Never trade without cooldowns up.
- Post6: Stand United becomes crucial; use it preemptively when Nunu channels Absolute Zero to save teammates from burst.
- Spike: Nunu spikes hardest at first item; avoid isolated fights. Your shield scales better; wait for teamfight advantage.
- Window: Post-first-item when your shields outvalue his sustained damage. Teamfights favor you; force grouping and block his W.
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions; Nunu needs space to roam. Deny his gank setup by controlling wave position.
- Rune: Grasp punishes his short trades and scales your tankiness into late game teamfights where you control space.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces Absolute Zero's damage and gives you armor; rush after core defensive items for safety.

shen__ornn.notes:
- Ornn's W Bellows Breath Brittle status makes him shred your resistances and enable his team.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near terrain that enables E Searing Charge knockup.
- Bait his W, then trade back hard; dodge Q Volcanic Rupture fissure and pillar.
- Stand United cannot save you from his R Call of the Forge God engage; position carefully.
- First item spike is dangerous; play safe until you complete your defensive items fully.
- You win mid-game teamfights when Ornn overextends away from terrain and his cooldowns reset.
- Slow-push to prevent him from using terrain walls to enable E Searing Charge knockups.
- Take Grasp to sustain his poke and win extended trades when he missteps.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip early to reduce his W Brittle resistance shred on you and allies.

shen__orianna.notes:
- Orianna Command: Shockwave catches grouped Shen; her poke and kite prevent your engagement.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Command: Attack poke and farm with Q when safe.
- Bait Command: Protect onto herself, then all-in; dodge Command: Dissonance slow before trading hard.
- Stand United becomes your engage tool post-6; use it to flank or save allies.
- First item spike (Liandry's or Luden's) hurts; respect her poke and scale into teamfights.
- Win mid-game when Orianna lacks mobility; engage from fog or flank with Shadow Dash.
- Slow-push to deny her roaming impact and set up ganks or your Stand United plays.
- Take Grasp for sustain against her poke; you need health to survive her spam.
- Build Hollow Radiance early for magic resist and health; scales your shields and survivability.

shen__pantheon.notes:
- Pantheon's W Shield Vault stuns you instantly; you cannot react or Shadow Dash away reliably.
- Play safe and farm at range with Q Twilight Assault; avoid close trades before level 3.
- Bait his W Shield Vault cooldown, then trade with Q into E Shadow Dash for escape.
- Stand United lets you help teammates, but Pantheon's Grand Starfall covers huge area; coordinate carefully.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; respect his damage and play behind minions.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where Spirit's Refuge and Stand United protect multiple allies.
- Slow-push waves to create gank opportunities for your jungler; avoid pushing into his stun range.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into Pantheon's burst damage.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce his burst damage and protect nearby allies from his threat.

shen__pyke.notes:
- Threat: Pyke's E Phantom Undertow stun chains into Q Bone Skewer all-in; you die if caught.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Pyke out-damages you early. Farm with Q Twilight Assault from distance.
- Trading: Never chase Pyke into fog. Bait his W Ghostwater Dive, then trade back hard.
- Post6: Stand United saves you from Death From Below executes; use it preemptively when Pyke roams.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Serrated Dirk) is dangerous. Respect his all-in damage window; play safer.
- Window: Level 9+ when your cooldowns drop and W Spirit's Refuge blocks his frequent combo attempts.
- Wave: Slow-push into him; deny Pyke roam flanks and force him to fight you for CS.
- Rune: Grasp procs reliably in short trades and keeps you healthy against his poke pressure.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces his burst and gives you tankiness to survive his E-Q combo.

shen__qiyana.notes:
- Threat: Qiyana's Audacity gap close and Royal Privilege burst combo oneshots you before counterplay lands
- Early: Play safe levels 1-2, farm with Q from range, avoid pushing into her bushes
- Trading: Bait her Audacity with Shadow Dash positioning, then E taunt her during cooldown window
- Post6: Stand United becomes escape tool—use it preemptively when she lands Audacity, don't wait for burst
- Spike: First item spike (likely AD or lethality) threatens you hard; respect her damage and play safer
- Window: Midgame when cooldowns matter more—land E taunts to lock her down before Audacity resets
- Wave: Slow-push toward your tower to bait Audacity into your team or minion block for taunts
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain and tank scaling—you need health to survive burst
- Item: Hollow Radiance late for magic resist and utility, or Kaenic Rookern if she builds AD

shen__quinn.notes:
- Quinn marks you with Harrier and kites away, avoiding your Shadow Dash and Stand United engagement tools.
- Play safe and farm at range with Twilight Assault. Avoid trading when Harrier is active on you.
- Bait Vault by positioning aggressively, then Shadow Dash when she commits. Never chase her into Vision range.
- Stand United becomes a liability if Quinn ults; she gains mobility and kiting power you cannot match.
- Her first item spike (likely crit or lethality) increases burst damage. Abuse cooldown windows before she completes.
- You spike when enemies group; coordinate ganks before Quinn reaches scaling. Roam more than she can match.
- Slow-push to deny her roaming and force her to farm. Prevent Quinn from controlling sidelane distance.
- Take Grasp for sustain trades and survivability; Quinn's poke damage pressures constantly without it providing returns.
- Purchase Kaenic Rookern early after core items to reduce her physical damage and critical strike effectiveness against you.

shen__rammus.notes:
- Rammus taunts you into his Defensive Ball Curl, forcing you to waste abilities and take reflected damage.
- Play safe and farm from range with Twilight Assault; avoid trading into his early Armor scaling.
- Bait Frenzying Taunt by positioning unpredictably, then Shadow Dash away; never all-in early.
- Stand United becomes your primary tool; use it to support allies and escape his engagement.
- After Rammus completes first armor item, his reflected damage spikes; play around cooldowns instead.
- Your advantage window is when Frenzying Taunt is down; pressure with Shadow Dash and Twilight Assault.
- Slow-push waves to deny Rammus roams and force him into defensive farming patterns.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain in extended trades and tank scaling synergy.
- Add a Thornmail to amplify reflected damage back into Rammus during his Defensive Ball Curl.

shen__reksai.notes:
- Rek'Sai's Void Rush true damage and max-health scaling burst deletes you if caught without cooldowns.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early aggression with Q empowered autos outdamages you easily.
- Bait her Burrow with positioning, then engage when she surfaces; dodge Unburrow knockup.
- Stand United becomes her escape tool post-6, making all-ins riskier for you unless coordinated.
- Her first damage item (Black Cleaver, Serrated Dirk) is a danger window; play safer.
