- You spike when she's burrowed and vulnerable or when your cooldowns reset mid-fight.
- Slow-push to maintain control; prevents her from setting up tunnels and ganks effectively.
- Grasp of the Undying for consistent true damage and health to survive her trades.
- Kaenic Lifeline reduces her true damage burst and gives you lifeline defensive utility.

shen__rell.notes:
- Magnet Storm pulls you in, stunning via Shattering Strike; you die if caught alone
- Play safe levels 1-3; Rell's armor gain from Crash Down makes trading unfavorable early
- Bait Shattering Strike by positioning unpredictably, then Shadow Dash away; avoid extended trades
- Stand United becomes critical; use it defensively when Rell Magnet Storm engages your team
- First item spike around Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern; respect it, don't fight frontally
- Power spike when Rell wastes Crash Down; engage with Shadow Dash taunt immediately after
- Slow-push waves to control spacing; prevents Rell from freely roaming to pull your team
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through her poke and reward you for Shadow Dash
- Kaenic Rookern reduces her magic damage and steals; build it early if she scales

shen__renataglasc.notes:
- Threat: Hostile Takeover forces you to fight; Bailout turns losing fights into wins for her team.
- Early: Safe farm levels one through three; avoid trading into her Leverage marks and bonus ally damage.
- Trading: Bait her Q Handshake root, then Shadow Dash through her for guaranteed taunt and disengage.
- Post6: Stand United saves marked allies from Hostile Takeover burst; use it preemptively when she channels ultimate.
- Spike: First item spike is moderate danger; dodge Loyalty Program E missiles to avoid shield denial.
- Window: Level six onward; Stand United cooldown advantage lets you save allies faster than she can ult.
- Wave: Slow-push toward her tower; forces her to overextend for Leverage marks or lose CS pressure.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain through poke and scale tankiness to survive Hostile Takeover fights.
- Item: Abyssal Mask second or third; reduces her E Loyalty Program shield value and ultimate damage output.

shen__rengar.notes:
- Rengar one-shots you with ferocity-empowered Q after Thrill of the Hunt engage.
- Play safe level 1-3; stay near minions to deny brush access and leaps.
- Bait Bola Strike with Shadow Dash, then trade back with Twilight Assault.
- Thrill of the Hunt forces you into reactive mode; use Stand United defensively.
- First item spike (usually damage-focused) is dangerous; play passive and scale safely.
- You spike when teamfights start; coordinate Stand United plays to protect carries.
- Slow-push to deny Rengar brush control; maintain wave near your tower for safety.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain to handle his trading damage.
- Buy Kaenic Lifeline early as defensive option; synergizes well with your shielding pattern.

shen__riven.notes:
- Riven's Q knockback and W stun combo lock you down; avoid getting caught immobile near her.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in potential. Use Q to poke from distance safely.
- Bait her W Ki Burst, then E Shadow Dash through her to taunt and disengage.
- Post-6, Stand United becomes your escape tool when Riven ults. Use it proactively to avoid Blade Exile combos.
- First item spike is dangerous; she gains raw damage. Play back and wait for your defensive items online.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where W Spirit's Refuge and R Stand United protect teammates effectively.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roaming opportunities and stack minions for safer farming under tower pressure.
- Pick Grasp for sustain in this long trade matchup; passive healing helps you survive her combo chains.
- Add Kaenic Orb to reduce her physical damage output and provide extra sustain for extended trades.

shen__rumble.notes:
- Rumble's The Equalizer wall zones you hard; respect its massive damage and slow.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Flamespitter poke hurts and Scrap Shield lets him kite you.
- Bait his Electro Harpoon cooldown, then Shadow Dash in to trade; avoid Flamespitter cone.
- Stand United becomes crucial post-6; shield allies caught in The Equalizer from distance.
- First item spike (Liandry's or similar) makes his Danger Zone damage lethal; respect spacing.
- You spike when Rumble overheats and is forced out; punish his Heat management mistakes.
- Slow-push to deny him Danger Zone stacks and force him to trade unfavorably.
- Take Grasp for sustain to out-trade his poke and survive laning phase pressure.
- Add Abyssal Mask to reduce his magic damage and enhance your own tankiness significantly.

shen__sejuani.notes:
- Sejuani's crowd control chain locks you down; avoid her Q Arctic Assault into E Permafrost combo.
- Play safe early; her Q Arctic Assault has longer range than your engagement tools allow.
- Bait out her W Winter's Wrath, then E Shadow Dash in; dodge her R Glacial Prison.
- Post-6, respect her R Glacial Prison range; it enables her team to collapse on you.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; she gains tankiness and crowd control that shuts you down.
- You spike when she wastes Q Arctic Assault or R Glacial Prison; punish her with E.
- Slow-push waves into her; she needs to engage, which wastes her cooldowns and opens kills.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain through her poke and scale into your teamfight advantage.
- Buy Force of Nature against her; magic resist helps you survive her crowd control chains.

shen__samira.notes:
- Samira's Inferno Trigger at close range deals massive AOE damage; stay distant and dodge.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Samira out-trades with Daredevil Impulse stacking; farm defensively under tower.
- Bait Wild Rush with positioning, then Shadow Dash to taunt; avoid fighting in her melee range.
- Post-6, Stand United becomes crucial for saving teammates from Inferno Trigger; don't fight her directly.
- First item spike (likely crit or AD item) makes Samira extremely dangerous; farm safely then.
- Shen spikes mid-game when tankiness peaks; use Shadow Dash ganks while Samira lacks mobility.
- Slow-push waves toward your tower; limits Samira's roam potential and keeps you safe from ganks.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain helps you survive her poke and trade favorably.
- Buy Force of Nature second or third; magic resist counters her Daredevil Impulse magic damage.

shen__ryze.notes:
- threat: Ryze roots you with W after applying Flux; you cannot dash or fight back
- early: Play safe; avoid trading. Farm at range with Q. Respect Ryze's mana pool damage
- trading: Bait W Rune Prison, then E Shadow Dash through him. Never eat Q Overload spam
- post6: Stand United saves rooted allies from Realm Warp engages. Use R proactively on threats
- spike: First item around level 9 hurts; farm safely and scale. Avoid extended fights early
- window: Level 11+ when you have two items and tankiness. Ryze struggles against sustained engage
- wave: Slow-push to deny Ryze safe roams. Build pressure and force him to clear wave
- rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustain and proc damage every trade without all-in risk
- item: Hollow Radiance. Reduces Ryze's spell damage output and provides needed tankiness against poke

shen__senna.notes:
- Threat: Piercing Darkness poke combined with Dawning Shadow global shield denies Shen lane pressure.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Senna outranges you heavily, avoid unnecessary Q trades.
- Trading: Dodge Piercing Darkness by positioning behind minions; Shadow Dash in only when she wastes cooldowns.
- Post6: Dawning Shadow shields her entire team globally; your Stand United becomes less impactful for fights.
- Spike: First item spike (usually crit) around 2500 gold makes her poke unmanageable; stay patient.
- Window: Play around her W Last Embrace cooldown; all-in when it's down and she overextends.
- Wave: Slow-push sidewaves to deny her roaming impact and force her to stay lane.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain against poke and scale into teamfights better.
- Item: Hollow Radiance; reduces her global Dawning Shadow damage and supports nearby allies defensively.

shen__seraphine.notes:
- Threat: Seraphine's E Beat Drop and R Encore charm lock you down before you can engage or escape safely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q High Note poke outranges your threats, so farm passively and avoid unnecessary pushes.
- Trading: Bait her E Beat Drop, then E Shadow Dash through her to taunt and close distance immediately after.
- Post6: Stand United becomes reactive defense; use it to prevent her R Encore charm from catching teammates in fights.
- Spike: Seraphine's first damage item (Luden's Echo or similar) is her spike; respect her range and poke damage.
- Window: Punish Seraphine when her E and R are down; all-in with Q Twilight Assault and E Shadow Dash.
- Wave: Slow-push toward her to deny her safe positioning and force her closer to your taunt range.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying—sustain her poke, strengthen your dueling, and grant health for later tankiness and survivability.
- Item: Hollow Radiance—reduces ability haste, weakening her spell spam and R Encore uptime significantly in extended fights.

shen__sett.notes:
- Threat: Sett's Haymaker true damage and The Show Stopper isolation kill immobile Shen fast.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades into his Pit Grit health regen.
- Trading: Bait Facebreaker by positioning on one side only; punish with Shadow Dash taunt.
- Post6: Stand United saves you from The Show Stopper slam; use it preemptively.
- Spike: First item spike threatens you; respect Haymaker shield window and play around cooldown.
- Window: Punish Sett after he wastes Facebreaker or Haymaker; engage when his Grit is low.
- Wave: Slow-push to control distance and deny Sett jungle proximity; avoid feeding him ganks.
- Rune: Take Grasp to match his sustain and gain tankiness from repeated short trades.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces his true damage and Grit storage while boosting your durability significantly.

shen__singed.notes:
- Singed flings you into his Mega Adhesive, rooting and bursting you down immediately.
- Play safe; his Fling range outmatches yours. Farm defensively, avoid pushing past river.
- Never trade near his Mega Adhesive. Bait Fling with Shadow Dash, punish cooldown.
- Stand United lets you escape Fling chains. Use it proactively when he dives.
- His first item spike is real danger. Play safer and group with teammates early.
- Post-teamfight when Singed ult expires; his Poison Trail loses Grievous Wounds then.
- Freeze near your tower. Slow-push only when teammates rotate to punish his roaming.
- Take Grasp; sustain his poke and pressure him with repeated short trades.
- Add Kaenic Lifeline early to counter his Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds application.

shen__sion.notes:
- Threat: Sion's Q stun and R knockup lock you down; avoid his charge paths always.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Q charge, farm with Q at range.
- Trading: Bait his Q charge, then E in; trade after he whiffs, never face-check.
- Post6: Stand United saves allies from R knockup; track his charge direction constantly.
- Spike: First item spike minimal threat; abuse cooldowns before he stacks health passively.
- Window: Early game before health stacking; punish Q whiffs with E-Q-W combos aggressively.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny his Q radius; prevent him from charging into your wave.
- Rune: Grasp for repeated trades and sustain; disengage between procs to avoid his Q.
- Item: Hollow Radiance delays his health stacking and reduces his sustained damage output significantly.

shen__sivir.notes:
- Sivir's Spell Shield blocks your Shadow Dash taunt, negating your primary engage tool.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Sivir outranges you with Boomerang Blade, avoid unnecessary poke.
- Bait her Spell Shield with Shadow Dash, then trade with Twilight Assault when shield expires.
- Stand United remains strong for teamfight engagement; use it when Sivir commits with On The Hunt.
- Her first item spike is moderate threat; she gains range but lacks burst to threaten you.
- Punish Sivir when Spell Shield is down; all-in windows exist after she blocks your abilities.
- Slow-push waves to create gank opportunities for your jungler; Sivir struggles against coordinate dives.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and tankiness against her poke damage.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce her Boomerang Blade damage and strengthen your shielding.

shen__skarner.notes:
- Threat: Impale suppresses you; once caught, you cannot escape or Shield allies with Stand United.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay near minions; Skarner wants close range to stack Quaking.
- Trading: Bait Ixtal's Impact into terrain, then Shadow Dash away. Avoid extended trades near walls.
- Post6: Impale range is dangerous. Play further back; Stand United cannot save you if suppressed.
- Spike: First item spike (likely tank item) strengthens his survivability. Punish with Shadow Dash ganks.
- Window: Levels 4-5 before Impale. Pressure him; Force cooldown burns before his ultimate threatens you.
- Wave: Slow-push toward his tower. Denies Skarner engagement angle; gives you space for Shadow Dash.
- Rune: Grasp. Sustain through his Quaking stacks and tank repeated poke from Shattered Earth.
- Item: Hollow Radiance. Reduces enemy magic damage from Quaking stacks and Seismic Bastion shockwave.

shen__sona.notes:
- Threat: Crescendo stun locks you; Sona's kite and shields make trading lethal for Shen.
- Early: Farm safely at range with Q. Avoid close trades; Sona out-damages early skirmishes.
- Trading: Bait Crescendo before committing E. Trade after her cooldowns; dodge her heal shield.
- Post6: Stand United becomes critical—shield allies from Crescendo damage, then teleport to teamfight.
- Spike: First item (Shard or Hollow Radiance) isn't dangerous. Farm and scale safely until mid.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Shen's taunt controls Sona; bait her ultimate on low-threat targets.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes. Force Sona to rotate, then collapse with E for picks.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustain mitigates poke; extra health helps survive Crescendo.
- Item: Hollow Radiance. Magic resist and healing reduce Sona's poke and burst threat significantly.

shen__soraka.notes:
- Threat: Soraka's Wish heals entire team; you cannot duel or pressure her effectively alone.
- Early: Play safe; Soraka outranges you with Starcall. Farm defensively, avoid Q poke clusters.
- Trading: Bait Equinox before committing. Shadow Dash through it to taunt and all-in.
- Post6: Stand United still beats Wish in raw impact; use ult proactively on carries.
- Spike: First item (Chemtech or Liandry's) strengthens poke. Farm safely; don't force bad trades.
- Window: Shen spikes at two items with cooldown. Hunt isolated targets before Soraka rotates.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny Soraka roam windows and force her to choose between wave.
- Rune: Grasp sustains against poke and procs reliably in short Shen trades versus Soraka.
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifeline for healing reduction and spell shield against Wish's massive heal.

shen__swain.notes:
- Swain's E Nevermove roots you, then W Vision of Empire slows and confirms R Demonic Ascension drain damage.
- Play safe level 1-3; Swain out-ranges you. Farm with Q Twilight Assault from distance, avoid pushing lane.
- Bait his E Nevermove root by moving unpredictably, then trade back with Q while he's on cooldown.
- Post-6, Swain becomes lethal all-in threat. Use R Stand United proactively on teammates or disengage via E Shadow Dash.
- First item spike (Liandry's or similar) is dangerous. Respect his damage; play safer farming patterns during this window.
- Shen spikes when Swain wastes E Nevermove. All-in him immediately with Q into E Shadow Dash combo then.
- Slow-push waves; prevents Swain from roaming and lets you scale. Denies his early R Stand United impact potential.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain into poke and extended trades; Swain excels in attrition wars.
- Build Adaptive Helm to reduce his Q Death's Hand and R Demonic Ascension sustained damage significantly.

shen__sylas.notes:
- Sylas Kingslayer dash closes gaps, heals, and bursts you before Shadow Dash taunts him.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading near Sylas as he all-ins with Kingslayer easily.
- Bait Sylas Abscond dash, then Shadow Dash taunt him as he commits; avoid Chain Lash slow.
- Stand United becomes his ultimate; he steals your ult to shield allies or escape fights.
- First item spike around level 9-11 is dangerous; play safer, rely on Spirit's Refuge blocks.
- You spike when Sylas burns cooldowns; punish with Shadow Dash taunt and Q collision slow.
- Slow-push waves to control Sylas all-in range; deny him freeze near your tower safety.
- Grasp of the Undying rewards short trades and sustains through his poke damage consistently.
- Add Adaptive Helm to reduce his Chain Lash and Kingslayer burst magic damage significantly.

shen__tahmkench.notes:
- Tahm Kench's Devour removes you from fights; avoid stacking An Acquired Taste to three.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid repeated Q poke that stacks An Acquired Taste on you.
- Bait Tongue Lash with Spirit's Refuge ready, then trade back with Twilight Assault immediately.
- Post-six, Devour becomes a threat; respect it and play around cooldown windows carefully.
- His first item spike pressures hard; stay healthy and don't fight extended trades then.
- You spike when Devour is on cooldown; punish aggressively during that window before reset.
- Slow-push waves to prevent Tahm Kench from roaming and using Devour on allies elsewhere.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains you through poke and scales into mid-game strength.
- Kaenic Rookern reduces his magic damage and His healing, blocking his sustain advantage.

shen__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Taliyah's Unraveled Earth stuns you mid-dash; Shadow Dash becomes a liability, not escape.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid pushing into minefield. Farm with Q from range when possible.
- Trading: Bait her W Seismic Shove, then trade back. Never E through her Unraveled Earth.
- Post6: Stand United remains strong for saves, but Weaver's Wall cuts map control. Ward river.
- Spike: First item powerspike (Luden's or similar) increases her zoning threat; respect Unraveled Earth placement heavily.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where E cooldown resets on multiple taunts; use this before she scales.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; avoid mid pushing into her wall setup. Control wave near your tower.
- Rune: Grasp sustains trades and scales tank stats; you need durability versus her poke.
- Item: Force of Nature reduces her spell damage and gives movement speed to kite minefields.

shen__taric.notes:
- Taric's Cosmic Radiance invulnerability negates your burst and ultimate pressure in teamfights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Taric out-damages you early. Farm with Q from range.
- Bait Dazzle stun before trading. Avoid extended fights where he stacks Bravado empowers.
- Post-6, your Stand United becomes less impactful when Taric shields and invulnerabilities stack.
- Taric's first armor item is dangerous; his tankiness and Bastion aura spike hard.
- Abuse windows when Taric's cooldowns are down. Rotate to force fights before his ult resets.
- Slow-push to stack waves and deny him easy engage angles with Bastion support.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness to outlast his healing and armor scaling.
- Build Hollow Radiance to reduce healing from his Starlight's Touch and enemy supports.

shen__thresh.notes:
- Threat: Death Sentence hook into The Box trap locks you down; avoid getting caught out of position
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect Death Sentence range and don't overextend past midlane without vision
- Trading: Bait Death Sentence with Shadow Dash positioning, then trade with Q Twilight Assault when he misses
- Post6: Stand United can save hooked allies; use it proactively before Thresh lands Death Sentence on teammates
- Spike: Thresh first item spike (Liandry's or similar) is moderate danger; abuse early lane before he scales
- Window: Punish Thresh hard pre-6 and when Death Sentence is on cooldown; all-in if he wastes hook
- Wave: Slow-push early to deny Thresh hook opportunities and stay near minions for safety and retreat options
- Rune: Grasp for sustain and tankiness trades; helps you survive poke and win short skirmishes with Thresh
- Item: Add Force of Nature into your build if Thresh stacks Ability Power and deals repeated damage

shen__trundle.notes:
- Threat: Subjugate steals your defenses; you become vulnerable and die quickly after.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid extended trades, Trundle wins extended fights easily.
- Trading: Bait Chomp cooldown, then trade with Q; never fight in Frozen Domain.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save you from Subjugate's stat theft; play safer.
- Spike: First item (likely Sunfire or tank item) is dangerous; he spikes hard.
- Window: After Subjugate cooldown ends, you have 4-5 seconds to pressure or escape.
- Wave: Slow-push; deny him Frozen Domain value and prevent easy all-in engagement.
- Rune: Grasp sustains you through his poke and Chomp's damage consistently.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts his damage into healing for you and allies nearby.

shen__tryndamere.notes:
- Tryndamere's sustained auto-attack damage and Undying Rage make him unkillable during fights without help.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait his Spinning Slash, then Shadow Dash in to taunt and disengage immediately after.
- Undying Rage nullifies burst; use Stand United to help teammates escape or secure kills elsewhere.
- His first Crit item spike is dangerous; play safer and look to roam with ult.
- You spike harder at levels 6 and 11; use Stand United to enable winning plays.
- Slow-push waves to deny him all-in opportunities and set up roam timings with ult.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke damage to chip him down over time safely.
- Buy Thornmail early to reduce his healing and punish his constant auto-attack trading pattern.

shen__twistedfate.notes:
- Threat: Destiny reveals you; Gate escape makes him untargetable during Stand United engagement windows
- Early: Safe farm—Twisted Fate outranges you; avoid pushing; respect Pick a Card red card slow
- Trading: Bait Pick a Card, then Shadow Dash in; dodge Wild Cards by moving sideways
- Post6: Stand United becomes risky; Twisted Fate can Gate away or collapse with team immediately
- Spike: First item (Lich Bane or similar) increases burst; play safer, don't overextend mid-lane
- Window: Early levels before Destiny; force trades when his W is on cooldown; mid-game teamfights
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; control spacing away from Twisted Fate; avoid center lane for Destiny reveals
- Rune: Grasp—sustain negates poke damage and rewards short trades with Shadow Dash taunts
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip—shields allies before Stand United lands and converts it into healing

shen__udyr.notes:
- Udyr's sustained attack-speed and healing from Iron Mantle makes him wear you down relentlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Udyr out-trades you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid melee range.
- Bait Blazing Stampede stun, then Shadow Dash away. Never trade into his attack-speed window after abilities.
- Stand United becomes your escape tool; use it proactively before Udyr's recast Blazing Stampede locks you down.
- His first item spike is dangerous. Respect his healing and damage; focus on scaling safely.
- You spike at level 6 and mid-game teamfights where Stand United enables your team's engage.
- Slow-push waves to stack them near your tower; forces Udyr to gank or lose plates.
- Take Grasp for sustain and short-trade value; you need health to outlast his poke.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline early; it counters his healing and gives you the durability you need.

shen__twitch.notes:
- Twitch Spray and Pray at range melts you; his true damage from Deadly Venom shreds your shield.
- Play safe; avoid face-checking bushes where he hides. Farm at distance, respect his Ambush angle.
- Bait his Ambush before engaging. Use Shadow Dash to taunt and close, then Shadow Dash away from Spray and Pray.
- Stand United becomes his kill setup tool; he ganks bot and forces your teleport into death.
- His first item spike (likely Runaan's Hurricane or Serrated Dirk) sharply increases Deadly Venom application; farm safely then.
- Your window: early jungle proximity or when Twitch overextends without Ambush ready. Taunt and commit with your team.
- Slow-push into him; let wave build so you control space and deny his bush access patterns.
- Grasp of the Undying; sustain mitigates his true damage chip and strengthens all-ins when you land Shadow Dash.
- Add Kaenic Lifeline; the anti-healing cuts his Deadly Venom damage and shields against Spray and Pray bursts.

shen__urgot.notes:
- Threat: Disdain catches and hurls you; Fear Beyond Death executes if you fall below threshold health.
- Early: Safely farm at range with Q; avoid walking into Disdain charge range near minions.
- Trading: Bait Disdain by positioning near minions, then E away; never trade into his W range.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save you from Fear Beyond Death execution; play around ult cooldown timers.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Black Cleaver) makes Urgot stronger; respect W damage and poke safety.
- Window: After Urgot uses Disdain or E cooldown, quickly trade and dash away before W channels.
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions; prevents Urgot from all-inning and lets you kite backward safely.
- Rune: Grasp for repeated trades and health scaling against his poke-heavy playstyle over time.
- Item: Force of Nature reduces his W physical damage and provides magic resist against leg blasts.

shen__varus.notes:
- Varus Chain of Corruption immobilizes you; dodge it or Stand United away immediately.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Varus out-ranges you. Farm with Q from distance only.
- Bait his E Hail of Arrows, then all-in with Shadow Dash and Q.
- Stand United becomes critical; use it to escape Chain of Corruption or save allies.
- His first item spike (likely Manamune or Liandry's) is dangerous; respect his poke range.
- Post-6 with Stand United, you outscale him; roam freely knowing you have ult backup.
- Slow-push; force him to farm under tower and rotate to impact other lanes early.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain his poke and scale into late-game teamfights.
- Buy Adaptive Helm early; it reduces his Blight detonation and E Hail of Arrows damage.

shen__vayne.notes:
- Vayne's Silver Bolts true damage on third hit shreds your max health regardless of armor
- Play safe levels 1-3, avoid extended trades; farm from range with Q Twilight Assault
- Bait her Condemn E into empty space, then all-in; never trade into Silver Bolts stacks
- Stand United R becomes crucial for saving teammates from her burst; don't engage her directly
- First item spike around 1100 gold is dangerous; respect her damage and play defensive
- Post-6 you spike when grouping with team; use R Stand United to turn fights
- Slow-push waves to stack minions and force her to choose between farming and harassing
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained tankiness and healing to mitigate true damage
- Add Hollow Radiance for health and magic resist, scaling better against her true damage threat

shen__veigar.notes:
- Veigar stuns you with Event Horizon cage; you cannot Shadow Dash or fight back.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid moving predictably so Veigar cannot land Event Horizon cages.
- Bait Event Horizon by positioning near it, then Shadow Dash away before he triggers stun.
- Stand United lets you escape Veigar ult Primordial Burst; use it proactively when he channels.
- First item spike around Liandry's or Shadowflame; stay mobile and grouped to limit his scaling.
- Mid-game before he stacks AP; engage when Event Horizon cooldown is down or unavailable.
- Slow-push to group faster with team; split-pushing alone feeds Veigar free scaling and picks.
- Grasp sustains poke damage and scales health into tankiness against his burst damage threat.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his magic damage and amplifies healing received from all sources meaningfully.

shen__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's true damage from Organic Deconstruction passive chunks you hard; respect stacking.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Plasma Fission and farm at range with Q.
- Bait Tectonic Disruption knockup, then Shadow Dash in; avoid standing in Void Rift.
- Stand United cannot block Life Form Disintegration Ray true damage; dodge or play around it.
- Vel'Koz first item spike (Liandry's or similar) hurts; punish his immobility with ganks.
- You spike when Vel'Koz wastes cooldowns; all-in with Shadow Dash taunts into Q.
- Slow-push waves toward Vel'Koz; he struggles to stop you and you scale better.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain lets you survive poke and outtrade extended.
- Build Hollow Radiance early; magic resist reduces true damage effectiveness significantly.

shen__vex.notes:
- threat: Vex's Doom 'n Gloom fear interrupts your Shadow Dash engage; play around cooldowns
- early: Farm safely at range with Twilight Assault; avoid pushing into her Personal Space
- trading: Bait her Doom 'n Gloom fear by faking Shadow Dash; trade after it expires
- post6: Stand United becomes riskier if Vex marks your ally with Shadow Surge first
- spike: Vex first item powerspike is dangerous; respect her burst and disengage threats early
- window: Post-level 9, your cooldown reductions let you Shadow Dash more frequently than she fears
- wave: Slow-push toward her tower; forces her to choose between farming and roaming
- rune: Grasp of the Undying gives sustain to offset Vex's poke and burst trades
- item: Hollow Radiance gives MR and haste; strengthens both defenses and cooldown efficiency

shen__viktor.notes:
- Threat: Gravity Field stun locks you; stay mobile and dodge it relentlessly always.
- Early: Safe farm levels one through three; avoid his Siphon Power poke trades.
- Trading: Bait Gravity Field, then Shadow Dash in; land Twilight Assault for damage.
- Post6: Stand United saves allies from Viktor burst; ult when his Arcane Storm drops.
- Spike: First item spike dangerous; respect his damage range and avoid extended trades.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor Shen when Viktor wastes cooldowns; punish with Stand United.
- Wave: Slow-push toward him; deny Viktor safe farming and force positioning mistakes.
- Rune: Grasp sustains through poke; healing reduces Viktor's pressure throughout laning phase.
- Item: Abyssal Mask reduces his magic damage; build after core for survivability spike.

shen__viego.notes:
- Viego's Heartbreaker execution and Spectral Maw stun delete you before Stand United shields trigger.
- Safe farm levels 1–3; Viego weak early. Use Q to poke from range safely.
- Bait Spectral Maw charges, then Shadow Dash past him. Never trade into his Blade passive.
- Stand United becomes liability post-6; Heartbreaker executes shielded targets. Ulting allies makes you vulnerable.
- Viego's first-item spike (Blade of the Ruined King passive scaling) forces Shen to scale defensively.
- Win window: levels 3–5 before Heartbreaker. Abuse Spirit's Refuge to block his early burst combos.
- Slow-push waves to deny Viego wraith resets from minion kills; control side-lane pressure instead.
- Grasp sustains your health pool against his percent-damage On-Hits and gives teamfight trading strength.
- Adaptive Helm reduces his Blade passive damage and stacks value against any team magic damage.

shen__vladimir.notes:
- Threat: Vladimir's Sanguine Pool untargetability negates your engage tools and sustained damage output.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Vladimir out-damages you early; avoid extended trades near minions.
- Trading: Bait his Sanguine Pool before committing Shadow Dash; trade when it's on cooldown only.
- Post6: Stand United becomes risky—Vladimir can Hemoplague you mid-teleport, amplifying incoming damage significantly.
- Spike: First item spike (Protobelt or similar) around 10-12 minutes; respect his burst potential window.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool early; punish with coordinated Shadow Dash taunts.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes to create picks; avoid grouping where Hemoplague catches your entire team.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying sustains you through Vladimir's Transfusion poke and extended trades.
- Item: Kaenic Lifeburst applies grievous wounds when damaged, reducing his healing from Transfusion and Hemoplague.

shen__warwick.notes:
- Warwick's sustained damage and healing make extended fights unwinnable; avoid trading when he's low health.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Warwick outdamages you early. Farm with Q from distance, never commit to trades.
- Bait his E Primal Howl, then trade briefly. Never all-in; he heals too much from Q.
- Post-6, Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5 seconds with no counterplay. Stay grouped or play safer.
- First item spike (Hollow Radiance or similar) strengthens him; abuse farming lead and E Shadow Dash gank pressure instead.
- You spike mid-game when Stand United enables roam plays. Warwick needs close range; abuse your range advantage then.
- Slow-push waves into him. Force him to choose between wave and roaming; E gaps are your advantage.
- Take Grasp for sustained poke and health scaling to survive his all-ins and extended duels better.
- Add Force of Nature if he stacks magic damage; reduces his healing and increases your bulk significantly.

shen__xayah.notes:
- Xayah roots you with Bladecaller after she lands her feathers on you repeatedly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid her Double Daggers poke, farm at range with Q.
- Bait her Bladecaller by positioning near feathers, then Shadow Dash away before she recalls.
- Stand United saves rooted allies but doesn't stop her burst; be cautious ulting in.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and Bladecaller range significantly.
- You gain advantage when her Bladecaller is down; aggressively trade and all-in then.
- Slow-push waves to deny her space and force her to overextend for feathers.
- Take Grasp for consistent sustain against her poke and frequent trading opportunities.
- Add Kaenic Lifebane second or third to reduce her healing if she builds Kraken.

shen__wukong.notes:
- Wukong's Cyclone knockup chains with Crushing Blow armor shred; you die fast if caught.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Crushing Blow and avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait Warrior Trickster with Shadow Dash threat, then trade when clone expires and cooldown high.
- Stand United becomes crucial defensive tool; use it proactively before Wukong engages with Cyclone.
- First item spike (likely Black Cleaver) is dangerous; play safer and respect his duel power.
- Your window: when Wukong wastes Warrior Trickster or Nimbus Strike; immediately Shadow Dash + Twilight Assault.
- Slow-push waves into tower; this limits Wukong's all-in angles and lets you scale safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain and tankiness let you survive his burst trades.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline early; the armor shred reduction directly counters his Crushing Blow percentage damage.

shen__xerath.notes:
- Threat: Xerath's long-range poke and stun lock you down before you close distance safely
- Early: Play safe and farm; dodge Arcanopulse by positioning behind minions, avoid center of Eye of Destruction
- Trading: Bait Shocking Orb by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash through him when it's down
- Post6: Stand United becomes your escape; use it proactively when Xerath ults to save allies
- Spike: First item spike hurts; respect his damage range and play around minion wave positioning
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where terrain lets you close gaps; coordinate Stand United with team engage
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions and force Xerath closer; limits his safe poking distance gradually
- Rune: Grasp sustains you through poke and strengthens your all-in trades when you finally connect
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip adds survivability against his magic damage and helps you stick to him

shen__xinzhao.notes:
- Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge and Crescent Guard reset enable all-in trades you cannot match in raw damage output.
- Play safe; Xin trades poorly into your Q Twilight Assault poke. Space well and avoid feeding early kills.
- Bait his Audacious Charge before committing. Use Shadow Dash to escape or taunt when he commits to fight.
- Stand United lets you bail allies, but Xin's sustained damage and resets outscale you in extended teamfights hard.
- His first spike (Trinity Force or similar) is dangerous; he gains raw damage and chase. Play defensively then.
- Post-10 minutes, if Xin used Audacious Charge poorly, you have a window to kite with Q and poke safely.
- Slow-push to set up ganks. Never hard-push; Xin can dive you with Audacious Charge and turn fights easily.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness in the long trade pattern; it helps you survive his repeated engages.
- Buy Kaenic Lifeline early if behind or taking poke; the magic resist and healing amplification help versus his pressure.

shen__yasuo.notes:
- Yasuo's mobility and Wind Wall block your Q and R engagement tools; respect his outplay potential
- Play safe and farm; Yasuo's early damage is high—avoid all-ins and poke with Q when safe
- Bait Wind Wall with Q before committing E; dodge his whirlwind knock-up or Shadow Dash away immediately
- Stand United can save allies from Last Breath, but Yasuo gains invulnerability during his dash to them
- First item spike (likely Infinity Edge or Phantom Dancer) is dangerous; farm safely and scale instead
- Mid-game teamfights favor Shen when Yasuo lacks immediate targets; use W to block his dashes for allies
- Slow-push into him; denies his roam potential and lets you build wave for E engagements safely
- Grasp of the Undying; sustain wins extended trades and mitigates poke before he gets items
- Kaenic Lifegrip; gives you AP scaling, defensive utility, and grievous wounds if Yasuo builds lifesteal

shen__yone.notes:
- Yone's Fate Sealed blink engages you instantly; avoid clustered positioning near walls.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Yone outranges you early, farm under tower when pressured.
- Bait Mortal Steel's dash stack, then Shadow Dash taunt him during recovery frames.
- Stand United now shields him too if he engages; use it defensively only.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes weakens you; respect his damage, don't overextend.
- Post-first-item when Yone backs, push wave hard and roam; he needs time scaling.
- Slow-push side lanes; prevents Yone from roaming freely and lets you rotate quickly.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke to match Yone's constant Way of Hunter damage.
- Build Hollow Radiance early; reduces Yone's magic damage and supports your tankiness core.

shen__yunara.notes:
- Yunara's Q attack speed and on-hit spreading deals sustained damage you cannot block with W.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q damage scales fast. Farm with Q, avoid extended trades.
- Bait her E movement, then E Shadow Dash to taunt and trade back decisively.
- Stand United becomes critical; use it defensively when she enters Transcendent State and upgrades abilities.
- Her first item spike (likely attack speed) accelerates Q spreading damage; play around cooldowns carefully.
- You spike when she wastes E mobility; all-in with E Shadow Dash plus Q follow-up.
- Slow-push to deny her roam patterns and force her to commit resources into you.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling against her poke.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip to amplify shields and reduce her on-hit spreading damage effectiveness significantly.

shen__yuumi.notes:
- threat: Yuumi attaches to allies, making her untargetable while healing and buffing them relentlessly
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Yuumi deals minimal damage alone, but don't overextend for poke
- trading: Bait Yuumi's Q Prowling Projectile, then trade while she's on cooldown and exposed
- post6: Stand United becomes reactive tool; use it defensively when Yuumi's ally engages on you
- spike: First item spike (around 1000g) is minor; punish by trading hard before she attaches
- window: Levels 4-5 before Yuumi unlocks Final Chapter; pressure and secure advantages then
- wave: Slow-push into enemy tower; forces Yuumi's attached ally to stay, reducing their team's roaming
- rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustained trading into tanky matchup scales your health advantage
- item: Add Kaenic Lifeburst into heavy healing comps; the utility passive counters Yuumi's constant shields

shen__zac.notes:
- Zac's Elastic Slingshot gap close plus Unstable Matter chunks burst you down quickly.
- Play safe; farm at range with Q. Avoid extended trades; dodge his grab.
- Bait Q Stretching Strikes, then Shadow Dash away. Never let him land W close.
- Stand United now covers his engage; use it defensively on teammates he dives.
- First item (likely tank item) strengthens Zac; punish him before he completes it.
- Mid-game when Shen has two items; Zac falls off relative to your tankiness spike.
- Slow-push to deny his Elastic Slingshot all-in; maintain distance and wave control.
- Grasp of the Undying procs repeatedly in short trades; sustain keeps you healthy.
- Kaenic Lifegrip converts his magic damage into healing; rush after core tank items.

shen__zed.notes:
- Zed's Death Mark amplifies all damage dealt; you cannot escape or block the delayed burst.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q and avoid W engage attempts.
- Bait his Shadow Dash cooldown, then trade back; never chase him into his shadows.
- Stand United cannot cleanse Death Mark; use it preemptively on teammates or to disengage.
- Zed's first item spike is dangerous; farm safely and look to roam before he completes it.
- Your power window is mid-game when teammates group; Zed struggles against coordinated team fights.
- Slow-push waves to maintain safety; fast pushes leave you vulnerable to Death Mark all-ins.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and trading power against his poke damage.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early to reduce his burst damage and protect nearby allies effectively.

shen__zaahen.notes:
- Zaahen's sustained damage and healing from Q and R drain you; his W pull locks you down.
- Play safe at range; let Zaahen push. Dodge W at all costs—pulled in = dead.
- Bait his W with Shadow Dash prediction, then Twilight Assault away. Never trade raw autos.
- Stand United becomes critical; use it proactively before Zaahen all-ins, not reactively after he commits.
- His first item spike (likely Gouge or Kaenic) hurts hard; respect his damage window around minute 10-12.
- You spike when Zaahen is low on Determination stacks and before his ultimate. Punish early.
- Slow-push sideways lanes to farm safely and roam; hard-pushing invites his W gank and burst.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains your poke trades and scales into mid-game tankiness versus his damage.
- Rush Force of Nature if he snowballs; the Magic Resist and move speed counter his chase.

shen__zeri.notes:
- Zeri's Spark Surge dash and Lightning Crash mobility let her chase and burst you down relentlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Zeri out-damages you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid extended trades.
- Bait Spark Surge, then Shadow Dash to taunt her mid-dash. Use W Spirit's Refuge defensively when needed.
- Stand United becomes crucial; shield teammates Zeri targets. Your ult turns fights by negating her burst.
- First item spike (Kraken Slayer or similar) is danger. Respect her damage; don't fight extended 1v1s.
- Your window is mid-game when cooldowns matter. Coordinate ult with team fights; Zeri weakens without resets.
- Slow-push waves into tower. This limits Zeri's all-in windows and denies her roam opportunities safely.
- Take Grasp for tankiness and sustain; you need health to survive Zeri's extended all-in damage.
- Thornmail punishes her Attack-reliant playstyle and reduces her healing if she builds lifesteal later.

shen__zilean.notes:
- threat: Chronoshift negates your Stand United engage; Time Warp kites you endlessly in teamfights.
- early: Safe farm only. Zilean out-ranges you heavily; avoid trading until you land Shadow Dash.
- trading: Bait his Time Warp, then Shadow Dash through for guaranteed taunt and Twilight Assault follow.
- post6: His Chronoshift blocks your Stand United kills; coordinate with jungler to burst before revive procs.
- spike: First item spike is minor for him; punish by forcing fights before he stacks survivability.
- window: Your advantage comes mid-game when cooldowns align; abuse gaps between his Time Warp casts relentlessly.
- wave: Slow-push to stack minions; forces him into your optimal range, prevents his kite-heavy roam potential.
- rune: Grasp sustains against poke while scaling tankier; Time Warp cannot prevent your healing from trading.
- item: Abyssal Mask reduces his bomb damage and Time Warp effectiveness significantly through magic resist density.

shen__zyra.notes:
- Threat: Grasping Roots root locks you; plants zone you away from enemies safely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect Grasping Roots range and dodge seeds spawning.
- Trading: Bait Grasping Roots, then Shadow Dash through her; avoid walking into vines.
- Post6: Stand United saves rooted allies, but you cannot escape Stranglethorns knockup yourself.
- Spike: First item spike minimal danger; Zyra scales better—punish her weak early game.
- Window: Levels 1-5 before plants stack; all-in with Shadow Dash when cooldowns down.
- Wave: Slow-push into her; deny seeds safe planting spots near your minions.
- Rune: Grasp sustains through poke and root; every trade heals you back.
- Item: Abyssal Mask reduces her magic damage and roots feel less oppressive overall.

sivir__aatrox.notes:
- threat: Aatrox's Q three-hit combo and W chains deal massive damage; dodge or die
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; his Q cooldown is long, abuse that window
- trading: Bait his Q swings with movement, trade back with Q boomerang safely
- post6: World Ender makes him unkillable; use E Spell Shield to block fear fear
- spike: First item spike is moderate; you outrange him, maintain distance and kite
- window: Mid-game teamfights where On The Hunt lets you kite and poke freely
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; forces Aatrox to chase you or lose CS pressure
- rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite his all-in attempts and escape chains
- item: Kaenic Lifesteal reduces his healing and keeps you safer in extended fights

shen__zoe.notes:
- threat: Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble chunks you and enables her burst combo; dodge it
- early: Safe farm. Stay behind minions. E Shadow Dash away if she lands Paddle Star!
- trading: Bait her E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, then all-in with Q Twilight Assault and E Shadow Dash
- post6: Stand United R lets you shield allies she targets; use it proactively before her burst lands
- spike: First item is danger window. Stay max range farming; don't let her land free Paddle Star!
- window: Post-6 when Stand United cooldown resets fast via W Spirit's Refuge blocking. Punish her mana dumps
- wave: Slow-push into her tower. Forces her to check wave; limits her roam and poke angles
- rune: Grasp of the Undying. Sustain her poke and win extended trades with consistent damage
- item: Hollow Radiance. Reduces her magic damage and gives you tankiness against her burst pattern

sivir__ahri.notes:
- threat: Charm stuns you before you can react; dodge it or use Spell Shield defensively
- early: Safe farm; respect Charm range, stay behind minions, abuse Q poke when she overextends
- trading: Bait her E Charm with positioning, then trade back with Q Boomerang Blade safely
- post6: Spirit Rush lets Ahri engage repeatedly; respect her all-in potential, save E Spell Shield for Charm
- spike: First item spike is moderate danger; focus on farming safely and punishing her mistakes
- window: Post-level 6 when your R On The Hunt engages teamfights; leverage the speed advantage
- wave: Slow-push to deny her roam opportunities; maintain distance from her while farming safely
- rune: Stormraider's Surge to kite away from her; the speed helps you escape Charm range
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip provides tankiness and MR; helps you survive her burst and duel her better

sivir__alistar.notes:
- threat: Alistar's Q Pulverize and W Headbutt combo locks you down; position carefully to avoid stuns.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; stay behind minions and respect his all-in range with Q-W.
- trading: Bait his Q or W before trading; use E Spell Shield to block either knockup.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite away from Alistar ult duration; abuse the movespeed advantage.
- spike: His first item isn't a major spike; punish him early before he reaches levelups.
- window: Mid-game when you have crit; kite and use R to escape his engages cleanly.
- wave: Slow-push into him; forces him to overextend for kills while you maintain safe positioning.
- rune: Grasp gives you sustain to offset his poke and healing from Triumphant Roar procs.
- item: Kaenic Lifeline blocks his burst damage and grants you defensive stats against his magic damage.

sivir__ambessa.notes:
- Ambessa's Public Execution suppresses you with no counterplay; respect ultimate range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Cunning Sweep out-trades your poke, farm safely.
- Bait Repudiation with Boomerang Blade, then all-in; dodge Lacerate slows with Fleet of Foot.
- Post-6, avoid centerline positioning; Ambessa can suppress from extreme range with Public Execution.
- First-item spike around 800-1200 gold is dangerous; respect her damage and positioning threat.
- Sivir spikes harder at two items; abuse this window before Ambessa scales into teamfights.
- Slow-push to deny her gank setup; maintain positioning near river ward coverage always.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against her all-in trading patterns.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip into your build for suppress cleanse and healing amplification.

sivir__anivia.notes:
- threat: Anivia's Q stun chains into E double damage; dodge or shield the stun
- early: Safe farm at range; respect her Q range and back off when it's up
- trading: Bait her Q with movement, trade back with W bounces; shield her E if needed
- post6: Glacial Storm zoning becomes severe; use R speed to kite around it or disengage
- spike: First item makes her R oppressive; farm safely and avoid extended fights in storm
- window: Early levels before R; push wave and harass with Q before she scales
- wave: Slow-push to deny her Q setup angle; rotate away if she positions aggressively
- rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite her R and disengage from Crystallize traps
- item: Abyssal Mask reduces her burst and storm damage while giving tankier stats early

sivir__aphelios.notes:
- threat: Aphelios' Calibrum marks let him kite and burst you; avoid extended fights.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; his range and weapon flexibility punish close trades.
- trading: Bait his Calibrum shots with E Spell Shield, then all-in when he swaps.
- post6: Moonlight Vigil into kite is lethal; use R On The Hunt to chase or escape.
- spike: First item spike hurts; stay grouped and use E to block marked follow-ups.
- window: When Aphelios runs out of ammo and swaps weapons, trade or disengage immediately.
- wave: Slow-push to deny him safety; force him to fight or lose CS.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you stick and kite around his Calibrum poke range.
- item: Add Kaenic Lifegrip for sustain against poke and defensive utility in skirmishes.

sivir__azir.notes:
- Azir kites and pokes you down with Sand Soldiers before all-inning with Emperor's Divide knockback.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Conquering Sands and farm from distance, do not chase soldiers.
- Bait Shifting Sands with positioning, then trade when he dashes; use Spell Shield reactively on Conquering Sands.
- On The Hunt lets you engage, but Emperor's Divide creates distance—use ult to chase or disengage.
- Azir's first item spike is dangerous; respect his soldier damage and poke, farm safely nearby turrets.
- Sivir dominates mid-game teamfights when Azir lacks mobility tools; group and use On The Hunt advantage.
- Slow-push to prevent Azir setting up soldiers near your tower; maintain pressure and trading safety.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for movement speed to kite soldiers and chase after Emperor's Divide knockback.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip for sustained healing against poke while teamfighting near Azir's soldier formations.

sivir__bard.notes:
- Threat: Cosmic Binding stun locks you; Tempered Fate ult denies your kiting and escape tools completely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect Cosmic Binding range and don't clump with minions near walls.
- Trading: Bait Cosmic Binding with Fleet of Foot movement, then trade back; dodge with E proactively.
- Post6: Tempered Fate completely shuts down your On The Hunt kiting; play around its cooldown strictly.
- Spike: First item spike around 10-12 minutes threatens you less; Bard lacks immediate power window.
- Window: Post-first-item, you outrange and outdamage Bard in extended fights when his cooldowns are down.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes to create distance; avoids Cosmic Binding setup and protects against ganks.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge for kiting potential and escaping Bard setup; mobility counters his control tools.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius adds magic resist against Meep damage and provides survivability against burst.

sivir__blitzcrank.notes:
- Threat: Rocket Grab one-shots or hard-locks you; position behind minions always
- Early: Extremely dangerous; stay far back, dodge Q predictably, never walk up
- Trading: Bait Rocket Grab with fake positioning, then all-in with Boomerang Blade
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite away when grabbed; play safer pre-six
- Spike: His first item spike is minimal; you outscale hard with attack speed
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you position safely and use Spell Shield reactively
- Wave: Slow-push sidewaves to maintain distance and safety; avoid river bushes entirely
- Rune: Fleet of Foot synergizes perfectly; extra movement speed beats his all-in range
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks burst and shields you from lightning damage chain

sivir__belveth.notes:
- Bel'Veth gaps you with Q Void Surge, then W Above and Below roots, preventing escape
- Play safe; her early damage is low but her mobility threatens all-ins; farm with Q range
- Bait W Above and Below with movement, then E Spell Shield it; never trade close
- On The Hunt lets you kite her better, but her R Endless Banquet range extension terrifies
- Her first Guinsoo's Rageblade spike hurts hard; respect it and play safer during this window
- After her ult expires, punish with R On The Hunt for cooldown resets and repositioning
- Slow-push waves to stack them; this lets you safety-farm further away from her engagement range
- Take Fleet of Foot for healing; sustain her poke and reposition safely throughout the game
- Add Adaptive Helm after core items; its resistances and healing reduction heavily counter her sustained damage

sivir__brand.notes:
- Brand's Pyroclasm bounces chain-stun you; dodge it or E it preemptively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Brand out-ranges you, avoid his Q-Sear poke.
- Bait his Q with movement, then all-in; dodge Pillar of Flame timing.
- Post-6, respect Pyroclasm engage range; position away from teammates to avoid chain bounces.
- Brand's first item spike around 1100g is dangerous; farm safely and scale.
- You spike harder mid-game when cooldowns matter; abuse R's cooldown reduction on hits.
- Slow-push waves to avoid Pyroclasm setup; prevent him stacking Blaze on your team.
- Take Grasp for sustain against poke and to win short extended trades.
- Build Adaptive Helm second or third to reduce his sustained magic damage output.

sivir__braum.notes:
- Threat: Braum stuns you with Concussive Blows after four stacks; you cannot kite effectively.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid his Q poke and don't let him stack you freely.
- Trading: Bait his E Unbreakable with Q Boomerang Blade, then trade hard when shield expires.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite his Glacial Fissure better; use speed to escape.
- Spike: Braum's first armor item is dangerous; your damage drops significantly against his tankiness early.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you have R active and can reposition; abuse your mobility advantage.
- Wave: Push the wave when Braum roams; deny him pressure and scale your lead safely.
- Rune: Grasp for sustain and trading; lets you outsustain his poke in extended laning phase.
- Item: Manamune or Trinity Force for extra damage to overcome his stacking armor items early.

sivir__briar.notes:
- Briar's Blood Frenzy makes her unstoppable once engaged; kite backwards and use Spell Shield.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in potential and farm from distance with Boomerang Blade.
- Bait Head Rush with positioning, then Spell Shield the stun and trade back hard.
- Certain Death forces you to respect her engage range; position near teammates for safety.
- First item spike is dangerous; avoid extended fights and rely on Spell Shield reactively.
- Mid-game teamfights favor Sivir when Briar lacks Blood Frenzy targets; group and kite.
- Slow-push to maintain distance and safety; never hard-push into Briar's all-in threat range.
- Grasp sustains poke trades and helps survive her early pressure; necessary for survival.
- Quicksilver Sash removes Blood Frenzy debuff and Fear from Certain Death; consider early.

sivir__caitlyn.notes:
- Caitlyn's Piltover Peacemaker and Ace in the Hole range forces you to stay far back or risk burst.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her range advantage and farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance.
- Bait her Piltover Peacemaker cast, then all-in with W Ricochet and autos; dodge with E Spell Shield.
- Post-6, respect Ace in the Hole range; use R On The Hunt to engage or disengage safely.
- First item spike (Kraken Slayer or similar) is dangerous; respect her damage and play passively until matched.
- Sivir spikes when you complete R On The Hunt cooldown reduction; group and use speed advantage.
- Slow-push to stack minions; force her to CS in an unsafe wave when you group mid-game.
- Grasp for sustained trading; proc it safely with Q then retreat before she repositions with E.
- Kaenic Lifeline adds tankiness and shields against her burst, giving you breathing room to scale.

sivir__cassiopeia.notes:
- Miasma grounds you, stopping all movement abilities and burst mobility—stay outside poison clouds always
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q and respect her Q poke damage
- Bait her W with positioning, then trade back hard; use E to block her R engage
- Petrifying Gaze stuns you if facing her—position sideways or behind teammates to reduce stun threat
- Her first item spike around 800-1200 gold isn't dangerous; punish her immobility window before completion
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where On The Hunt speed outraces her kite potential
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces her to choose between farming and roaming to punish you
- Take Stormraider's Surge for movement speed to kite and escape her poison zones safely
- Add Mercurial Scimitar late to cleanse poison stacks and her slow effects when necessary

sivir__camille.notes:
- Camille's E Hookshot into R Hextech Ultimatum locks you down for all-in burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade, avoid close trades.
- Bait her E Hookshot with positioning, then punish her cooldown; dodge W Tactical Sweep.
- Sivir gains massive advantage post-6; R On The Hunt lets you kite and escape.
- First item spike (~10 min) is dangerous; respect her all-in potential, play back carefully.
- Your power window opens after 6 and extends through mid-game; use R to engage safely.
- Slow-push waves to safety; deny her wall engagement angles and create gank opportunities for allies.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for mobility to kite after she uses E; escape her ult range.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip for tankiness and heal reduction on her W; negates her sustain leverage.

sivir__corki.notes:
- Corki's Missile Barrage and Gatling Gun output burst damage you cannot fully block with Spell Shield
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Phosphorus Bomb and avoid extended trades near minion waves
- Bait Phosphorus Bomb with positioning, then all-in short windows; dodge with Fleet of Foot movement
- On The Hunt lets you kite Corki's Valkyrie engages and dodge Missile Barrage more effectively
- Corki's first-item spike forces you back; respect the damage window and farm safely
- Post-teamfight or when Corki wastes Valkyrie cooldown, push sidelane with On The Hunt active
- Slow-push to stack minions and force Corki to answer; prevents gank setup and poke abuse
- Take Grasp for sustain against Corki's constant poke and to win longer trade patterns
- Build Kaenic Lifeline to survive Gatling Gun armor shred and Missile Barrage burst combos

sivir__darius.notes:
- threat: Darius pulls you in with Apprehend, then stacks Hemorrhage fast—you die to Noxian Guillotine.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid his Q blade and don't let him stack bleeds on you.
- trading: Use Spell Shield to block Apprehend or W Crippling Strike; trade back with Boomerang Blade safely.
- post6: Noxian Guillotine true damage executes you—respect his ult range and never fight at low health.
- spike: His first armor item hurts; abuse your range advantage before he completes it early.
- window: You outrange him significantly; kite backward with On The Hunt and poke with Boomerang Blade.
- wave: Slow-push waves to keep distance; avoid pushing into him where he controls all-in territory easily.
- rune: Fleet of Foot synergizes naturally; your passive plus rune MS lets you kite his gap-close.
- item: Manamune gives you mana sustain and poke damage to stay safe while farming from distance.

sivir__ekko.notes:
- Ekko's Phase Dive gaps you instantly and locks burst damage with Z-Drive Resonance procs.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Q range outmatches yours, so respect it heavily.
- Bait Phase Dive with positioning, then Spell Shield his follow-up burst damage immediately.
- On The Hunt lets you kite and escape Phase Dive; use it defensively first.
- First item spike (likely AP bruiser item) is dangerous; respect his all-in threat window.
- You spike when Ekko wastes Phase Dive cooldown; punish with Boomerang Blade and autos.
- Slow-push to deny Phase Dive engagement range; force him to use abilities on minions.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; it lets you kite Phase Dive and escape his burst.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius early; it blocks his magic burst and gives you survivability.

sivir__draven.notes:
- threat: Draven's axes deal massive damage; catch them and he kills you with raw AD
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his E Stand Aside, farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade
- trading: Never trade when he has axes ready; bait E Stand Aside then reposition immediately
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite, but Whirling Death returns—position sideways to dodge reverting axes
- spike: First item (likely Youmuu's Ghostblade or Black Cleaver) is dangerous; respect his damage and space
- window: When Draven drops axes or wastes E Stand Aside, punish with W Ricochet bounces freely
- wave: Slow-push; deny him kills by keeping minions away from his axe catch positions
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; extra mobility helps you kite his axes and disengage from Stand Aside
- item: Add Maw of Malmortius for survivability against his sustained physical damage and burst potential

sivir__elise.notes:
- Elise Cocoon stun locks you and enables her all-in burst damage; respect it always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid pushing up since Cocoon range catches overextended ADCs easily.
- Bait Cocoon with Spell Shield, then trade back hard with Boomerang Blade and autos.
- Post-6 Elise gains mobility and dive potential; respect Spider Form rappel engage windows carefully.
- First item spike around Liandry or similar makes her sustained damage dangerous; play safer.
- Your window opens when Elise wastes Cocoon; punish immediately with full combo before cooldown resets.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance from her engage range and control gank timing windows.
- Grasp provides sustain to offset her poke and helps you survive all-in attempts consistently.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline early; its active cleanses her burst and provides survivability against magic.

sivir__evelynn.notes:
- threat: Evelynn's W Allure charm locks you down; her R Last Caress one-shots from fog
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Evelynn weak pre-6 so abuse range advantage with Q Boomerang Blade
- trading: Bait her W Allure with E Spell Shield, then trade back with Q safely
- post6: Evelynn gains map pressure and burst; play safer, ward river, position near teammates always
- spike: First item spike dangerous; Evelynn gains kill pressure so respect her all-in potential immediately
- window: You outscale mid-game with R On The Hunt; use it to group and teamfight advantage
- wave: Slow-push sidewaves to deny her roam targets; maintain position near teammates for safety coverage
- rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain against her poke and tankiness in extended fights
- item: Kaenic Rookern provides magic resist and healing reduction against her burst and W charm setup

sivir__ezreal.notes:
- Ezreal's long-range Mystic Shot and Trueshot Barrage whittle you down safely from distance.
- Play safe behind minions; Mystic Shot cooldown reduction lets him spam. Avoid overextending.
- Bait his Mystic Shot with positioning, then trade back with Boomerang Blade immediately.
- Ezreal gains massive teamfight presence; use On The Hunt to engage or disengage decisively.
- First item spike around 1200 gold is moderate; abuse your early Spell Shield value.
- Levels 2-3 and post-first-back when his mana runs low; punish with sustained aggression.
- Slow-push to deny his Mystic Shot safety; force him into your range or miss.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; extra mobility helps dodge Mystic Shot chains and kite his trades.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip early; blocks his burst and converts damage into sustained healing pressure.

sivir__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Threat: Fiddlesticks' Terrify fear locks you down; Crowstorm catches immobile Sivir in teamfights easily.
- Early: Safe farm at distance; Fiddlesticks weak levels 1-3, avoid getting ulted near walls or jungle.
- Trading: Bait Reap with positioning, then trade back; dodge Terrify activation with E Spell Shield preemptively.
- Post6: Crowstorm forces you into On The Hunt engages; position near walls to limit fear distance.
- Spike: First item power spike minimal for Fiddlesticks; your spike matters more—abuse his cooldowns early teamfights.
- Window: After Crowstorm cooldown expires, you control 100+ seconds; group with allies and pressure objectives then.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny Fiddlesticks roam angles; maintain space for E Spell Shield against ganks.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite fear and Crowstorm damage with sustained movement speed bursts.
- Item: Quicksilver Sash cleanses fear and Reap slow; delays Fiddlesticks' engage windows significantly for teamfights.

sivir__galio.notes:
- Galio's W Shield of Durand taunts you, forcing terrible positioning and guaranteed damage trades.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his Q Winds of War damage and avoid close range.
- Bait his W Shield of Durand by backing off, then trade with Q Boomerang Blade safely.
- Hero's Entrance turns fights; position away from allies so Galio can't land optimal ult coverage.
- Galio's first item spike is dangerous; play safer and use range advantage with Q poke.
- You spike when Galio wastes W Shield of Durand; immediately all-in with E Spell Shield ready.
- Slow-push waves toward river; this prevents Galio from ulting deep while keeping you safe.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for the movement speed to kite away from his taunt range.
- Add Adaptive Force into your build; it helps poke Galio down before he gets tanky.

sivir__gangplank.notes:
- Gangplank's Cannon Barrage zones you and his Powder Keg combo deals massive area damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his melee range and avoid clustered minions near kegs.
- Bait his Remove Scurvy with Boomerang Blade, then trade when it's down; dodge Cannon Barrage.
- Post-6, Cannon Barrage limits your teamfight presence; use On The Hunt to reposition and escape.
- First item spike is dangerous; play safer and use Spell Shield to block key abilities.
- Sivir spikes when Gangplank lacks cooldown reduction; punish with consistent Boomerang Blade poke then all-in.
- Slow-push waves to deny his Powder Keg setup space and force him to overextend.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against his poke and scaling into teamfights.
- Add Adaptive Helm to reduce his repeated Cannon Barrage and Powder Keg explosion damage output.

sivir__gragas.notes:
- threat: Gragas E stun into W combo deletes you; respect its range constantly
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm from distance with Q, avoid pushing forward
- trading: Bait his E with positioning; use E Spell Shield to block W damage
- post6: Gragas R becomes a threat; use your R to kite and escape teamfights
- spike: His first Liandry's or Demonic is dangerous; don't fight in close quarters
- window: Post-6 with R active, kite backward while allies follow; abuse range advantage
- wave: Slow-push to maintain distance; prevents Gragas from engaging with minions blocking his path
- rune: Stormraider's Surge for guaranteed escape velocity when Gragas commits to all-in
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip adds survivability against his magic damage-heavy burst rotation

sivir__gnar.notes:
- threat: Mega Gnar's Wallop stun into GNAR! ultimate leaves you immobilized and dead
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Gnar's short range means you outrange with Q Boomerang Blade
- trading: Bait his E Hop engagement, then W Ricochet trade back while he's vulnerable
- post6: GNAR! ultimate range is massive; respect it and position near walls carefully always
- spike: First item spike isn't dangerous; punish him before he completes first major item
- window: Mid-game teamfights favor you; kite with R On The Hunt and E Spell Shield
- wave: Slow-push to deny him engage angles; reset often to maintain safety distance
- rune: Fleet of Foot synergy; go Lethal Tempo for extended kite trading in skirmishes
- item: Kaenic Lifeline provides survivability and shields against his burst damage spike

sivir__hecarim.notes:
- Threat: Hecarim's E Devastating Charge closes gap, knocks you back, and deals massive damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance, avoid close trades.
- Trading: Bait his E Devastating Charge, then use E Spell Shield to block knockback damage.
- Post6: Onslaught of Shadows gap-closes faster; position near allies for R On The Hunt speed.
- Spike: First item spike dangerous; stay grouped and kite backward when he engages hard.
- Window: After his E is down, push wave aggressively with W Ricochet bounces for damage.
- Wave: Slow-push to safety; denies his engage angles and lets allies rotate to help.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge for kiting and escaping his E Devastating Charge engages cleanly.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his magic damage from W Spirit of Dread and R.

sivir__heimerdinger.notes:
- His turrets zone you hard; E Spell Shield blocks grenade stun but not turret damage pressure.
- Play safe near minions; his W Hextech Micro-Rockets converge at range, avoid predictable positioning.
- Bait his E Electron Storm Grenade with E Spell Shield, then trade with Q Boomerang Blade.
- R On The Hunt lets you kite his turrets and dodge E; massive advantage spike.
- First item spike (usually Liandry's or similar) strengthens turrets; respect zone and farm safer distance.
- Post-15 minutes when R On The Hunt cooldown allows repeated rotations; use mobility to punish.
- Slow-push into him; forces turret usage and lets you roam with R On The Hunt.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; extra mobility helps escape turret zones and chase after R boost.
- Add Mercury's Treads early; reduces E Electron Storm Grenade stun duration and protects against ganks.

sivir__irelia.notes:
- Irelia's Bladesurge and Flawless Duet combo locks you down; kite backward constantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from distance with Boomerang Blade, avoid all-ins.
- Bait her Flawless Duet with positioning, then trade back with Ricochet bounces.
- On The Hunt lets you kite her better; use movement speed to escape.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and maintain maximum distance always.
- You spike when she overextends; punish with Boomerang Blade and kite with Fleet of Foot.
- Slow-push waves to control spacing; prevent her from diving you under tower safely.
- Grasp sustains through her poke and trading damage; outscales her per-hit pressure.
- Kaenic Lifeline blocks her burst and gives you survivability against her all-in threat.

sivir__hwei.notes:
- threat: Hwei's crowd control abilities chain together and lock you down for burst damage
- early: Play safe and farm at range; dodge his Subject abilities by moving unpredictably
- trading: Bait out his crowd control with Spell Shield, then trade back with Boomerang Blade
- post6: On The Hunt lets you chase or escape; use it when Hwei commits his abilities
- spike: First item spike forces you back; respect his damage and play for late teamfights
- window: Mid-game teamfights where Ricochet bounces and On The Hunt's cooldown reduction shine brightest
- wave: Slow-push to safety; prevents Hwei from roaming and lets you scale into late game
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; gives you escape mobility when Hwei lands crowd control on you
- item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his ability damage and gives you survivability against his burst

sivir__ivern.notes:
- threat: Rootcaller roots you in place; follow with Daisy burst kills immobilized targets
- early: Safe farm. Ivern weak early; avoid brush near his Brushmaker patches always
- trading: Bait Rootcaller with movement, dodge with Fleet of Foot, then all-in trades
- post6: Daisy provides sustained damage and peel; On The Hunt lets you kite better
- spike: First item around 10 minutes; not dangerous if you respect Rootcaller range limits
- window: Levels 1-5 before Daisy; spam Q to pressure him before his power spikes
- wave: Slow-push sideways away from brush; deny Ivern grouping angles and Brushmaker value
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; need mobility to escape Rootcaller root after it lands on you
- item: Kaenic Rookern blocks Brushmaker magic damage and Triggerseed shield explosion damage completely

sivir__janna.notes:
- threat: Janna's E Eye Of The Storm shields allies and buffs their damage; dodge Q Howling Gale
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Janna outranges you. Use Q Boomerang Blade to harass from distance safely
- trading: Bait E Spell Shield with Q, then all-in with W Ricochet. Never trade into her shield
- post6: On The Hunt lets you chase; R Monsoon knocks you back and heals her team. Respect spacing
- spike: First item spike around 10-12 minutes; dodge Howling Gale more carefully as her poke gets deadlier
- window: Mid-game teamfights favor you; your On The Hunt outpaces her Tailwind bonus and resets cooldowns
- wave: Slow-push side lanes; prevents Janna from roaming freely and forces her into uncomfortable defensive positions
- rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite her Monsoon knockback and chase after On The Hunt engage
- item: Maw of Malmortius adds magic resist and shield against her poke damage and Monsoon healing reduction

sivir__jarvaniv.notes:
- Jarvan IV's Cataclysm traps you in arena; use Spell Shield to block or kite hard afterward.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Jarvan needs E-Q combo to threaten. Farm at range, avoid close fights.
- Bait his Q Dragon Strike with repositioning, then trade back with Boomerang Blade as he commits.
- Post-6 Cataclysm is lethal if you're caught; position near edges and keep Spell Shield ready always.
- First item spike (Plated Steelcaps or Hollow Radiance) is moderately dangerous; respect his burst, don't overextend.
- You spike when Jarvan burns Cataclysm on allies; punish with Boomerang Blade and On The Hunt chase.
- Slow-push waves to control space; prevents Jarvan from using terrain effectively and keeps you safer overall.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains into his poke and helps you survive early skirmishes.
- Add Hollow Radiance second or third to tank Martial Cadence hits and reduce his burst damage.

sivir__jax.notes:
- Jax's Counter Strike stun locks you down; his Grandmaster-at-Arms burst deletes your health bar.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Boomerang Blade from distance, avoid all-in trades near him.
- Bait Counter Strike with Ricochet attacks, then unload with Boomerang Blade while he's on cooldown.
- On The Hunt lets you kite and escape; Jax becomes harder to pin down post-six.
- First Triforce spike hurts; respect his damage window and maintain maximum distance during this period.
- Mid-game teamfights where On The Hunt is active; stick with allies and burst him with Q.
- Slow-push sideways; avoid letting Jax all-in you in river; keep lane position for escape routes.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; the movement speed ensures you stick kiting patterns and escape his all-ins.
- Build Quicksilver Sash after core items; cleanse his stuns and neuter Counter Strike follow-ups completely.

sivir__jhin.notes:
- Threat: Jhin's W Deadly Flourish range and execute damage forces Sivir to respect spacing constantly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Jhin outranges your Q Boomerang Blade significantly early game.
- Trading: Bait his W with E Spell Shield ready; dodge it then trade with Q.
- Post6: Curtain Call forces you into R On The Hunt to kite and dodge shots.
- Spike: First item spike is dangerous; respect his damage and play near minion wave.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor Sivir when Jhin has no traps; use R aggressively then.
- Wave: Slow-push to stack minions; this prevents Jhin from positioning for clean W shots.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite Jhin's range and stick through his W threat.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip adds tankiness and healing against his poke and burst damage pattern.

sivir__ksante.notes:
- threat: K'Sante All Out transforms him into a gap-closer who ignores kiting; dodge or die
- early: Safe farm at range; avoid Q poke trades—his Ntofo Strikes stack too quickly for you
- trading: Bait his W Path Maker, then E Spell Shield it and kite backward hard
- post6: All Out makes him unkitable; play further back and use R On The Hunt preemptively
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; respect his engage range and stay near tower safety
- window: When his R All Out is down, you have free reign to position aggressively
- wave: Slow-push to control spacing; prevents him from all-ining while letting you scale safely
- rune: Fleet of Foot synergizes perfectly; extra movespeed helps you kite his relentless chase patterns
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his burst and gives you survivability against his transformed state

sivir__kaisa.notes:
- Kai'Sa's Plasma stacks burst you down; her all-in with Killer Instinct catches you off-guard.
- Play safe early; farm with Q from distance, avoid short trades that let her stack Plasma.
- Bait her W Void Seeker, then E Spell Shield it for health and movespeed advantage.
- Post-6, respect Killer Instinct dash range; stay grouped with allies or maintain distance in sidelanes.
