- First item spike is dangerous; play safer until you complete your first item for power parity.
- Your window opens when she wastes Killer Instinct or uses abilities on teammates; all-in aggressively then.
- Slow-push waves to control jungle proximity; prevents her from roaming and keeps you safe farming.
- Lethal Tempo for extended trading; sustained attack speed helps you trade favorably and proc Fleet of Foot.
- Add Maw of Malmortius; its magic shield and lifesteal reduce her Plasma burst and healing pressure.

sivir__kalista.notes:
- Kalista's Rend stacking damage forces you to disengage before she detonates; stay mobile always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early Rend pressure outdamages your Q harass, so farm defensively.
- Bait her Pierce with movement, then trade back with Q; dodge Rend activation windows entirely.
- Post-6 her Fate's Call engage threatens your team; position away from Oathsworn and watch positioning.
- First-item spike hurts around 1100 gold; abuse her pre-spike window to push and gain leads.
- Sivir dominates when Kalista lacks Oathsworn nearby; splitpush and rotate to punish her isolation.
- Slow-push waves to deny her free Rend stacking on minions while maintaining safety distance.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite her Rend trades and escape Oathsworn all-in engages.
- Build Maw of Malmortius second to reduce her burst and shield against Oathsworn damage.

sivir__kassadin.notes:
- Threat: Kassadin's Riftwalk mobility lets him gap-close and burst you down before you escape.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; use Q range to cs without pushing into his all-in.
- Trading: Bait his Q Null Sphere with E Spell Shield, then trade with W Ricochet.
- Post6: Riftwalk makes him extremely dangerous; respect his engage range and position near allies.
- Spike: First Tear/mana item spike is dangerous; Kassadin gains repeated Riftwalk casts—play safer and grouped.
- Window: Early game before level 6 is your window; pressure and secure kills with allies.
- Wave: Slow-push to set up ganks; avoid hard-pushing which lets Kassadin roam or dive safely.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo gives you attack-speed to kite and trade sustained damage in fights.
- Item: Manamune provides raw damage and mana to scale safely into his late-game threat.

sivir__katarina.notes:
- Katarina's Shunpo onto you combined with Death Lotus channels massive unavoidable magic damage.
- Play safe and farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance; avoid close trades.
- Bait her Shunpo with positioning, then use E Spell Shield to block Death Lotus.
- Death Lotus becomes lethal; respect her all-in and position near teammates for backup.
- Her first Liandry's or Zhonyas spike is dangerous; play safer and farm safer.
- You spike when grouping; R On The Hunt lets allies kite her Death Lotus.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam opportunities and keep her pressured constantly.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for kiting and escaping her Shunpo engages mid-fight reliably.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline for magic damage reduction and healing against her burst damage.

sivir__kayle.notes:
- Kayle's range and attack speed scaling make her a hyper-carry threat; dodge her Q.
- Play safe and farm. Kayle outranges you early; avoid unnecessary trades near minions.
- Bait her Q with Spell Shield, then trade back. Don't chase into her autos.
- Kayle's invulnerability ult makes her untargetable; use On The Hunt to kite and escape.
- Her first item spike (Nashor's Tooth or Lich Bane) hurts; respect damage and back off.
- Levels 1-5 before her range gains are your window; pressure with Ricochet bounces.
- Slow-push into her to deny wave control; Kayle needs space to scale safely.
- Take Grasp for sustain in a poke-heavy matchup; healing helps you survive her damage.
- Add Adaptive Helm or Visage to mitigate her magic damage and healing debuffs.

sivir__kennen.notes:
- Kennen's Mark of the Storm stun locks you; avoid eating three ability hits in succession
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kennen out-trades you early—farm with Q from range, respect his poke
- Bait his Q Thundering Shuriken, then trade back hard; dodge his W procs by spacing properly
- Post-6 Slicing Maelstrom forces you to position far back; use R On The Hunt to kite away
- First item spike around level 9 is dangerous; respect his all-in threat when he has items
- You spike hardest mid-game when your R cooldown reduction stacks; abuse this to team-fight advantage
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Kennen to walk up and risk getting caught by your team
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into his poke-heavy lane
- Build a Kaenic Lifegrip for magic resist and healing synergy against his relentless magical damage

sivir__khazix.notes:
- Kha'Zix isolated you with Leap, then all-ins with Q damage before you react or escape.
- Play safe near minions to deny Isolation marks; use Q to farm from distance early.
- Bait his Leap with positioning, then Spell Shield his follow-up Q or W for healing denial.
- Post-6 Kha'Zix Invisibility triggers Unseen Threat; stay grouped or use E reactively when he appears.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect his evolved Q burst and avoid isolated sidelane skirmishes.
- You spike when grouped with allies—Isolation becomes harder for Kha'Zix and On The Hunt enables teamfights.
- Slow-push or group mid; avoid extended sidelane farming where Kha'Zix can isolate and all-in you safely.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite and escape Kha'Zix's Leap engagement or his evolved cooldown resets.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline for the magic shield layer against his burst and survivability against repeated dives.

sivir__kled.notes:
- threat: Kled's E Jousting dash combo with W attack speed bursts delete you if caught
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; use Q Boomerang Blade from distance, never walk up for autos
- trading: Bait his E Jousting, then trade back with Q while he's on cooldown
- post6: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! gives him engage range and speed; use E Spell Shield to block the ram
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; respect his all-in potential, maintain max distance farming
- window: Post-6 when R On The Hunt active; kite away while teammates collapse on him
- wave: Slow-push to deny his all-in range; rotate safely when he roams bot side
- rune: Stormraider's Surge for kiting speed when Kled commits to chasing you down hard
- item: Malmogat or Manamune early; survivability and damage output pressure him before first items

sivir__kindred.notes:
- Threat: Kindred's Mounting Dread combo chunks you hard; Wolf's Frenzy sustain keeps them healthy in extended fights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Kindred outdamages you early, so farm with Q and respect their all-in range.
- Trading: Bait Wolf's Frenzy with fake aggression, then trade back hard; dodge Mounting Dread's slow or E-shield it.
- Post6: Lamb's Respite negates your burst and protects Kindred during dives; play around it by disengaging before activation.
- Spike: Kindred's first item spike (likely crit or attack speed) is dangerous; you scale better into mid-game items.
- Window: You outrange Kindred in mid-game teamfights; use R mobility to kite and force them to chase you.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes to create spacing; avoid letting Kindred group and mark you in close teamfights easily.
- Rune: Take Stormraider's Surge for kiting tools; lets you escape Mounting Dread combos and chase with R.
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifeline for the healing reduction passive against Wolf's Frenzy sustain and defensive survivability.

sivir__kogmaw.notes:
- Kog'Maw's W range and percent health damage outscales you; kite carefully or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid his Q poke and respect his early all-in potential.
- Bait his Q with movement, then trade back with Boomerang Blade when he's cooldown.
- Post-6, Living Artillery creates zone control; respect the range and use Spell Shield wisely.
- His first attack speed item (Runaan's or Wit's End) is dangerous; respect the damage spike.
- You spike harder at items with mobility and burst; fight when he's low resources.
- Slow-push to control wave; prevents him from freely scaling and lets you kite safely.
- Take Fleet of Foot; sustain against his poke and escape his all-in attempts.
- Consider Adaptive Helm if he stacks magic damage; reduces his percent health burn significantly.

sivir__leblanc.notes:
- Threat: LeBlanc's Ethereal Chains root locks you down; Sigil combo bursts before you escape.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect her Q-W combo range and dodge Ethereal Chains.
- Trading: Bait her W dash, then trade back; use E Spell Shield to block Sigil.
- Post6: Mimic copies her hardest ability; expect doubled chain pressure or burst from Q-W-R-Q.
- Spike: First item spike is dangerous; dodge aggressively and use Spell Shield preemptively then.
- Window: Post-6 when your R On The Hunt is up; kite her with team speed.
- Wave: Slow-push to safety; avoid extended trades that let her land both W and E.
- Rune: Take Grasp for sustain to offset her burst and landing guaranteed procs safely.
- Item: Add Kaenic Lifeline for magic shield and cleanse against her combo chain pressure.

sivir__leona.notes:
- Leona's E Zenith Blade immobilizes you, enabling Q Shield of Daybreak stun and all-in burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in range after level 2 when she has E and Q.
- Bait her E Zenith Blade with positioning, then use E Spell Shield to block the immobilize.
- Post-6, R On The Hunt lets you kite away from R Solar Flare stun burst range safely.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; stay further back and avoid her E engage window entirely.
- Sivir spikes when you complete items and can R On The Hunt to chase isolated targets.
- Push the wave constantly; Leona struggles to engage on a pushing Sivir with her team behind.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for the movement speed boost to escape E immobilize and R Solar Flare.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip early to reduce incoming magic damage and survive her combo burst attempts.

sivir__lillia.notes:
- Lillia's slowing seeds and Lullaby lock you down; kite away from her engage range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Lillia out-ranges you. Last-hit from distance, avoid her Swirlseed poke.
- Bait her Swirlseed, then trade back with Boomerang Blade. Never stand still near her.
- On The Hunt lets you kite her better; Lillia's Lullaby sleep forces you to space.
- First item spike around 1-2 items lets her duel harder; don't commit to trades then.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where Spell Shield blocks Lullaby or Swirlseed utility matters most.
- Slow-push waves to control space; avoid letting her stack passive safely on minion waves.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for raw kiting power and escape from her pursuit and crowd control.
- Add Kaenic Lifeline for the cleanse effect; strips her sleep and gives you survivability edge.

sivir__locke.notes:
- Locke's Silver Stake magic damage scales with your missing health, punishing low-HP fights severely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Locke out-damages you early. Farm under tower, avoid extended trades.
- Bait his Q Ritual Nails, then trade back quickly before he consumes marks for bonus damage.
- Post-6, Locke's Purgatory execute threat forces you further back; respect the execution range always.
- Locke first-items around level 9; watch for sudden power spike and play safer then.
- You spike harder mid-game when On The Hunt teamfight value exceeds his single-target execute threat.
- Slow-push sidewaves to control mana and positioning; prevents Locke from forcing extended duels on you.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health buffer against his missing-health damage scaling mechanics.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip early to heal back the execute chip damage and magic hurt from trades.

sivir__maokai.notes:
- Maokai roots you with W and traps you for his team to burst down.
- Play safe behind minions; his Q range is shorter than your Boomerang Blade range.
- Bait his W with positioning; use Spell Shield to block root when he commits.
- On The Hunt lets you kite away from his engage; use it proactively.
- First item power spike is moderate; use it to punish him with range advantage.
- You spike when Maokai lacks cooldown reduction; abuse spacing before his ult comes up.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance; deny him brush control where Sapling Toss is stronger.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite away from his engages and roots reliably.
- Add Quicksilver Sash to cleanse roots and survive his Nature's Grasp initiation.

sivir__lucian.notes:
- Lucian's Lightslinger double-shots and mobility let him kite and burst you down repeatedly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near minions where he Lightsingers freely.
- Bait his E Relentless Pursuit before committing; use Q Boomerang Blade to poke safely.
- On The Hunt lets you stick and fight; his R The Culling outdamages you one-on-one.
- First item spike hits hard around 1100 gold; respect his damage and trade less.
- Post-first-item when you complete yours, W Ricochet lets you duel and kite back effectively.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces Lucian to either engage into your minion advantage or lose farm.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains your poke trades and scales into teamfights reliably.
- Kaenic Lifegrip shields you during his burst trades and gives you necessary tankiness.

sivir__milio.notes:
- threat: Milio's Cozy Campfire zone prevents you from trading effectively; stay outside it
- early: Safe farm. Don't contest Milio's zone; kite backward and poke with Boomerang Blade
- trading: Bait Warm Hugs shield before committing trades; dodge Ultra Mega Fire Kick knockback
- post6: On The Hunt lets you chase or escape; Breath of Life removes your pressure
- spike: First item spike is moderate threat; abuse cooldown advantage with Ricochet bounces early
- window: Mid-game when Milio lacks cooldown reduction; punish between Cozy Campfire resets with Q spam
- wave: Slow-push into his zone to deny farming safely; force him to trade disadvantageously
- rune: Stormraider's Surge for kiting and repositioning away from Campfire zone effectively
- item: Kaenic Rookern to reduce healing from his enchantments and protect against burn damage

sivir__morgana.notes:
- Morgana's Q Dark Binding stuns you; dodge it or use E Spell Shield to block reliably.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect Dark Binding range and farm at distance with Q Boomerang Blade.
- Bait Dark Binding with movement, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces; never eat free binding.
- Post-6 Soul Shackles threatens your whole team; position sideways and use R On The Hunt to kite.
- Morgana's first item spike pressures you; abuse your superior range and mobility to farm safely.
- You spike when grouping with teammates post-6; R On The Hunt negates her engage threat entirely.
- Slow-push waves to deny her all-in setup windows; maintain spacing and threaten with Q poke.
- Take Hail of Blades for early W attack speed and trading; synergizes with Ricochet bounces.
- Buy Quicksilver Sash early if Dark Binding chains kill you; removes her disable threat immediately.

sivir__nami.notes:
- Nami's Q stun locks you down; follow with W damage combo kills you instantly.
- Play safe; Nami outranges you early. Farm passively, avoid her Q projectile path.
- Bait Q with E Spell Shield, then trade back with Q Boomerang Blade.
- Post-6, Nami gains teamfight control. Group with team; don't get caught isolated.
- First item (likely Moonstone) strengthens Nami's support role; pressure sidelane before grouping.
- You spike hard at level 6 with R On The Hunt; roam aggressively.
- Slow-push waves to create side pressure and avoid Nami's W bouncing damage poke.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; mobility and damage help you kite away from her stun.
- Build Maw of Malmortius early; magic damage reduction cuts her W and R.

sivir__neeko.notes:
- threat: Neeko's E Tangle-Barbs roots you; her R Pop Blossom stun combo deletes you instantly.
- early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Q Boomerang Blade; avoid walking into E Tangle-Barbs range.
- trading: Bait her E Tangle-Barbs with movement, then trade. Use E Spell Shield reactively on her E.
- post6: Extremely dangerous. Her R Pop Blossom hidden setup into stun kills you; play safer, deeper.
- spike: First item matters less; her R utility spike at level 6 is the real danger.
- window: Post-teamfight when her R on cooldown. Your R On The Hunt chase-down wins skirmishes.
- wave: Slow-push sideways. Keeps you away from center where she lands R; denies easy engage.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying gives you durability to survive her burst and trade back.
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip converts her magic burst into healing; makes you survive Pop Blossom chains better.

sivir__nidalee.notes:
- threat: Nidalee's Javelin Toss one-shots you from fog; dodge it or use Spell Shield proactively.
- early: Safe farm only. Stay behind minions, watch brush. Nidalee's early poke forces caution always.
- trading: Never fight in brush. Bait Javelin Toss, then Boomerang Blade her. Block her Bushwhack traps.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite her cougar form better and reduce cooldowns faster overall.
- spike: First item spike hurts; she has better 1v1. Farm safely, don't contest her power.
- window: Mid-game teamfights favor you when allies cluster; On The Hunt multiplies your team's advantage significantly.
- wave: Slow-push toward her tower. Deny her brush access and force her into extended skirmishes.
- rune: Fleet Footwork sustains poke and synergizes with your passive for superior kiting and dueling.
- item: Adaptive Helm blocks her burst and reduces Javelin Toss damage incrementally over time effectively.

sivir__nilah.notes:
- threat: Nilah's W Jubilant Veil dodges all your damage; her E Slipstream gap-closes and sticks to you.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her sustained damage and mobility outmatch yours early, so farm defensively with Q.
- trading: Bait out her W Jubilant Veil before committing; trade only when her dash is down with Q poke.
- post6: On The Hunt helps kite but Apotheosis pulls you in; use E Spell Shield to block the ult.
- spike: Nilah's first item spike is dangerous; she gains sustained damage and dueling power you cannot match yet.
- window: After you complete two items and CDR, your Q Boomerang Blade spam and kite pressure exceed hers.
- wave: Slow-push sideways; avoid extended teamfights where she can W Jubilant Veil through your whole team's damage.
- rune: Take Stormraider's Surge to kite away from her E Slipstream gap-closes and maintain safe distance always.
- item: Add Mikael's Blessing to cleanse crowd control and help allies; grants needed defensive stats against her.

sivir__nocturne.notes:
- Nocturne's Paranoia removes your vision and enables his all-in; Unspeakable Horror fear locks you down helplessly.
- Play safe near tower; his early all-in is weak but respect Duskbringer range and Unspeakable Horror threat.
- Bait his Shroud of Darkness with Spell Shield before committing; use Boomerang Blade to kite away safely.
- Post-six you lose map control; stay grouped, keep Spell Shield ready to block Unspeakable Horror fear duration.
- His first item spike is dangerous; play ultra-safe and group with team; avoid isolated sidelane farming.
- Your power window is early teamfights before his items; use On The Hunt to kite and escape.
- Slow-push waves to stay grouped with team; avoid pushing far up since Paranoia makes you vulnerable alone.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for kiting potential; the Move Speed helps you escape Nocturne's fear and all-ins.
- Build Quicksilver Sash early if he snowballs; cleanse his Unspeakable Horror fear and maintain positioning safety.

sivir__olaf.notes:
- Olaf closes the gap relentlessly and sticks to you with reduced armor while dealing true damage.
- Play safe at range; farm with Q Boomerang Blade and avoid short trades with Olaf.
- Bait his Q Undertow, then reposition; dodge it with movement or block with E Spell Shield.
- Olaf becomes unkiteable with R Ragnarok active; use R On The Hunt to escape immediately.
- His first item spike (likely Black Cleaver) increases armor shred threat; respect his damage window.
- You outrange him safely before level 6; abuse this to poke and farm freely.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance and safety; avoid pushing into him where he engages easier.
- Grasp provides sustain against his poke and true damage trading to survive his pressure.
- Manamune or Serpent's Fang adds survivability or utility; build whichever matches your team's needs.

sivir__ornn.notes:
- Ornn's E into terrain knockup locks you down for his team's follow-up damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his Q-W combo range and farm with Q.
- Bait his E into terrain, then kite back; dodge Q with sidestep movement.
- On The Hunt makes Ornn unkillable; position away from his R elemental path.
- First item spike is moderate; punish him if he wastes cooldowns on minions.
- Post-6 window closes; play for teamfights where your ultimate's speed buff matters most.
- Slow-push waves to deny his Q terrain setup and keep him under pressure.
- Grasp sustains through his poke; Stormraider's Surge lets you kite his charges better.
- Consider Abyssal Mask late to reduce his W magic damage and sustain better.

sivir__pantheon.notes:
- Pantheon's W Shield Vault stuns you before you can react or escape with mobility.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge his Q Comet Spear and avoid letting him land W.
- Bait his W Shield Vault, then use E Spell Shield to block his followup damage.
- His R Grand Starfall gives him map pressure; stay grouped and watch minimap carefully.
- First item spike is moderate; focus on scaling and avoid overextending into his all-in range.
- You spike harder mid-game with items; kite him with Q Boomerang Blade and W Ricochet.
- Slow-push waves to deny him roam opportunities and maintain safety near tower for E blocks.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against his poke and stronger short trades.
- Build Kaenic Lifeline early if ahead; the magic resist and shield help against his burst.

sivir__pyke.notes:
- Pyke executes with Death From Below; stay healthy and respect his lethal range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Pyke's all-in with Bone Skewer and Phantom Undertow kills easily.
- Bait Bone Skewer pulls, then use Spell Shield to block Phantom Undertow stun engage.
- Post-6 Death From Below resets on kills; respect execute threshold and never fight alone.
- First item spike varies; watch for Serpent's Fang rush—adjust positioning and Spell Shield usage.
- Sivir gains window when Pyke's Ghostwater Dive is on cooldown; trade and push hard.
- Slow-push waves to deny Pyke roam timing; maintain control and prevent ally picks safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain; you need health to survive his burst.
- Build Maw of Malmortius early; the shield and AD boost counter his execution threat.

sivir__poppy.notes:
- Poppy's Heroic Charge stun into Keeper's Verdict knockback chains into your death easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge her Hammer Shock zones and avoid dash-range positioning.
- Bait Heroic Charge by positioning near walls you control, then Spell Shield the stun.
- Post-6 Keeper's Verdict blasts you away; use On The Hunt's speed to kite her ult.
- First item spike around Sheen or tank item makes her tankier; exploit levels 5-6 window.
- Punish window at level 5 before her ult; spam Boomerang Blade and all-in if she misses E.
- Slow-push to deny her wall-stun setup; crash waves into tower where walls won't trap you.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for movement speed to escape her Heroic Charge into Keeper's Verdict chains.
- Add Quicksilver Sash early if she chains cc; removes grounded status from Steadfast Presence.

sivir__quinn.notes:
- Quinn's Vault gap-close interrupts you and enables all-in damage before you respond effectively.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid trading when Harrier marks you or Quinn closes distance.
- Bait Vault with positioning, then Spell Shield the interrupt; use Boomerang Blade to poke safely.
- Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines mobility and Harrier resets make extended fights heavily favor her.
- Her first item spike around 1000 gold is dangerous; play passively and farm safely.
- Post-15 minutes when cooldowns matter more, use On The Hunt to kite and duel better.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance from Quinn's all-in range while scaling for teamfights.
- Fleet Footwork sustains poke and enables safer lane; Sivir needs the healing pressure here.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip early for survivability, especially if Quinn rushes crit or lethality items.

sivir__rakan.notes:
- threat: Grand Entrance dash-knockup combo closes gap and forces you into unfavorable close-range fights
- early: Play safe; Rakan's early game is weak but his engage threat grows with levels
- trading: Bait Grand Entrance with positioning, then Boomerang Blade him as he dashes in
- post6: The Quickness charm is devastating; respect massive range increase and disengage carefully always
- spike: First item spike is moderate; use it to farm safely and scale into teamfights
- window: Mid-game teamfights where On The Hunt active lets you kite and output sustained damage
- wave: Slow-push sideways; maintains distance from Rakan while letting you safely farm and scale
- rune: Stormraider's Surge for guaranteed kiting tools when Rakan engages or ult activates near you
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his charm and heals you; adds needed survivability against magic

sivir__rammus.notes:
- Rammus E Frenzying Taunt locks you down for his team to burst you before escape tools activate.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade, avoid walking into E Frenzying Taunt range.
- Bait his E Frenzying Taunt with positioning, then kite sideways; use E Spell Shield reactively on his taunt.
- On The Hunt amplifies your kiting and cooldown reduction; use it to escape Powerball engage attempts constantly.
- Rammus first armor item spike makes W Ricochet trades terrible; play around cooldowns instead of auto-trading.
- Your window opens when Rammus wastes Q Powerball or E Frenzying Taunt; punish immediately with R On The Hunt.
- Slow-push waves to control Rammus spacing; deny his Q Powerball engage angles by staying near your tower.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for additional movement speed to kite his engagement and escape E Frenzying Taunt combos.
- Add Maw of Malmortius for magic resist and spell shield; mitigates burst after his taunt lands on you.

sivir__renataglasc.notes:
- Hostile Takeover forces you to fight or die; respect its range and don't get caught grouped.
- Play safe behind minions; Handshake roots are devastating early, so avoid overextending for CS.
- Bait Handshake with positioning, then Spell Shield the root; use Boomerang Blade to poke from distance.
- On The Hunt lets you kite Hostile Takeover victims; position carefully since Renata controls teamfights now.
- First item spike around Chemtech Putrifier timing; maintain distance and use Spell Shield reactively for safety.
- Post-15 minutes when Renata's cooldowns matter; Ricochet trades and Fleet of Foot kiting win skirmishes.
- Slow-push to deny Handshake engagement angles; control wave near your tower to maximize safety margin.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tank pressure; Renata's poke forces extended trades favoring Sivir's durability.
- Add Kaenic Cascade to cleanse Berserk and damage Renata's shield-spam supporting allies effectively.

sivir__renekton.notes:
- Renekton's W stun locks you down for his combo; dodge it or you die fast
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from distance, avoid his all-in range completely
- Bait his W with your positioning, then E it when he commits to stun
- On The Hunt lets you kite his Dominus form; use speed to stay away
- First item spike is dangerous; respect his burst window and play further back
- Post-level 9 when Q cooldown drops; you outpoke him and he can't all-in
- Slow-push waves to control distance; prevent him from freezing near his tower
- Fleet Footwork sustains his poke and lets you kite better than Stormraider's Surge
- Maw of Malmortius blocks his burst rotation and gives you survivability against his damage

sivir__rengar.notes:
- threat: Rengar's all-in from brush with Unseen Predator leap one-shots you without counterplay available
- early: Play safe near river; avoid brush; farm with Q from range; respect his all-in
- trading: Never trade in brush; bait Bola Strike with E Spell Shield; Q poke from distance
- post6: Thrill of the Hunt reveals you; play around vision; use E preemptively on incoming threats
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; stay grouped and warded; dodge his Bola Strike rooted engage
- window: Post-item when you have tankier stats; stick with team; punish his brush reliance with vision
- wave: Slow-push sidewaves away from brush; keep minions near tower; prevent his Unseen Predator setup angles
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; kite and escape his all-ins with movement speed when threat imminent
- item: Kaenic Lifeline; blocks his burst and provides survivability against his Ferocity-empowered all-in damage combo

sivir__riven.notes:
- Riven's Broken Wings combo with Ki Burst stun catches immobile Sivir before Spell Shield activates.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from distance, avoid close quarters where she combos.
- Bait her Broken Wings third hit knockback, then trade with Q Boomerang Blade safely after.
- On The Hunt grants Sivir mobility to kite and escape Riven's all-in Blade of the Exile.
- Watch Riven's first item spike around 10-12 minutes; respect her damage but don't overextend mid.
- Sivir gains window when Riven Broken Wings is on cooldown; push wave and create distance.
- Slow-push to stack wave before your turret, denying Riven all-in opportunities and gank setup angles.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for movement speed to escape Riven's gapclosing and extended combo chains.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce Riven's burst damage and provide survivability against her all-in threat.

sivir__ryze.notes:
- Ryze's E Spell Flux debuff lets his spells shred you; avoid staying marked.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade, don't walk up.
- Bait his W Rune Prison with E Spell Shield; trade when cooldown burns.
- R On The Hunt lets you kite his W Rune Prison root easily now.
- Ryze first item spike hurts; respect his damage and play further back temporarily.
- You spike when Ryze uses abilities carelessly; punish with W Ricochet bounces nearby.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Ryze to fight on your terms constantly.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health to survive poke.
- Add a Kaenic Lifeburst or Adaptive Helm to reduce his spell damage significantly.

sivir__samira.notes:
- Samira's melee range combo damage and dash resets devastate immobile Sivir caught out of position.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in potential with Wild Rush and Daredevil Impulse stacking.
- Bait Wild Rush with positioning, then Spell Shield her follow-up ability; avoid extended trades.
- Post-6, Inferno Trigger from melee range kills you; maintain distance and kite backward relentlessly.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect her damage window and play passive farming for safety.
- Your power window comes late game when kiting from distance; On The Hunt enables escape.
- Slow-push waves to create space between you and her dash range; avoid her all-in setup.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite away from her melee engages and escape Wild Rush.
- Consider Kaenic Lifeline for the shield and Grievous Wounds against her sustain and close fights.

sivir__sett.notes:
- Sett's The Show Stopper ult locks you down; you can't kite or escape after caught.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid close range where Knuckle Down and Haymaker chunk you hard.
- Bait Facebreaker by positioning to one side; use Spell Shield to block The Show Stopper ult.
- Post-6, respect The Show Stopper range constantly; stay positioned where he cannot isolate you easily.
- His first item spike (Titanic Hydra/Black Cleaver) is dangerous; respect his damage and maintain distance.
- You spike when On The Hunt is up; kite backward and use mobility to punish gaps.
- Slow-push waves toward your tower; deny him Facebreaker setup opportunities and maintain safe positioning control.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; it grants escape speed when you proc it against Sett's engaging attempts.
- Add Maw of Malmortius second/third; the magic shield and lifeline passive counter his burst threat.

sivir__shen.notes:
- threat: Shadow Dash taunt locks you down for Shen's Spirit's Refuge and sustained damage
- early: Safe farm; respect E range and avoid predictable positioning near minion waves
- trading: Bait E with unpredictable movement, then Boomerang Blade when he commits dash
- post6: Stand United enables Shen to roam freely; push wave before he leaves lane
- spike: First item spike window; Shen gains survivability but you scale better with attack speed
- window: Mid-game when Boomerang Blade and Ricochet fully online; abuse his lack of wave clear
- wave: Slow-push to deny Shen roam attempts and force him to defend tower
- rune: Fleet of Foot synergizes naturally; grants mobility to kite away from E engages
- item: Kaenic Rookern blocks Spirit's Refuge procs while providing magic resist and survivability

sivir__singed.notes:
- threat: Singed's E Fling into W Mega Adhesive roots you; avoid getting caught out of position
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; respect his all-in potential and position near minions for escape routes
- trading: Bait his E Fling, then use Q Boomerang Blade to trade back; dodge his poison trail
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite away from his engages; use it to maintain distance safely
- spike: First item spike is moderate threat; focus on farming safely and avoid his W placement
- window: After Singed uses E or W, punish with Q and W attacks before he re-engages
- wave: Slow-push and maintain distance; allows you to kite backward and control engagement terms
- rune: Fleet of Foot synergizes naturally; gives Move Speed to escape his chase and engages
- item: Mortal Reminder prevents his R Insanity Potion Grievous Wounds from healing enemies you damage

sivir__shyvana.notes:
- Shyvana's Dragon Form transforms her into an unstoppable teamfight threat with empowered abilities and raw damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Shyvana outrades you early. Farm at range with Q, avoid extended fights.
- Bait her W with Spell Shield; dodge Molten Burst with movement. Trade only when her Q is down.
- Post-6 Shyvana becomes a major threat in teamfights. Play around her ult cooldown; group defensively until it's used.
- First item spike makes her tanky and dangerous. Avoid committing to fights; maintain distance and kite backward.
- Your window opens mid-game when Shyvana ult is down. Push wave and farm safely; punish her cooldown.
- Slow-push side lanes to control pacing and deny her opportunities to engage. Keep wave near your tower.
- Take Fleet of Foot for sustain and kiting; it synergizes with your attack pattern and mobility needs.
- Build Manamune early for mana and damage scaling; it helps sustain your poke and teamfight damage.

sivir__sona.notes:
- Crescendo stun locks you down; position carefully to avoid five-man engagement
- Play safe; Sona out-ranges your Q, avoid extended trades early
- Bait Crescendo with E Spell Shield, then all-in with W Ricochet
- Sona gains teamfight control; group with teammates, never face her alone
- First item spike (around 10-12 min) is moderate; exploit cooldown windows
- Mid-game when teammates group; R On The Hunt lets you leverage numbers
- Slow-push to deny her safety; force rotations and create side pressure
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke; healing counters her chip damage
- Adaptive Helm reduces her Q and W spam damage significantly over time

sivir__smolder.notes:
- threat: Smolder's Q Super Scorcher Breath scales infinitely; stack management makes him increasingly dangerous.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance; avoid close trades.
- trading: Bait out his Q Super Scorcher Breath, then E Spell Shield it for health burst.
- post6: MMOOOMMMM! ultimate slows and zoned you hard. Play around cooldown; respect mom's fire damage.
- spike: First item spike hurts. Stay behind minions; use Q Boomerang Blade to poke safely.
- window: When Smolder wastes Q Super Scorcher Breath on minions, trade hard with W Ricochet bounces.
- wave: Slow-push to control spacing. Deny him stacking opportunities near your wave; scale safely.
- rune: Grasp for sustained trading and health to survive his poke; durability matters here.
- item: Hollow Radiance adds armor and healing reduction to reduce his sustained burn damage threat.

sivir__soraka.notes:
- threat: Equinox silence locks down Sivir's mobility and damage; Wish sustain makes her unkillable
- early: Safe farm. Soraka weak early; avoid pushing into Equinox range near minions
- trading: Bait Equinox with Boomerang Blade, then all-in. Never fight inside zone radius
- post6: Wish negates your burst damage; focus on extended fights where she runs out of mana
- spike: First item spike minimal; Soraka needs Mana/Healing items. You can pressure this window
- window: Mid-game teamfights; your Ricochet and On The Hunt outscale her poke and sustain
- wave: Push wave out. Force her to choose between defending tower or rotating to help
- rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite and escape Equinox setup; essential for chase and reset
- item: Add Abyssal Mask after core. Reduces healing received and Soraka's Q sustain effectiveness

sivir__swain.notes:
- Swain roots you with Nevermove and drains your health during Demonic Ascension transformation.
- Play safe behind minions; Swain's Q pierces through so avoid tight groupings early.
- Bait Nevermove with positioning, then Spell Shield the root when he pulls it back.
- Demonic Ascension makes him tanky and drain-heavy; kite away and use On The Hunt to escape.
- His first item spike around 800 gold is minimal; abuse your early attack speed and mobility.
- Mid-game when you have attack speed items; kite and poke with Boomerang Blade safely.
- Slow-push to control wave position; prevents Swain from all-inning you near his tower.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for extra kiting power and chase prevention during his ult phase.
- Add Abyssal Mask late to reduce his drain damage and survive Demonic Ascension fights.

sivir__sylas.notes:
- Sylas W Kingslayer all-in trades combined with E Abscond mobility make him deadly up close.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance, avoid short trades.
- Bait his E Abscond dash, then Spell Shield his W Kingslayer when he commits.
- Post-6 Sylas becomes extremely threatening; he steals On The Hunt for chase and mobility.
- First item spike around level 9 is dangerous; respect his all-in and play safer positioning.
- Your window is when his E Abscond and W Kingslayer are both on cooldown.
- Slow-push waves; maintain distance and force Sylas to walk into your Q Boomerang Blade range.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained poke and healing to survive his all-ins.
- Add Kaenic Lifeline to reduce his burst damage and provide survivability against his magic.

sivir__syndra.notes:
- Threat: Syndra's Unleashed Power ult with stacked Dark Spheres deletes you instantly from range.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Dark Sphere poke outdamages your trades severely.
- Trading: Bait her E Scatter the Weak, then all-in with Q Boomerang Blade trades.
- Post6: Respect her Unleashed Power range; stay behind minions and never group without vision.
- Spike: First item spike (Luden's Tempest or Liandry's) accelerates her burst—play safer, farm safely.
- Window: Mid-game when her cooldowns are high; use R On The Hunt to roam.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her all-in range; space backward while maintaining CS safety.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain and tankiness against her poke damage.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip provides healing against her damage while supporting your team's engage.

sivir__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Taliyah's W Seismic Shove displaces you into E Unraveled Earth mines for guaranteed stun combo
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Threaded Volley poke outdamages your trades significantly at range
- Trading: Bait her W with positioning, then E Spell Shield the shove attempt to gain tempo
- Post6: Weaver's Wall creates escape and engage pressure; respect her roam threat but push wave hard
- Spike: First item around 10 minutes is her powerspike; abuse cooldowns with R On The Hunt attack resets
- Window: Post-level 9 when your Q Boomerang Blade and W Ricochet cooldowns outpace her mana pool severely
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her W engagement range while maintaining safety; don't hard-shove into her setup
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge for kiting and escape after W Seismic Shove lands; mobility over raw damage here
- Item: Kaenic Lifeline provides spell shield overlap and health sustain against her poke and all-in attempts

sivir__talon.notes:
- Talon's all-in burst from Q and W combo kills you before you react or escape.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge W Rake and avoid melee range where Q Noxian Diplomacy leaps.
- Bait his W Rake, then use E Spell Shield to block the return damage and slow.
- Post-6, Shadow Assault makes him invisible and mobile; use E to block incoming W or Q.
- His first item spike is dangerous; stay grouped and use R On The Hunt for safety.
- You spike when Talon uses E Assassin's Path on terrain; punish with Q and W attacks.
- Slow-push waves to deny him all-in opportunities and keep minions near your tower for safety.
- Grasp of the Undying gives sustain against his poke and extra HP to survive burst.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip for healing reduction against his Wound bleeding passive and survivability against burst.

sivir__taric.notes:
- Threat: Taric's Dazzle stun locks you down; Bastion makes him unkillable with ally support nearby.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Taric wants close range; abuse Q Boomerang Blade from distance safely.
- Trading: Bait his E Dazzle, then trade back. Never fight when Bastion is active on nearby ally.
- Post6: Cosmic Radiance makes teamfights impossible to win. Play around cooldown; force fights when ult unavailable.
- Spike: First item spike matters less for Taric. Focus on dodging Dazzle; your kiting advantage persists.
- Window: Mid-game when Taric ult is down. Push and group fast; punish before he regroups.
- Wave: Slow-push sidewaves. Create picks away from Taric's Bastion ally; avoid grouped 5v5 near him.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge. Extra move speed lets you kite Taric and escape Dazzle landing window.
- Item: Mage's Tempest slows Taric when he approaches; reduces his effective engagement range significantly.

sivir__thresh.notes:
- Q Death Sentence chains and pulls you into his team; dodge it relentlessly.
- Play safe behind minions; Thresh Q range exceeds yours, so respect his threat.
- Bait his Q by repositioning unpredictably, then trade back with W bounces.
- His R The Box locks you down; use E Spell Shield to block it.
- First item spike is marginal; punish him when he misses Q chains.
- Post-level 6, respect The Box range; position away from walls and teammates.
- Slow-push to deny him easy chain angles; maintain distance from lane walls.
- Fleet of Foot sustains pressure and dodges chains; take it for kiting.
- Mercury's Treads reduce his chain and box lock duration; buy early.

sivir__trundle.notes:
- Threat: Subjugate steals your resistances, making you squishy and vulnerable to follow-up damage
- Early: Play safe and farm at range; Trundle's short legs mean you kite easily early
- Trading: Dodge Pillar of Ice, use Spell Shield on Chomp to block Attack Damage sap
- Post6: Subjugate doubles stolen stats over four seconds; respect his power spike immediately after ulting
- Spike: First item spike around Sheen or Manamune is dangerous; he gains raw stats advantage
- Window: Post-teamfight when enemies are dead; King's Tribute healing becomes irrelevant without nearby corpses
- Wave: Slow-push to control distance; force Trundle to chase you where his domain control fails
- Rune: Grasp sustains you through poke and provides durability against his stat theft in extended fights
- Item: Add Kaenic Orb to reduce his healing and provide magic resist against his stealing threat

sivir__twistedfate.notes:
- threat: Destiny reveals you and Gate enables ganks; Play around vision and map awareness
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Stay back from Wild Cards range; Respect his poke
- trading: Bait Pick a Card with Spell Shield; Trade when his W is down
- post6: Destiny forces you back; Play safer; Coordinate with team for his teleport timing
- spike: First item spike around 10-12 minutes; Sivir scales better; Stay safe, scale up
- window: Mid-game teamfights; Use On The Hunt to kite and chase; Punish his immobility
- wave: Slow-push for safety; Avoid hard pushing into Destiny vision; Control wave positioning carefully
- rune: Lethal Tempo gives you attack speed and chase pressure; Outscale his early control
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks Destiny reveal damage and gives you survivability against burst

sivir__twitch.notes:
- Twitch's Spray and Pray pierces through your team; his range and poison damage overwhelm you.
- Play safe and farm at range with Boomerang Blade; avoid close trades before level 3.
- Bait his Venom Cask with Spell Shield; use E to block his engage attempts.
- Spray and Pray forces you back; use On The Hunt to kite and reposition safely.
- His first item spike is dangerous; respect his damage and play defensively near minions.
- You spike harder at two items; group with allies and use On The Hunt's cooldown reduction.
- Slow-push to control wave positioning; deny him good Venom Cask angles into your team.
- Pick Stormraider's Surge for mobility to kite his Spray and Pray effectively in teamfights.
- Build Maw of Malmortius early; its magic resist and shield counter his poison burst damage.

sivir__varus.notes:
- Varus Chain of Corruption immobilizes you; dodge it or die quickly thereafter.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Piercing Arrow outranges you, so respect his poke range.
- Bait Hail of Arrows with movement, then Boomerang Blade trade while he's on cooldown.
- Post-6, Chain of Corruption becomes lethal; position behind minions and never cluster with allies.
- First item spike around 2000 gold accelerates his Blight damage; play safer then.
- Win window after your On The Hunt at level 6; use speed to force fights.
- Slow-push to deny his Piercing Arrow accuracy and create gank opportunities for your jungler.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite away from Chain of Corruption and his all-ins.
- Add Adaptive Helm after core to reduce his ability power and Blight detonation damage.

sivir__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's Q and W poke from range; stack Organic Deconstruction then true damage bursts you down
- Play safe behind minions; dodge Q splits and W rift damage; farm with Q when possible
- Bait his Q then Spell Shield the W; trade only when his cooldowns are down
- His R channeled beam applies stacks fast; use E to block or reposition away immediately
- First item spike around Liandry or Shadowflame; respect his damage; don't all-in; farm safely
- Mid-game when cooldowns reset; use R mobility to kite and close gaps for trades
- Slow-push to stack minions; deny him poke angles; group with team to avoid isolated skirmishes
- Grasp sustains his poke damage over time and rewards short trades when you land them
- Add Hexdrinker early if dying to poke; blocks burst and gives magic resist and AD

sivir__vex.notes:
- Vex's Doom 'n Gloom fear interrupts your dashes; play around her empowerment timing carefully.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Vex outranges you. Farm with Q, avoid her Mistral Bolt.
- Bait her Personal Space shield with feints, then trade back hard with Ricochet.
- Post-6 Shadow Surge lets Vex all-in with a dash-mark; respect her all-in range.
- Watch Vex's first item spike; build tankier early to survive her burst windows.
- Sivir dominates once she completes core items; her range and speed outscale Vex's utility.
- Slow-push waves into Vex to deny her roam and deny Gloom zone setup.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; it lets you kite Vex and escape her fear-interrupt combos.
- Add Kaenic Lifeline to block her burst and cleanse Gloom slows threatening your escape.

sivir__viktor.notes:
- Gravity Field slows and stuns you; W Hextech Ray chunks you from range safely.
- Play safe; Viktor out-damages you early. Farm with Q from distance; avoid close trades.
- Bait W Gravity Field, then trade hard. Use E Spell Shield to block E Hextech Ray.
- On The Hunt lets you chase or escape; Viktor's R Arcane Storm zones you hard.
- First item spike hurts; play safer when Viktor completes it. Punish his early mana issues.
- Mid-game when Viktor lacks augments; before he stacks Hex Fragments and gains power spikes.
- Slow-push to deny Viktor safe wave control; abuse his immobility when he overextends.
- Take Grasp; sustain trades and pressure Viktor's fragile early game consistently throughout laning.
- Buy Adaptive Helm; reduces his magic damage and E Hextech Ray burst significantly.

sivir__vi.notes:
- Vi's Cease and Desist ultimate locks you down for a guaranteed combo kill with no counterplay.
- Play safe behind minions; Vi's Vault Breaker range is shorter than your Boomerang Blade, abuse this.
- Bait Vi's Vault Breaker, then use Spell Shield to block her follow-up ability during her combo.
- Post-6, respect Vi's all-in range; stay near turret or maintain maximum distance for safety always.
- Vi's first major item spike (around item two-three) is when she threatens your life most heavily.
- Your power window exists when Vi wastes Vault Breaker; immediately abuse cooldown with Boomerang Blade poke.
- Slow-push waves into tower; this denies Vi easy all-in angles and gives you retreat room always.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for consistent kiting against Vi's relentless forward movement and engagement patterns.
- Add Plated Steelcaps early to reduce Vi's auto-attack damage and her Denting Blows armor shred.

sivir__viego.notes:
- Viego's W Spectral Maw stun locks you down; he executes with R Heartbreaker while you're helpless.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid his W dash range. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance.
- Bait W Spectral Maw, then use E Spell Shield to block follow-up abilities. Never stand still.
- Post-6, R Heartbreaker executes you if caught alone. Never face-check; group with allies for safety.
- First item spike is dangerous. Play safer, farm sideways, avoid isolated positions until you complete items.
- Sivir spikes when R On The Hunt is active; kite and duel with W Ricochet bounces.
- Slow-push sideways; forces Viego to roam or lose wave. Denies him easy W engage angles.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; kite and escape after E Spell Shield blocks W, creating distance naturally.
- Add Silvermere Dawn; cleanses the stun from W Spectral Maw, keeping you mobile and safe.

sivir__vladimir.notes:
- Threat: Vladimir's Sanguine Pool makes him untargetable, negating your damage and letting him reposition freely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Vladimir's Q out-trades your damage. Farm from distance, avoid extended fights.
- Trading: Bait his Sanguine Pool with Boomerang Blade, then all-in when it ends and he's vulnerable.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you chase, but Hemoplague's damage amp means you die faster in extended fights.
- Spike: Vladimir's first Protobelt or Zhonyas spike is dangerous; you cannot pressure him effectively during this window.
- Window: Mid-game when Vladimir lacks Zhonyas; abuse your superior range and kiting to force fights on your terms.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; Vladimir struggles to clear waves fast, letting you gain map pressure and roam advantage.
- Rune: Take Grasp for sustain trades when Vladimir's Q is down; keeps you healthy in this poke matchup.
- Item: Add Maw of Malmortius to reduce Hemoplague's damage amp and gain a shield against his burst.

sivir__wukong.notes:
- Wukong's E Nimbus Strike gap-close plus R Cyclone knockup combo deletes you instantly.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid extended trades. Use Q Boomerang Blade from range safely.
- Bait his W Warrior Trickster with positioning, then trade back hard immediately after.
- On The Hunt lets you kite his R Cyclone easier; respect his all-in damage.
- His first item spike hurts; play further back and use E Spell Shield preemptively then.
- After your first item, kite with Fleet of Foot procs and W Ricochet bounces.
- Slow-push to maintain distance; avoid pushing into him where he can E gap-close easily.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to escape his gap-close and stick with allies for safety.
- Rush Thornmail or Force of Nature to reduce his burst and sustained pressure threat.

sivir__xayah.notes:
- Threat: Xayah's Bladecaller roots you after she lands enough Feathers; avoid her feather zone.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Double Daggers outrange your Boomerang Blade early; farm carefully.
- Trading: Bait her Bladecaller with positioning, then trade when her Feathers are on cooldown.
- Post6: Featherstorm makes her untargetable; use Spell Shield to block follow-up abilities, not the ult.
- Spike: First item spike is minor threat; punish when she builds attack speed items.
- Window: You spike harder with movement speed items; use On The Hunt to kite her.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her all-in potential; avoid pushing into her Feather patterns.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite her Bladecaller root attempts and escape ganks easier.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius gives durability against her damage and helps survive her combos.

sivir__xerath.notes:
- Threat: Xerath's long-range Q and W force you into vulnerable positioning; dodging is mandatory.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from distance, avoid Xerath's poke range entirely.
- Trading: Bait Xerath's E Shocking Orb, then use E Spell Shield to block his follow-up.
- Post6: Rite of the Arcane makes Xerath lethal; position behind minions and use terrain cover.
- Spike: First item spike around 10-12 minutes hurts; stay out of lane if overextended then.
- Window: Punish when Xerath misses E Shocking Orb; all-in with W Ricochet and Q Boomerang Blade.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny Xerath safe siege angles; prevents his immobile ult channeling opportunities.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite and escape Xerath's follow-up after dodging his barrage.
- Item: Abyssal Mask reduces his magic damage and gives you tankiness against repeated poke.

sivir__xinzhao.notes:
- Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge gap-closes and locks you down; you cannot kite effectively alone.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Boomerang Blade, never fight directly.
- Bait Audacious Charge with positioning, then Spell Shield it or use Fleet of Foot to escape.
- On The Hunt lets Xin Zhao chase you down; use ult to kite and space properly.
- His first item spike (likely Blade of The Ruined King) is extremely dangerous; play passive.
- Sivir scales better; punish Xin Zhao's weak mid-game by grouping with ult and teamfighting.
- Slow-push waves to stack minions; fight near your tower where Xin cannot all-in safely.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite and escape Audacious Charge; mobility is your survival tool.
- Build Kaenic Lifesteal to reduce his healing from Determination procs and Blade of Ruined King.

sivir__zaahen.notes:
- Threat: Zaahen's W Dreaded Return and Q knock up lock you down for guaranteed burst damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid clumping near minions as W pull range is deceptive.
- Trading: Bait his W pull, then kite backward with Q poke; never trade inside his melee range.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite faster, but Zaahen gains more healing—keep distance strict.
- Spike: His first item spike is dangerous; don't fight him alone or near walls post-6.
- Window: You outscale him mid-game when you get attack speed and team grouping begins.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; deny his W engage range and force him to chase through minions.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge ensures you kite away from his Q and W combo reliably.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields you from his burst while adding AD and spell vamp sustain.

sivir__zed.notes:
- Zed's Death Mark combined with shadow damage bursts you down before you can react or escape.
- Play safe behind minions; don't let Zed land free Razor Shurikens; use Q to farm safely.
- Bait his W Living Shadow dash, then trade back with Q; never fight him directly early.
- Post-6, Death Mark is lethal; use Spell Shield E to block his R dash or follow-up.
- First item spike around Serrated Dirk is dangerous; respect his burst and play further back.
- Mid-game teamfights where Zed lacks targets; use R On The Hunt to kite and escape.
- Slow-push waves to deny Zed roam pressure and maintain distance for safety farming.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for survivability and poke damage to pressure Zed safely.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip early for survivability against his burst damage and grievous wounds resistance.

sivir__zac.notes:
- Zac's E Elastic Slingshot engages you from fog; you can't kite or escape reliably.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; respect his all-in after level 2 E.
- Bait his Q Stretching Strikes, then sidestep; dodge his W Unstable Matter explosions.
- On The Hunt ult lets you kite his R Let's Bounce! knockups better now.
- Zac's first item spike (likely health tank item) strengthens his W damage; play respectfully.
- Post-level 9 you outrange and outdamage him; abuse Q Boomerang Blade poke from distance.
- Slow-push waves to deny his E Elastic Slingshot engage windows and control space.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling; you'll need durability against his W.
- Add Kaenic Lifeburst after core to reduce his W Unstable Matter and heal yourself.

sivir__zeri.notes:
- Zeri's all-in dash with Spark Surge combined with Lightning Crash makes her unstoppable once engaged.
- Play safe early; Zeri out-trades you in extended fights; use Q poke and respect her gap close.
- Bait Spark Surge with positioning, then trade back; use E Spell Shield to block Ultrashock Laser.
- On The Hunt lets you kite better, but Zeri's Lightning Crash resets and chases you down hard.
- Zeri's first item spike is dangerous; she gains damage and stickiness; play back and farm safely.
- You spike when Zeri wastes Spark Surge; all-in her with R On The Hunt then follow-up.
- Slow-push waves into tower; this denies Zeri roam and forces her to stay for farm.
- Fleet Footwork gives movement speed to match her kiting; helps you survive her all-in attempts.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius to block her magic damage and gain a shield against Lightning Crash.

sivir__zoe.notes:
- Zoe's Sleepy Trouble Bubble catches you immobilized, enabling burst combos you cannot escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her Paddle Star! range and dodge sideways unpredictably.
- Bait her Sleepy Trouble Bubble with positioning, then trade while it's down cooldown.
- On The Hunt lets you chase or escape Portal Jump; Spell Shield blocks her cc.
- Zoe's first item spike (usually burst AP) is dangerous; play back and farm safely.
- You spike harder mid-game when On The Hunt cooldown resets enable sustained teamfight presence.
- Slow-push waves to deny Zoe roam window and maintain pressure without overextending into bubble.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain to survive her poke and all-ins.
- Add Adaptive Helm or Hollow Radiance to reduce her spell damage and survive burst.

kogmaw__aatrox.notes:
- Aatrox's Q and W combo close distance and deal massive damage; dodge or die.
- Farm safely at range with Caustic Spittle; avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait his Q swings, then kite backward; never let him chain you with Infernal Chains.
- World Ender makes him unkillable in fights; use Living Artillery from max range only.
- His first item spike (usually Stridebreaker or Eclipse) is dangerous; play further back then.
- Spike harder when he wastes cooldowns; punish with Void Ooze and kite backward hard.
- Slow-push to deny him all-in engage angles; maintain distance and poke with Caustic Spittle.
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and kiting; Aatrox all-ins heavily and needs outhealing.
- Consider Kaenic Lifegrip to reduce his healing and survive his burst damage windows.

kogmaw__chogath.notes:
- Rupture locks you down; Feast executes you—both end fights instantly if you're caught.
- Play safe behind minions; Rupture range is deceptive, so respect it heavily early.
- Bait Rupture with positioning, then Caustic Spittle to kite; never let him close.
- Feast damage scales massively—stay full health and abuse range with Bio-Arcane Barrage relentlessly.
- Cho'Gath's first item spike (usually tank) is your punish window; abuse range advantage hard.
- Post-first-item, your sustained damage outscales his tankiness if you maintain range and kite.
- Slow-push into him; deny freeze setup and force Cho'Gath to engage or lose wave.
- Grasp sustains him too well; take Fleet Footwork for kiting safety and poke consistency.
- Build Rylai's Crystal Scepter third; slows lock Cho'Gath down and prevent Rupture engages.

kogmaw__ezreal.notes:
- Threat: Ezreal's Mystic Shot poke is safe, spammable, and reduces his cooldowns relentlessly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Ezreal out-ranges you with Q, avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait his Arcane Shift before committing; dodge Mystic Shot by positioning behind minions.
- Post6: Trueshot Barrage is global threat; stay behind cover and watch minimap constantly.
- Spike: First item spike (Manamune) is dangerous; respect his damage and play safer.
- Window: Level 9+ with W maxed and Nashor's Tooth gives you outrange and sustain.
- Wave: Slow-push to extend lane; denies Ezreal safe poke angles and gank setup.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke damage and strengthens your scaling.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip shields you against burst and converts his poke into survivability.

kogmaw__yuumi.notes:
- Yuumi's On-Hit healing from W attached ally sustains their poke; you can't out-damage it easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Yuumi's Q slows and her ally can abuse range advantage freely.
- Bait Q Prowling Projectile by repositioning sideways; dodge the slow, then all-in with W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Post-6, Final Chapter heal chains make extended fights harder; use R Living Artillery to burst before teamfights.
- Yuumi's first item spike (Ardent Censer) buffs ally attack speed; punish by kiting and spacing carefully.
- Kog'Maw spikes at two items (attack speed + magic pen); force fights before Yuumi gets Mikael's.
- Slow-push to stack minions; force Yuumi's ally to choose between farming or roaming with you present.
- Take Lethal Tempo for extended teamfights and Attack Speed stacking against Yuumi's ally buff window.
- Add Maw of Malmortius for its spell shield; blocks burst and heals from attached ally's aura.

drmundo__masteryi.notes:
- Master Yi's true damage from Wuju Style shreds your tankiness; Highlander makes him untargetable and unpurgeable.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Master Yi outduels you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Bait his Alpha Strike with positioning, then trade back with Heart Zapper and Blunt Force Trauma.
- Post-6, Maximum Dosage lets you survive Highlander burst, but avoid extended fights during his ult window.
- His first item spike (likely Blade of The Ruined King) is dangerous; play around cooldowns carefully.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Highlander is down; engage with your ult and zone him out.
- Slow-push waves to stack health and deny him roam windows; grouping helps your team handle him.
- Run Grasp of The Undying for sustain and tankiness scaling against his true damage threat.
- Add Thornmail to reduce his lifesteal and reflect damage back during extended duels with him.

drmundo__kassadin.notes:
- Kassadin's Riftwalk mobility and Force Pulse slow kite you relentlessly while he scales into unkillable late game.
- Play safe and farm; Kassadin is weak early—avoid overextending or he'll land Null Sphere and all-in you.
- Bait his Null Sphere with Goes Where He Pleases, then trade with Infected Bonesaw and Blunt Force Trauma.
- Post-6, Riftwalk gives him escape and chase tools—respect spacing and don't chase into unwarded areas blindly.
- His first Tear spike is a minor danger; abuse his mana scarcity before he completes Seraph's Embrace.
- Levels 9-11 are your window—max Infected Bonesaw, force teamfights, and punish his squishy mid-game before scaling.
- Slow-push waves to deny him safe farming and control jungle proximity; never let him free-scale uncontested.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and poke pressure that Kassadin cannot match early.
- Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce his magic damage and force him into longer fights favoring your tankiness.

drmundo__renataglasc.notes:
- Hostile Takeover forces you to fight while berserk; you can't kite or disengage safely then.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Renata outranges you early, so farm from distance and avoid extended trades.
- Dodge Handshake at all costs; if rooted, you're vulnerable. Bait it, then all-in with Blunt Force Trauma.
- Maximum Dosage lets you sustain her poke, but Hostile Takeover still forces bad fights; respect ult range.
- Her first item spike (likely Rylai's or Liandry's) hurts; farm safely until you complete Hollow Radiance.
- Post-Hollow Radiance you outstat her; all-in when her Handshake and Hostile Takeover are on cooldown.
- Slow-push waves into her tower; this keeps her away from you and sets up roams.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; it sustains poke damage and scales with your health pool perfectly.
- Add Hollow Radiance second or third; its magic resist and ability haste counter her sustained damage.

drmundo__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's true damage from Organic Deconstruction stacks shreds your Health regardless of resistances.
- Play safe; Vel'Koz outranges you heavily. Farm defensively, dodge Plasma Fission, expect poke.
- Never walk straight at Vel'Koz; bait Tectonic Disruption, then all-in with Goes Where He Pleases.
- Maximum Dosage healing becomes critical; Vel'Koz's true damage ult will chunk you hard post-six.
- Vel'Koz's first item spike (Liandry's Torment or Shadowflame) is dangerous; respect range and poke.
- Your window comes when Vel'Koz wastes cooldowns; gap-close with Blunt Force Trauma immediately after.
- Slow-push waves to deny Vel'Koz kill pressure and set up jungle ganks on immobilized targets.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain in lane offsets poke and empowers all-in trading.
- Build Hollow Radiance early; its magic resistance and healing amplification directly counter true damage scaling.

drmundo__viego.notes:
- Viego's Heartbreaker execute and Black Mist mobility let him kite and burst you repeatedly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from range, avoid extended trades near minions.
- Dodge Spectral Maw at all costs; bait it, then trade with Q and E.
- Maximum Dosage healing sustains poke, but Heartbreaker execution ignores it—respect ult range constantly.
- Watch Viego's first item spike around 10-12 minutes; play safer until you finish Hollow Radiance.
- You outscale mid-game; abuse tankiness after Blunt Force Trauma stacks and first defensive item.
- Slow-push side lanes to stack minions; forces Viego to choose between wave and roaming.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained lane pressure and scaling health for tankiness.
- Consider Kaenic Lifeburst as third item to amplify healing and pressure Viego's team fights.

olaf__anivia.notes:
- Crystallize traps you; Flash Frost stuns; Frostbite doubles damage on chilled targets.
- Safe farm behind minions; dodge Q; never all-in before level 3 safely.
- Bait Q with movement; trade after she misses; avoid standing in Glacial Storm.
- Ragnarok breaks Crystallize walls and immunity lets you dive through her cc chain.
- First item spike dangerous; Anivia gains sustained waveclear and zone control; play safer.
- Post-6 Ragnarok active is your window; activate and run her down relentlessly.
- Slow-push to deny her wall value; crash waves into tower for dive setup.
- Grasp sustains poke damage and scales; Stormraider's lets you escape or chase through walls.
- Abyssal Mask reduces her damage and synergizes with your tanky Berserker Rage build.

olaf__caitlyn.notes:
- Caitlyn traps immobilize you, proc Headshot at range before you close gap safely.
- Play safe levels 1–3; respect trap range, farm from fog of war when possible.
- Bait Yordle Snap Trap with Undertow positioning, then all-in when trap is down.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through Ace in the Hole; activate aggressively post-six.
- Her first Manamune spike hurts; abuse levels 4–5 before she gains poke pressure.
- All-in windows appear after her Yordle Snap Trap cooldown; force fights immediately then.
- Slow-push toward her tower to deny trap setup space and deny safe farming.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and strengthens short all-in trades.
- Force of Nature provides magic resist and movement speed against her kite pattern.

drmundo__xinzhao.notes:
- Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge gap-closes and locks you down; his sustained damage chunks you hard.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Xin Zhao out-trades you early. Farm at max range with Q Infected Bonesaw.
- Never fight when Xin Zhao has three stacks on Q Three Talon Strike; dodge his engage entirely.
- Maximum Dosage lets you survive his burst and kite; use it reactively when he Audacious Charge commits.
- His first item spike (Trinity Force or similar) hurts; play safer and scale into your tankier build.
- Post-12 minutes when you have two items, your Health pool and W Heart Zapper outdueling him sustained.
- Slow-push waves toward him; this denies Xin Zhao roaming and lets you kite near your tower.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; it sustains you through his poke and scales with your max Health.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip; its damage redirect and heal synergizes perfectly with your tankiness and W Heart Zapper.

olaf__ezreal.notes:
- Ezreal kites and pokes relentlessly; Mystic Shot resets cooldowns, keeping him safe and damaging.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Mystic Shot outranges Undertow, so avoid extended trades early.
- Bait Arcane Shift before committing; dodge Mystic Shot by positioning behind minions when possible.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore Arcane Shift kite attempts; all-in when activated.
- Manamune spike is dangerous; Ezreal gains damage and mana sustain, making him harder to catch.
- You spike at level 6 with Ragnarok; run him down during his cooldown windows.
- Slow-push toward Ezreal; force him to farm close to you or lose CS safely.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain through poke and gain tankiness for extended brawls.
- Add Force of Nature against his magic damage and Mystic Shot poke pressure.

olaf__kayn.notes:
- Umbral Trespass burst and Darkin healing make Kayn unkillable if you let him scale freely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kayn outduels early. Farm with Q Undertow from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Bait Shadow Step by positioning near walls. Dodge Blade's Reach, then trade with Undertow spam.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you run Kayn down. Use this window aggressively post-six.
- Kayn's first item spike is dangerous. Play around cooldowns and force fights when his ult down.
- Your power window is mid-game before Kayn's Darkin form scales. Invade and dominate early teamfights.
- Slow-push to deny Kayn roam opportunities. Keep waves near your tower to control his mobility.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health advantage into his poke.
- Build Hollow Radiance to reduce Kayn's magic damage and strengthen your Berserker Rage tankiness.

olaf__smolder.notes:
- Smolder's Q Super Scorcher Breath and R MMOOOMMMM! burst combo kills you if caught.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Smolder out-ranges you. Farm with Q Undertow; dodge his W Achooo!.
- Bait W Achooo! then all-in. Never trade into his Q Super Scorcher Breath spam freely.
- Post-6, respect R MMOOOMMMM! slow and burst. Use Ragnarok immunity when he commits ult fully.
- First item spike (Liandry's or Nashor's) is dangerous. Dodge and scale; you outscale him.
- Your power window: levels 9-11 when you're tanky and he lacks full build damage.
- Slow-push waves into him. Force him to push; then all-in when he extends forward.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustainability and tankiness against his poke and burst.
- Add Hollow Radiance early if losing to burst; reduces his ability damage significantly over fights.

olaf__syndra.notes:
- Syndra's Unleashed Power and Scatter the Weak lock you down; dodge or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Dark Spheres outrange your Undertow; farm under tower.
- Bait Scatter the Weak, then all-in; dodge her E and trade with Reckless Swing.
- Ragnarok immunity breaks her stun chain; activate it preemptively when she groups spheres.
- Her first Liandry's spike hurts; respect her damage but Undertow cooldown resets matter.
- Level 6 onwards you duel harder; she zones you until Ragnarok is ready.
- Slow-push waves to bait her forward; gank becomes easier when she's pushed up.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and tankiness; Undertow poke resets it constantly.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early; it blocks her burst and gives you needed magic resist.

shen__gangplank.notes:
- Cannon Barrage from fog of war catches you without counterplay; respect its range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gangplank out-trades you early, so farm defensively near tower.
- Bait Powder Keg placement, then Shadow Dash past it; never fight inside keg radius.
- Stand United becomes your only reliable engage tool; use it to gank or escape ult.
- First item spike around 10 minutes hurts; play safer and scale into your mid-game power.
- You spike at three items with tankiness; punish Gangplank's immobility then and dominate sidelane.
- Slow-push waves to deny him safety; force him to choose between farm and map pressure.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and trading damage in prolonged lane phases.
- Buy Force of Nature if Cannon Barrage repeatedly catches you; the magic resist helps survive.

shen__kayle.notes:
- Kayle's Divine Judgment makes her untargetable; your Stand United cannot save allies during it.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Radiant Blast slows and you lack escape tools early.
- Bait Radiant Blast, then Shadow Dash in; dodge her Starfire Spellblade active by spacing.
- Post-6, Divine Judgment counters your ult timing; coordinate Stand United before her channel completes.
- Her first item spike (typically Nashor's Tooth or Kraken Slayer) signals danger; stay defensive.
- Level 6 onwards is your window; use Stand United proactively before Divine Judgment availability.
- Slow-push into her; deny her roaming while scaling into late-game teamfight superiority naturally.
- Pick Grasp of the Undying; sustain through her poke and win extended trades.
- Build Hollow Radiance after core; her magic damage from Starfire Spellblade and passive suffers.

shen__malzahar.notes:
- Nether Grasp suppresses you; build tankiness and play around cooldown windows.
- Farm safely at range with Q Twilight Assault; avoid close trades early.
- Bait Call of the Void silence, then trade with Shadow Dash into him.
- Stand United becomes crucial; use it to save allies from Nether Grasp pressure.
- His first Liandry's Torment spike hurts; farm safely and scale into tankiness.
- Post-first-item you outscale; group with team when his cooldowns reset.
- Slow-push waves to control mana and force him to farm dangerously forward.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and trading through his poke.
- Purchase Kaenic Lifeline to cleanse Malefic Visions and reduce his sustained damage output.

shen__rakan.notes:
- Rakan's Grand Entrance and The Quickness charm lock you down; positioning matters most.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Rakan out-ranges you early—farm with Q from distance only.
- Bait his Grand Entrance dash, then Shadow Dash through him for guaranteed taunt.
- Stand United becomes reactive tool; use it to save charmed allies, not engage.
- First item spike (often Moonstone Renewer) heals his team—punish before he completes it.
- Post-first-item, you spike harder; abuse cooldown windows when his mobility is down.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Rakan to engage unfavorably or lose cs.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain against poke and extended trades.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce his charm effectiveness and amplify tankiness.

sivir__aurora.notes:
- Aurora's Across the Veil invisibility lets her kite and escape your all-in attempts repeatedly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Aurora out-ranges you early, so farm defensively with Q bounces.
- Bait out Across the Veil before committing to trades; dodge The Weirding's slow effect.
- On The Hunt at level 6 lets you chase Aurora down and stick to her.
- Aurora's first item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and kite potential immediately after.
- Post-first-item when you have attack speed items, you outscale her sustained damage output significantly.
- Slow-push waves to deny Aurora roam opportunities and set up ganks with your jungler.
- Take Hail of Blades for early attack speed and burst to trade with Aurora.
- Grab Quicksilver Sash early if Aurora lands too many Twofold Hex curses on you.

sivir__drmundo.notes:
- Mundo's Infected Bonesaw slow and tankiness let him walk down and all-in you; kite backward.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Mundo out-trades you early. Farm with Q, avoid his Bonesaw range.
- Bait Infected Bonesaw with movement, then trade back. Use E Spell Shield to block Bonesaw slow.
- Mundo becomes unkillable at six with Maximum Dosage healing. Kite and focus on team fights.
- First item spike around level 9-11; Mundo gains sustain. Punish him before he completes it.
- Sivir wins mid-game teamfights when Mundo lacks cooldowns. Use R On The Hunt to engage.
- Slow-push and rotate; never let Mundo free-farm or heal. Deny him solo lane pressure.
- Fleet of Foot synergizes with your kiting pattern and sustain needs in this poke matchup.
- Kaenic Lifeburst stops Mundo's healing burst, forcing him to re-engage or retreat; adds CDR.

sivir__graves.notes:
- Graves' shotgun burst and Collateral Damage one-shot potential; respect his close-range damage.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge Smoke Screen and avoid letting him close distance freely.
- Bait Quickdraw with E Spell Shield, then trade back; never fight inside minion wave.
- On The Hunt lets you kite and escape Collateral Damage; use it proactively.
- First item spike (Black Cleaver or Serpent's Fang) is dangerous; respect his damage window.
- After he wastes Quickdraw or Smoke Screen, punish with Q Boomerang Blade and W Ricochet.
- Slow-push waves to deny him all-in angles; prevent him from resetting into you.
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustain and mobility to kite his close-range burst consistently.
- Build Kaenic Lifegrip early to survive burst and heal; synergizes with On The Hunt.

sivir__gwen.notes:
- Gwen's W Hallowed Mist limits your ability to kite; her sustained damage overwhelms you.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q Boomerang Blade from range, avoid extended trades.
- Bait W Hallowed Mist cooldown before committing; dodge Q Snip Snip! center for true damage.
- Post-6, R On The Hunt lets you kite Gwen's E Skip 'n Slash dives better.
