- Watch Gwen's first item spike; play safer when she completes Lich Bane or Nashor's Tooth.
- Sivir punishes Gwen when W Hallowed Mist is down; all-in during that window.
- Slow-push to deny Gwen favorable mist positioning; prevent her from diving under tower.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for survivability against her sustained magic damage output.
- Consider Kaenic Lifeburst to reduce her healing from A Thousand Cuts passive damage.

sivir__karthus.notes:
- Requiem channels and hits you globally; E Spell Shield blocks it or dodge positioning.
- Safe farm at range; abuse Fleet of Foot to kite away from Lay Waste.
- Bait Lay Waste on minions, then trade hard with Q and W before he repositions.
- Post-6, play around Requiem channel timing; position near terrain or behind minions to block damage.
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes; punish Karthus if he channels Requiem—engage with R immediately.
- You spike harder mid-game; use R to gap close and end fights before Wall of Pain stacks.
- Slow-push waves to deny Karthus safe Lay Waste angles and control Requiem channel windows.
- Take Fleet of Footwork for mobility and healing against poke; sustain through Lay Waste harassment.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip for magic resist and teamfight utility against his Area of Effect damage patterns.

sivir__lissandra.notes:
- Lissandra's Ring of Frost root locks you down; Frozen Tomb stun prevents escape or counterplay.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her Ice Shard poke and avoid clustering near minions.
- Bait Ring of Frost with positioning, then Boomerang Blade trade when it's down; dodge Ice Shard.
- Post-6 Frozen Tomb is a hard engage tool; respect ultimate range and play further back.
- Lissandra's first Liandry's Torment spike hurts; punish her if she misses Ice Shard heavily.
- You spike when Lissandra is on cooldown; push aggressively and roam when she backs.
- Slow-push into her towers; control wave near your side to kite and maintain safety.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and tankiness against her repeated poke damage.
- Add Adaptive Force or Abyssal Mask second to reduce her burst and increase survivability.

sivir__nautilus.notes:
- Nautilus Q Dredge Line catches you out of position and enables his all-in burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his Staggering Blow root on first hit, stay back.
- Bait his Q Dredge Line, then all-in with W Ricochet and autos while it's down.
- On The Hunt lets you kite and escape Depth Charge; use R to disengage safely.
- His Titan's Wrath first item is dangerous; avoid extended trades when shield is active.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where On The Hunt and mobility outpace his engage.
- Slow-push waves to prevent Dredge Line ganks and maintain distance from his anchor range.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and strengthens your extended trading patterns overall.
- Marakana adds shield to help you survive Depth Charge and his burst combo attempts.

sivir__orianna.notes:
- Threat: Command: Shockwave catches grouped Sivir; Command: Dissonance slows you hard during fights.
- Early: Safe farm at range; respect her Q poke and avoid clustered minions early.
- Trading: Dodge Command: Attack with E Spell Shield; trade when her Ball is far away.
- Post6: On The Hunt enables kiting but Command: Shockwave still controls teamfights—play around cooldowns.
- Spike: First Liandry's Torment spike hurts at mid-game; punish Orianna before she completes it.
- Window: Post-laning when Orianna groups; Boomerang Blade and Ricochet shred when she lacks mobility.
- Wave: Slow-push; prevents Orianna from roaming and forces her to farm; safer positioning overall.
- Rune: Fleet of Foot with Inspiration; sustain laning phase and gain Stopwatch timing advantage.
- Item: Kaenic Lifegrip; blocks Shockwave knockup effect and converts her damage into healing for team.

sivir__sejuani.notes:
- Sejuani's Glacial Prison stun chains into her team's damage; respect the range constantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Arctic Assault has surprising early engage range.
- Bait her W Winter's Wrath with positioning, then trade back with Q Boomerang Blade.
- Her R Glacial Prison range increases dramatically; respect it and position further back always.
- Watch for Sejuani's first Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern spike; kite backwards immediately.
- You spike harder when she wastes Q Arctic Assault; punish with R On The Hunt.
- Slow-push waves to deny her easy Q Arctic Assault engages into your turret range.
- Take Fleet of Foot for sustain and kiting; her slows are constant threat.
- Build Maw of Malmortius to block her burst and resist her magic damage.

sivir__shaco.notes:
- Shaco's Deceive and Backstab combo burst you down before you react or escape.
- Play safe early; farm at range with Boomerang Blade, avoid pushing into fog of war.
- Bait Deceive with positioning, then use Spell Shield reactively to block Two-Shiv Poison or Boomerang.
- On The Hunt lets you kite and escape Shaco's engage; his ult now threatens burst.
- Watch for Shaco's first item spike around 10-12 minutes; play safer, position deeper in lane.
- Post-first-item, you outrange and out-team-fight him; group and use On The Hunt to dominate.
- Slow-push and keep wave near tower; deny Shaco flank angles and safe Deceive landing spots.
- Take Grasp for sustainability against poke and extra durability in extended trades or all-ins.
- Add Maw of Malmortius early if Shaco builds AP-heavy or you fall behind early.

sivir__skarner.notes:
- Impale suppresses you immobile; use Spell Shield to block or kite with Fleet of Foot.
- Play safe; Skarner gaps close fast. Farm ranged with Boomerang Blade, avoid short trades.
- Bait Seismic Bastion's slow, then trade back. Never let him stack Quaking freely on you.
- Impale is lethal; always hold Spell Shield ready. On The Hunt lets allies escape suppression.
- His Shattered Earth empowered auto spike hurts; stay mobile and respect his all-in range window.
- Mid-game after Sivir finishes first item; kite and use On The Hunt to escape engage.
- Slow-push sideways; deny Skarner terrain charges through lane. Maintain distance for Boomerang Blade poke safety.
- Hail of Blades enables faster Ricochet procs and kiting; Spell Shield blocks his key combos.
- Manamune converts your mana into extra damage; helps you kite and farm safely from range.

sivir__zyra.notes:
- Threat: Zyra's Grasping Roots root and her plants zone you off farm safely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid walking toward her planted seeds near lane.
- Trading: Bait Grasping Roots with movement, then trade back; dodge her Deadly Spines.
- Post6: Stranglethorns knockup locks you down; use Spell Shield to block the root.
- Spike: First item spike (Liandry's Torment) is dangerous; stay at max range farming.
- Window: Level 9+ when your cooldowns let you kite; ult and chase kills.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; avoid her seed clusters and deny her plant setup angles.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for survivability and sustained trades into her poke.
- Item: Adaptive Helm blocks her plant damage and reduces her ult burst threat.

kogmaw__taliyah.notes:
- Taliyah's Seismic Shove and Unraveled Earth combo locks you down; respect her crowd control.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early poke from Threaded Volley hurts. Farm under tower.
- Dodge Seismic Shove by positioning away from clumps; bait it then trade with Q.
- Weaver's Wall lets her roam aggressively; play safer and spam R for map pressure.
- After Luden's Tempest she deals lethal burst; respect her damage and stay farther back.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Taliyah wastes Seismic Shove; then unload Q and W.
- Slow-push waves to build size; forces her to choose between shoving and roaming.
- Take Aery for poke trading and shield disengage against her burst and crowd control.
- Buy Kaenic Lifeline to survive her combo burst and add tankiness for extended fights.

kogmaw__zed.notes:
- Zed's Death Mark all-in dash combo one-shots you if you're caught alone mid-lane.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; Zed out-trades you early with Razor Shuriken poke.
- Never stand still; dodge Razor Shuriken by moving perpendicular, avoid Walking into Shadow Slash range.
- Post-6 Death Mark forces you into tower or instant death—stay grouped or back off.
- Zed's first item spike (Serrated Dirk) is lethal; respect it and farm safely under tower.
- Punish Zed when Living Shadow is down; land Caustic Spittle combos and kite backward freely.
- Slow-push waves toward your tower; deny him roam windows and force him to stay lane.
- Pick Grasp of the Undying for survivability and poke trading against Zed's all-in threat.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass early to counter Death Mark burst and guarantee survival during his ult.

drmundo__skarner.notes:
- threat: Impale suppresses you immediately; you cannot use Goes Where He Pleases to escape it
- early: Safe farm. Stay behind minions; Skarner's Shattered Earth range is shorter than yours
- trading: Bait Seismic Bastion shield with Infected Bonesaw, then trade with Heart Zapper when shield breaks
- post6: Extremely dangerous. Play closer to tower; Impale + wall slam combo deletes you; respect range
- spike: First Hollow Radiance spike hurts but isn't lethal; use it to farm safely and scale
- window: After Impale cooldown expires and before Skarner rotates; use Maximum Dosage aggressively then
- wave: Slow-push to deny Skarner gank setup angles; stay closer to tower for Impale safety
- rune: Grasp procs after Blunt Force Trauma active; sustain keeps you healthy against poke
- item: Force of Nature gives magic resist and movement speed to kite away from Impale

olaf__rengar.notes:
- Rengar's Thrill of the Hunt camouflage enables all-in burst trades you cannot see coming or escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge brush engages and farm ranged when possible to avoid Unseen Predator.
- Bait Bola Strike with Undertow, then trade back hard; never fight extended when Rengar has Ferocity.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his crowd control, but he still deals massive burst damage post-six.
- Watch his first item spike around 10-12 minutes; play cautious and farm safely until you complete yours.
- Punish Rengar hard when his Thrill of the Hunt is down; force fights during that downtime window.
- Slow-push waves to control minion timing and deny him brush proximity for Unseen Predator leap angles.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain and tankiness to mitigate his burst combo damage patterns.
- Add Kaenic Lifegrip to convert your Attack Speed into healing and reduce his crowd control impact significantly.

shen__kindred.notes:
- Mounting Dread's three-hit combo chunks you hard; avoid repeated attacks on marked targets.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kindred out-damages you early, so farm at range with Q.
- Bait Wolf's Frenzy away from minions, then trade when Wolf is on cooldown.
- Stand United counters Lamb's Respite by shielding allies inside it; coordinate with your team.
- First Kraken Slayer spike is dangerous; respect her damage and play behind minions.
- You spike at Hollow Radiance; her sustained damage drops and you survive longer.
- Slow-push to deny her Hunt marks on minions; group when her marks appear.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains you through her poke and fuels tankiness scaling.
- Kaenic Lifeburst converts her damage into your healing via your shields and W blocks.

shen__briar.notes:
- Briar's Head Rush stun locks you out; her Blood Frenzy pursuit prevents kiting or escape safely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid her all-in range. Farm with Q from distance when possible.
- Bait Head Rush by positioning near minions; use Shadow Dash to dodge and taunt her mid-leap.
- Stand United now shields an ally from her Certain Death initiation; reduces her ult's snowball potential.
- First item spike (likely Stridebreaker or Manamune) strengthens her dueling; respect the damage window, farm safer.
- You spike with Spirit's Refuge active and Echo or Hollow Radiance online; block her key hits.
- Slow-push into her; force her to chase you toward your tower where Shadow Dash setup improves.
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through her poke and strengthens your endurance in extended fights.
- Add Thornmail late to punish her relentless attack-based healing and reduce her overall drain potential.

shen__nami.notes:
- Nami's Aqua Prison stun chains into Ebb and Flow damage; avoid bubble.
- Play safe levels 1-3. Farm with Q from distance, never extend forward.
- Bait Aqua Prison with Shadow Dash positioning, then trade back aggressively.
- Stand United becomes defensive tool only; Nami gains wave control with Tidal Wave.
- Nami's first item spike (Liandry's Torment or similar) hurts; play around cooldowns.
- Level 6+ Shen dominates if Nami wastes Aqua Prison; punish immediately after.
- Slow-push to stack wave; forces Nami closer and sets up Shadow Dash taunts.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into teamfights.
- Build Kaenic Lifeburst to reduce Nami's magic damage output and gain healing utility.

shen__syndra.notes:
- Syndra's Unleashed Power at range one-shots you; respect her ult cooldown always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Dark Sphere, stay out of Scatter the Weak range.
- Bait Scatter the Weak, then Shadow Dash in; Force of Will is her real threat.
- Post-6 you cannot all-in; Unleashed Power outranges Stand United shielding; play around cooldowns.
- First item spike (Luden's Tempest) hurts; respect the damage; farm safely and scale.
- Your window is when her Unleashed Power is down; Shadow Dash engage then immediately.
- Slow-push sideways; prevents Syndra from ulting you near tower; keeps you safer overall.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain through poke and abuse short trades constantly.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip early; reduces her burst and gives you healing to sustain poke.

sivir__fiora.notes:
- Fiora's Vitals and on-hit damage chain combo threatens to out-duel Sivir in extended trades
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Boomerang Blade, avoid Fiora's Lunge engage range
- Bait Riposte with Boomerang Blade, then trade when her parry is down; dodge Lunge
- On The Hunt grants speed to kite Fiora's Grand Challenge; use it to disengage
- Fiora's first item spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; respect her damage and duel threat
- Sivir spikes when enemies group post-15 minutes; On The Hunt enables team kiting of Fiora
- Slow-push waves to avoid Fiora's all-in; maintain distance and reset when Fiora walks up aggressively
- Take Fleet of Foot for sustain and kiting; it synergizes with Sivir's attack-based kit
- Purchase Manamune early for mana sustain and damage scaling without committing to pure defense items

sivir__reksai.notes:
- Rek'Sai's Void Rush gap-close and true damage burst catch Sivir immobilized or out of position easily.
- Play safe behind minions; Rek'Sai Burrow ganks are real threats, so ward river and respect her.
- Bait her Burrow with positioning, then trade hard with Boomerang Blade and Ricochet when unburrowed.
- Void Rush makes her untargetable and lethal; use Spell Shield to block the damage or burst.
- First item spike (Goliath's Stompers or similar) pressures Sivir; farm safely and scale through On The Hunt.
- Sivir dominates mid-game teamfights when On The Hunt and Ricochet fully online; group and punish.
- Slow-push waves to deny Rek'Sai clean Burrow tunnels and force her to respond without ult setup.
- Lethal Tempo gives attack speed for extended trading and kiting away from Void Rush engage attempts.
- Kaenic Rookern reduces her burst and true damage threat while offering survivability in skirmishes.

sivir__qiyana.notes:
- Qiyana's Audacity dash lets her close, burst you down, and escape before you retaliate meaningfully.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in potential with Royal Privilege bonus damage on first trade.
- Bait her Audacity dash with positioning, then use Spell Shield to block her follow-up combo.
- On The Hunt at level 6 lets you kite and duel better; respect her Supreme Display stun.
- Watch for her first item completion; she spikes hard and can all-in you then.
- You outscale mid-game; farm safely and look to group with team after first item.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam value and create gank opportunities for your jungler.
- Take Lethal Tempo to match her dueling pressure and extend your kiting with attack speed.
- Consider Maw of Malmortius as a flex item to block her burst and ult damage.

shen__lissandra.notes:
- Frozen Tomb stun locks you; dodge it or use Shadow Dash to taunt her first.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q range, avoid her Ring of Frost engage range.
- Bait Ring of Frost with Shadow Dash, then trade back with Twilight Assault empowered hit.
- Stand United becomes crucial; shield allies she targets, then teleport to counter-engage or protect.
- Watch for Luden's Tempest spike around 10-12 minutes; respect her damage but maintain trading stance.
- Post-levelup windows: when Shadow Dash cooldown resets or after her Ring of Frost misses.
- Slow-push waves toward her tower; forces her to decide between farming and roaming pressure.
- Take Grasp of the Undying; sustain her poke, proc it with Twilight Assault empowered.
- Consider Kaenic Lifeline in itemization; its magic shield value and heal resist her burst combo.

sivir__karma.notes:
- Karma's Focused Resolve tether roots you; dodge it or Spell Shield it immediately always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Boomerang Blade, avoid her Inner Flame poke.
- Bait Focused Resolve with positioning, then Spell Shield it or move sideways to break tether.
- On The Hunt lets you chase or escape; use it to kite her Mantra combos.
- Her first item spike (Liandry's or Luden's) hurts; respect her damage and stay cautious then.
- Post-itemization, Sivir outscales; On The Hunt cooldown reduction makes you faster and deadlier mid-game.
- Slow-push waves into her; force her to choose between defending turret or roaming with Mantra.
- Take Grasp for consistent trading poke and survivability throughout this middling-threat support matchup.
- Buy Kaenic Lifegrip early if her poke overwhelms you; shields and healing mitigate her burst.
